`crates/pt-core/src/timeline.rs`:

```rs
//! Job timeline reconstruction (PLAN §5).
//!
//! Frames of one (player, game, profile) stream are pushed in plugin order. The
//! timeline follows the game's own history: a save load truncates, restores or
//! gaps the job's *kept* timeline, and reverted material is kept separately and
//! never scored. The whole design rests on the capture findings in PLAN §3:
//!
//! - **Bracket**: everything between two consecutive samples. Loads, deliveries,
//!   config changes and teleports all happen inside one.
//! - **W (world reload)**: `job` and `truck` configs both emptied in one bracket.
//!   All captured in-session loads showed it; accepts, cargo loading, cancels and
//!   ferries never empty `truck`.
//! - **S (session change)**: new plugin session, seq gap or `timer_restart`. It is
//!   a load only together with a discontinuity against the last kept state.
//! - Anything else that jumps is a **teleport**: no distance, no load, no review.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

use crate::config::Config;
use crate::game::Game;
use crate::job::{Delivered, Fingerprint, JobInfo, JobType};
use crate::rules::{evaluate_in, Context, JobResult};
use crate::store::{PointStore, Resolve, TrackId, VecStore};
use crate::trace::{attr, Body, Frame, Sample};
use crate::units::mps_to_mph;

/// Plausible top speed used to tell a data gap from driving (world m/s).
const MAX_PLAUSIBLE_WORLD_MPS: f64 = 100.0;

/// One kept (or reverted) sample of a job.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Point {
    pub sess: u32,
    pub seq: u64,
    pub wall_ms: i64,
    /// Paused simulation time (µs); only comparable within one run.
    pub sim_us: u64,
    /// Run id: distance and overspeed only accumulate between neighbours of the
    /// same run. A new run starts at every load, gap, session change, truck change
    /// and teleport.
    pub run: u32,
    pub speed_mps: f64,
    pub odometer_km: Option<f64>,
    pub fuel_l: Option<f64>,
    pub pos: Option<[f64; 3]>,
    pub game_time_min: Option<u32>,
    /// `local.scale` (1 when the game does not provide it: a 1:1 map).
    pub local_scale: f64,
    pub cargo_loaded: bool,
    pub trailer_connected: bool,
    pub truck: u32,
    pub mp_time_offset: i64,
    pub truckersmp: bool,
    /// The `[[multiplayer.mods]]` kind loaded in this session, if any.
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub mp_mod: Option<String>,
    /// First point after a teleport (ferry, train, F7): overspeed episodes end
    /// here, but distance carries on (the odometer does not move on a teleport).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub after_teleport: bool,
    /// Cargo damage 0-1 when the game reports it (job graphs only).
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub cargo_damage: Option<f64>,
}

impl Point {
    pub fn mph(&self) -> f64 {
        mps_to_mph(self.speed_mps.abs())
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum JobState {
    Tracking,
    Suspended,
    Delivered,
    Cancelled,
    /// A save of this already-delivered job was loaded; nothing is recorded.
    Stopped,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum StartKind {
    Tracked,
    LateStart,
}

/// A stretch of a job that a save load undid. Never scored unless a later
/// load returns to it ("revert, then restore"). `P` holds the points: a
/// `Vec<Point>` for a finished job, a [`TrackId`] on a live timeline.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Branch<P = Vec<Point>> {
    /// Seq of the kept point this branch forked from.
    pub fork_seq: u64,
    pub points: P,
    pub reverted_at_wall_ms: i64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum GapKind {
    /// A forward load to a point never seen: goes to review.
    Load,
    /// Missing samples (client closed, game restarted) with plausible driving in
    /// between: the distance counts and nothing is reviewed.
    Bridge,
}

/// Distance between two kept points that are not neighbours on one run.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Gap {
    pub kind: GapKind,
    pub from_seq: u64,
    pub to_sess: u32,
    pub to_seq: u64,
    /// Odometer difference when both ends are the same truck (game km).
    pub game_km: Option<f64>,
    pub local_scale: f64,
    pub counted: bool,
    pub duration_s: f64,
    pub wall_ms: i64,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "kind", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum JobEvent {
    Started { start: StartKind, wall_ms: i64 },
    /// A load truncated the kept timeline back to `to_seq`.
    LoadTruncate { to_seq: u64, reverted_points: usize, wall_ms: i64 },
    /// A load returned into previously reverted material, which is restored.
    LoadRestore { from_fork_seq: u64, restored_points: usize, wall_ms: i64 },
    LoadGap { game_km: Option<f64>, wall_ms: i64 },
    /// A session change with no discontinuity: the job simply continues.
    SessionContinue { wall_ms: i64 },
    Teleport {
        world_m: f64,
        ferry_or_train: bool,
        /// `ferry` or `train` when the game said which.
        #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
        via: Option<String>,
        wall_ms: i64,
    },
    Suspended { wall_ms: i64 },
    Resumed { wall_ms: i64 },
    CargoLoaded { wall_ms: i64 },
    CargoSwitch { from: Box<crate::job::CargoKey>, to: Box<crate::job::CargoKey>, wall_ms: i64 },
    TruckChange { wall_ms: i64 },
    Delivered { wall_ms: i64 },
    Cancelled { penalty: Option<i64>, wall_ms: i64 },
    CancellationReverted { wall_ms: i64 },
    /// A load reopened a delivery that had been Invalid (falling under the map).
    InvalidDeliveryReopened { wall_ms: i64 },
    /// A save of this delivered job was loaded; tracking stopped.
    StoppedAfterDelivery { wall_ms: i64 },
    /// The job was delivered again from an old save: ignored.
    DuplicateDelivery { wall_ms: i64 },
}

/// A job. `P` holds its points: `Vec<Point>` (the default) for a finished or
/// stored job, a [`TrackId`] into the timeline's [`PointStore`] while live.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Job<P = Vec<Point>> {
    pub id: u32,
    pub game: Game,
    pub profile: String,
    /// Latest job config.
    pub info: JobInfo,
    /// The config the job was first tracked with (bonus basis after a cargo switch).
    pub first_info: JobInfo,
    pub state: JobState,
    pub start: StartKind,
    pub kept: P,
    pub reverted: Vec<Branch<P>>,
    pub gaps: Vec<Gap>,
    pub events: Vec<JobEvent>,
    pub cargo_switched: bool,
    pub delivered: Option<Delivered>,
    pub delivered_wall_ms: Option<i64>,
    /// Deliveries undone by a load (Invalid deliveries reopened).
    pub reverted_deliveries: Vec<Delivered>,
    /// The points before `kept[0]` live only on the server's disk (owner,
    /// 2026-10-16: finished jobs are not held in memory). `kept` keeps the
    /// last point, so a job brought back by a load continues from it with a gap.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub offloaded: bool,
    /// The delivery was over the invalid speed when it was offloaded, so a load
    /// into it reopens it (its points are no longer here to tell).
    #[serde(default)]
    pub offloaded_invalid: bool,
}

impl Job {
    /// Gaps whose far end is still on the kept timeline. A later load back past
    /// a gap reverts it together with everything after it.
    pub fn active_gaps(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &Gap> {
        self.gaps.iter().filter(|g| self.kept.iter().any(|p| p.sess == g.to_sess && p.seq == g.to_seq))
    }
}

impl<P> Job<P> {
    /// [`Job::active_gaps`] for points held anywhere, in one pass over them.
    pub fn active_gaps_in<R: Resolve<P> + ?Sized>(&self, r: &R) -> Vec<&Gap> {
        if self.gaps.is_empty() {
            return Vec::new();
        }
        let mut found = vec![false; self.gaps.len()];
        for p in r.iter(&self.kept) {
            for (k, g) in self.gaps.iter().enumerate() {
                if p.sess == g.to_sess && p.seq == g.to_seq {
                    found[k] = true;
                }
            }
        }
        self.gaps.iter().zip(found).filter(|(_, f)| *f).map(|(g, _)| g).collect()
    }

    /// The same job with its points held some other way.
    pub fn with_points<Q>(&self, kept: Q, reverted: Vec<Branch<Q>>) -> Job<Q> {
        Job {
            id: self.id,
            game: self.game,
            profile: self.profile.clone(),
            info: self.info.clone(),
            first_info: self.first_info.clone(),
            state: self.state,
            start: self.start,
            kept,
            reverted,
            gaps: self.gaps.clone(),
            events: self.events.clone(),
            cargo_switched: self.cargo_switched,
            delivered: self.delivered.clone(),
            delivered_wall_ms: self.delivered_wall_ms,
            reverted_deliveries: self.reverted_deliveries.clone(),
            offloaded: self.offloaded,
            offloaded_invalid: self.offloaded_invalid,
        }
    }
}

impl Job<TrackId> {
    /// The job with all its points in memory.
    pub fn materialize<S: PointStore + ?Sized>(&self, store: &S) -> Job {
        let reverted = self
            .reverted
            .iter()
            .map(|b| Branch { fork_seq: b.fork_seq, points: store.to_vec(b.points), reverted_at_wall_ms: b.reverted_at_wall_ms })
            .collect();
        self.with_points(store.to_vec(self.kept), reverted)
    }

    /// Kept points, and reverted points over all branches.
    pub fn point_counts<S: PointStore + ?Sized>(&self, store: &S) -> (usize, usize) {
        (store.len(self.kept), self.reverted.iter().map(|b| store.len(b.points)).sum())
    }

    /// Frees the job's tracks in `store`.
    fn release<S: PointStore + ?Sized>(&self, store: &mut S) {
        store.remove(self.kept);
        for b in &self.reverted {
            store.remove(b.points);
        }
    }
}

/// Streaming notices for the client (provisional; the server re-derives all).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(tag = "kind", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum Notice {
    JobStarted { job: u32 },
    JobDelivered { job: u32 },
    JobCancelled { job: u32 },
    /// Rule 5's speed penalty became active on the kept timeline.
    PenaltyActivated { job: u32, wall_ms: i64 },
}

#[derive(Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(default)]
struct Bracket {
    /// New plugin session or a seq gap: the plugin re-sends empty configs at
    /// init, so W is not evidence here; only a discontinuity is.
    session_change: bool,
    timer_restart: bool,
    job_emptied: bool,
    truck_emptied: bool,
    truck_changed: bool,
    transfer: bool,
    /// `ferry` or `train`, from the gameplay event.
    transfer_kind: Option<String>,
    /// The game sent a truck while no job was set: the state it is in (after a
    /// load, a cancel or a delivery) has no job.
    no_job_state: bool,
    /// A job config arrived after that: the job was accepted in this bracket,
    /// so its start was seen (quick job taken right after loading, 2026-10-13).
    job_after_no_job: bool,
}

/// Streaming overspeed state for the penalty notification.
#[derive(Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct OverspeedWatch {
    run: u32,
    since_us: Option<u64>,
    notified: bool,
}

/// The state is serialisable so the server can snapshot it between batches
/// (PLAN §7a); a restored timeline continues exactly like the original.
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Timeline {
    cfg: Config,
    profile: String,
    game: Option<Game>,
    jobs: Vec<Job<TrackId>>,
    current: Option<usize>,
    sess_ids: Vec<String>,
    sess: Option<u32>,
    last_seq: u64,
    bracket: Bracket,
    /// The current job: freight, else a road trip.
    job_cfg: Option<JobInfo>,
    #[serde(default)]
    freight_cfg: Option<JobInfo>,
    #[serde(default)]
    car_cfg: Option<JobInfo>,
    truck_ids: Vec<String>,
    truck: u32,
    /// Loaded-module heuristic (fallback for plugins without the TruckersMP SDK side).
    truckersmp_module: bool,
    /// TruckersMP SDK state, once reported in this session.
    truckersmp_sdk: Option<bool>,
    truckersmp: bool,
    /// A `[[multiplayer.mods]]` kind seen in this session's module lists.
    #[serde(default)]
    mp_mod: Option<String>,
    last: Option<Point>,
    next_run: u32,
    watch: Vec<OverspeedWatch>,
    notices: Vec<Notice>,
    /// Next job id. Ids stay unique when old jobs are evicted.
    next_id: u32,
    /// Jobs that left the live timeline (`reopen_window_wall_h`), not yet taken.
    evicted: Vec<Job<TrackId>>,
}

impl Timeline {
    pub fn new(cfg: Config, profile: impl Into<String>) -> Timeline {
        Timeline {
            cfg,
            profile: profile.into(),
            game: None,
            jobs: Vec::new(),
            current: None,
            sess_ids: Vec::new(),
            sess: None,
            last_seq: 0,
            bracket: Bracket::default(),
            job_cfg: None,
            freight_cfg: None,
            car_cfg: None,
            truck_ids: Vec::new(),
            truck: 0,
            truckersmp_module: false,
            truckersmp_sdk: None,
            truckersmp: false,
            mp_mod: None,
            last: None,
            next_run: 0,
            watch: Vec::new(),
            notices: Vec::new(),
            next_id: 0,
            evicted: Vec::new(),
        }
    }

    pub fn jobs(&self) -> &[Job<TrackId>] {
        &self.jobs
    }

    /// Every job, evicted ones included, in creation order.
    fn into_jobs(self) -> Vec<Job<TrackId>> {
        let mut jobs = self.evicted;
        jobs.extend(self.jobs);
        jobs.sort_by_key(|j| j.id);
        jobs
    }

    /// Jobs evicted since the last call (PLAN §7a). They never change again.
    fn take_evicted(&mut self) -> Vec<Job<TrackId>> {
        std::mem::take(&mut self.evicted)
    }

    /// Drops jobs that ended more than `reopen_window_wall_h` before `now_wall`
    /// (a frame's wall clock, so a full replay evicts exactly the same jobs).
    /// Delivered, cancelled and stopped jobs end at their last event; a suspended
    /// job counts as abandoned after the same time. The current job always stays.
    fn evict_finished(&mut self, now_wall: i64) {
        let window_ms = (self.cfg.timeline.reopen_window_wall_h * 3_600_000.0) as i64;
        let mut k = self.jobs.len();
        while k > 0 {
            k -= 1;
            let job = &self.jobs[k];
            let ended = matches!(
                job.state,
                JobState::Delivered | JobState::Cancelled | JobState::Stopped | JobState::Suspended
            );
            let last = job.events.last().map(event_wall).unwrap_or(0);
            if self.current == Some(k) || !ended || now_wall - last <= window_ms {
                continue;
            }
            self.evicted.push(self.jobs.remove(k));
            self.watch.remove(k);
            if let Some(c) = self.current {
                if c > k {
                    self.current = Some(c - 1);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn game(&self) -> Option<Game> {
        self.game
    }

    /// Takes the notices produced since the last call.
    pub fn take_notices(&mut self) -> Vec<Notice> {
        std::mem::take(&mut self.notices)
    }

    /// Marks the next sample as following a session change (used when frames
    /// were routed elsewhere in between, e.g. another profile was active).
    pub fn mark_session_change(&mut self) {
        self.bracket.session_change = true;
    }

    pub fn push<S: PointStore + ?Sized>(&mut self, f: &Frame, store: &mut S) {
        let sess = match self.sess_ids.iter().position(|s| *s == f.sess) {
            Some(i) => i as u32,
            None => {
                self.sess_ids.push(f.sess.clone());
                (self.sess_ids.len() - 1) as u32
            }
        };
        if self.sess != Some(sess) {
            self.bracket.session_change = true;
            self.truckersmp_module = false;
            self.truckersmp_sdk = None;
            self.truckersmp = false;
            self.mp_mod = None;
            self.sess = Some(sess);
        } else if f.seq > 0 && f.seq != self.last_seq + 1 && f.seq > self.last_seq {
            // Frames missing inside one session: a data gap.
            self.bracket.session_change = true;
        }
        if f.seq > 0 {
            self.last_seq = f.seq;
        }
        match &f.body {
            Body::Init { game, .. } => {
                if game.is_some() {
                    self.game = *game;
                }
                if f.wall_ms > 0 {
                    self.evict_finished(f.wall_ms);
                }
                self.bracket.session_change = true;
            }
            Body::TimerRestart => self.bracket.timer_restart = true,
            Body::Config { id, attrs } if JobType::from_config_id(id).is_some() => {
                let Some(game) = self.game else { return };
                let job_type = JobType::from_config_id(id).expect("matched");
                let info = JobInfo::from_config_of(game, job_type, attrs);
                match job_type {
                    JobType::Freight => self.freight_cfg = info,
                    JobType::Car => self.car_cfg = info,
                }
                self.job_cfg = self.freight_cfg.clone().or_else(|| self.car_cfg.clone());
                if self.job_cfg.is_none() {
                    self.bracket.job_emptied = true;
                } else if !attrs.is_empty() && self.bracket.no_job_state {
                    self.bracket.job_after_no_job = true;
                }
            }
            Body::Config { id, attrs } if id == "truck" => {
                if attrs.is_empty() {
                    self.bracket.truck_emptied = true;
                    // Another load starts: whatever it brings is not known yet.
                    self.bracket.no_job_state = false;
                    self.bracket.job_after_no_job = false;
                } else {
                    if self.job_cfg.is_none() {
                        self.bracket.no_job_state = true;
                    }
                    let tid = attr(attrs, "id").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or_default().to_string();
                    let idx = match self.truck_ids.iter().position(|t| *t == tid) {
                        Some(i) => i,
                        None => {
                            self.truck_ids.push(tid);
                            self.truck_ids.len() - 1
                        }
                    } as u32;
                    if !self.truck_ids.is_empty() && idx != self.truck && self.last.is_some() {
                        self.bracket.truck_changed = true;
                    }
                    self.truck = idx;
                }
            }
            Body::Gameplay { id, attrs } => match id.as_str() {
                // Applied at once: the job config may already be empty, and the game can
                // stop before another sample arrives (captured deliveries). Both belong
                // to the job that was current (PLAN §5).
                "job.delivered" => self.deliver(Delivered::from_attrs(attrs), f.wall_ms),
                "car_job.delivered" => {
                    if self.current.is_none() {
                        self.resume_lost_road_trip(f.wall_ms, store);
                    }
                    self.deliver(Delivered::from_attrs(attrs), f.wall_ms)
                }
                "job.cancelled" | "car_job.cancelled" => {
                    self.cancel(attr(attrs, "cancel.penalty").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()), f.wall_ms)
                }
                "player.use.ferry" | "player.use.train" => {
                    self.bracket.transfer = true;
                    self.bracket.transfer_kind = id.strip_prefix("player.use.").map(str::to_string);
                }
                _ => {}
            },
            Body::Modules { truckersmp, mods } => {
                self.truckersmp_module |= *truckersmp;
                if self.mp_mod.is_none() {
                    self.mp_mod = mods.first().cloned();
                }
                self.truckersmp = self.truckersmp_sdk.unwrap_or(self.truckersmp_module);
            }
            Body::Truckersmp { connected, .. } => {
                self.truckersmp_sdk = Some(*connected);
                self.truckersmp = *connected;
            }
            Body::Sample(s) => self.on_sample(sess, f, s, store),
            _ => {}
        }
    }

    fn make_point(&self, sess: u32, f: &Frame, s: &Sample) -> Point {
        Point {
            sess,
            seq: f.seq,
            wall_ms: f.wall_ms,
            sim_us: f.sim_us.unwrap_or(0),
            run: self.next_run,
            speed_mps: s.speed_mps.unwrap_or(0.0),
            odometer_km: s.odometer_km,
            fuel_l: s.fuel_l,
            pos: s.pos,
            game_time_min: s.game_time_min,
            local_scale: s.local_scale.filter(|v| *v > 0.0).unwrap_or(1.0),
            cargo_loaded: self.job_cfg.as_ref().is_some_and(|j| j.cargo_loaded),
            trailer_connected: s.trailer_connected.unwrap_or(true),
            truck: self.truck,
            mp_time_offset: s.mp_time_offset.unwrap_or(0),
            truckersmp: self.truckersmp,
            mp_mod: self.mp_mod.clone(),
            after_teleport: false,
            cargo_damage: s.cargo_damage,
        }
    }

    fn new_run(&mut self) -> u32 {
        self.next_run += 1;
        self.next_run
    }

    fn on_sample<S: PointStore + ?Sized>(&mut self, sess: u32, f: &Frame, s: &Sample, store: &mut S) {
        let bracket = std::mem::take(&mut self.bracket);
        let mut p = self.make_point(sess, f, s);
        let prev = self.last.clone();
        let wall = f.wall_ms;
        let teleport_min = self.cfg.timeline.teleport_min_distance_world_m;

        // Classify the bracket.
        // W only within a running session (at init every config starts out empty).
        // A profile switch or main-menu load keeps the session: W plus timer_restart.
        let world_reload = bracket.job_emptied && bracket.truck_emptied && !bracket.session_change;
        let session = bracket.session_change || bracket.timer_restart;
        // Position jump beyond what driving could cover in the elapsed simulation
        // time (samples can go missing while the truck keeps driving).
        let jump_m = match (&prev, p.pos) {
            (Some(a), Some(b)) => a.pos.map(|a| dist3(a, b)).unwrap_or(0.0),
            _ => 0.0,
        };
        let drivable_m = prev.as_ref().map_or(0.0, |a| {
            let dt = if a.sess == p.sess { p.sim_us.saturating_sub(a.sim_us) as f64 / 1e6 } else { 0.0 };
            dt * MAX_PLAUSIBLE_WORLD_MPS
        });
        let jump_m = if jump_m > drivable_m { jump_m } else { 0.0 };
        let disc = prev.as_ref().is_some_and(|a| self.discontinuity(a, &p, jump_m));
        let is_load = world_reload || (session && disc);

        // A stopped (already-delivered) job ignores everything until the job changes.
        if let Some(i) = self.current {
            if self.jobs[i].state == JobState::Stopped
                && self.job_cfg.as_ref().map(|j| &j.fingerprint) != Some(&self.jobs[i].info.fingerprint)
            {
                self.current = None;
            }
        }

        if is_load {
            p.run = self.new_run();
            self.on_load(&mut p, session, bracket.job_after_no_job, wall, store);
        } else {
            let teleport = jump_m >= teleport_min;
            if session || bracket.truck_changed {
                p.run = self.new_run();
            }
            p.after_teleport = teleport;
            self.on_continuous(&p, prev.as_ref(), &bracket, session, teleport, jump_m, wall, store);
        }

        // Record the point on the current job.
        if let Some(i) = self.current {
            if self.jobs[i].state == JobState::Tracking {
                p.cargo_loaded = self.jobs[i].info.cargo_loaded;
                store.push(self.jobs[i].kept, p.clone());
                self.watch_overspeed(i, &p);
            }
        }
        self.last = Some(p);
    }

    /// Would `b` be impossible to reach from `a` by driving?
    fn discontinuity(&self, a: &Point, b: &Point, jump_m: f64) -> bool {
        let t = &self.cfg.timeline;
        let eps = self.cfg.rules.distance.odometer_epsilon_km;
        if jump_m >= t.teleport_min_distance_world_m {
            return true;
        }
        if a.truck != b.truck {
            return jump_m > t.match_position_tolerance_world_m;
        }
        if let (Some(x), Some(y)) = (a.odometer_km, b.odometer_km) {
            let dt = b.sim_us.saturating_sub(a.sim_us) as f64 / 1e6;
            let max_km = dt * MAX_PLAUSIBLE_WORLD_MPS * b.local_scale.max(a.local_scale) / 1000.0;
            if y < x - eps || y > x + max_km + eps {
                return true;
            }
        }
        if let (Some(x), Some(y)) = (a.fuel_l, b.fuel_l) {
            if (y - x).abs() > t.match_fuel_tolerance_l && jump_m > t.match_position_tolerance_world_m {
                return true;
            }
        }
        false
    }

    fn find_job(&self, fp: &Fingerprint) -> Option<usize> {
        // Route key identifies the job; a different cargo key is a cargo switch.
        self.jobs.iter().rposition(|j| j.info.fingerprint.route == fp.route)
    }

    fn start_job<S: PointStore + ?Sized>(&mut self, info: JobInfo, start: StartKind, wall: i64, store: &mut S) -> usize {
        let id = self.next_id;
        self.next_id += 1;
        self.jobs.push(Job {
            id,
            game: info.fingerprint.route.game,
            profile: self.profile.clone(),
            first_info: info.clone(),
            info,
            state: JobState::Tracking,
            start,
            kept: store.create(),
            reverted: Vec::new(),
            gaps: Vec::new(),
            events: vec![JobEvent::Started { start, wall_ms: wall }],
            cargo_switched: false,
            delivered: None,
            delivered_wall_ms: None,
            reverted_deliveries: Vec::new(),
            offloaded: false,
            offloaded_invalid: false,
        });
        self.watch.push(OverspeedWatch::default());
        self.notices.push(Notice::JobStarted { job: id });
        self.jobs.len() - 1
    }

    fn suspend_current(&mut self, wall: i64) {
        if let Some(i) = self.current.take() {
            if self.jobs[i].state == JobState::Tracking {
                self.jobs[i].state = JobState::Suspended;
                self.jobs[i].events.push(JobEvent::Suspended { wall_ms: wall });
            }
        }
    }

    fn cancel(&mut self, penalty: Option<i64>, wall: i64) {
        if let Some(i) = self.current.take() {
            if self.jobs[i].state == JobState::Tracking {
                self.jobs[i].state = JobState::Cancelled;
                self.jobs[i].events.push(JobEvent::Cancelled { penalty, wall_ms: wall });
                self.notices.push(Notice::JobCancelled { job: self.jobs[i].id });
            }
        }
    }

    fn deliver(&mut self, d: Delivered, wall: i64) {
        let Some(i) = self.current else { return };
        let job = &mut self.jobs[i];
        match job.state {
            JobState::Tracking => {
                job.state = JobState::Delivered;
                job.delivered = Some(d);
                job.delivered_wall_ms = Some(wall);
                job.events.push(JobEvent::Delivered { wall_ms: wall });
                self.notices.push(Notice::JobDelivered { job: job.id });
            }
            JobState::Stopped => job.events.push(JobEvent::DuplicateDelivery { wall_ms: wall }),
            _ => {}
        }
        self.current = None;
    }

    /// The game can drop a road trip's config at a load and never send it
    /// again, then still deliver the trip (the owner's ATS road trip,
    /// 2026-10-16: three loads, the config back after the first only). The
    /// delivery belongs to the road trip suspended at that load, if nothing
    /// has replaced it: it resumes, and the stretch it was not tracked becomes
    /// a gap from its last point, so the job goes to review instead of being lost.
    fn resume_lost_road_trip<S: PointStore + ?Sized>(&mut self, wall: i64, store: &mut S) {
        let Some(k) = self.jobs.len().checked_sub(1) else { return };
        let job = &self.jobs[k];
        if job.state != JobState::Suspended || job.info.fingerprint.route.job_type != JobType::Car || self.job_cfg.is_some() {
            return;
        }
        let Some(mut p) = self.last.clone() else { return };
        p.cargo_loaded = job.info.cargo_loaded;
        let since = store.last(job.kept).map(|q| q.wall_ms);
        self.jobs[k].state = JobState::Tracking;
        self.jobs[k].events.push(JobEvent::Resumed { wall_ms: wall });
        self.current = Some(k);
        self.rebase(k, &p, false, wall, store);
        // The stretch always counts as a gap: after loads its distance can be
        // near zero and the simulation clock restarts, so time it by the PC clock.
        let job = &mut self.jobs[k];
        if let (Some(g), Some(since)) = (job.gaps.last_mut(), since) {
            if g.to_seq == p.seq && g.to_sess == p.sess {
                g.duration_s = g.duration_s.max((p.wall_ms - since).max(0) as f64 / 1000.0);
            }
        }
        store.push(job.kept, p);
    }

    /// Applies a config (cargo loaded, cargo switch) to a job about to track.
    fn apply_config(&mut self, i: usize, info: &JobInfo, wall: i64) {
        let job = &mut self.jobs[i];
        if job.info.fingerprint.cargo != info.fingerprint.cargo {
            job.cargo_switched = true;
            job.events.push(JobEvent::CargoSwitch {
                from: Box::new(job.info.fingerprint.cargo.clone()),
                to: Box::new(info.fingerprint.cargo.clone()),
                wall_ms: wall,
            });
        }
        if info.cargo_loaded && !job.info.cargo_loaded {
            job.events.push(JobEvent::CargoLoaded { wall_ms: wall });
        }
        job.info = info.clone();
    }

    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    fn on_continuous<S: PointStore + ?Sized>(
        &mut self,
        p: &Point,
        prev: Option<&Point>,
        b: &Bracket,
        session: bool,
        teleport: bool,
        jump_m: f64,
        wall: i64,
        store: &mut S,
    ) {
        let cfg = self.job_cfg.clone();
        if teleport {
            if let Some(i) = self.current {
                self.jobs[i].events.push(JobEvent::Teleport {
                    world_m: jump_m,
                    ferry_or_train: b.transfer,
                    via: b.transfer_kind.clone(),
                    wall_ms: wall,
                });
            }
        }
        if b.truck_changed {
            if let Some(i) = self.current {
                self.jobs[i].events.push(JobEvent::TruckChange { wall_ms: wall });
            }
        }
        match (self.current, cfg) {
            (Some(i), Some(info)) if self.jobs[i].info.fingerprint.route == info.fingerprint.route => {
                if session && self.jobs[i].state == JobState::Tracking {
                    self.jobs[i].events.push(JobEvent::SessionContinue { wall_ms: wall });
                    self.bridge(i, p, wall, store);
                }
                if self.jobs[i].state == JobState::Tracking {
                    self.apply_config(i, &info, wall);
                }
            }
            (Some(_), Some(info)) => {
                // A different job without a load or an end event.
                self.suspend_current(wall);
                self.begin(info, (session || prev.is_none()) && !b.job_after_no_job, wall, store);
            }
            (Some(_), None) => self.suspend_current(wall),
            (None, Some(info)) => self.begin(info, (session || prev.is_none()) && !b.job_after_no_job, wall, store),
            (None, None) => {}
        }
    }

    /// Samples went missing but the truck plainly kept driving: count the distance.
    fn bridge<S: PointStore + ?Sized>(&mut self, i: usize, p: &Point, wall: i64, store: &S) {
        let job = &mut self.jobs[i];
        let Some(last) = store.last(job.kept) else { return };
        if last.truck != p.truck {
            return;
        }
        if let (Some(a), Some(b)) = (last.odometer_km, p.odometer_km) {
            if b - a > 0.0 {
                job.gaps.push(Gap {
                    kind: GapKind::Bridge,
                    from_seq: last.seq,
                    to_sess: p.sess,
                    to_seq: p.seq,
                    game_km: Some(b - a),
                    local_scale: p.local_scale,
                    counted: p.cargo_loaded && p.trailer_connected,
                    duration_s: 0.0,
                    wall_ms: wall,
                });
            }
        }
    }

    /// A job config with no current job and no load: a known job returning, or
    /// a new one (tracked if accepted in continuous data, late start otherwise).
    fn begin<S: PointStore + ?Sized>(&mut self, info: JobInfo, first_seen_after_session: bool, wall: i64, store: &mut S) {
        if let Some(k) = self.find_job(&info.fingerprint) {
            match self.jobs[k].state {
                JobState::Suspended | JobState::Tracking => {
                    self.jobs[k].state = JobState::Tracking;
                    self.jobs[k].events.push(JobEvent::Resumed { wall_ms: wall });
                    self.apply_config(k, &info, wall);
                    self.current = Some(k);
                    return;
                }
                JobState::Delivered | JobState::Stopped | JobState::Cancelled => {}
            }
        }
        let kind = if first_seen_after_session { StartKind::LateStart } else { StartKind::Tracked };
        self.current = Some(self.start_job(info, kind, wall, store));
    }

    /// `accepted_here`: the job appeared after the loaded state had none, so it
    /// was accepted after the load and its start was seen.
    fn on_load<S: PointStore + ?Sized>(&mut self, p: &mut Point, session: bool, accepted_here: bool, wall: i64, store: &mut S) {
        let before = self.current;
        let Some(info) = self.job_cfg.clone() else {
            self.suspend_current(wall);
            return;
        };
        let Some(k) = self.find_job(&info.fingerprint) else {
            self.suspend_current(wall);
            let kind = if accepted_here { StartKind::Tracked } else { StartKind::LateStart };
            self.current = Some(self.start_job(info, kind, wall, store));
            return;
        };
        if before != Some(k) {
            self.suspend_current(wall);
        }
        match self.jobs[k].state {
            JobState::Delivered => {
                let job = &self.jobs[k];
                let invalid = job.offloaded_invalid
                    || (!job.offloaded && evaluate_in(job, store, &self.cfg, &Default::default()).speed.invalid);
                if invalid {
                    let job = &mut self.jobs[k];
                    if let Some(d) = job.delivered.take() {
                        job.reverted_deliveries.push(d);
                    }
                    job.delivered_wall_ms = None;
                    job.events.push(JobEvent::InvalidDeliveryReopened { wall_ms: wall });
                } else {
                    self.jobs[k].state = JobState::Stopped;
                    self.jobs[k].events.push(JobEvent::StoppedAfterDelivery { wall_ms: wall });
                    self.current = Some(k);
                    return;
                }
            }
            JobState::Stopped => {
                self.current = Some(k);
                return;
            }
            JobState::Cancelled => {
                self.jobs[k].events.push(JobEvent::CancellationReverted { wall_ms: wall })
            }
            JobState::Suspended | JobState::Tracking => {}
        }
        self.jobs[k].state = JobState::Tracking;
        if before != Some(k) {
            self.jobs[k].events.push(JobEvent::Resumed { wall_ms: wall });
        }
        self.apply_config(k, &info, wall);
        p.cargo_loaded = self.jobs[k].info.cargo_loaded;
        self.current = Some(k);
        self.rebase(k, p, session, wall, store);
    }

    /// Places the loaded point `p` on job `k`'s kept timeline (PLAN §5 rows).
    fn rebase<S: PointStore + ?Sized>(&mut self, k: usize, p: &Point, session: bool, wall: i64, store: &mut S) {
        let _ = session;
        if let Some(idx) = self.match_in(self.jobs[k].kept, p, store) {
            let job = &mut self.jobs[k];
            let tail = store.split_off(job.kept, idx + 1);
            let n = store.len(tail);
            let to_seq = store.get(job.kept, idx).expect("matched point").seq;
            if n > 0 {
                job.reverted.push(Branch { fork_seq: to_seq, points: tail, reverted_at_wall_ms: wall });
            } else {
                store.remove(tail);
            }
            job.events.push(JobEvent::LoadTruncate { to_seq, reverted_points: n, wall_ms: wall });
            self.watch[k] = OverspeedWatch { notified: self.watch[k].notified, ..Default::default() };
            return;
        }
        // Previously reverted material: restore it (closes "revert, then restore").
        let mut found = None;
        for (bi, br) in self.jobs[k].reverted.iter().enumerate().rev() {
            if let Some(j) = self.match_in(br.points, p, store) {
                let fork_seq = br.fork_seq;
                if store.position(self.jobs[k].kept, &|q| q.seq == fork_seq).is_some() {
                    found = Some((bi, j));
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if let Some((bi, j)) = found {
            let job = &mut self.jobs[k];
            let br = job.reverted.remove(bi);
            let fork = store.position(job.kept, &|q| q.seq == br.fork_seq).expect("checked above");
            let tail = store.split_off(job.kept, fork + 1);
            if !store.is_empty(tail) {
                job.reverted.push(Branch { fork_seq: br.fork_seq, points: tail, reverted_at_wall_ms: wall });
            } else {
                store.remove(tail);
            }
            // br.points[..=j] go back on the kept timeline, the rest stays reverted.
            let rest_fork_seq = store.get(br.points, j).expect("matched point").seq;
            let rest = store.split_off(br.points, j + 1);
            let n = j + 1;
            store.append(job.kept, br.points);
            if !store.is_empty(rest) {
                job.reverted.push(Branch { fork_seq: rest_fork_seq, points: rest, reverted_at_wall_ms: wall });
            } else {
                store.remove(rest);
            }
            job.events.push(JobEvent::LoadRestore { from_fork_seq: br.fork_seq, restored_points: n, wall_ms: wall });
            return;
        }
        // Beyond anything seen: a gap from the last kept point.
        let job = &mut self.jobs[k];
        if let Some(last) = store.last(job.kept) {
            let game_km = match (last.odometer_km, p.odometer_km) {
                (Some(a), Some(b)) if last.truck == p.truck => Some(b - a),
                _ => None,
            };
            let duration_s = p.sim_us.saturating_sub(last.sim_us) as f64 / 1e6;
            job.gaps.push(Gap {
                kind: GapKind::Load,
                from_seq: last.seq,
                to_sess: p.sess,
                to_seq: p.seq,
                game_km,
                local_scale: p.local_scale,
                counted: p.cargo_loaded && p.trailer_connected,
                duration_s,
                wall_ms: wall,
            });
            job.events.push(JobEvent::LoadGap { game_km, wall_ms: wall });
        }
    }

    /// Index of the point in track `pts` that `p` was loaded from, if any.
    fn match_in<S: PointStore + ?Sized>(&self, pts: TrackId, p: &Point, store: &S) -> Option<usize> {
        let t = &self.cfg.timeline;
        let p_pos = p.pos?;
        // A server clock (TruckersMP, some mods) does not roll back with a save.
        let server_clock = p.truckersmp || self.cfg.multiplayer.mod_clock(p.mp_mod.as_deref()).is_some();
        let mut best: Option<(usize, f64)> = None;
        for (i, q) in store.near(pts, p_pos, t.match_position_tolerance_world_m) {
            let Some(q_pos) = q.pos else { continue };
            let d = dist3(q_pos, p_pos);
            if d > t.match_position_tolerance_world_m {
                continue;
            }
            if q.truck == p.truck {
                if let (Some(a), Some(b)) = (q.fuel_l, p.fuel_l) {
                    if (a - b).abs() > t.match_fuel_tolerance_l {
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                if let (Some(a), Some(b)) = (q.odometer_km, p.odometer_km) {
                    // Position already pins the place; the odometer tells repeat visits apart.
                    if (a - b).abs() > 1.0 {
                        continue;
                    }
                }
            }
            if !server_clock {
                if let (Some(a), Some(b)) = (q.game_time_min, p.game_time_min) {
                    if a.abs_diff(b) > t.match_game_time_tolerance_min_game {
                        continue;
                    }
                }
            }
            // Closest match; later points win ties (the most recent visit).
            match best {
                Some((_, bd)) if d > bd => {}
                _ => best = Some((i, d)),
            }
        }
        best.map(|(i, _)| i)
    }

    fn watch_overspeed(&mut self, i: usize, p: &Point) {
        let Some(game) = self.game else { return };
        let (penalty_mph, _) = self.cfg.rules.speed.limits_for(game, self.jobs[i].info.fingerprint.route.job_type);
        let window_us = (self.cfg.rules.speed.sustained_window_s * 1e6) as u64;
        let prec = self.cfg.rules.speed.compare_precision_mph;
        let w = &mut self.watch[i];
        if w.run != p.run || p.after_teleport {
            w.run = p.run;
            w.since_us = None;
        }
        if crate::units::exceeds(p.mph(), penalty_mph, prec) {
            let since = *w.since_us.get_or_insert(p.sim_us);
            if !w.notified && p.sim_us.saturating_sub(since) > window_us {
                w.notified = true;
                self.notices.push(Notice::PenaltyActivated { job: self.jobs[i].id, wall_ms: p.wall_ms });
            }
        } else {
            w.since_us = None;
        }
    }
}

pub fn dist3(a: [f64; 3], b: [f64; 3]) -> f64 {
    ((a[0] - b[0]).powi(2) + (a[1] - b[1]).powi(2) + (a[2] - b[2]).powi(2)).sqrt()
}

/// Routes frames to one [`Timeline`] per profile (PLAN §6b: profiles are
/// separate timelines). Frames before any profile notice go to "unknown".
/// The jobs' points live in `S`, every profile's in the same store.
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Profiles<S = VecStore> {
    cfg: Config,
    active: String,
    timelines: Vec<(String, Timeline)>,
    /// Init and module messages of the current session, replayed to a profile
    /// timeline created mid-session so it knows the game and multiplayer state.
    session: Vec<Frame>,
    store: S,
}

impl Profiles {
    /// Points in memory ([`VecStore`]); [`Profiles::with_store`] for another store.
    pub fn new(cfg: Config) -> Profiles {
        Profiles::with_store(cfg, VecStore::new())
    }
}

impl<S: PointStore> Profiles<S> {
    pub fn with_store(cfg: Config, store: S) -> Profiles<S> {
        Profiles { cfg, active: "unknown".into(), timelines: Vec::new(), session: Vec::new(), store }
    }

    /// Where the jobs' points are.
    pub fn store(&self) -> &S {
        &self.store
    }

    pub fn store_mut(&mut self) -> &mut S {
        &mut self.store
    }

    /// Jobs evicted since the last call, their points still in the store:
    /// [`Profiles::release`] each once it is stored elsewhere.
    pub fn take_evicted_live(&mut self) -> Vec<Job<TrackId>> {
        self.timelines.iter_mut().flat_map(|(_, t)| t.take_evicted()).collect()
    }

    /// Frees the tracks of a job that left the timelines.
    pub fn release(&mut self, job: &Job<TrackId>) {
        job.release(&mut self.store);
    }

    fn timeline(&mut self, key: &str) -> &mut Timeline {
        if let Some(i) = self.timelines.iter().position(|(k, _)| k == key) {
            return &mut self.timelines[i].1;
        }
        let mut t = Timeline::new(self.cfg.clone(), key);
        for f in &self.session {
            t.push(f, &mut self.store);
        }
        self.timelines.push((key.to_string(), t));
        &mut self.timelines.last_mut().expect("just pushed").1
    }

    pub fn push(&mut self, f: &Frame) {
        if let Body::Profile { key } = &f.body {
            if *key != self.active {
                self.active = key.clone();
                self.timeline(key).mark_session_change();
            }
            return;
        }
        // Session-level facts (game, multiplayer) are shared by every profile.
        let active = self.active.clone();
        if matches!(f.body, Body::Init { .. }) {
            self.session.clear();
        }
        if matches!(f.body, Body::Init { .. } | Body::Modules { .. } | Body::Truckersmp { .. }) {
            self.session.push(f.clone());
            for (k, t) in self.timelines.iter_mut() {
                if *k != active {
                    t.push(f, &mut self.store);
                }
            }
        }
        self.timeline(&active);
        let i = self.timelines.iter().position(|(k, _)| *k == active).expect("just made");
        self.timelines[i].1.push(f, &mut self.store);
    }

    /// Live jobs of every profile timeline (evicted ones excluded). Their
    /// points are in [`Profiles::store`].
    pub fn jobs(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &Job<TrackId>> {
        self.timelines.iter().flat_map(|(_, t)| t.jobs())
    }

    /// A live job with all its points in memory.
    pub fn materialize(&self, job: &Job<TrackId>) -> Job {
        job.materialize(&self.store)
    }

    /// Scores a live job straight from the store.
    pub fn evaluate(&self, job: &Job<TrackId>, cfg: &Config, ctx: &Context) -> JobResult {
        evaluate_in(job, &self.store, cfg, ctx)
    }

    /// Gives back the spare capacity of every job's point lists. Lists grow by
    /// doubling, which left a third of a large rebuild's memory unused
    /// (2026-10-16); the server calls this after each pass.
    pub fn shrink_to_fit(&mut self) {
        self.store.shrink_to_fit();
    }

    /// Drops a finished job's points from memory but its last one (the
    /// server keeps them on disk). `speed_invalid`: the delivery was over the
    /// invalid speed, so a load into it still reopens it.
    pub fn offload(&mut self, profile: &str, id: u32, speed_invalid: bool) {
        let Some((_, t)) = self.timelines.iter_mut().find(|(k, _)| k == profile) else { return };
        let Some(job) = t.jobs.iter_mut().find(|j| j.id == id) else { return };
        let n = self.store.len(job.kept);
        if n > 1 {
            let last = self.store.split_off(job.kept, n - 1);
            self.store.remove(job.kept);
            job.kept = last;
        }
        for b in std::mem::take(&mut job.reverted) {
            self.store.remove(b.points);
        }
        job.offloaded = true;
        job.offloaded_invalid = speed_invalid;
    }

    /// Jobs evicted from any profile timeline since the last call, with their
    /// points; the store forgets them.
    pub fn take_evicted(&mut self) -> Vec<Job> {
        let evicted: Vec<Job<TrackId>> = self.timelines.iter_mut().flat_map(|(_, t)| t.take_evicted()).collect();
        evicted
            .into_iter()
            .map(|j| {
                let full = j.materialize(&self.store);
                j.release(&mut self.store);
                full
            })
            .collect()
    }

    /// Notices of every profile timeline since the last call, each with its
    /// profile (job ids are per profile timeline).
    pub fn take_notices(&mut self) -> Vec<(String, Notice)> {
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        for (k, t) in self.timelines.iter_mut() {
            out.extend(t.take_notices().into_iter().map(|n| (k.clone(), n)));
        }
        out
    }

    pub fn active_profile(&self) -> &str {
        &self.active
    }

    /// The plugin sessions a job's points (kept and reverted) came from, in
    /// first-seen order.
    pub fn sessions_of(&self, job: &Job<TrackId>) -> Vec<String> {
        let Some((_, t)) = self.timelines.iter().find(|(k, _)| *k == job.profile) else { return Vec::new() };
        let mut idx: Vec<u32> = self.point_sessions(job);
        idx.sort_unstable();
        idx.dedup();
        idx.into_iter().filter_map(|i| t.sess_ids.get(i as usize).cloned()).collect()
    }

    /// The `sess` index of every kept and reverted point of a job, unsorted
    /// and with repeats collapsed only where neighbours share one.
    pub fn point_sessions(&self, job: &Job<TrackId>) -> Vec<u32> {
        let mut idx: Vec<u32> = Vec::new();
        let tracks = std::iter::once(job.kept).chain(job.reverted.iter().map(|b| b.points));
        for tr in tracks {
            for p in self.store.iter(tr) {
                if idx.last() != Some(&p.sess) {
                    idx.push(p.sess);
                }
            }
        }
        idx
    }

    /// The session id behind a point's `sess` index in a profile's timeline.
    pub fn session_id(&self, profile: &str, idx: u32) -> Option<&str> {
        let (_, t) = self.timelines.iter().find(|(k, _)| k == profile)?;
        t.sess_ids.get(idx as usize).map(String::as_str)
    }

    pub fn into_jobs(self) -> Vec<Job> {
        let store = self.store;
        let mut jobs: Vec<Job> =
            self.timelines.into_iter().flat_map(|(_, t)| t.into_jobs()).map(|j| j.materialize(&store)).collect();
        jobs.sort_by_key(|j| j.events.first().map(event_wall).unwrap_or(0));
        jobs
    }
}

fn event_wall(e: &JobEvent) -> i64 {
    match e {
        JobEvent::Started { wall_ms, .. }
        | JobEvent::LoadTruncate { wall_ms, .. }
        | JobEvent::LoadRestore { wall_ms, .. }
        | JobEvent::LoadGap { wall_ms, .. }
        | JobEvent::SessionContinue { wall_ms }
        | JobEvent::Teleport { wall_ms, .. }
        | JobEvent::Suspended { wall_ms }
        | JobEvent::Resumed { wall_ms }
        | JobEvent::CargoLoaded { wall_ms }
        | JobEvent::CargoSwitch { wall_ms, .. }
        | JobEvent::TruckChange { wall_ms }
        | JobEvent::Delivered { wall_ms }
        | JobEvent::Cancelled { wall_ms, .. }
        | JobEvent::CancellationReverted { wall_ms }
        | JobEvent::InvalidDeliveryReopened { wall_ms }
        | JobEvent::StoppedAfterDelivery { wall_ms }
        | JobEvent::DuplicateDelivery { wall_ms } => *wall_ms,
    }
}
```

`crates/pt-core/src/trace.rs`:

```rs
//! Typed view of the plugin's raw frames (docs/WIRE.md), as the timeline needs
//! them. Parsing is lenient: unknown kinds and channels are kept or ignored, never
//! fatal, so newer plugins and undocumented game data do not break replay.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::Value;

use crate::config::Multiplayer;
use crate::game::Game;

/// One plugin message, in the order the plugin produced it.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Frame {
    pub sess: String,
    pub seq: u64,
    pub wall_ms: i64,
    /// `paused_simulation_time` of the frame (µs); absent on sender-thread messages.
    pub sim_us: Option<u64>,
    pub body: Body,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum Body {
    Init { game: Option<Game>, game_version: (u32, u32) },
    Config { id: String, attrs: Vec<Attr> },
    Gameplay { id: String, attrs: Vec<Attr> },
    Paused,
    Started,
    TimerRestart,
    Sample(Sample),
    Scale { local_scale: Option<f64> },
    /// Module list, raw (capture mode, local client) or redacted (uploads).
    /// `mods`: the kinds of `[[multiplayer.mods]]` whose module names it has.
    Modules {
        truckersmp: bool,
        #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")]
        mods: Vec<String>,
    },
    /// TruckersMP client SDK state (plugin >= this change): authoritative for
    /// "on a TruckersMP server" once seen in a session. `account_id` is the
    /// player's TruckersMP account (0 = unknown); uploaded for the bot to link
    /// TruckersMP profiles (PLAN §11, decision 24).
    Truckersmp { loaded: bool, connected: bool, server_id: u64, account_id: u64 },
    Shutdown,
    /// Client-inserted: the active game profile changed (PLAN §6b).
    Profile { key: String },
    Other(String),
}

/// A config or gameplay attribute: `{name, index, type, value}`.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Attr {
    pub name: String,
    pub index: Option<u32>,
    pub value: Value,
}

/// Channel values of one sample (SDK units). `None` = the game reported no value.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Sample {
    pub speed_mps: Option<f64>,
    pub odometer_km: Option<f64>,
    pub fuel_l: Option<f64>,
    /// World position in metres of the 3D world (`truck.world.placement`).
    pub pos: Option<[f64; 3]>,
    /// In-game minutes (`game.time`).
    pub game_time_min: Option<u32>,
    pub local_scale: Option<f64>,
    pub mp_time_offset: Option<i64>,
    /// First trailer hitched (`trailer.0.connected`); absent in older captures.
    pub trailer_connected: Option<bool>,
    /// Cargo damage 0-1 (`job.cargo.damage`), for the job graphs.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub cargo_damage: Option<f64>,
}

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum TraceError {
    #[error("not a JSON object: {0}")]
    Json(String),
    #[error("missing envelope field {0}")]
    Missing(&'static str),
}

pub fn attr<'a>(attrs: &'a [Attr], name: &str) -> Option<&'a Value> {
    attrs.iter().find(|a| a.name == name && a.index.unwrap_or(0) == 0).map(|a| &a.value)
}

fn parse_attrs(v: &Value) -> Vec<Attr> {
    v.as_array()
        .map(|a| {
            a.iter()
                .map(|x| Attr {
                    name: x["name"].as_str().unwrap_or_default().to_string(),
                    index: x["index"].as_u64().map(|i| i as u32),
                    value: x["value"].clone(),
                })
                .collect()
        })
        .unwrap_or_default()
}

fn parse_sample(ch: &Value) -> Sample {
    let f = |k: &str| ch.get(k).and_then(Value::as_f64);
    let pos = ch
        .get("truck.world.placement")
        .and_then(|p| p.get("position"))
        .and_then(|p| Some([p["x"].as_f64()?, p["y"].as_f64()?, p["z"].as_f64()?]));
    Sample {
        speed_mps: f("truck.speed"),
        odometer_km: f("truck.odometer"),
        fuel_l: f("truck.fuel.amount"),
        pos,
        game_time_min: ch.get("game.time").and_then(Value::as_u64).map(|v| v as u32),
        local_scale: f("local.scale"),
        mp_time_offset: ch.get("multiplayer.time.offset").and_then(Value::as_i64),
        trailer_connected: ch.get("trailer.0.connected").and_then(Value::as_bool),
        cargo_damage: f("job.cargo.damage"),
    }
}

/// Parses one frame. `mp` names the modules that mean multiplayer, for raw
/// module lists and for the mod matches a redacted one keeps.
pub fn parse_frame(json: &str, mp: &Multiplayer) -> Result<Frame, TraceError> {
    let v: Value = serde_json::from_str(json).map_err(|e| TraceError::Json(e.to_string()))?;
    if !v.is_object() {
        return Err(TraceError::Json("not an object".into()));
    }
    let kind = v["kind"].as_str().ok_or(TraceError::Missing("kind"))?;
    let sess = v["sess"].as_str().ok_or(TraceError::Missing("sess"))?.to_string();
    let seq = v["seq"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0);
    let wall_ms = v["wall_ms"].as_i64().unwrap_or(0);
    let sim_us = v["sim_us"].as_u64();
    let body = match kind {
        "init" => {
            let gv = &v["game_version"];
            Body::Init {
                game: v["game_id"].as_str().and_then(Game::from_sdk_game_id),
                game_version: (
                    gv["major"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) as u32,
                    gv["minor"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) as u32,
                ),
            }
        }
        "config" => Body::Config {
            id: v["id"].as_str().unwrap_or_default().to_string(),
            attrs: parse_attrs(&v["attrs"]),
        },
        "gameplay" => Body::Gameplay {
            id: v["id"].as_str().unwrap_or_default().to_string(),
            attrs: parse_attrs(&v["attrs"]),
        },
        "paused" => Body::Paused,
        "started" => Body::Started,
        "timer_restart" => Body::TimerRestart,
        "sample" => Body::Sample(parse_sample(&v["ch"])),
        "scale" => Body::Scale { local_scale: v["local_scale"].as_f64() },
        "modules" => {
            let wanted: Vec<String> = mp.truckersmp_module_names.iter().map(|n| n.to_ascii_lowercase()).collect();
            let raw_hit = v["modules"]
                .as_array()
                .is_some_and(|m| m.iter().filter_map(Value::as_str).any(|n| wanted.contains(&n.to_ascii_lowercase())));
            let redacted_hit = v["truckersmp_matches"].as_array().is_some_and(|m| !m.is_empty());
            let names: Vec<&str> = [&v["modules"], &v["mod_matches"]]
                .into_iter()
                .filter_map(Value::as_array)
                .flatten()
                .filter_map(Value::as_str)
                .collect();
            Body::Modules { truckersmp: raw_hit || redacted_hit, mods: mp.mods_matching(&names) }
        }
        "truckersmp" => Body::Truckersmp {
            loaded: v["loaded"].as_bool().unwrap_or(false),
            connected: v["connected"].as_bool().unwrap_or(false),
            server_id: v["server_id"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0),
            account_id: v["account_id"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0),
        },
        "shutdown" => Body::Shutdown,
        "profile" => Body::Profile { key: v["profile_key"].as_str().unwrap_or("unknown").to_string() },
        other => Body::Other(other.to_string()),
    };
    Ok(Frame { sess, seq, wall_ms, sim_us, body })
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    const SESS: &str = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef";

    #[test]
    fn parses_a_real_sample_line() {
        // Shape copied from the first ATS capture (docs/PLAN.md §3).
        let line = format!(
            r#"{{"v":1,"kind":"sample","sess":"{SESS}","seq":390,"wall_ms":1790600226175,"frame":20851,"sim_us":33332,"simulation_us":347502766,"render_us":347472939,"ch":{{"truck.speed":-0.00019482193,"truck.odometer":12844.921,"truck.fuel.amount":642.4152,"truck.world.placement":{{"position":{{"x":-103988.59376907349,"y":11.977951049804688,"z":-66894.78128051758}},"orientation":{{"heading":0.92525786,"pitch":2.5044026e-06,"roll":-1.3015305e-05}}}},"game.time":10401482,"local.scale":3,"multiplayer.time.offset":0,"job.cargo.damage":null,"trailer.0.connected":true}},"stale":[]}}"#
        );
        let f = parse_frame(&line, &mp(&[])).unwrap();
        assert_eq!((f.seq, f.sim_us), (390, Some(33332)));
        let Body::Sample(s) = f.body else { panic!("not a sample") };
        assert_eq!(s.odometer_km, Some(12844.921));
        assert_eq!(s.local_scale, Some(3.0));
        assert_eq!(s.game_time_min, Some(10401482));
        assert_eq!(s.trailer_connected, Some(true));
        assert_eq!(s.pos.unwrap()[0], -103988.59376907349);
    }

    #[test]
    fn parses_config_gameplay_and_modules() {
        let cfg = format!(
            r#"{{"v":1,"kind":"config","sess":"{SESS}","seq":5,"wall_ms":1,"id":"job","attrs":[{{"name":"cargo.id","index":null,"type":"string","value":"tyres"}},{{"name":"planned_distance.km","index":null,"type":"u32","value":235}}]}}"#
        );
        let Body::Config { id, attrs } = parse_frame(&cfg, &mp(&[])).unwrap().body else { panic!() };
        assert_eq!(id, "job");
        assert_eq!(attr(&attrs, "planned_distance.km").and_then(Value::as_u64), Some(235));
        let raw = format!(r#"{{"v":1,"kind":"modules","sess":"{SESS}","seq":3,"modules":["KERNEL32.DLL","core_atsmp.dll"]}}"#);
        let tmp = mp(&["core_atsmp.dll"]);
        assert_eq!(parse_frame(&raw, &tmp).unwrap().body, Body::Modules { truckersmp: true, mods: vec![] });
        assert_eq!(parse_frame(&raw, &mp(&[])).unwrap().body, Body::Modules { truckersmp: false, mods: vec![] });
        let red = format!(r#"{{"v":1,"kind":"modules","sess":"{SESS}","seq":3,"module_count":2,"truckersmp_matches":["core_atsmp.dll"],"redacted":true}}"#);
        assert_eq!(parse_frame(&red, &mp(&[])).unwrap().body, Body::Modules { truckersmp: true, mods: vec![] });
    }

    #[test]
    fn modules_name_a_multiplayer_mod_raw_or_redacted() {
        let cfg = haulmp();
        let raw = format!(r#"{{"v":1,"kind":"modules","sess":"{SESS}","seq":3,"modules":["KERNEL32.DLL","HaulMP_Stub.dll"]}}"#);
        assert_eq!(parse_frame(&raw, &cfg).unwrap().body, Body::Modules { truckersmp: false, mods: vec!["haulmp".into()] });
        // The redacted list keeps the matched names; the kind is looked up again.
        let red = format!(r#"{{"v":1,"kind":"modules","sess":"{SESS}","seq":3,"module_count":2,"truckersmp_matches":[],"mod_matches":["haulmp-telemetry.dll"],"redacted":true}}"#);
        assert_eq!(parse_frame(&red, &cfg).unwrap().body, Body::Modules { truckersmp: false, mods: vec!["haulmp".into()] });
        // A config without the mod does not know the name.
        assert_eq!(parse_frame(&red, &mp(&[])).unwrap().body, Body::Modules { truckersmp: false, mods: vec![] });
    }

    fn mp(truckersmp: &[&str]) -> Multiplayer {
        Multiplayer { truckersmp_module_names: truckersmp.iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect(), mods: vec![] }
    }

    fn haulmp() -> Multiplayer {
        Multiplayer {
            truckersmp_module_names: vec![],
            mods: vec![crate::config::MultiplayerMod {
                kind: "haulmp".into(),
                name: "HaulMP".into(),
                module_names: vec!["haulmp_stub.dll".into(), "haulmp-telemetry.dll".into()],
                game_min_per_real_min: None,
                singleplayer_division_discard: true,
            }],
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn parses_truckersmp_state_with_account() {
        let line = format!(r#"{{"v":1,"kind":"truckersmp","sess":"{SESS}","seq":7,"loaded":true,"connected":true,"server_id":42,"account_id":5557777}}"#);
        assert_eq!(
            parse_frame(&line, &mp(&[])).unwrap().body,
            Body::Truckersmp { loaded: true, connected: true, server_id: 42, account_id: 5557777 }
        );
    }
}
```

`crates/pt-core/src/units.rs`:

```rs
//! Unit conversions and threshold comparisons.
//!
//! The conversion factors are fixed by the PlasmaTrack spec and are not
//! configurable. SDK units: `truck.odometer` is km
//! (common/scssdk_telemetry_truck_common_channels.h:640-645), `truck.speed` is m/s,
//! negative when reversing (same header, :107-114).

/// Spec: 1 km = 0.621371 mi.
pub const MI_PER_KM: f64 = 0.621371;

/// Spec: speed in mph = m/s x 2.23694.
pub const MPH_PER_MPS: f64 = 2.23694;

pub fn km_to_mi(km: f64) -> f64 {
    km * MI_PER_KM
}

pub fn mps_to_mph(mps: f64) -> f64 {
    mps * MPH_PER_MPS
}

/// Quantizes `value` to a whole number of `precision` steps.
///
/// Comparing quantized integers instead of raw floats makes the spec's boundary
/// cases deterministic: a speed that converts to 104.9999999 or 105.0000001 mph
/// is "exactly 105.0" at 0.001 mph precision, so it is not "over 105".
fn quantize(value: f64, precision: f64) -> i64 {
    debug_assert!(precision > 0.0, "precision must be positive");
    (value / precision).round() as i64
}

/// True if `value` is strictly greater than `threshold` at the given precision.
pub fn exceeds(value: f64, threshold: f64, precision: f64) -> bool {
    quantize(value, precision) > quantize(threshold, precision)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn conversions_use_spec_factors() {
        assert_eq!(km_to_mi(1.0), 0.621371);
        assert_eq!(mps_to_mph(1.0), 2.23694);
        assert!((km_to_mi(100.0) - 62.1371).abs() < 1e-9);
    }

    #[test]
    fn exactly_at_threshold_is_not_over() {
        let p = 0.001;
        for limit in [100.0, 105.0, 125.0, 150.0] {
            // The m/s value a game would report for exactly `limit` mph (f32 channel).
            let mps = (limit / MPH_PER_MPS) as f32;
            let mph = mps_to_mph(mps as f64);
            assert!(!exceeds(mph, limit, p), "{limit} mph reported as {mph}");
            assert!(exceeds(limit + 0.001, limit, p));
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn manual_review_boundary() {
        let p = 0.001;
        assert!(!exceeds(3000.0, 3000.0, p));
        assert!(exceeds(3000.1, 3000.0, p));
        // 3000 mi driven in ETS2, measured in km.
        let km = 3000.0 / MI_PER_KM;
        assert!(!exceeds(km_to_mi(km), 3000.0, p));
    }
}
```

`crates/pt-core/src/update.rs`:

```rs
//! Client updates (docs/UPDATES.md). A release's update manifest lists every
//! file the installer puts in the client's `bin` folder with its SHA-256 and
//! size. The manifest is signed with the release key (Ed25519, kept offline by
//! the maintainer; `scripts/make-release-key.mjs`), and clients only install
//! what carries a signature by one of [`UPDATE_KEYS`]. The server stores and
//! serves updates but cannot make one.

use ed25519_dalek::{Signature, VerifyingKey};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

/// Public keys whose signatures clients accept. A second key can be added
/// before the first is retired.
pub const UPDATE_KEYS: &[[u8; 32]] = &[hex32("7dd1f8d93cb66cb2f8ec86acab45add8e9c8b9bb484f77eb95ca1af7e256e073")];

/// Signed bytes are this prefix followed by the manifest text, so a signature
/// cannot be reused for anything else.
pub const SIGNING_CONTEXT: &[u8] = b"plasmatrack-update-v1\n";
pub const PRODUCT: &str = "plasmatrack";
/// Where the client asks for updates (`?platform=windows&version=0.2.0`).
pub const UPDATE_PATH: &str = "/api/v1/client/update";
/// Each file is served gzip-compressed at `{DOWNLOAD_PATH}{platform}/{version}/{path}.gz`.
pub const DOWNLOAD_PATH: &str = "/dl/releases/";
/// Largest file an update may contain (uncompressed).
pub const MAX_FILE_BYTES: u64 = 256 << 20;
pub const MAX_FILES: usize = 64;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct UpdateManifest {
    pub product: String,
    pub platform: String,
    pub version: String,
    pub files: Vec<UpdateFile>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct UpdateFile {
    /// Relative to `bin`, `/`-separated: `plasmatrack.dll`, `licenses/…`.
    pub path: String,
    pub sha256: String,
    pub size: u64,
    /// Size of the `.gz` download.
    pub gz_size: u64,
}

impl UpdateManifest {
    /// R2 key / download path of one file, below [`DOWNLOAD_PATH`].
    pub fn key(&self, f: &UpdateFile) -> String {
        format!("{}/{}/{}.gz", self.platform, self.version, f.path)
    }
}

impl UpdateFile {
    /// The file's location below `dir`.
    pub fn local_path(&self, dir: &std::path::Path) -> std::path::PathBuf {
        self.path.split('/').fold(dir.to_path_buf(), |p, part| p.join(part))
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum UpdateError {
    #[error("signature: {0}")]
    Signature(&'static str),
    #[error("manifest: {0}")]
    Manifest(String),
}

const fn hex32(s: &str) -> [u8; 32] {
    let b = s.as_bytes();
    assert!(b.len() == 64);
    let mut out = [0u8; 32];
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < 32 {
        out[i] = (nibble(b[2 * i]) << 4) | nibble(b[2 * i + 1]);
        i += 1;
    }
    out
}

const fn nibble(c: u8) -> u8 {
    match c {
        b'0'..=b'9' => c - b'0',
        b'a'..=b'f' => c - b'a' + 10,
        _ => panic!("lowercase hex"),
    }
}

fn unhex(s: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    if s.len() % 2 != 0 || !s.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_hexdigit()) {
        return None;
    }
    (0..s.len()).step_by(2).map(|i| u8::from_str_radix(&s[i..i + 2], 16).ok()).collect()
}

/// `major.minor.patch` as numbers, for ordering versions.
pub fn parse_version(v: &str) -> Option<(u64, u64, u64)> {
    let mut it = v.split('.').map(|p| if p.is_empty() || p.len() > 9 || !p.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()) { None } else { p.parse().ok() });
    let out = (it.next()??, it.next()??, it.next()??);
    it.next().is_none().then_some(out)
}

fn valid_path(p: &str) -> bool {
    !p.is_empty()
        && p.len() <= 200
        && p.split('/').all(|part| {
            !part.is_empty() && part != "." && part != ".." && part.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b"._-".contains(&c))
        })
}

/// Parses a manifest and checks what does not need the signature: product,
/// version format, safe and unique paths, hash format, sizes.
pub fn parse(text: &str) -> Result<UpdateManifest, UpdateError> {
    let m: UpdateManifest = serde_json::from_str(text).map_err(|e| UpdateError::Manifest(e.to_string()))?;
    let bad = |s: String| Err(UpdateError::Manifest(s));
    if m.product != PRODUCT {
        return bad(format!("product {:?}", m.product));
    }
    if !matches!(m.platform.as_str(), "windows" | "linux") {
        return bad(format!("platform {:?}", m.platform));
    }
    if parse_version(&m.version).is_none() {
        return bad(format!("version {:?}", m.version));
    }
    if m.files.is_empty() || m.files.len() > MAX_FILES {
        return bad(format!("{} files", m.files.len()));
    }
    let mut seen = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
    for f in &m.files {
        if !valid_path(&f.path) || !seen.insert(f.path.to_ascii_lowercase()) {
            return bad(format!("path {:?}", f.path));
        }
        if f.sha256.len() != 64 || !f.sha256.bytes().all(|c| matches!(c, b'0'..=b'9' | b'a'..=b'f')) {
            return bad(format!("sha256 of {}", f.path));
        }
        if f.size > MAX_FILE_BYTES || f.gz_size == 0 || f.gz_size > MAX_FILE_BYTES + (1 << 20) {
            return bad(format!("size of {}", f.path));
        }
    }
    Ok(m)
}

/// Checks `signature_hex` over the manifest text against [`UPDATE_KEYS`].
pub fn verify(text: &str, signature_hex: &str) -> Result<UpdateManifest, UpdateError> {
    verify_with(text, signature_hex, UPDATE_KEYS)
}

pub fn verify_with(text: &str, signature_hex: &str, keys: &[[u8; 32]]) -> Result<UpdateManifest, UpdateError> {
    let sig = unhex(signature_hex.trim()).ok_or(UpdateError::Signature("not hex"))?;
    let sig = Signature::from_slice(&sig).map_err(|_| UpdateError::Signature("not 64 bytes"))?;
    let msg = [SIGNING_CONTEXT, text.as_bytes()].concat();
    let ok = keys
        .iter()
        .filter_map(|k| VerifyingKey::from_bytes(k).ok())
        .any(|k| k.verify_strict(&msg, &sig).is_ok());
    if !ok {
        return Err(UpdateError::Signature("not signed by a release key"));
    }
    parse(text)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use ed25519_dalek::{Signer, SigningKey};

    fn manifest(version: &str, path: &str) -> String {
        serde_json::to_string(&UpdateManifest {
            product: PRODUCT.into(),
            platform: "windows".into(),
            version: version.into(),
            files: vec![UpdateFile { path: path.into(), sha256: "ab".repeat(32), size: 10, gz_size: 30 }],
        })
        .unwrap()
    }

    fn sign(key: &SigningKey, text: &str) -> String {
        let sig = key.sign(&[SIGNING_CONTEXT, text.as_bytes()].concat());
        sig.to_bytes().iter().map(|b| format!("{b:02x}")).collect()
    }

    #[test]
    fn accepts_only_signed_manifests() {
        let key = SigningKey::from_bytes(&[7; 32]);
        let other = SigningKey::from_bytes(&[8; 32]);
        let keys = [key.verifying_key().to_bytes()];
        let text = manifest("0.2.0", "licenses/LLVM-LICENSE.txt");
        let m = verify_with(&text, &sign(&key, &text), &keys).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(m.key(&m.files[0]), "windows/0.2.0/licenses/LLVM-LICENSE.txt.gz");
        assert_eq!(verify_with(&text, &sign(&other, &text), &keys), Err(UpdateError::Signature("not signed by a release key")));
        let changed = text.replace("0.2.0", "0.2.1");
        assert!(verify_with(&changed, &sign(&key, &text), &keys).is_err(), "any change breaks it");
        // Signed without the context prefix: refused.
        let bare: String = key.sign(text.as_bytes()).to_bytes().iter().map(|b| format!("{b:02x}")).collect();
        assert!(verify_with(&text, &bare, &keys).is_err());
        assert!(verify_with(&text, "zz", &keys).is_err());
        // The shipped key is a valid curve point.
        assert!(VerifyingKey::from_bytes(&UPDATE_KEYS[0]).is_ok());
    }

    #[test]
    fn refuses_unsafe_paths_and_bad_versions() {
        for p in ["../x.dll", "a//b", "/abs.exe", "c:\\x.exe", "a/./b", ""] {
            assert!(parse(&manifest("0.2.0", p)).is_err(), "{p}");
        }
        for v in ["0.2", "0.2.0.1", "v0.2.0", "0.2.x", "0..2"] {
            assert!(parse(&manifest(v, "x.exe")).is_err(), "{v}");
        }
        assert!(parse(&manifest("0.2.0", "plasmatrack-clientw.exe")).is_ok());
        assert!(parse(&manifest("0.2.0", "x.exe").replace("\"files\"", "\"extra\":1,\"files\"")).is_err(), "unknown fields");
    }

    #[test]
    fn orders_versions() {
        assert!(parse_version("0.10.0") > parse_version("0.9.9"));
        assert!(parse_version("1.0.0") > parse_version("0.99.99"));
        assert_eq!(parse_version("0.2.0"), Some((0, 2, 0)));
        assert_eq!(parse_version("0.2.0-rc1"), None);
    }
}
```

`crates/pt-core/src/upload.rs`:

```rs
//! Client → server upload contract (`POST /api/v1/chunks`, gzip-compressed JSON,
//! `Authorization: Bearer <player token>`). The server derives every job from
//! these raw frames; nothing the client computed is an input.

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::value::RawValue;

pub const UPLOAD_PROTOCOL: u32 = 1;
pub const CHUNKS_PATH: &str = "/api/v1/chunks";

/// One installed file and its hash (rule 0 install manifest).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ManifestEntry {
    /// `client_binary`, `config_file`, or `plugin` (the plugin DLL/.so in a
    /// game's plugins folder).
    pub role: String,
    pub path: String,
    pub sha256: String,
}

/// A contiguous-by-seq run of one plugin session's raw frames.
#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct UploadChunk {
    pub protocol: u32,
    pub client_version: String,
    pub sess: String,
    /// Latest `hello` received for this session, if any.
    pub hello: Option<Box<RawValue>>,
    pub seq_from: u64,
    pub seq_to: u64,
    /// Raw plugin messages in seq order (seq gaps are plugin-side drops).
    /// `modules` messages are redacted (`wire::redact_modules`).
    pub frames: Vec<Box<RawValue>>,
    /// `Config::integrity_hash()` of the client's effective config.
    pub config_hash: String,
    /// `Config::integrity_canonical_json()`, so the server can diff it.
    pub config: Box<RawValue>,
    pub manifest: Vec<ManifestEntry>,
}

/// Server response: every frame of `sess` up to `accepted_through` is stored.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct UploadAck {
    pub sess: String,
    pub accepted_through: u64,
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn chunk_roundtrip_keeps_frames_verbatim() {
        let frame = r#"{"v":1,"kind":"sample","sess":"s","seq":5,"ch":{"truck.speed":20.5}}"#;
        let chunk = UploadChunk {
            protocol: UPLOAD_PROTOCOL,
            client_version: "0.1.0".into(),
            sess: "s".into(),
            hello: None,
            seq_from: 5,
            seq_to: 5,
            frames: vec![RawValue::from_string(frame.into()).unwrap()],
            config_hash: "ab".into(),
            config: RawValue::from_string("{\"k\":1}".into()).unwrap(),
            manifest: vec![ManifestEntry { role: "plugin".into(), path: "p".into(), sha256: "00".into() }],
        };
        let json = serde_json::to_string(&chunk).unwrap();
        let back: UploadChunk = serde_json::from_str(&json).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(back.frames[0].get(), frame);
        assert_eq!(back.config.get(), "{\"k\":1}");
        assert_eq!(back.manifest, chunk.manifest);
    }
}
```
