`crates/pt-core/src/wire.rs`:

```rs
//! Plugin wire protocol (docs/WIRE.md): length-prefixed JSON frames.
//!
//! Shared by the client (which receives frames from the plugin) and the server
//! (which receives the same raw frames inside upload chunks).

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

use crate::config::Multiplayer;

/// Largest frame the client accepts from the plugin. A capture-mode snapshot is
/// well below this.
pub const MAX_FRAME_BYTES: usize = 64 << 20;

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum WireError {
    #[error("frame of {0} bytes exceeds the {MAX_FRAME_BYTES} byte limit")]
    Oversized(usize),
    #[error("frame is not UTF-8")]
    NotUtf8,
    #[error("frame is not a JSON object with an envelope: {0}")]
    BadEnvelope(String),
}

/// Encodes one frame: u32 little-endian length, then the JSON bytes.
pub fn encode_frame(json: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(4 + json.len());
    out.extend_from_slice(&(json.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());
    out.extend_from_slice(json.as_bytes());
    out
}

/// Incremental decoder for a byte stream of frames.
#[derive(Default)]
pub struct FrameDecoder {
    buf: Vec<u8>,
}

impl FrameDecoder {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self::default()
    }

    pub fn push(&mut self, bytes: &[u8]) {
        self.buf.extend_from_slice(bytes);
    }

    /// Returns the next complete frame, `Ok(None)` if more bytes are needed.
    /// After an error the stream is unusable and the connection must be dropped.
    pub fn next_frame(&mut self) -> Result<Option<String>, WireError> {
        if self.buf.len() < 4 {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        let len = u32::from_le_bytes([self.buf[0], self.buf[1], self.buf[2], self.buf[3]]) as usize;
        if len > MAX_FRAME_BYTES {
            return Err(WireError::Oversized(len));
        }
        if self.buf.len() < 4 + len {
            return Ok(None);
        }
        let payload: Vec<u8> = self.buf.drain(..4 + len).skip(4).collect();
        String::from_utf8(payload).map(Some).map_err(|_| WireError::NotUtf8)
    }

    pub fn buffered(&self) -> usize {
        self.buf.len()
    }
}

/// Envelope fields common to all plugin messages. `seq` is absent on `hello`
/// and `snapshot`; `frame`/`sim_us` are absent on sender-thread messages.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Envelope {
    pub v: u32,
    pub kind: String,
    pub sess: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub seq: Option<u64>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub wall_ms: Option<i64>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub frame: Option<u64>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub sim_us: Option<u64>,
}

impl Envelope {
    pub fn parse(json: &str) -> Result<Envelope, WireError> {
        let env: Envelope = serde_json::from_str(json).map_err(|e| WireError::BadEnvelope(e.to_string()))?;
        if env.sess.len() != 32 || !env.sess.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_hexdigit()) {
            return Err(WireError::BadEnvelope(format!("bad session id {:?}", env.sess)));
        }
        Ok(env)
    }
}

/// The acknowledgement the client sends back to the plugin: everything of
/// `sess` up to and including `seq` is persisted.
pub fn ack_json(sess: &str, seq: u64) -> String {
    let sess = serde_json::to_string(sess).expect("strings always serialize");
    format!("{{\"kind\":\"ack\",\"sess\":{sess},\"seq\":{seq}}}")
}

/// Privacy: a `modules` message lists every DLL loaded in the game process.
/// Before anything leaves the player's PC it is reduced to the TruckersMP
/// matches (case-insensitive), the matches of `[[multiplayer.mods]]` names
/// (`mod_matches`, only when mods are configured) and a count. Other messages
/// are returned as-is.
pub fn redact_modules(json: &str, mp: &Multiplayer) -> String {
    let Ok(mut v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(json) else {
        return json.to_string();
    };
    if v.get("kind").and_then(|k| k.as_str()) != Some("modules") {
        return json.to_string();
    }
    let obj = v.as_object_mut().expect("checked above");
    let modules: Vec<String> = obj
        .remove("modules")
        .and_then(|m| serde_json::from_value(m).ok())
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let wanted: Vec<String> = mp.truckersmp_module_names.iter().map(|n| n.to_ascii_lowercase()).collect();
    let matches: Vec<&String> = modules
        .iter()
        .filter(|m| wanted.contains(&m.to_ascii_lowercase()))
        .collect();
    obj.insert("module_count".into(), modules.len().into());
    obj.insert("truckersmp_matches".into(), serde_json::json!(matches));
    if !mp.mods.is_empty() {
        let names: Vec<&str> = modules.iter().map(String::as_str).collect();
        obj.insert("mod_matches".into(), serde_json::json!(mp.mod_module_matches(&names)));
    }
    obj.insert("redacted".into(), true.into());
    v.to_string()
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::config::MultiplayerMod;

    const SESS: &str = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef";

    #[test]
    fn frames_roundtrip_across_arbitrary_splits() {
        let msgs = ["{\"a\":1}", "", "{\"k\":\"K\u{f6}ln\"}"];
        let mut bytes = Vec::new();
        for m in msgs {
            bytes.extend(encode_frame(m));
        }
        for split in 0..bytes.len() {
            let mut d = FrameDecoder::new();
            let mut got = Vec::new();
            for chunk in [&bytes[..split], &bytes[split..]] {
                d.push(chunk);
                while let Some(f) = d.next_frame().unwrap() {
                    got.push(f);
                }
            }
            assert_eq!(got, msgs, "split at {split}");
            assert_eq!(d.buffered(), 0);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn oversized_and_non_utf8_frames_are_errors() {
        let mut d = FrameDecoder::new();
        d.push(&((MAX_FRAME_BYTES as u32) + 1).to_le_bytes());
        assert!(matches!(d.next_frame(), Err(WireError::Oversized(_))));
        let mut d = FrameDecoder::new();
        d.push(&2u32.to_le_bytes());
        d.push(&[0xff, 0xfe]);
        assert_eq!(d.next_frame(), Err(WireError::NotUtf8));
    }

    #[test]
    fn envelope_parsing() {
        let e = Envelope::parse(&format!(
            "{{\"v\":1,\"kind\":\"sample\",\"sess\":\"{SESS}\",\"seq\":7,\"wall_ms\":1,\"frame\":3,\"sim_us\":16667,\"ch\":{{}}}}"
        ))
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!((e.kind.as_str(), e.seq, e.sim_us), ("sample", Some(7), Some(16667)));
        let hello = Envelope::parse(&format!("{{\"v\":1,\"kind\":\"hello\",\"sess\":\"{SESS}\"}}")).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(hello.seq, None);
        assert!(Envelope::parse("{\"v\":1,\"kind\":\"x\",\"sess\":\"short\"}").is_err());
        assert!(Envelope::parse("[1,2]").is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn modules_are_redacted_to_truckersmp_matches() {
        let raw = format!(
            "{{\"v\":1,\"kind\":\"modules\",\"sess\":\"{SESS}\",\"seq\":3,\"modules\":[\"KERNEL32.DLL\",\"Core_ATSMP.dll\",\"secret-mod.dll\"]}}"
        );
        let tmp = Multiplayer { truckersmp_module_names: vec!["core_atsmp.dll".into()], mods: vec![] };
        let out = redact_modules(&raw, &tmp);
        let v: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&out).unwrap();
        assert!(v.get("modules").is_none());
        assert_eq!(v["module_count"], 3);
        assert_eq!(v["truckersmp_matches"], serde_json::json!(["Core_ATSMP.dll"]));
        assert!(v.get("mod_matches").is_none(), "no mods configured: the message is as before");
        assert_eq!(v["seq"], 3);
        assert!(!out.contains("secret-mod"));
        // Non-module messages pass through unchanged.
        let sample = format!("{{\"kind\":\"sample\",\"sess\":\"{SESS}\",\"seq\":4}}");
        assert_eq!(redact_modules(&sample, &tmp), sample);
    }

    #[test]
    fn modules_keep_multiplayer_mod_matches() {
        let raw = format!(
            "{{\"v\":1,\"kind\":\"modules\",\"sess\":\"{SESS}\",\"seq\":3,\"modules\":[\"KERNEL32.DLL\",\"haulmp_stub.dll\",\"secret-mod.dll\"]}}"
        );
        let mp = Multiplayer {
            truckersmp_module_names: vec!["core_ets2mp.dll".into()],
            mods: vec![MultiplayerMod {
                kind: "haulmp".into(),
                name: "HaulMP".into(),
                module_names: vec!["haulmp_stub.dll".into(), "haulmp-telemetry.dll".into()],
                game_min_per_real_min: None,
                singleplayer_division_discard: true,
            }],
        };
        let out = redact_modules(&raw, &mp);
        let v: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&out).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(v["truckersmp_matches"], serde_json::json!([]));
        assert_eq!(v["mod_matches"], serde_json::json!(["haulmp_stub.dll"]));
        assert_eq!(v["module_count"], 3);
        assert!(!out.contains("secret-mod"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn ack_format_matches_plugin_parser() {
        assert_eq!(ack_json(SESS, 42), format!("{{\"kind\":\"ack\",\"sess\":\"{SESS}\",\"seq\":42}}"));
    }
}
```

`crates/pt-replay/src/lib.rs`:

```rs
//! Replay harness: raw frames in, jobs and scores out, through exactly the code
//! the client and server use (`pt-core`).
//!
//! Inputs are JSON Lines of plugin frames (a capture file, or a fixture), plain
//! or gzip-compressed. Several files are merged in session order.

use std::io::{BufRead, BufReader, Read};
use std::path::Path;

use pt_core::rules::{evaluate, Context, JobResult};
use pt_core::timeline::{Job, Profiles};
use pt_core::trace::{parse_frame, Frame};
use pt_core::Config;

pub fn read_lines(path: &Path) -> std::io::Result<Vec<String>> {
    let file = std::fs::File::open(path)?;
    let reader: Box<dyn Read> = if path.extension().is_some_and(|e| e == "gz") {
        Box::new(flate2::read::GzDecoder::new(file))
    } else {
        Box::new(file)
    };
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for line in BufReader::new(reader).lines() {
        let line = line?;
        if !line.trim().is_empty() {
            out.push(line);
        }
    }
    Ok(out)
}

/// Parses lines into frames. A truncated last line (a capture cut off by a
/// crash) is skipped and counted.
pub fn parse_lines(lines: &[String], cfg: &Config) -> (Vec<Frame>, usize) {
    let mp = &cfg.multiplayer;
    let mut frames = Vec::with_capacity(lines.len());
    let mut bad = 0;
    for l in lines {
        match parse_frame(l, mp) {
            Ok(f) => frames.push(f),
            Err(_) => bad += 1,
        }
    }
    (frames, bad)
}

/// Orders frames of several sessions: sessions by their first wall-clock time,
/// frames within a session by seq (the plugin's order).
pub fn order_sessions(frames: &mut [Frame]) {
    let mut first: Vec<(String, i64)> = Vec::new();
    for f in frames.iter() {
        match first.iter_mut().find(|(s, _)| *s == f.sess) {
            Some((_, w)) => {
                if f.wall_ms > 0 && (*w == 0 || f.wall_ms < *w) {
                    *w = f.wall_ms;
                }
            }
            None => first.push((f.sess.clone(), f.wall_ms)),
        }
    }
    first.sort_by_key(|(_, w)| *w);
    let rank: Vec<String> = first.iter().map(|(s, _)| s.clone()).collect();
    frames.sort_by_key(|f| (rank.iter().position(|s| *s == f.sess).unwrap_or(usize::MAX), f.seq));
}

pub struct Replayed {
    pub job: Job,
    pub result: JobResult,
}

pub fn replay(frames: &[Frame], cfg: &Config, ctx: &Context) -> Vec<Replayed> {
    let mut profiles = Profiles::new(cfg.clone());
    for f in frames {
        profiles.push(f);
    }
    profiles
        .into_jobs()
        .into_iter()
        .map(|job| {
            let result = evaluate(&job, cfg, ctx);
            Replayed { job, result }
        })
        .collect()
}

pub fn sample_config() -> Config {
    Config::from_toml_str(include_str!("../../../config/plasmatrack.sample.toml")).expect("sample config is valid")
}

/// Shrinks a capture into a committable regression fixture:
/// - samples decimated to every `every`-th one, but the samples on both sides of
///   any other message (a bracket) are always kept, so loads, deliveries and
///   teleports replay exactly;
/// - `seq` renumbered per session so the decimation does not look like data gaps;
/// - `modules` redacted the way the client does before upload;
/// - heartbeats dropped.
///
/// Distances survive exactly (odometer differences telescope).
pub fn trim(lines: &[String], every: usize, mp: &pt_core::config::Multiplayer) -> Vec<String> {
    let every = every.max(1);
    // Heartbeats carry nothing the timeline uses; dropping them keeps fixtures small.
    let parsed: Vec<serde_json::Value> = lines
        .iter()
        .filter_map(|l| serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(l).ok())
        .filter(|v| v["kind"] != "heartbeat")
        .collect();
    let is_sample = |v: &serde_json::Value| v["kind"] == "sample";
    let n = parsed.len();
    let mut keep = vec![false; n];
    let mut sample_idx = 0usize;
    for i in 0..n {
        if !is_sample(&parsed[i]) {
            keep[i] = true;
            if let Some(j) = (0..i).rev().find(|&j| is_sample(&parsed[j])) {
                keep[j] = true;
            }
            if let Some(j) = (i + 1..n).find(|&j| is_sample(&parsed[j])) {
                keep[j] = true;
            }
        } else {
            if sample_idx % every == 0 {
                keep[i] = true;
            }
            sample_idx += 1;
        }
    }
    if let Some(j) = (0..n).rev().find(|&j| is_sample(&parsed[j])) {
        keep[j] = true;
    }
    let mut next_seq: Vec<(String, u64)> = Vec::new();
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for (i, mut v) in parsed.into_iter().enumerate() {
        if !keep[i] {
            continue;
        }
        let sess = v["sess"].as_str().unwrap_or_default().to_string();
        if v.get("seq").is_some_and(|s| s.is_u64()) {
            let slot = match next_seq.iter().position(|(s, _)| *s == sess) {
                Some(p) => p,
                None => {
                    next_seq.push((sess, 1));
                    next_seq.len() - 1
                }
            };
            v["seq"] = next_seq[slot].1.into();
            next_seq[slot].1 += 1;
        }
        out.push(pt_core::wire::redact_modules(&v.to_string(), mp));
    }
    out
}

pub fn write_gz(path: &Path, lines: &[String]) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    use std::io::Write;
    let file = std::fs::File::create(path)?;
    let mut gz = flate2::write::GzEncoder::new(file, flate2::Compression::best());
    for l in lines {
        gz.write_all(l.as_bytes())?;
        gz.write_all(b"\n")?;
    }
    gz.finish()?;
    Ok(())
}

```

`crates/pt-replay/src/main.rs`:

```rs
//! `pt-replay [--config FILE] [--json] [--sp-division] CAPTURE...`
//!
//! Replays captures or fixtures and prints every job with its score.

use std::path::PathBuf;

use pt_core::rules::Context;
use pt_core::units::km_to_mi;
use pt_replay::{order_sessions, parse_lines, read_lines, replay, sample_config};

fn main() {
    let mut cfg = sample_config();
    let mut json = false;
    let mut ctx = Context::default();
    let mut files: Vec<PathBuf> = Vec::new();
    let mut trim_to: Option<PathBuf> = None;
    let mut every = 15usize;
    let mut args = std::env::args().skip(1);
    while let Some(a) = args.next() {
        match a.as_str() {
            "--config" => {
                let p = args.next().expect("--config needs a file");
                let text = std::fs::read_to_string(&p).expect("readable config");
                cfg = pt_core::Config::from_toml_str(&text).expect("valid config");
            }
            "--json" => json = true,
            "--sp-division" => ctx.singleplayer_division = true,
            "--trim-to" => trim_to = Some(PathBuf::from(args.next().expect("--trim-to needs a file"))),
            "--every" => every = args.next().expect("--every needs N").parse().expect("number"),
            _ => files.push(a.into()),
        }
    }
    if files.is_empty() {
        eprintln!("usage: pt-replay [--config FILE] [--json] [--sp-division] [--trim-to OUT.jsonl.gz [--every N]] CAPTURE.jsonl[.gz]...");
        std::process::exit(2);
    }
    let mut lines = Vec::new();
    for f in &files {
        lines.extend(read_lines(f).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{}: {e}", f.display())));
    }
    if let Some(out) = trim_to {
        let trimmed = pt_replay::trim(&lines, every, &cfg.multiplayer);
        pt_replay::write_gz(&out, &trimmed).expect("write fixture");
        eprintln!("wrote {} ({} of {} lines)", out.display(), trimmed.len(), lines.len());
        return;
    }
    let (mut frames, bad) = parse_lines(&lines, &cfg);
    order_sessions(&mut frames);
    if bad > 0 {
        eprintln!("skipped {bad} unparsable line(s) (e.g. a capture cut off by a crash)");
    }
    let jobs = replay(&frames, &cfg, &ctx);
    if json {
        let out: Vec<_> = jobs
            .iter()
            .map(|r| {
                serde_json::json!({
                    "id": r.job.id, "profile": r.job.profile, "state": r.job.state, "start": r.job.start,
                    "info": r.job.info, "events": r.job.events, "gaps": r.job.gaps,
                    "kept_points": r.job.kept.len(),
                    "reverted_points": r.job.reverted.iter().map(|b| b.points.len()).sum::<usize>(),
                    "delivered": r.job.delivered, "result": r.result,
                })
            })
            .collect();
        println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&out).expect("serializable"));
        return;
    }
    for r in &jobs {
        let i = &r.job.info;
        let rt = &i.fingerprint.route;
        let d = &r.result.distances;
        println!(
            "job {} [{}] {} {}/{} -> {}/{} (planned {} km, {}) state={:?} start={:?}",
            r.job.id,
            r.job.profile,
            i.fingerprint.cargo.cargo_id,
            rt.source_city,
            rt.source_company,
            rt.destination_city,
            rt.destination_company,
            rt.planned_distance_km.map_or("?".into(), |v| v.to_string()),
            rt.job_market,
            r.job.state,
            r.job.start
        );
        println!(
            "  tracked: whole {:.2} game km = counted {:.2} + uncounted {:.2}; counted 1:1 {:.3} km; kept {} pts, reverted {} pts, gaps {}",
            d.tracked_whole_game_km,
            d.tracked_counted_game_km,
            d.tracked_uncounted_game_km,
            d.tracked_counted_world_km,
            r.job.kept.len(),
            r.job.reverted.iter().map(|b| b.points.len()).sum::<usize>(),
            r.job.gaps.len()
        );
        println!(
            "  game delivered {:?} km -> counted {:.2} game km ({:.1} mi in game) -> {:.3} km 1:1 = {:.3} mi",
            d.delivered_game_km,
            d.counted_game_km,
            km_to_mi(d.counted_game_km),
            d.world_km,
            d.world_mi
        );
        println!(
            "  speed: peak {:.1} mph, over penalty {:.1}s, over invalid {:.1}s; refuels {}; truckersmp={} convoy={} mod={}",
            r.result.speed.peak_mph,
            r.result.speed.over_penalty_s,
            r.result.speed.over_invalid_s,
            r.result.refuels.len(),
            r.result.truckersmp,
            r.result.convoy,
            r.result.multiplayer_mod.as_deref().unwrap_or("-")
        );
        println!(
            "  => {:?}{} points {:.1} (raw {:.3}); review {:?}",
            r.result.outcome,
            r.result.discard.as_ref().map_or(String::new(), |d| format!(" ({d:?})")),
            r.result.points,
            r.result.points_raw,
            r.result.review
        );
        for e in &r.job.events {
            println!("    {}", serde_json::to_string(e).expect("serializable"));
        }
    }
}
```

`crates/pt-replay/tests/equivalence.rs`:

```rs
//! Equivalence guard for changes to how the timeline stores its points
//! (scorer memory, 2026-10-20). Every fixture, and every local capture in
//! `captures/` when present, is replayed through `Profiles`; at checkpoints
//! along the way and at the end, the live jobs (with all their points) and
//! their scores are hashed. The hashes were recorded from the code before the
//! change (`tests/golden/`), so any difference in a job, a point or a score
//! fails here.
//!
//! `PT_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p pt-replay --test equivalence` rewrites
//! the golden files; only do that for an intended change in results.

use std::fmt::Write as _;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use pt_core::rules::{evaluate, Context, JobResult};
use pt_core::timeline::{Job, Profiles};
use pt_core::trace::Frame;
use pt_replay::{order_sessions, parse_lines, read_lines, sample_config};
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};

/// Frames between checkpoints: enough to land inside loads, gaps and
/// deliveries of the longer captures, few enough to keep the test quick.
const CHECKPOINT_EVERY: usize = 5_000;

fn root() -> PathBuf {
    Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).to_path_buf()
}

fn sha(v: &impl serde::Serialize) -> String {
    let bytes = serde_json::to_vec(v).expect("serializable");
    Sha256::digest(&bytes).iter().map(|b| format!("{b:02x}")).collect()
}

/// The live jobs with all their points, the way a caller sees them, and
/// their scores taken straight from the point store.
fn live_jobs(p: &Profiles) -> (Vec<Job>, Vec<JobResult>) {
    let cfg = sample_config();
    let ctx = Context::default();
    p.jobs().map(|j| (p.materialize(j), p.evaluate(j, &cfg, &ctx))).unzip()
}

fn job_line(out: &mut String, tag: &str, (jobs, live_results): (Vec<Job>, Vec<JobResult>)) {
    let cfg = sample_config();
    let ctx = Context::default();
    let results: Vec<_> = jobs.iter().map(|j| evaluate(j, &cfg, &ctx)).collect();
    assert_eq!(results, live_results, "{tag}: scoring from the store differs from scoring in memory");
    writeln!(out, "{tag} jobs={} jobs_sha={} results_sha={}", jobs.len(), sha(&jobs), sha(&results)).unwrap();
}

/// One line per checkpoint and per final job: what the golden file holds.
fn digest(frames: &[Frame]) -> String {
    let cfg = sample_config();
    let ctx = Context::default();
    let mut out = String::new();
    let mut profiles = Profiles::new(cfg.clone());
    for (i, f) in frames.iter().enumerate() {
        profiles.push(f);
        if (i + 1) % CHECKPOINT_EVERY == 0 {
            job_line(&mut out, &format!("frame {}", i + 1), live_jobs(&profiles));
        }
    }
    job_line(&mut out, "live", live_jobs(&profiles));
    let jobs = profiles.into_jobs();
    let results = jobs.iter().map(|j| evaluate(j, &cfg, &ctx)).collect();
    job_line(&mut out, "final", (jobs.clone(), results));
    for j in &jobs {
        let r = evaluate(j, &cfg, &ctx);
        let reverted: usize = j.reverted.iter().map(|b| b.points.len()).sum();
        writeln!(
            out,
            "job {}/{} state={:?} start={:?} kept={} reverted={} branches={} gaps={} events={} outcome={:?} points={} job_sha={}",
            j.profile,
            j.id,
            j.state,
            j.start,
            j.kept.len(),
            reverted,
            j.reverted.len(),
            j.gaps.len(),
            j.events.len(),
            r.outcome,
            r.points,
            sha(j),
        )
        .unwrap();
    }
    out
}

fn frames_of(files: &[PathBuf]) -> Vec<Frame> {
    let cfg = sample_config();
    let mut frames = Vec::new();
    for f in files {
        let (mut fr, _bad) = parse_lines(&read_lines(f).expect("readable input"), &cfg);
        frames.append(&mut fr);
    }
    order_sessions(&mut frames);
    frames
}

fn check(name: &str, files: &[PathBuf]) {
    let got = digest(&frames_of(files));
    let golden = root().join("tests/golden").join(format!("{name}.txt"));
    if std::env::var_os("PT_UPDATE_GOLDEN").is_some() {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(golden.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(&golden, &got).unwrap();
        return;
    }
    let want = std::fs::read_to_string(&golden)
        .unwrap_or_else(|_| panic!("no golden file {}: run with PT_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 on the old code", golden.display()));
    if got != want {
        let first = got.lines().zip(want.lines()).position(|(a, b)| a != b);
        panic!(
            "{name}: results differ from the golden file{}\n--- want\n{want}\n--- got\n{got}",
            first.map(|i| format!(" (first at line {})", i + 1)).unwrap_or_default()
        );
    }
}

#[test]
fn fixtures_match_golden() {
    let dir = root().join("tests/fixtures/real");
    let mut names: Vec<PathBuf> = std::fs::read_dir(&dir).unwrap().map(|e| e.unwrap().path()).collect();
    names.sort();
    assert!(!names.is_empty());
    for path in names {
        let name = path.file_name().unwrap().to_string_lossy().trim_end_matches(".jsonl.gz").to_string();
        check(&format!("fixture-{name}"), &[path]);
    }
}

/// The full-rate captures (git-ignored, so only where they exist): 20 Hz data
/// with the real number of points per job.
#[test]
fn captures_match_golden() {
    let dir = root().join("../../captures");
    let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&dir) else {
        eprintln!("no captures/ here; skipped");
        return;
    };
    let mut dirs: Vec<PathBuf> = entries.map(|e| e.unwrap().path()).filter(|p| p.is_dir()).collect();
    dirs.sort();
    for d in dirs {
        let mut files: Vec<PathBuf> = std::fs::read_dir(&d)
            .unwrap()
            .map(|e| e.unwrap().path())
            .filter(|p| p.extension().is_some_and(|e| e == "jsonl"))
            .collect();
        files.sort();
        if files.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let name = d.file_name().unwrap().to_string_lossy().to_string();
        check(&format!("capture-{name}"), &files);
    }
}
```

`crates/pt-replay/tests/real_captures.rs`:

```rs
//! Regression tests on real game captures (ATS 1.61.2.0s, 2026-09-28), trimmed
//! with `pt-replay --trim-to ... --every 15`: every non-sample message and its
//! neighbouring samples are kept, other samples decimated to 4 Hz, seq
//! renumbered, module lists redacted, heartbeats dropped. Odometer distances
//! survive exactly. What happened in each is documented in docs/PLAN.md §3/§6.

use std::path::Path;

use pt_core::job::JobType;
use pt_core::rules::{Context, DiscardReason, Outcome, ReviewReason};
use pt_core::Config;
use pt_core::timeline::{GapKind, JobEvent, JobState, StartKind};
use pt_replay::{order_sessions, parse_lines, read_lines, replay, sample_config, Replayed};

fn run(name: &str) -> Vec<Replayed> {
    run_with(name, &sample_config(), &Context::default())
}

fn run_with(name: &str, cfg: &Config, ctx: &Context) -> Vec<Replayed> {
    let path = Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("tests/fixtures/real").join(name);
    let (mut frames, bad) = parse_lines(&read_lines(&path).expect("fixture"), cfg);
    assert_eq!(bad, 0);
    order_sessions(&mut frames);
    replay(&frames, cfg, ctx)
}

fn find<'a>(jobs: &'a [Replayed], cargo: &str) -> &'a Replayed {
    jobs.iter().find(|r| r.job.info.fingerprint.cargo.cargo_id == cargo).expect("job present")
}

fn count(events: &[JobEvent], f: impl Fn(&JobEvent) -> bool) -> usize {
    events.iter().filter(|e| f(e)).count()
}

fn close(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) -> bool {
    (a - b).abs() <= tol
}

/// The owner's ATS session of 2026-10-16: warp tests in free roam (no job),
/// then a road trip (`car_job`) in an F-150 across New Orleans, 34 km, with
/// three loads. After the first the game sent the trip back with its deadline
/// a minute later; after the second it never sent it again, yet delivered it.
#[test]
fn ats_road_trip_across_loads() {
    let jobs = run("ats-road-trip-car-job-loads.jsonl.gz");
    assert_eq!(jobs.len(), 1, "one road trip, not split at the loads");
    let r = &jobs[0];
    assert_eq!(r.job.info.fingerprint.route.job_type, JobType::Car);
    assert_eq!(r.job.info.fingerprint.cargo.cargo_id, "xfer_seals");
    assert_eq!(r.job.state, JobState::Delivered);
    assert_eq!(r.job.delivered.as_ref().and_then(|d| d.distance_km), Some(34.0));
    // The untracked end of the trip is a gap, so a moderator sees it.
    assert!(r.result.review.iter().any(|x| matches!(x, ReviewReason::Gap { .. })), "{:?}", r.result.review);
    // Up to 163 mph in the pickup: over the road-trip penalty limit (155 mph)
    // for more than 3 s, under its invalid limit (200 mph). 3.41 mi x 0.85.
    assert_eq!(r.result.speed.over_invalid_s, 0.0);
    assert!(r.result.speed.penalty && !r.result.speed.invalid, "{:?}", r.result.speed);
    assert_eq!(r.result.outcome, Outcome::PendingReview);
    assert_eq!(r.result.points, 2.8);
    // No warp while on the trip.
    assert!(!r.result.review.iter().any(|x| matches!(x, ReviewReason::TimeWarp { .. })));
}

/// Chicago → Chicago, planned 70 km: the game reported 71 km (game scale).
#[test]
fn chicago_clean_delivery() {
    let jobs = run("ats-chicago-clean-delivery.jsonl.gz");
    assert_eq!(jobs.len(), 1);
    let r = &jobs[0];
    assert_eq!((r.job.state, r.job.start), (JobState::Delivered, StartKind::Tracked));
    let d = &r.result.distances;
    assert!(close(d.tracked_counted_game_km, 70.72, 0.01));
    assert!(close(d.tracked_uncounted_game_km, 0.75, 0.01));
    assert!(close(d.driven_counted_world_km, 5.929, 0.002));
    assert_eq!(d.delivered_game_km, Some(71.0));
    assert_eq!(r.result.outcome, Outcome::Valid, "{:?}", r.result.review);
    assert_eq!(r.result.points, 3.6);
}

/// Chicago → Sioux Falls on TruckersMP, planned 1042 km: a 159 km empty drive
/// to the pickup, a game restart mid-job and an autosave load before the
/// pickup. The game reported 1233 km for the whole trip.
#[test]
fn sioux_falls_empty_leg_restart_and_autosave() {
    let jobs = run("ats-sioux-falls-tmp-empty-leg.jsonl.gz");
    let r = find(&jobs, "dynamite");
    assert_eq!((r.job.state, r.job.start), (JobState::Delivered, StartKind::Tracked));
    assert_eq!(count(&r.job.events, |e| matches!(e, JobEvent::SessionContinue { .. })), 1);
    assert_eq!(count(&r.job.events, |e| matches!(e, JobEvent::LoadTruncate { .. })), 1);
    let d = &r.result.distances;
    assert!(close(d.tracked_whole_game_km, 1232.13, 0.02));
    assert!(close(d.tracked_uncounted_game_km, 158.84, 0.02));
    assert!(close(d.counted_game_km, 1074.16, 0.02));
    assert!(r.result.truckersmp && !r.result.convoy);
    assert_eq!(r.result.outcome, Outcome::Valid, "{:?}", r.result.review);
    assert_eq!(r.result.points, 36.1);
    // The beverages job was cancelled at the start of the session.
    assert_eq!(find(&jobs, "beverages").job.state, JobState::Cancelled);
}

/// Port Angeles → Tacoma on TruckersMP: six loads between saves 139 and 143
/// (including loading forward onto reverted material), a ferry, an autosave
/// load back across it, F7, and a cancel.
#[test]
fn six_loads_ferry_f7_cancel() {
    let jobs = run("ats-tmp-six-loads-ferry-f7-cancel.jsonl.gz");
    let r = find(&jobs, "tyres");
    let ev = &r.job.events;
    assert_eq!(count(ev, |e| matches!(e, JobEvent::LoadTruncate { .. })), 4);
    assert_eq!(count(ev, |e| matches!(e, JobEvent::LoadRestore { .. })), 2, "143 after 139 restores");
    assert_eq!(count(ev, |e| matches!(e, JobEvent::Teleport { ferry_or_train: true, .. })), 1);
    assert_eq!(count(ev, |e| matches!(e, JobEvent::Teleport { ferry_or_train: false, .. })), 1, "F7");
    assert!(r.job.gaps.is_empty());
    assert_eq!(r.job.state, JobState::Cancelled);
    assert!(r.result.review.is_empty(), "loads and teleports raise nothing: {:?}", r.result.review);
    assert!(close(r.result.distances.tracked_whole_game_km, 33.77, 0.02));
}

/// The tampered run: a save with the odometer ×10, a developer-mode teleport to
/// the destination and a save-edited 1000 km delivery of a 7 km job. Also two
/// refuels and a profile switch (no profile notices yet, so it falls back to
/// load handling).
#[test]
fn save_edits_are_held_for_review() {
    let jobs = run("ats-save-edits-profile-refuel.jsonl.gz");
    let r = find(&jobs, "beverages");
    assert_eq!(r.job.state, JobState::Delivered);
    assert_eq!(r.result.outcome, Outcome::PendingReview);
    assert!(r.result.review.iter().any(|x| matches!(x, ReviewReason::DistanceMismatch { delivered_km, .. } if *delivered_km == 1000.0)));
    assert_eq!(r.job.gaps.iter().filter(|g| g.kind == GapKind::Load).count(), 1, "the odometer edit");
    assert_eq!(r.result.refuels.len(), 2);
    assert!(!r.result.review.iter().any(|x| matches!(x, ReviewReason::FuelJump { .. } | ReviewReason::NegativeFuel { .. })));
    assert_eq!(count(&r.job.events, |e| matches!(e, JobEvent::Teleport { .. })), 2);
    // The other profile's quick job is a separate (late-start) job.
    assert_eq!(find(&jobs, "moving_cont").job.info.fingerprint.route.job_market, "quick_job");
}

/// ETS2 1.61.1.1s on TruckersMP (2026-10-13; account ID replaced). Four jobs in one
/// session: a Norway job continued from an earlier session (four ferries,
/// delivered, a manual save loaded seven seconds later and delivered again);
/// Dover → Calais through the Channel Tunnel with the empty drive to the
/// pickup; a 1 km quick job interrupted by a switch to another profile (whose
/// own quick job was accepted) and back.
#[test]
fn ets2_truckersmp_norway_tunnel_and_profiles() {
    let jobs = run("ets2-tmp-norway-tunnel-profiles.jsonl.gz");
    assert_eq!(jobs.len(), 4);
    for r in &jobs {
        assert!(r.result.truckersmp && !r.result.convoy, "TruckersMP SDK says connected");
    }

    // Loaded back into a delivered job and delivered again: counted once.
    let norway = jobs.iter().find(|r| r.job.info.fingerprint.route.source_city == "honningsvag").expect("norway");
    assert_eq!((norway.job.state, norway.job.start), (JobState::Stopped, StartKind::LateStart));
    assert_eq!(count(&norway.job.events, |e| matches!(e, JobEvent::Delivered { .. })), 1);
    assert_eq!(count(&norway.job.events, |e| matches!(e, JobEvent::DuplicateDelivery { .. })), 1);
    assert_eq!(norway.result.distances.delivered_game_km, Some(2512.0));
    assert_eq!(norway.result.outcome, Outcome::PendingReview);
    assert_eq!(norway.result.review, vec![ReviewReason::LateStart]);

    // The tunnel is a teleport and adds nothing; distance.km leaves it out too
    // (239 reported, 238.87 tracked). UK roads are scale 15.
    let tunnel = jobs.iter().find(|r| r.job.info.fingerprint.route.source_city == "dover").expect("dover");
    assert_eq!((tunnel.job.state, tunnel.job.start), (JobState::Delivered, StartKind::Tracked));
    assert_eq!(count(&tunnel.job.events, |e| matches!(e, JobEvent::Teleport { ferry_or_train: true, .. })), 1);
    let d = &tunnel.result.distances;
    assert_eq!(d.delivered_game_km, Some(239.0));
    assert!(close(d.tracked_whole_game_km, 238.87, 0.01));
    assert!(close(d.tracked_uncounted_game_km, 113.30, 0.01), "empty drive to the pickup");
    assert_eq!(tunnel.result.outcome, Outcome::Valid, "{:?}", tunnel.result.review);
    assert_eq!(tunnel.result.points, 7.0);

    // 1 km quick job: tracked 1.8 km against a whole-km report of 1 km is within
    // the reporting resolution. The return to its profile reloads its autosave.
    let quick = find(&jobs, "med_equip");
    assert_eq!(quick.job.state, JobState::Delivered);
    assert_eq!(count(&quick.job.events, |e| matches!(e, JobEvent::LoadTruncate { .. })), 1);
    // It paid 388 for 1 km (624 a mile): over the income limit, which applies to
    // every job however short (owner, 2026-10-16).
    assert_eq!(quick.result.outcome, Outcome::PendingReview);
    assert!(matches!(quick.result.review[..], [ReviewReason::HighIncome { income: 388, .. }]), "{:?}", quick.result.review);

    // The other profile's quick job, accepted right after its autosave loaded
    // (no job in the save), was seen from its start; it was never delivered.
    let apples = find(&jobs, "apples");
    assert_eq!(apples.job.start, StartKind::Tracked);
    assert_eq!(apples.result.outcome, Outcome::Incomplete);
}

/// ETS2 1.61.1.1s, a Convoy hosted alone (2026-10-13): a quick job accepted
/// right after the start autosave loaded, then the Convoy session started and
/// the job was driven about 80 s. TruckersMP was not loaded.
#[test]
fn ets2_convoy_with_a_quick_job() {
    let jobs = run("ets2-convoy-quick-job.jsonl.gz");
    assert_eq!(jobs.len(), 1);
    let r = &jobs[0];
    assert_eq!(r.job.info.fingerprint.cargo.cargo_id, "hvac");
    assert_eq!((r.job.state, r.job.start), (JobState::Tracking, StartKind::Tracked));
    assert!(r.result.convoy && !r.result.truckersmp, "multiplayer.time.offset 3..5, no TruckersMP");
    assert!(r.job.events.iter().all(|e| !matches!(e, JobEvent::LoadTruncate { .. } | JobEvent::LoadGap { .. })), "hosting is not a load");
    assert_eq!(r.result.outcome, Outcome::Incomplete);
}

/// The owner's first HaulMP job (ETS2 1.61.1.9s, HaulMP v814, Traffic server,
/// 2026-10-22): Dover → Groningen across three game sessions, with the Dover →
/// Calais ferry. HaulMP keeps `multiplayer.time.offset` at 0 and runs the game
/// clock at `local.scale`, so only its module names (kept by redaction as
/// `mod_matches`) tell it from singleplayer.
#[test]
fn ets2_haulmp_job_across_sessions() {
    let name = "ets2-haulmp-ferry-three-sessions.jsonl.gz";
    let jobs = run(name);
    assert_eq!(jobs.len(), 1);
    let r = &jobs[0];
    assert_eq!(r.job.info.fingerprint.cargo.cargo_id, "jcb_pw125qe");
    assert_eq!((r.job.state, r.job.start), (JobState::Delivered, StartKind::Tracked));
    let ev = &r.job.events;
    assert_eq!(count(ev, |e| matches!(e, JobEvent::Teleport { ferry_or_train: true, .. })), 1, "the ferry");
    assert_eq!(count(ev, |e| matches!(e, JobEvent::SessionContinue { .. })), 2, "two game restarts");
    assert!(r.job.gaps.is_empty());
    assert_eq!(r.result.multiplayer_mod.as_deref(), Some("haulmp"));
    assert!(!r.result.truckersmp && !r.result.convoy);
    assert_eq!(r.result.distances.delivered_game_km, Some(603.0));
    assert!(close(r.result.distances.driven_counted_world_km, 36.248, 0.002));
    assert_eq!(r.result.outcome, Outcome::Valid, "{:?}", r.result.review);
    assert_eq!(r.result.points, 22.5);

    // The Singleplayer Division discards it, as configured for HaulMP.
    let sp = Context { singleplayer_division: true, ..Context::default() };
    let r = &run_with(name, &sample_config(), &sp)[0];
    assert_eq!(r.result.outcome, Outcome::Discarded);
    assert_eq!(r.result.discard, Some(DiscardReason::SingleplayerDivisionMultiplayerMod));
    assert_eq!(r.result.points, 0.0);

    // With the toggle off it counts for them too.
    let mut keep = sample_config();
    keep.multiplayer.mods.iter_mut().for_each(|m| m.singleplayer_division_discard = false);
    assert_eq!(run_with(name, &keep, &sp)[0].result.outcome, Outcome::Valid);

    // A config without HaulMP sees singleplayer, as clients did before.
    let mut none = sample_config();
    none.multiplayer.mods.clear();
    let r = &run_with(name, &none, &sp)[0];
    assert_eq!(r.result.multiplayer_mod, None);
    assert!(!r.result.truckersmp && !r.result.convoy);
    assert_eq!(r.result.outcome, Outcome::Valid);
}

/// The owner's first TrucklineMP job (ETS2 1.61.1.9s, launcher 1.2.3,
/// 2026-10-23): Calais → Reims, 274 km, from the client's own database (capture
/// mode was off). The server holds the game clock at a game minute per 9 real
/// seconds, pulling the game's own steps back a minute about 100 times.
#[test]
fn ets2_trucklinemp_server_clock() {
    let name = "ets2-trucklinemp-calais-reims.jsonl.gz";
    let jobs = run(name);
    let r = jobs.iter().find(|r| r.job.state == JobState::Delivered).expect("delivered job");
    assert_eq!(r.job.info.fingerprint.cargo.cargo_id, "frozen_hake");
    assert_eq!(r.result.multiplayer_mod.as_deref(), Some("trucklinemp"));
    assert!(!r.result.truckersmp && !r.result.convoy);
    assert_eq!(r.result.distances.delivered_game_km, Some(274.0));
    assert_eq!((r.result.outcome, r.result.points), (Outcome::Valid, 10.2), "{:?}", r.result.review);
    // The pullbacks cancel: 91 game minutes at the server rate are the 13.7
    // real minutes driven, not 191 minutes counted one step at a time.
    let d = &r.result.distances;
    assert_eq!(d.driven_game_min, 91.0);
    assert!(close(d.driven_game_clock_min, d.driven_s / 60.0, 0.3), "{} vs {}", d.driven_game_clock_min, d.driven_s / 60.0);

    let sp = Context { singleplayer_division: true, ..Context::default() };
    let r = run_with(name, &sample_config(), &sp).into_iter().find(|r| r.job.state == JobState::Delivered).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.result.discard, Some(DiscardReason::SingleplayerDivisionMultiplayerMod));
}

/// The server snapshots the timeline between batches (PLAN §7a): stopping
/// anywhere, serialising and continuing must give exactly the same jobs.
#[test]
fn a_snapshot_mid_capture_replays_identically() {
    let path = Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("tests/fixtures/real/ets2-tmp-norway-tunnel-profiles.jsonl.gz");
    let cfg = sample_config();
    let (mut frames, _) = parse_lines(&read_lines(&path).expect("fixture"), &cfg);
    order_sessions(&mut frames);
    let straight = replay(&frames, &cfg, &Context::default());
    for cut in [frames.len() / 3, frames.len() / 2, frames.len() * 9 / 10] {
        let mut a = pt_core::timeline::Profiles::new(cfg.clone());
        for f in &frames[..cut] {
            a.push(f);
        }
        let json = serde_json::to_string(&a).expect("serialise");
        let mut b: pt_core::timeline::Profiles = serde_json::from_str(&json).expect("deserialise");
        for f in &frames[cut..] {
            b.push(f);
        }
        let jobs = b.into_jobs();
        assert_eq!(jobs.len(), straight.len());
        for (j, s) in jobs.iter().zip(&straight) {
            assert_eq!(j, &s.job, "cut at {cut}");
            assert_eq!(pt_core::rules::evaluate(j, &cfg, &Context::default()), s.result);
        }
    }
}
```

`crates/pt-replay/tests/scenarios.rs`:

```rs
//! Replay fixtures for every case in PLAN §10 plus the decisions of PLAN §11.
//! Each test drives the simulator (tests/sim) and checks the job the shared
//! timeline and rules produce.

mod sim;

use pt_core::rules::{Bonus, BonusKind, Context, DiscardReason, Outcome, ReviewReason};
use pt_core::timeline::{GapKind, JobEvent, JobState, StartKind};
use pt_core::job::JobType;
use pt_core::Game;
use sim::{rescore, JobSpec, Sim};

fn has<F: Fn(&JobEvent) -> bool>(events: &[JobEvent], f: F) -> bool {
    events.iter().any(f)
}

fn reasons(r: &pt_core::rules::JobResult) -> Vec<String> {
    r.review.iter().map(|x| format!("{x:?}")).collect()
}

fn close(a: f64, b: f64, tol: f64) -> bool {
    (a - b).abs() <= tol
}

/// Accept with an empty drive to the pickup, load, drive, deliver with the
/// game's figure = the whole trip (as measured on the Sioux Falls job).
#[test]
fn clean_delivery_scores_loaded_distance_at_1_to_1() {
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("dynamite").empty_leg());
    s.drive_km(10.0);
    s.load_cargo();
    s.drive_km(200.0);
    s.deliver(210.0);
    let (job, r) = s.job("dynamite");
    assert_eq!(job.state, JobState::Delivered);
    assert_eq!(job.start, StartKind::Tracked);
    assert_eq!(r.outcome, Outcome::Valid, "{:?}", r.review);
    assert!(close(r.distances.tracked_uncounted_game_km, 10.0, 0.05));
    assert!(close(r.distances.counted_game_km, 200.0, 0.05));
    // 200 game km at scale 20 = 10 km 1:1 = 6.21371 mi -> 6.2 points.
    assert!(close(r.distances.world_km, 10.0, 0.01));
    assert_eq!(r.points, 6.2);
}

// ---- spec boundaries ---------------------------------------------------------

fn speed_run(game: &'static str, mph: f64, secs: f64) -> pt_core::rules::JobResult {
    let mut s = Sim::new(game);
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
    s.drive_km(5.0);
    s.drive_secs(secs, mph);
    s.drive_km(5.0);
    let whole = s.odo;
    let _ = whole;
    s.deliver(10.0);
    s.job("tyres").1
}

#[test]
fn ats_speed_limits_exactly_on_the_limit_are_not_over() {
    let r = speed_run("ats", 105.0, 10.0);
    assert!(!r.speed.penalty, "exactly 105.0 mph is not over 105");
    let r = speed_run("ats", 105.01, 4.0);
    assert!(r.speed.penalty && !r.speed.invalid);
    let r = speed_run("ats", 125.0, 10.0);
    assert!(!r.speed.invalid, "exactly 125.0 mph is not over 125");
    let r = speed_run("ats", 125.01, 4.0);
    assert!(r.speed.invalid);
    assert_eq!(r.outcome, Outcome::Invalid);
    assert_eq!(r.points, 0.0);
}

#[test]
fn ets2_speed_limits_exactly_on_the_limit_are_not_over() {
    assert!(!speed_run("eut2", 100.0, 10.0).speed.penalty);
    assert!(speed_run("eut2", 100.01, 4.0).speed.penalty);
    assert!(!speed_run("eut2", 150.0, 10.0).speed.invalid);
    assert!(speed_run("eut2", 150.01, 4.0).speed.invalid);
}

#[test]
fn a_one_second_spike_is_not_sustained_overspeed() {
    let r = speed_run("ats", 140.0, 1.0);
    assert!(!r.speed.invalid && !r.speed.penalty);
    assert!(r.speed.peak_mph > 139.0);
    let r = speed_run("ats", 140.0, 3.5);
    assert!(r.speed.invalid);
}

    }
    s.drive_km(5.0);
    s.deliver(10.0);

    assert!(r.speed.penalty, "4.5 s over 105 split by pauses is still sustained");
}

#[test]
fn review_threshold_150_vs_150_1_world_km() {
    for (delivered, over) in [(150.0, false), (150.1, true)] {
        let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
        s.scale = 1.0; // a 1:1 map: game km = world km
        s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
        s.drive_km(150.0);
        s.deliver(delivered);
        let (_, r) = s.job("tyres");
        let long = r.review.iter().any(|x| matches!(x, ReviewReason::LongJob { .. }));
        assert_eq!(long, over, "delivered {delivered}: {:?}", r.review);
    }
}

#[test]
fn fuel_jump_within_tolerance_is_silent_beyond_it_is_reviewed() {
    for (jump, flagged) in [(0.3, false), (1.0, true)] {
        let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
        s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
        s.drive_km(5.0);
        s.fuel += jump;
        s.drive_km(5.0);
        s.deliver(10.0);
        let (_, r) = s.job("tyres");
        let fuel = r.review.iter().any(|x| matches!(x, ReviewReason::FuelJump { .. } | ReviewReason::NegativeFuel { .. }));
        assert_eq!(fuel, flagged, "jump {jump}: {:?}", r.review);
        if flagged {
            assert_eq!(r.outcome, Outcome::PendingReview, "negative fuel holds the points for review");
        }
    }
}

#[test]
fn a_crash_mid_job_continues_or_loads_the_autosave() {
    // Restarted where it was: the job just continues, distance bridged.
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
    s.drive_km(20.0);
    s.crash(None);
    s.drive_km(20.0);
    s.deliver(40.0);
    let (job, r) = s.job("tyres");
    assert!(has(&job.events, |e| matches!(e, JobEvent::SessionContinue { .. })));
    assert_eq!(r.outcome, Outcome::Valid, "{:?}", r.review);
    assert!(close(r.distances.tracked_whole_game_km, 40.0, 0.05));

    // Restarted from an older autosave: a load back to it.
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
    s.drive_km(10.0);
    let autosave = s.save();
    s.drive_km(20.0);
    s.crash(Some(&autosave));
    s.drive_km(20.0);
    s.deliver(30.0);
    let (job, r) = s.job("tyres");
    assert!(has(&job.events, |e| matches!(e, JobEvent::LoadTruncate { .. })));
    assert!(close(r.distances.tracked_whole_game_km, 30.0, 0.05));
    assert_eq!(r.outcome, Outcome::Valid, "{:?}", r.review);
}

#[test]
fn the_greatest_bonus_applies_and_stacks_with_the_penalty() {
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("dynamite"));
    s.drive_km(100.0);
    s.drive_secs(4.0, 110.0);
    s.drive_km(100.0);
    let whole: f64 = 200.0 + 4.0 * 110.0 / 2.23694 * 20.0 / 1000.0;
    s.deliver(whole.round());
    let (job, _) = s.job("dynamite");
    let bonus = |kind, amount, m: &str| Bonus {
        id: String::new(),
        exact: false,
        game: Game::Ats,
        cargo_match: m.into(),
        kind,
        amount,
        active_from_ms: None,
        active_to_ms: None,
    };
    let ctx = Context {
        bonuses: vec![
            bonus(BonusKind::Multiplier, 2.0, "dynamite"),
            bonus(BonusKind::Flat, 100.0, "dyna*"),
            bonus(BonusKind::Flat, 500.0, "tyres"),
        ],
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let r = rescore(&job, &ctx);
    assert!(r.speed.penalty);
    let accepted = r.distances.world_mi * 0.85;
    assert!(close(r.accepted_world_mi, accepted, 1e-9));
    assert_eq!(r.bonus.as_ref().map(|b| b.kind), Some(BonusKind::Flat), "flat 100 beats x2 on ~9 mi");
    assert_eq!(r.points, ((accepted + 100.0) * 10.0).floor() / 10.0);
}

}

// ---- save-load scenarios -------------------------------------------------------

fn future(s: &Sim, game_km: f64) -> sim::Snap {
    let mut f = s.save();
    f.odo += game_km;
    f.pos[0] += game_km * 1000.0 / s.scale;
    f.fuel -= 10.0;
    f.gt += 90.0;
    f
}

#[test]
fn load_forward_on_the_same_job_then_deliver() {
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
    s.drive_km(50.0);
    let ahead = future(&s, 100.0);
    s.load(&ahead);
    s.drive_km(50.0);
    s.deliver(200.0);
    let (job, r) = s.job("tyres");
    assert_eq!(job.gaps.iter().filter(|g| g.kind == GapKind::Load).count(), 1);
    assert!(reasons(&r).iter().any(|x| x.starts_with("Gap")), "{:?}", r.review);
    assert!(!r.review.iter().any(|x| matches!(x, ReviewReason::DistanceMismatch { .. })), "gap counted in the whole trip");
    assert_eq!(r.outcome, Outcome::PendingReview);
}

}

#[test]

#[test]
fn load_forward_then_back_past_the_gap_reverts_the_gap() {
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
    s.drive_km(10.0);
    let before_gap = s.save();
    s.drive_km(10.0);
    let ahead = future(&s, 100.0);
    s.load(&ahead);
    s.drive_km(10.0);
    s.load(&before_gap);
    s.drive_km(20.0);
    s.deliver(30.0);
    let (job, r) = s.job("tyres");
    assert_eq!(job.gaps.len(), 1, "the gap stays in the trace");
    assert_eq!(job.active_gaps().count(), 0, "but it was reverted");
    assert_eq!(r.outcome, Outcome::Valid, "{:?}", r.review);
    assert!(close(r.distances.tracked_whole_game_km, 30.0, 0.05));
}

#[test]
fn load_forward_onto_a_different_jobs_save() {
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
    s.drive_km(20.0);
    let mut other = future(&s, 50.0);
    other.job = Some(JobSpec::new("bricks").to("denver"));
    s.load(&other);
    s.drive_km(10.0);
    let jobs = s.replay();
    let tyres = jobs.iter().find(|r| r.job.info.fingerprint.cargo.cargo_id == "tyres").unwrap();
    let bricks = jobs.iter().find(|r| r.job.info.fingerprint.cargo.cargo_id == "bricks").unwrap();
    assert_eq!(tyres.job.state, JobState::Suspended);
    assert!(tyres.result.review.is_empty(), "suspended, not penalised");
    assert_eq!(bricks.job.start, StartKind::LateStart);
}

#[test]
fn load_into_an_already_delivered_job_stops_tracking() {
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
    s.drive_km(10.0);
    let mid = s.save();
    s.drive_km(10.0);
    s.deliver(20.0);
    s.load(&mid);
    s.drive_km(10.0);
    s.deliver(20.0);
    let (job, r) = s.job("tyres");
    assert_eq!(job.state, JobState::Stopped);
    assert!(has(&job.events, |e| matches!(e, JobEvent::StoppedAfterDelivery { .. })));
    assert!(has(&job.events, |e| matches!(e, JobEvent::DuplicateDelivery { .. })));
    assert_eq!(r.outcome, Outcome::Valid, "the first delivery stands: {:?}", r.review);
    assert!(close(r.distances.tracked_whole_game_km, 20.0, 0.05), "nothing after the stop is recorded");
}

#[test]
fn a_late_start_takes_the_games_distance_and_goes_to_review() {
    let mut s = Sim::with_job("ats", Some(JobSpec::new("tyres")));
    s.drive_km(40.0);
    s.deliver(100.0); // the game knows the 60 km driven before tracking began
    let (job, r) = s.job("tyres");
    assert_eq!(job.start, StartKind::LateStart);
    assert!(r.review.iter().any(|x| matches!(x, ReviewReason::LateStart)));
    assert!(!r.review.iter().any(|x| matches!(x, ReviewReason::DistanceMismatch { .. })));
    assert!(close(r.distances.counted_game_km, 100.0, 1e-9));
    assert!(close(r.distances.world_km, 5.0, 0.01));
}

#[test]
fn an_invalid_status_is_cleared_by_a_load() {
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
    s.drive_km(10.0);
    let before = s.save();
    s.drive_secs(5.0, 200.0); // falling under the map
    s.load(&before);
    s.drive_km(10.0);
    s.deliver(20.0);
    let (job, r) = s.job("tyres");
    assert!(!r.speed.invalid);
    assert!(job.reverted.iter().any(|b| b.points.iter().any(|p| p.mph() > 190.0)), "kept as evidence");
    assert_eq!(r.outcome, Outcome::Valid, "{:?}", r.review);
}

#[test]
fn a_delivered_invalid_job_is_reopened_by_a_load_then_delivered_clean() {
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
    s.drive_km(10.0);
    let before = s.save();
    s.drive_secs(5.0, 200.0);
    s.drive_km(5.0);
    s.deliver(15.0);
    assert_eq!(s.job("tyres").1.outcome, Outcome::Invalid);
    s.load(&before);
    s.drive_km(10.0);
    s.deliver(20.0);
    let (job, r) = s.job("tyres");

    assert_eq!(job.reverted_deliveries.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(r.outcome, Outcome::Valid, "{:?}", r.review);
}

#[test]
fn singleplayer_division_discards_truckersmp_but_scores_convoy() {
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.truckersmp();
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
    s.drive_km(20.0);
    s.deliver(20.0);
    let (job, r) = s.job("tyres");
    assert!(r.truckersmp && !r.convoy);
    assert_eq!(r.outcome, Outcome::Valid, "tracked like any job");
    let sp = rescore(&job, &Context { singleplayer_division: true, ..Default::default() });
    assert_eq!(sp.discard, Some(DiscardReason::SingleplayerDivisionTruckersmp));

    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.mp_offset = 24_136_737;
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
    s.drive_km(20.0);
    s.deliver(20.0);
    let (job, r) = s.job("tyres");
    assert!(r.convoy && !r.truckersmp);
    let sp = rescore(&job, &Context { singleplayer_division: true, ..Default::default() });
    assert_eq!(sp.outcome, Outcome::Valid);
}

#[test]
fn a_profile_switch_mid_job_keeps_separate_timelines() {
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.profile("P1");
    s.idle(0.5); // the profile's world is sampled before a job is taken
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
    s.drive_km(10.0);
    let p1 = s.save();
    let mut p2 = s.save();
    p2.job = Some(JobSpec::new("bricks").to("denver"));
    p2.pos[0] += 50_000.0;
    p2.odo = 500.0;
    s.profile("P2");
    s.load(&p2);
    s.drive_km(10.0);
    s.profile("P1");
    s.load(&p1);
    s.drive_km(10.0);
    s.deliver(20.0);
    let jobs = s.replay();
    let tyres = jobs.iter().find(|r| r.job.info.fingerprint.cargo.cargo_id == "tyres").unwrap();
    let bricks = jobs.iter().find(|r| r.job.info.fingerprint.cargo.cargo_id == "bricks").unwrap();
    assert_eq!(tyres.job.profile, "P1");
    assert_eq!(bricks.job.profile, "P2");
    assert!(!has(&tyres.job.events, |e| matches!(e, JobEvent::Suspended { .. })), "{:?}", tyres.job.events);
    assert_eq!(tyres.result.outcome, Outcome::Valid, "{:?}", tyres.result.review);
    assert!(close(tyres.result.distances.tracked_whole_game_km, 20.0, 0.05));
}

}

#[test]
fn revert_then_restore_keeps_the_overspeed() {
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
    s.drive_km(10.0);
    let a = s.save();
    s.drive_secs(5.0, 110.0);
    s.drive_km(2.0);
    let b = s.save();
    s.load(&a);
    s.idle(1.0); // the game always samples after a load
    s.load(&b); // back onto the reverted branch
    s.drive_km(10.0);
    let whole = s.odo;
    let _ = whole;
    s.deliver(22.0);
    let (job, r) = s.job("tyres");
    assert!(has(&job.events, |e| matches!(e, JobEvent::LoadRestore { .. })));
    assert!(r.speed.penalty, "the restored overspeed counts");
}

#[test]
fn accepting_a_job_or_a_quick_job_is_not_a_load() {
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.drive_km(2.0);
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
    s.drive_km(5.0);
    s.deliver(5.0);
    s.switch_truck("vehicle.freightliner.cascadia2024", 0.085);
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("moving_cont").market("quick_job").to("las_vegas"));
    s.drive_km(5.0);
    s.deliver(5.0);
    for r in s.replay() {
        assert_eq!(r.job.start, StartKind::Tracked, "{:?}", r.job.events);
        assert!(!has(&r.job.events, |e| matches!(e, JobEvent::LoadTruncate { .. } | JobEvent::LoadGap { .. } | JobEvent::LoadRestore { .. })));
        assert_eq!(r.result.outcome, Outcome::Valid, "{:?}", r.result.review);
    }
}

#[test]
fn delivery_and_cancel_ordering_attribute_to_the_last_job() {
    // deliver(): event before the config empties; cancel(): config empties first.
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
    s.drive_km(5.0);
    s.cancel();
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("bricks").to("denver"));
    s.drive_km(5.0);
    s.deliver(5.0);
    assert_eq!(s.job("tyres").0.state, JobState::Cancelled);
    assert_eq!(s.job("bricks").0.state, JobState::Delivered);
}

#[test]
fn a_delivery_while_the_client_was_closed_still_scores() {
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
    s.drive_km(20.0);
    let cut = s.lines.len();
    s.drive_km(10.0);
    let resume = s.lines.len();
    s.drive_km(10.0);
    s.deliver(40.0);
    // The plugin journals durable messages but samples older than its replay
    // buffer are lost: drop 10 km of samples.
    s.lines.drain(cut..resume);
    let (job, r) = s.job("tyres");
    assert_eq!(job.state, JobState::Delivered);
    assert!(job.gaps.iter().any(|g| g.kind == GapKind::Bridge));
    assert_eq!(r.outcome, Outcome::Valid, "{:?}", r.review);
    assert!(close(r.distances.tracked_whole_game_km, 40.0, 0.05));
}

#[test]

#[test]
fn a_road_trip_is_tracked_like_freight() {

    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("xfer_seals").road_trip());
    s.drive_km(30.0);
    s.deliver(30.0);
    let (job, r) = s.job("xfer_seals");
    assert_eq!(job.info.fingerprint.route.job_type, JobType::Car);
    assert_eq!(job.info.fingerprint.route.job_market, "dispatch_job");
    assert_eq!(job.state, JobState::Delivered);
    assert_eq!(r.outcome, Outcome::Valid, "{:?}", r.review);
    assert!(r.points > 0.0);
}

#[test]
fn road_trips_have_their_own_speed_limits() {
    // ATS road trips (owner, 2026-10-16): penalty over 155 mph, invalid over 200.
    let trip = |mph: f64, road_trip: bool| {
        let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
        let spec = JobSpec::new("xfer_seals");
        s.accept(if road_trip { spec.road_trip() } else { spec });
        s.drive_secs(60.0, 60.0);
        s.drive_secs(10.0, mph);
        s.drive_secs(60.0, 60.0);
        s.deliver(30.0);
        s.job("xfer_seals").1
    };
    let r = trip(150.0, true);
    assert!(!r.speed.penalty && !r.speed.invalid, "{:?}", r.speed);
    let r = trip(160.0, true);
    assert!(r.speed.penalty && !r.speed.invalid, "{:?}", r.speed);
    let r = trip(205.0, true);
    assert!(r.speed.invalid, "{:?}", r.speed);
    assert_eq!(r.outcome, Outcome::Invalid);
    // A truck at 150 mph is still invalid (ATS: over 125).
    let r = trip(150.0, false);
    assert!(r.speed.invalid, "{:?}", r.speed);
}

#[test]
fn a_freight_delivery_never_ends_a_road_trip() {

}

#[test]
fn income_over_the_limits_is_held_for_review() {
    // Owner, 2026-10-16: over 400 a mile of the game's delivery distance, or
    // over 500,000 in all (possible on a very long job: a review, not invalid).
    let pays = |km: f64, revenue: i64| {
        let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
        s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
        s.drive_km(km);
        s.deliver_paid(km, revenue);
        s.job("tyres").1
    };
    let ok = pays(100.0, 100 * 400 * 62 / 100); // 400 a mile on the dot
    assert!(!ok.review.iter().any(|r| matches!(r, ReviewReason::HighIncome { .. })), "{:?}", ok.review);
    let r = pays(100.0, 30_000); // 483 a mile
    assert_eq!(r.outcome, Outcome::PendingReview);
    assert!(matches!(r.review[..], [ReviewReason::HighIncome { income: 30_000, .. }]), "{:?}", r.review);
    // A long job at a normal rate, but over 500,000 in all.
    let r = pays(4000.0, 600_000); // 241 a mile
    assert!(r.review.iter().any(|x| matches!(x, ReviewReason::HighIncome { income: 600_000, .. })), "{:?}", r.review);
}

#[test]
fn the_warp_command_is_held_for_review() {
    // The owner's ATS test (2026-10-16): under `warp 2` every game clock runs
    // twice as fast as the PC's; the truck's speed looks normal.
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
    s.drive_secs(120.0, 60.0);
    s.warp = 2.0;
    s.drive_secs(120.0, 60.0);
    s.warp = 1.0;
    s.drive_secs(60.0, 60.0);
    s.deliver(21.0);
    let (_, r) = s.job("tyres");
    assert_eq!(r.outcome, Outcome::PendingReview);
    let warp = r.review.iter().find_map(|x| match x {
        ReviewReason::TimeWarp { max_factor, gained_s } => Some((*max_factor, *gained_s)),
        _ => None,
    });
    let (factor, gained) = warp.expect("time_warp raised");
    assert!(factor > 1.5, "{factor}");
    assert!(gained > 40.0, "{gained}");
    assert!(!r.review.iter().any(|x| matches!(x, ReviewReason::FastAverage { .. })), "the pace looks normal: {:?}", r.review);
}

#[test]
fn a_cargo_switch_goes_to_review_and_keeps_the_original_bonus_basis() {
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
    s.drive_km(10.0);
    let mut edited = s.save();
    if let Some(j) = edited.job.as_mut() {
        j.cargo = "gold".into();
    }
    s.load(&edited);
    s.drive_km(10.0);
    s.deliver(20.0);
    let (job, r) = s.job("gold");
    assert!(job.cargo_switched);
    assert_eq!(job.first_info.fingerprint.cargo.cargo_id, "tyres");
    assert!(r.review.iter().any(|x| matches!(x, ReviewReason::CargoSwitch)));
    let ctx = Context {
        bonuses: vec![Bonus {
            id: String::new(),
            exact: false,
            game: Game::Ats,
            cargo_match: "gold".into(),
            kind: BonusKind::Multiplier,
            amount: 10.0,
            active_from_ms: None,
            active_to_ms: None,
        }],
        ..Default::default()
    };
    assert!(rescore(&job, &ctx).bonus.is_none(), "no bonus for the switched-in cargo");
}

#[test]
fn the_truckersmp_sdk_tells_server_play_from_launcher_singleplayer() {
    // TruckersMP loaded (its DLL is in the process) but not on a server:
    // singleplayer through the TruckersMP launcher is not TruckersMP.
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.truckersmp();
    s.truckersmp_sdk(false);
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
    s.drive_km(20.0);
    s.deliver(20.0);
    let (job, r) = s.job("tyres");
    assert!(!r.truckersmp);
    let sp = rescore(&job, &Context { singleplayer_division: true, ..Default::default() });
    assert_eq!(sp.outcome, Outcome::Valid);

    // Connected to a server: TruckersMP, discarded for the Singleplayer Division.
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.truckersmp();
    s.truckersmp_sdk(true);
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
    s.drive_km(20.0);
    s.deliver(20.0);
    let (job, r) = s.job("tyres");
    assert!(r.truckersmp);
    let sp = rescore(&job, &Context { singleplayer_division: true, ..Default::default() });
    assert_eq!(sp.discard, Some(DiscardReason::SingleplayerDivisionTruckersmp));
}

fn a_whole_job_averaging_over_5_km_per_minute_goes_to_review() {

    // in game km: both pace checks fire (2026-10-14).
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");

}

#[test]
fn normal_driving_and_pauses_do_not_trip_the_pace_checks() {
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
    s.drive_secs(300.0, 60.0);
    s.pause();
    s.idle(0.0);
    s.drive_secs(300.0, 60.0);
    s.deliver(40.0);
    let (_, r) = s.job("tyres");
    assert!(
        !r.review.iter().any(|x| matches!(x, ReviewReason::FastAverage { .. } | ReviewReason::FastAverageGame { .. })),
        "{:?}",
        r.review
    );
}

#[test]
fn a_short_burst_is_not_averaged() {
    // Under a minute of driving: too short to average.
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
    s.drive_secs(30.0, 200.0);
    s.deliver(18.0);
    let (_, r) = s.job("tyres");
    assert!(!r.review.iter().any(|x| matches!(x, ReviewReason::FastAverage { .. } | ReviewReason::FastAverageGame { .. })));
}

#[test]
fn the_in_game_pace_check_uses_the_truckersmp_clock() {
    // On TruckersMP one in-game minute is 10 real seconds (6 per real minute),
    // not the map scale. 75 mph at road scale 20 would read 6.7 "km per minute"
    // if TruckersMP game minutes were treated like singleplayer ones.
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.truckersmp_sdk(true);
    s.time_rate = Some(6.0);
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
    s.drive_secs(1800.0, 75.0);
    s.deliver(1207.0);
    let (_, r) = s.job("tyres");
    assert!(r.truckersmp);
    assert!(!r.review.iter().any(|x| matches!(x, ReviewReason::FastAverage { .. } | ReviewReason::FastAverageGame { .. })), "{:?}", r.review);

    // A TruckersMP speed hack still trips both.
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.truckersmp_sdk(true);
    s.time_rate = Some(6.0);
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
    s.drive_secs(240.0, 200.0); // 24 in-game minutes at the TruckersMP rate
    s.deliver(429.0);
    let (_, r) = s.job("tyres");
    assert!(r.review.iter().any(|x| matches!(x, ReviewReason::FastAverage { .. })), "{:?}", r.review);
    assert!(r.review.iter().any(|x| matches!(x, ReviewReason::FastAverageGame { .. })), "{:?}", r.review);
}

// ---- bounded memory (PLAN §7a) -------------------------------------------------

/// Delivers a job, then the game restarts `hours_later` into a save taken
/// during that job and drives on.
fn restart_into_delivered_job(hours_later: f64) -> Sim {
    let mut s = Sim::new("ats");
    s.accept(JobSpec::new("tyres"));
    s.drive_km(10.0);
    let mid = s.save();
    s.drive_km(10.0);
    s.deliver(20.0);
    s.wall_ms += (hours_later * 3_600_000.0) as i64;
    s.restart(Some(&mid));
    s.drive_km(10.0);
    s
}

#[test]
fn a_delivered_job_stays_reopenable_inside_the_window() {
    let s = restart_into_delivered_job(47.0);
    let jobs = s.replay();
    assert_eq!(jobs.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(jobs[0].job.state, JobState::Stopped);
}

#[test]
fn a_job_finished_before_the_window_is_evicted_and_a_late_load_is_reviewed() {
    let s = restart_into_delivered_job(49.0);
    let cfg = pt_replay::sample_config();
    let (frames, _) = pt_replay::parse_lines(&s.lines, &cfg);
    let mut profiles = pt_core::timeline::Profiles::new(cfg.clone());
    let mut evicted = Vec::new();
    for f in &frames {
        profiles.push(f);
        evicted.extend(profiles.take_evicted());
    }
    assert_eq!(evicted.len(), 1, "evicted when the new session starts");
    assert_eq!(evicted[0].state, JobState::Delivered);
    let live: Vec<_> = profiles.jobs().collect();
    assert_eq!(live.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!((live[0].state, live[0].start), (JobState::Tracking, StartKind::LateStart));
    assert_ne!(live[0].id, evicted[0].id, "ids stay unique after eviction");
    // A full replay sees the same two jobs.
    let jobs = s.replay();
    assert_eq!(jobs.len(), 2);
    assert_eq!(jobs[0].result.outcome, Outcome::Valid, "{:?}", jobs[0].result.review);
}
```
