`crates/pt-replay/tests/sim/mod.rs`:

```rs
//! A tiny game simulator that writes plugin frames (docs/WIRE.md JSON), shaped
//! after the real captures in PLAN §3: loads empty `job` + `truck` inside a
//! pause, a new session starts with empty configs and `timer_restart`, samples
//! stop while paused, the odometer advances at world distance × `local.scale`.
#![allow(dead_code)]

use pt_core::rules::{evaluate, Context, JobResult};
use pt_core::timeline::Job;
use pt_replay::{parse_lines, replay, sample_config, Replayed};
use serde_json::{json, Value};

pub const MPS_PER_MPH: f64 = 1.0 / 2.23694;

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct JobSpec {
    pub cargo: String,
    pub source: String,
    pub destination: String,
    pub planned_km: u64,
    pub market: String,
    pub loaded: bool,
    pub deadline: u64,
    /// A road trip (`car_job`) instead of freight.
    pub car: bool,
}

impl JobSpec {
    pub fn new(cargo: &str) -> JobSpec {
        JobSpec {
            cargo: cargo.into(),
            source: "chicago".into(),
            destination: "sioux_falls".into(),
            planned_km: 1042,
            market: "cargo_market".into(),
            loaded: true,
            deadline: 10_402_602,
            car: false,
        }
    }
    /// A road trip in a car or pickup: `car_job`, with its own market key.
    pub fn road_trip(mut self) -> JobSpec {
        self.car = true;
        self.market = "dispatch_job".into();
        self
    }
    pub fn to(mut self, dest: &str) -> JobSpec {
        self.destination = dest.into();
        self
    }
    pub fn market(mut self, m: &str) -> JobSpec {
        self.market = m.into();
        self
    }
    pub fn empty_leg(mut self) -> JobSpec {
        self.loaded = false;
        self
    }
}

/// Everything a save file restores.
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Snap {
    pub odo: f64,
    pub fuel: f64,
    pub pos: [f64; 3],
    pub gt: f64,
    pub job: Option<JobSpec>,
    pub truck: String,
    pub connected: bool,
}

pub struct Sim {
    pub game: &'static str,
    sess_n: u32,
    pub sess: String,
    seq: u64,
    pub wall_ms: i64,
    pub sim_us: u64,
    pub odo: f64,
    pub fuel: f64,
    pub pos: [f64; 3],
    pub gt: f64,
    pub scale: f64,
    pub truck: String,
    pub connected: bool,
    pub mp_offset: i64,
    /// In-game minutes per real minute; `None` = `scale` (singleplayer). A
    /// TruckersMP server runs at 6 (one in-game minute every 10 s).
    pub time_rate: Option<f64>,
    pub job: Option<JobSpec>,
    pub lines: Vec<String>,
    /// The last job was a road trip: its config id empties, and its events fire.
    last_car: bool,
    /// The `warp` console command: game time per real time while driving.
    pub warp: f64,
    paused: bool,
}

impl Sim {
    /// A fresh game session in the world, unpaused, with no job.
    pub fn new(game: &'static str) -> Sim {
        Sim::with_job(game, None)
    }

    /// A session that starts with a job already in the save (a late start).
    pub fn with_job(game: &'static str, job: Option<JobSpec>) -> Sim {
        let mut s = Sim {
            game,
            sess_n: 0,
            sess: String::new(),
            seq: 0,
            wall_ms: 1_790_000_000_000,
            sim_us: 0,
            odo: 12_000.0,
            fuel: 800.0,
            pos: [1000.0, 10.0, -5000.0],
            gt: 10_400_000.0,
            scale: if game == "ats" { 20.0 } else { 19.0 },
            truck: "vehicle.volvo.vnl2025".into(),
            connected: true,
            mp_offset: 0,
            time_rate: None,
            job,
            lines: Vec::new(),
            last_car: false,
            warp: 1.0,
            paused: true,
        };
        s.boot(true);
        s
    }

    fn emit(&mut self, kind: &str, mut body: Value) {
        self.seq += 1;
        self.wall_ms += 5;
        let o = body.as_object_mut().expect("object");
        o.insert("v".into(), json!(1));
        o.insert("kind".into(), json!(kind));
        o.insert("sess".into(), json!(self.sess));
        o.insert("seq".into(), json!(self.seq));
        o.insert("wall_ms".into(), json!(self.wall_ms));
        o.insert("sim_us".into(), json!(self.sim_us));
        self.lines.push(body.to_string());
    }

    fn job_attrs(&self, j: &JobSpec) -> Value {
        let a = |n: &str, t: &str, v: Value| json!({"name": n, "index": null, "type": t, "value": v});
        json!([
            a("cargo.id", "string", json!(j.cargo)),
            a("cargo", "string", json!(j.cargo)),
            a("cargo.mass", "float", json!(11635.0)),
            a("cargo.unit.count", "u32", json!(25)),
            a("destination.company.id", "string", json!("dst_co")),
            a("source.company.id", "string", json!("src_co")),
            a("destination.city.id", "string", json!(j.destination)),
            a("source.city.id", "string", json!(j.source)),
            a("income", "u64", json!(4314)),
            a("delivery.time", "u32", json!(j.deadline)),
            a("planned_distance.km", "u32", json!(j.planned_km)),
            a("cargo.loaded", "bool", json!(j.loaded)),
            a(if j.car { "car_job.market" } else { "job.market" }, "string", json!(j.market)),
            a("is.special.job", "bool", json!(false)),
        ])
    }

    /// `job` or `car_job`: the config id and the gameplay event prefix.
    fn job_id(&mut self) -> &'static str {
        self.last_car = self.job.as_ref().map_or(self.last_car, |j| j.car);
        if self.last_car {
            "car_job"
        } else {
            "job"
        }
    }

    fn cfg_job(&mut self) {
        let attrs = match self.job.clone() {
            Some(j) => self.job_attrs(&j),
            None => json!([]),
        };
        let id = self.job_id();
        self.emit("config", json!({"id": id, "attrs": attrs}));
    }

    fn cfg_truck(&mut self, empty: bool) {
        let attrs = if empty {
            json!([])
        } else {
            json!([{"name": "id", "index": null, "type": "string", "value": self.truck}])
        };
        self.emit("config", json!({"id": "truck", "attrs": attrs}));
    }

    fn boot(&mut self, first: bool) {
        self.sess_n += 1;
        self.sess = format!("{:032x}", 0xabc0_0000u64 + self.sess_n as u64);
        self.seq = 0;
        self.sim_us = 0;
        let gid = self.game;
        self.emit("init", json!({"game_id": gid, "game_version": {"major": 1, "minor": 7}, "api_version": "1.01"}));
        self.emit("config", json!({"id": "job", "attrs": []}));
        self.emit("config", json!({"id": "truck", "attrs": []}));
        let _ = first;
        // The world loads: configs re-sent (job before truck, as the game does),
        // then timer_restart (PLAN §3).
        self.cfg_job();
        self.cfg_truck(false);
        self.emit("timer_restart", json!({"simulation_us": 16666, "render_us": 0}));
        self.sim_us = 16_666;
        self.paused = true;
        self.start();
        // The truck is sampled in the world before anything else happens.
        self.sample(0.0);
    }

    pub fn pause(&mut self) {
        if !self.paused {
            self.emit("paused", json!({}));
            self.paused = true;
        }
    }

    pub fn start(&mut self) {
        if self.paused {
            self.emit("started", json!({}));
            self.paused = false;
        }
    }

    pub fn sample(&mut self, speed_mps: f64) {
        let ch = json!({
            "truck.speed": speed_mps,
            "truck.odometer": self.odo as f32 as f64,
            "truck.fuel.amount": self.fuel,
            "truck.world.placement": {"position": {"x": self.pos[0], "y": self.pos[1], "z": self.pos[2]}},
            "game.time": self.gt as u64,
            "local.scale": self.scale,
            "multiplayer.time.offset": self.mp_offset,
            "trailer.0.connected": self.connected,
        });
        self.emit("sample", json!({"simulation_us": self.sim_us, "render_us": self.sim_us, "ch": ch, "stale": []}));
    }

    /// Drives for `secs` of simulation at `mph`, sampling at 20 Hz.
    pub fn drive_secs(&mut self, secs: f64, mph: f64) {
        self.start();
        let v = mph * MPS_PER_MPH;
        let steps = (secs * 20.0).round() as u64;
        for _ in 0..steps {
            self.sim_us += 50_000;
            self.wall_ms += (50.0 / self.warp).round() as i64;
            let world_m = v * 0.05;
            self.pos[0] += world_m;
            self.odo += world_m * self.scale / 1000.0;
            self.fuel -= world_m * 0.0004;
            self.gt += 0.05 * self.time_rate.unwrap_or(self.scale) / 60.0;
            self.sample(v);
        }
    }

    /// Drives `game_km` on the odometer at 60 mph.
    pub fn drive_km(&mut self, game_km: f64) {
        let v = 60.0 * MPS_PER_MPH;
        let secs = game_km * 1000.0 / (v * self.scale);
        self.drive_secs(secs, 60.0);
    }

    pub fn idle(&mut self, secs: f64) {
        self.drive_secs(secs, 0.0);
    }

    pub fn save(&self) -> Snap {
        Snap {
            odo: self.odo,
            fuel: self.fuel,
            pos: self.pos,
            gt: self.gt,
            job: self.job.clone(),
            truck: self.truck.clone(),
            connected: self.connected,
        }
    }

    fn restore(&mut self, s: &Snap) {
        self.odo = s.odo;
        self.fuel = s.fuel;
        self.pos = s.pos;
        self.gt = s.gt;
        self.job = s.job.clone();
        self.truck = s.truck.clone();
        self.connected = s.connected;
    }

    /// In-session load (quick-load, autosave or save menu): W inside a pause.
    pub fn load(&mut self, s: &Snap) {
        self.pause();
        self.emit("config", json!({"id": "job", "attrs": []}));
        self.emit("config", json!({"id": "truck", "attrs": []}));
        self.restore(s);
        self.wall_ms += 15_000;
        self.cfg_job();
        self.cfg_truck(false);
        self.start();
    }

    /// The game is closed normally, restarted and continues from `s` (or
    /// from where it was when `s` is `None`).
    pub fn restart(&mut self, s: Option<&Snap>) {
        self.pause();
        self.emit("shutdown", json!({}));
        if let Some(s) = s {
            self.restore(s);
        }
        self.wall_ms += 60_000;
        self.boot(false);
    }

    /// The game is killed: no shutdown message.
    pub fn crash(&mut self, s: Option<&Snap>) {
        if let Some(s) = s {
            self.restore(s);
        }
        self.wall_ms += 60_000;
        self.boot(false);
    }

    pub fn accept(&mut self, j: JobSpec) {
        self.pause();
        self.job = Some(j);
        self.cfg_job();
        self.start();
    }

    pub fn load_cargo(&mut self) {
        self.pause();
        if let Some(j) = self.job.as_mut() {
            j.loaded = true;
        }
        self.gt += 48.0;
        self.cfg_job();
        self.cfg_truck(false);
        self.start();
    }

    /// `job.delivered` with the game's distance, then the job config empties.
    pub fn deliver(&mut self, distance_km: f64) {
        // About 80 a mile, like real jobs (the income review is over 400).
        self.deliver_paid(distance_km, (distance_km * 50.0).round().max(1.0) as i64);
    }

    /// `job.delivered` paying `revenue`.
    pub fn deliver_paid(&mut self, distance_km: f64, revenue: i64) {
        self.pause();
        let a = |n: &str, t: &str, v: Value| json!({"name": n, "index": null, "type": t, "value": v});
        let attrs = json!([
            a("revenue", "s64", json!(revenue)),
            a("distance.km", "float", json!(distance_km)),
            a("delivery.time", "u32", json!(124)),
            a("auto.park.used", "bool", json!(true)),
        ]);
        let id = format!("{}.delivered", self.job_id());
        self.emit("gameplay", json!({"id": id, "attrs": attrs}));
        self.job = None;
        self.cfg_job();
        self.start();
    }

    /// Captured order: the job config empties first, then `job.cancelled`.
    pub fn cancel(&mut self) {
        self.pause();
        self.job = None;
        self.cfg_job();
        let attrs = json!([{"name": "cancel.penalty", "index": null, "type": "s64", "value": 12000}]);
        let id = format!("{}.cancelled", self.job_id());
        self.emit("gameplay", json!({"id": id, "attrs": attrs}));
        self.start();
    }

    /// F7, quick travel or a developer teleport: a jump inside a pause.
    pub fn teleport(&mut self, world_m: f64) {
        self.pause();
        self.pos[0] += world_m;
        self.start();
    }

    pub fn ferry(&mut self, world_m: f64) {
        self.pause();
        let attrs = json!([{"name": "source.id", "index": null, "type": "string", "value": "porttownsend"}]);
        self.emit("gameplay", json!({"id": "player.use.ferry", "attrs": attrs}));
        self.pos[0] += world_m;
        self.gt += 36.0;
        self.start();
    }

    pub fn switch_truck(&mut self, id: &str, odo: f64) {
        self.pause();
        self.truck = id.into();
        self.odo = odo;
        self.cfg_truck(false);
        self.start();
    }

    pub fn truckersmp(&mut self) {
        self.emit("modules", json!({"modules": ["KERNEL32.DLL", "core_atsmp.dll"]}));
    }

    /// The plugin's TruckersMP client SDK report (plugin/src/tmp.cpp).
    pub fn truckersmp_sdk(&mut self, connected: bool) {
        let server = if connected { 42 } else { 0 };
        self.emit("truckersmp", json!({"loaded": true, "connected": connected, "server_id": server, "account_id": 5557777}));
    }

    /// Client-inserted profile notice (PLAN §6b); not a plugin message, so no seq.
    pub fn profile(&mut self, key: &str) {
        self.lines.push(json!({"v": 1, "kind": "profile", "sess": self.sess, "wall_ms": self.wall_ms, "profile_key": key}).to_string());
    }

    /// A sample whose odometer moved by `game_km` (e.g. backwards) with no load.
    pub fn odometer_step(&mut self, game_km: f64) {
        self.odo += game_km;
        self.sim_us += 50_000;
        self.sample(0.0);
    }

    pub fn refuel(&mut self, litres: f64, l_per_s: f64) {
        self.start();
        let steps = (litres / l_per_s * 20.0).ceil() as u64;
        for _ in 0..steps {
            self.sim_us += 50_000;
            self.wall_ms += 50;
            self.fuel += l_per_s * 0.05;
            self.sample(0.0);
        }
    }

    pub fn replay_ctx(&self, ctx: &Context) -> Vec<Replayed> {
        let cfg = sample_config();
        let (frames, bad) = parse_lines(&self.lines, &cfg);
        assert_eq!(bad, 0);
        replay(&frames, &cfg, ctx)
    }

    pub fn replay(&self) -> Vec<Replayed> {
        self.replay_ctx(&Context::default())
    }

    /// The only job, or the job hauling `cargo`.
    pub fn job(&self, cargo: &str) -> (Job, JobResult) {
        let jobs = self.replay();
        let r = jobs
            .into_iter()
            .find(|r| r.job.info.fingerprint.cargo.cargo_id == cargo)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("no job hauling {cargo}"));
        (r.job, r.result)
    }
}

pub fn rescore(job: &Job, ctx: &Context) -> JobResult {
    evaluate(job, &sample_config(), ctx)
}
```

`crates/pt-server/migrations/0001_init.sql`:

```sql
-- PlasmaTrack server schema (D1 = SQLite). Applied with
-- `wrangler d1 migrations apply`, and by the native tests (pt-server).
-- Times are Unix milliseconds. Discord IDs are TEXT (snowflakes exceed 2^53).

CREATE TABLE users (
    user_id               TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    discord_user_id       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    display_name          TEXT NOT NULL,
    role                  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'player',   -- player | admin
    singleplayer_division INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    -- When the flag last changed: it applies to jobs delivered after that.
    division_changed_at   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    disabled              INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at            INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE tokens (
    token_id      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    token_sha256  TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    created_at    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    last_used_at  INTEGER,
    revoked_at    INTEGER
);
CREATE INDEX tokens_user ON tokens (user_id, revoked_at);

-- One row per plugin session of a player.
CREATE TABLE plugin_sessions (
    user_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    sess           TEXT NOT NULL,
    game           TEXT,                 -- ets2 | ats, once the init frame is seen
    first_wall_ms  INTEGER NOT NULL,     -- the player's clock: orders sessions
    received_at    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    hello          TEXT,
    client_version TEXT,
    config_hash    TEXT,
    config_json    TEXT,
    manifest       TEXT,
    stored_through INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,   -- highest plugin seq stored
    chunk_count    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    notes_seen     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',   -- identities of stored client notes
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, sess)
);
CREATE INDEX plugin_sessions_game ON plugin_sessions (user_id, game, first_wall_ms);

-- Raw frames live in R2; this indexes them. Only new frames are stored, so the
-- chunks of a session never overlap and replay in chunk_no order.
CREATE TABLE raw_chunks (
    user_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
    sess        TEXT NOT NULL,
    chunk_no    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    seq_from    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    seq_to      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    frames      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    bytes       INTEGER NOT NULL,
    r2_key      TEXT NOT NULL,
    received_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, sess, chunk_no)
);

CREATE TABLE jobs (
    job_id               TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id              TEXT NOT NULL,
    game                 TEXT NOT NULL,
    profile_key          TEXT NOT NULL,
    local_id             INTEGER NOT NULL,   -- pt-core's id in that profile timeline
    version              INTEGER NOT NULL,   -- job_version (webhooks) and the etag
    state                TEXT NOT NULL,      -- pt-core JobState
    start_kind           TEXT NOT NULL,
    outcome              TEXT NOT NULL,      -- valid | pending_review | invalid | discarded | approved | rejected | voided | incomplete
    auto_outcome         TEXT NOT NULL,      -- what the rules say
    pre_void_outcome     TEXT,
    points               REAL,
    held_points          REAL,
    computed_points      REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,  -- what approval would count
    world_km             REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    game_km              REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    cargo_id             TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    market               TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    reasons              TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    multiplayer          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'singleplayer',
    tmp_server_id        INTEGER,
    tmp_account_id       INTEGER,
    bonus_id             TEXT,
    config_version_id    TEXT,
    delivered_at         INTEGER,            -- server clock when the delivery arrived
    reported_delivered_at INTEGER,           -- the player's clock
    started_wall_ms      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    summary              TEXT NOT NULL,      -- JSON: names, distances, speed, bonus, notes
    detail               TEXT NOT NULL,      -- JSON: admin detail (rules, integrity, timeline…)
    updated_at           INTEGER NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (user_id, game, profile_key, local_id)
);
CREATE INDEX jobs_user ON jobs (user_id, game, delivered_at);
CREATE INDEX jobs_outcome ON jobs (game, outcome, delivered_at);
```

`crates/pt-server/src/admin.rs`:

```rs
//! Moderator endpoints about jobs (ADMIN_API §1-8, §13) and the TruckersMP
//! flags (§3).

use pt_core::store::Resolve;
use pt_core::timeline::{Job, JobEvent};
use serde_json::{json, Map, Value};

use crate::env::{Host, Row, RowExt};
use crate::http::{self, ApiError, ApiResult, Request, Response};
use crate::jobs::{self, Trigger};
use crate::public::{self, job_row};

use crate::store::{self, Audit, User};
use crate::util::{self, rfc3339};
use crate::{auth, config, manual, params, sheet, webhooks};

// ---- review queue (§1) -----------------------------------------------------------

fn queue_filter(req: &Request) -> ApiResult<(String, Vec<crate::env::P>)> {
    let mut sql = String::from("outcome IN (");
    let outcomes: Vec<&str> = match req.q("outcome") {
        Some(s) if !s.is_empty() => s.split(',').map(str::trim).collect(),
        _ => vec!["pending_review", "invalid"],
    };
    if outcomes.iter().any(|o| !matches!(*o, "pending_review" | "invalid")) {
        return Err(ApiError::bad_request("outcome is pending_review and/or invalid"));
    }
    sql.push_str(&outcomes.iter().map(|o| format!("'{o}'")).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(","));
    sql.push(')');
    let mut p = Vec::new();
    if let Some(g) = req.q("game") {
        public::game(g)?;
        p.push(g.into());
        sql.push_str(&format!(" AND game = ?{}", p.len()));
    }
    if let Some(code) = req.q("reason") {
        if !code.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_lowercase() || b == b'_') {
            return Err(ApiError::bad_request("bad reason code"));
        }
        p.push(format!("%\"code\":\"{code}\"%").into());
        sql.push_str(&format!(" AND reasons LIKE ?{}", p.len()));
    }
    Ok((sql, p))
}

pub async fn review_queue<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    auth::admin(h, req).await?;
    let now = h.now_ms();
    let (limit, offset) = http::page(req, now)?;
    let (filter, p) = queue_filter(req)?;
    let total = store::count(h, &format!("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM jobs WHERE {filter}"), p.clone()).await?;
    let mut p2 = p;
    p2.push((limit as i64).into());
    p2.push((offset as i64).into());
    let n = p2.len();
    let rows = h
        .all(
            &format!("SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE {filter} ORDER BY delivered_at, job_id LIMIT ?{} OFFSET ?{}", n - 1, n),
            p2,
        )
        .await?;
    let mut items = Vec::new();
    for r in &rows {
        let user = store::user_by_id(h, &r.s("user_id")).await?.ok_or_else(|| ApiError::internal("job without user"))?;
        let s = r.json("summary");
        let brief = |p: &Value| json!({"city_id": p["city_id"], "city_name": p["city_name"]});
        items.push(json!({
            "job_id": r.s("job_id"), "game": r.s("game"), "origin": r.s("origin"), "outcome": r.s("outcome"), "player": user.brief(),
            "held_points": r.opt_f("held_points"), "world_km": s["world_km"], "game_km": s["game_km"],
            "cargo": s["cargo"], "source": brief(&s["source"]), "destination": brief(&s["destination"]),
            "delivered_at": util::opt_rfc3339(r.opt_i("delivered_at")),
            "age_s": r.opt_i("delivered_at").map(|d| (now - d) / 1000),
            "reasons": r.json("reasons"),
        }));
    }
    Ok(Response::ok(http::list(items, offset, limit, Some(total), offset + limit < total, now)))
}

pub async fn review_queue_count<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    auth::admin(h, req).await?;
    let (filter, p) = match req.q("game") {
        Some(g) => {
            public::game(g)?;
            ("AND game = ?1", vec![g.into()])
        }
        None => ("", vec![]),
    };
    let rows = h.all(&format!("SELECT outcome, reasons FROM jobs WHERE outcome IN ('pending_review', 'invalid') {filter}"), p).await?;
    let mut by_reason = Map::new();
    for code in ["late_start", "distance_mismatch", "long_job", "fuel_jump"] {
        by_reason.insert(code.into(), json!(0));
    }
    let (mut pending, mut invalid) = (0, 0);
    for r in &rows {
        if r.s("outcome") == "invalid" {
            invalid += 1;
            continue;
        }
        pending += 1;
        for reason in r.json("reasons").as_array().into_iter().flatten() {
            if let Some(code) = reason["code"].as_str() {
                let e = by_reason.entry(code.to_string()).or_insert(json!(0));
                *e = json!(e.as_i64().unwrap_or(0) + 1);
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(Response::ok(json!({"pending_review": pending, "invalid": invalid, "by_reason": by_reason})))
}

// ---- job detail (§4) -------------------------------------------------------------

async fn audit_items<H: Host>(h: &H, rows: &[Row]) -> ApiResult<Vec<Value>> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for r in rows {
        let actor = r.s("actor");
        let name = match actor.as_str() {
            "self" | "system" => Value::Null,
            id => store::user_by_discord(h, id).await?.map_or(Value::Null, |u| u.display_name.into()),
        };
        out.push(json!({
            "audit_id": format!("aud_{}", r.i("audit_no")), "at": rfc3339(r.i("at")),
            "actor": {"discord_user_id": actor, "display_name": name},
            "action": r.s("action"), "target": {"kind": r.s("target_kind"), "id": r.s("target_id")},
            "reason": r.opt_s("reason"), "before": r.json("before"), "after": r.json("after"),
        }));
    }
    Ok(out)
}

pub async fn job_detail<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request, raw_id: &str) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    auth::admin(h, req).await?;
    let row = job_row(h, raw_id).await?;
    let user = store::user_by_id(h, &row.s("user_id")).await?.ok_or_else(|| ApiError::not_found("job"))?;
    let cfg = config::scoring(h).await?.cfg;
    let mut v = jobs::detail_json(&row, &user, &cfg);
    let job_id = row.s("job_id");
    v["reasons"] = row.json("reasons");
    v["etag"] = jobs::etag(&job_id, row.i("version")).into();
    if let Value::Object(d) = row.json("detail") {
        for (k, x) in d {
            v[k.as_str()] = x;
        }
    }
    v["config_version"] = match row.opt_s("config_version_id") {
        Some(id) => {
            let c = store::one(h, "SELECT integrity_hash, current FROM config_versions WHERE version_id = ?1", params![&id]).await?;
            json!({"version_id": id, "integrity_hash": c.as_ref().map(|c| c.s("integrity_hash")), "current": c.is_some_and(|c| c.b("current"))})
        }
        None => Value::Null,
    };
    let audit_rows =
        h.all("SELECT * FROM audit_log WHERE target_kind = 'job' AND target_id = ?1 ORDER BY audit_no DESC", params![&job_id]).await?;
    v["audit"] = audit_items(h, &audit_rows).await?.into();
    manual::admin_extras(h, &row, &mut v).await?;
    v["custom_map"] = manual::custom_map(h, &row, true).await?;
    Ok(Response::ok(v))
}

// ---- edits (§14) -----------------------------------------------------------------

fn check_etag(body: &Value, job_id: &str, version: i64) -> ApiResult<()> {
    if let Some(expected) = body.get("expected_etag").and_then(Value::as_str) {
        if expected != jobs::etag(job_id, version) {
            return Err(ApiError::conflict("The job changed; reload it.", json!({"current_etag": jobs::etag(job_id, version)})));
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn snapshot(r: &Row) -> Value {
    json!({"outcome": r.s("outcome"), "points": r.opt_f("points"), "held_points": r.opt_f("held_points")})
}

/// Applies a moderator's field changes to a job and re-scores it. Returns the
/// reloaded row.
async fn apply_edit<H: Host>(h: &H, admin: &User, row: Row, fields: &Value, reason: &str, quiet: bool) -> ApiResult<Row> {
    let job_id = row.s("job_id");
    if !fields.as_object().is_some_and(|o| o.keys().any(|k| sheet::EDIT_KEYS.contains(&k.as_str()))) {
        return Err(ApiError::field("fields", "nothing to change"));
    }
    let mut row = row;
    if row.s("origin") == "tracked" && row.json("detail")["sheet_base"].is_null() {
        // Scored before edits existed: score it once so the recording's sheet is stored.
        crate::scorer::rescore_job(h, &job_id, Trigger::Recalculation, None).await?;
        row = job_row(h, &job_id).await?;
    }
    let before = snapshot(&row);
    let (o_before, o_after) = manual::write_overrides(h, &row, fields).await?;
    let m = jobs::Moderator { discord_user_id: &admin.discord_user_id, quiet };
    crate::scorer::rescore_job(h, &job_id, Trigger::Edit, Some(m)).await?;
    let now = job_row(h, &job_id).await?;
    let (mut b, mut a) = (before, snapshot(&now));
    b["overrides"] = sheet::to_json(&serde_json::from_value(o_before).unwrap_or_default());
    a["overrides"] = sheet::to_json(&serde_json::from_value(o_after).unwrap_or_default());
    let user = store::user_by_id(h, &now.s("user_id")).await?;
    store::audit(h, Audit {
        actor: &admin.discord_user_id, action: "job.edit", target_kind: "job", target_id: &job_id,
        target_user: user.as_ref().map(|u| u.discord_user_id.as_str()), reason: Some(reason), before: b, after: a,
    })
    .await?;
    Ok(now)
}

/// `PATCH /api/v1/admin/jobs/{job_id}`: correct any field of any job.
pub async fn edit<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request, raw_id: &str) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    let admin = auth::admin(h, req).await?;
    let idem = match store::idem_begin(h, req, "bot").await? {
        Ok(i) => i,
        Err(replay) => return Ok(replay),
    };
    let body = req.json_body()?;
    let reason = store::reason(&body)?;
    sheet::check_keys(&body, &["reason", "expected_etag"])?;
    let row = job_row(h, raw_id).await?;
    let job_id = row.s("job_id");
    check_etag(&body, &job_id, row.i("version"))?;
    let now = apply_edit(h, &admin, row, &body, &reason, false).await?;
    let overrides: serde_json::Map<String, Value> = serde_json::from_value(now.json("overrides")).unwrap_or_default();
    let resp = json!({"job_id": job_id, "outcome": now.s("outcome"), "points": now.opt_f("points"), "held_points": now.opt_f("held_points"),
                      "overrides": sheet::to_json(&overrides), "etag": jobs::etag(&job_id, now.i("version"))});
    store::idem_store(h, idem, 200, &resp).await?;
    Ok(Response::ok(resp))
}

// ---- decisions (§7) --------------------------------------------------------------

pub async fn decide<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request, raw_id: &str, action: &str) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    let admin = auth::admin(h, req).await?;
    let idem = match store::idem_begin(h, req, "bot").await? {
        Ok(i) => i,
        Err(replay) => return Ok(replay),
    };
    let body = req.json_body()?;
    let reason = store::reason(&body)?;
    let mut row = job_row(h, raw_id).await?;
    let job_id = row.s("job_id");
    check_etag(&body, &job_id, row.i("version"))?;
    let corrections = body.get("corrections").filter(|c| !c.is_null());
    let hide_map = match body.get("hide_map") {
        None | Some(Value::Null) => None,
        Some(Value::Bool(b)) => Some(*b),
        Some(_) => return Err(ApiError::field("hide_map", "true or false")),
    };
    if action != "approve" && (corrections.is_some() || hide_map.is_some()) {
        return Err(ApiError::field(if corrections.is_some() { "corrections" } else { "hide_map" }, "only with approve"));
    }
    let from = row.s("outcome");
    let to = match (action, from.as_str()) {
        ("approve", "pending_review" | "invalid" | "rejected") => "approved".to_string(),
        ("reject", "pending_review" | "valid" | "approved" | "invalid") => "rejected".to_string(),
        ("void", f) if !matches!(f, "discarded" | "voided") => "voided".to_string(),
        ("restore", "voided") => row.opt_s("pre_void_outcome").unwrap_or_else(|| row.s("auto_outcome")),
        _ => {
            return Err(ApiError::invalid_transition(&from, action, &format!("A {from} job cannot be {action}d.")));
        }
    };
    // Approval may correct stats in the same step (§7, §14); the edit sends no
    // webhook of its own, the approval's job.scored carries the result.
    let mut extra = json!({});
    if let Some(c) = corrections {
        if !c.is_object() {
            return Err(ApiError::field("corrections", "an object"));
        }
        sheet::check_keys(c, &[])?;
        row = apply_edit(h, &admin, row, c, &reason, true).await?;
        extra["corrections"] = row.json("overrides");
    }
    if let Some(hm) = hide_map {
        h.run("UPDATE jobs SET hide_map = ?2 WHERE job_id = ?1", params![&job_id, hm]).await?;
        extra["hide_map"] = hm.into();
    }
    let version = row.i("version");
    let computed = row.f("computed_points");
    let (points, held) = jobs::points_for(&to, computed, computed);
    let pre_void = if to == "voided" { Some(from.clone()) } else { None };
    let user = store::user_by_id(h, &row.s("user_id")).await?.ok_or_else(|| ApiError::internal("job without user"))?;
    let new_version = version + 1;
    let before = json!({"outcome": from, "points": row.opt_f("points"), "held_points": row.opt_f("held_points")});
    let mut after = json!({"outcome": to, "points": points, "held_points": held});
    for (k, v) in extra.as_object().into_iter().flatten() {
        after[k.as_str()] = v.clone();
    }
    h.batch(vec![
        (
            "UPDATE jobs SET outcome = ?2, points = ?3, held_points = ?4, version = ?5, updated_at = ?6,
                 pre_void_outcome = COALESCE(?7, pre_void_outcome) WHERE job_id = ?1"
                .into(),
            params![&job_id, &to, points.as_f64(), held.as_f64(), new_version, h.now_ms(), pre_void],
        ),
        store::audit_stmt(h, Audit {
            actor: &admin.discord_user_id, action: &format!("job.{action}"), target_kind: "job", target_id: &job_id,
            target_user: Some(&user.discord_user_id), reason: Some(&reason), before, after,
        }),
    ])
    .await?;
    webhooks::emit(
        h,
        "job.scored",
        json!({"job_id": job_id, "game": row.s("game"), "job_version": new_version, "player": user.brief(),
               "outcome": to, "previous_outcome": from, "points": points, "held_points": held,
               "by": {"kind": "moderator", "discord_user_id": admin.discord_user_id}}),
        0,
    )
    .await?;
    let resp = json!({"job_id": job_id, "outcome": to, "points": points, "held_points": held, "etag": jobs::etag(&job_id, new_version)});
    store::idem_store(h, idem, 200, &resp).await?;
    Ok(Response::ok(resp))
}

// ---- recalculation (§8) ----------------------------------------------------------

pub async fn recalculate_job<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request, raw_id: &str) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    let admin = auth::admin(h, req).await?;
    let idem = match store::idem_begin(h, req, "bot").await? {
        Ok(i) => i,
        Err(replay) => return Ok(replay),
    };
    let reason = store::reason(&req.json_body()?)?;
    let row = job_row(h, raw_id).await?;
    let job_id = row.s("job_id");
    let snap = |r: &Row| json!({"outcome": r.s("outcome"), "points": r.opt_f("points"), "held_points": r.opt_f("held_points")});
    let before = snap(&row);
    crate::scorer::rescore_job(h, &job_id, Trigger::Recalculation, None).await?;
    let now_row = store::one(h, "SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE job_id = ?1", params![&job_id]).await?.ok_or_else(|| ApiError::not_found("job"))?;
    let after = snap(&now_row);
    store::audit(h, Audit {
        actor: &admin.discord_user_id, action: "job.recalculate", target_kind: "job", target_id: &job_id,
        target_user: None, reason: Some(&reason), before: before.clone(), after: after.clone(),
    })
    .await?;
    let resp = json!({"job_id": job_id, "before": before, "after": after, "etag": jobs::etag(&job_id, now_row.i("version"))});
    store::idem_store(h, idem, 200, &resp).await?;
    Ok(Response::ok(resp))
}

// ---- series (§5) -----------------------------------------------------------------

/// One series bucket: start, speed and fuel and damage ranges, and the
/// cumulative distances at its last point.
#[derive(Clone)]
struct Bucket {
    t: i64,
    speed: (f64, f64),
    fuel: Option<(f64, f64)>,
    damage: Option<(f64, f64)>,
    game_km: f64,
    world_km: f64,
}

fn widen(r: &mut Option<(f64, f64)>, v: Option<f64>) {
    if let Some(x) = v {
        *r = Some(r.map_or((x, x), |(lo, hi)| (lo.min(x), hi.max(x))));
    }
}

/// Most points a view (map, graphs) holds in memory: longer jobs are thinned
/// while read ([`jobs::load_view`]). A job driven for days has over 700k; the
/// map draws at most 5,000 vertices and the graphs 4,000 buckets.
pub const VIEW_POINTS: usize = jobs::VIEW_POINTS;

pub async fn load_stored<H: Host>(h: &H, job_id: &str) -> ApiResult<jobs::StoredJob> {
    jobs::load_stored(h, job_id).await?.ok_or_else(|| ApiError::not_found("job data"))
}

/// A stored job for a view, thinned to [`VIEW_POINTS`].
pub async fn load_job<H: Host>(h: &H, job_id: &str) -> ApiResult<(Job, Vec<(u32, String)>)> {
    jobs::load_view(h, job_id, VIEW_POINTS).await?.ok_or_else(|| ApiError::not_found("job data"))
}

fn max_points(req: &Request) -> ApiResult<usize> {
    match req.q("max_points") {
        None => Ok(1000),
        Some(s) => s.parse::<usize>().ok().filter(|n| (1..=4000).contains(n)).ok_or_else(|| ApiError::bad_request("max_points is 1..4000")),
    }
}

/// The series of a job (§5). `public` (PUBLIC_API §3): no reverted windows
/// and no review markers.
pub async fn series_json<H: Host>(h: &H, row: &Row, max_points: usize, public: bool) -> ApiResult<Value> {
    let (job, _) = load_job(h, &row.s("job_id")).await?;
    let cfg = config::scoring(h).await?.cfg;
    let limits = cfg.rules.speed.limits(job.game);
    let (Some(first), Some(last)) = (job.kept.first(), job.kept.last()) else {
        return Ok(json!({"job_id": row.s("job_id"), "game": row.s("game"), "bucket_s": 0.0,
            "penalty_over_mph": limits.penalty_over_mph, "invalid_over_mph": limits.invalid_over_mph,
            "points": [], "windows": [], "markers": []}));
    };
    let span = (last.wall_ms - first.wall_ms).max(1);
    let bucket_ms = (span as f64 / max_points as f64).max(1.0);
    let mut buckets: Vec<Option<Bucket>> = vec![None; max_points];
    // Distance from the job's start: the odometer (in game), and the scored
    // part at 1:1 (loaded and hitched, or any driving for World of Trucks).
    let wot = job.info.is_world_of_trucks();
    let gaps: Vec<_> = job.active_gaps().collect();
    let (mut game_km, mut world_km) = (0.0f64, 0.0f64);
    for (k, p) in job.kept.iter().enumerate() {
        if let Some(a) = k.checked_sub(1).map(|j| &job.kept[j]) {
            if let (true, Some(x), Some(y)) = (a.run == p.run && a.truck == p.truck, a.odometer_km, p.odometer_km) {
                let d = (y - x).max(0.0);
                game_km += d;
                if wot || (p.cargo_loaded && p.trailer_connected) {
                    world_km += d / p.local_scale;
                }
            }
        }
        for g in gaps.iter().filter(|g| g.to_sess == p.sess && g.to_seq == p.seq) {
            let d = g.game_km.unwrap_or(0.0).max(0.0);
            game_km += d;
            if g.counted || wot {
                world_km += d / g.local_scale;
            }
        }
        let i = (((p.wall_ms - first.wall_ms) as f64 / bucket_ms) as usize).min(max_points - 1);
        let mph = p.mph();
        let b = buckets[i].get_or_insert(Bucket {
            t: first.wall_ms + (i as f64 * bucket_ms) as i64, speed: (mph, mph), fuel: None, damage: None, game_km, world_km,
        });
        b.speed = (b.speed.0.min(mph), b.speed.1.max(mph));
        widen(&mut b.fuel, p.fuel_l);
        widen(&mut b.damage, p.cargo_damage.map(|d| d * 100.0));
        b.game_km = game_km;
        b.world_km = world_km;
    }
    let r2 = util::round2;
    let points: Vec<Value> = buckets
        .into_iter()
        .flatten()
        .map(|b| {
            json!({"t": rfc3339(b.t), "speed_mph_min": r2(b.speed.0), "speed_mph_max": r2(b.speed.1),
                   "fuel_l_min": b.fuel.map(|f| r2(f.0)), "fuel_l_max": b.fuel.map(|f| r2(f.1)),
                   "damage_pct_min": b.damage.map(|d| r2(d.0)), "damage_pct_max": b.damage.map(|d| r2(d.1)),
                   "game_km": r2(b.game_km), "game_mi": util::mi(b.game_km), "world_km": util::round3(b.world_km),
                   "world_mi": util::round3(pt_core::units::km_to_mi(b.world_km)), "reverted": false})
        })
        .collect();
    let mut windows = Vec::new();
    for w in job.kept.windows(2) {
        let (a, b) = (&w[0], &w[1]);
        let wall = b.wall_ms - a.wall_ms;
        let sim = b.sim_us.saturating_sub(a.sim_us) as i64 / 1000;
        if a.sess == b.sess && wall - sim > 5_000 {
            windows.push(json!({"kind": "pause", "from": rfc3339(a.wall_ms), "to": rfc3339(b.wall_ms)}));
        }
    }
    for e in &job.events {
        if let JobEvent::Teleport { ferry_or_train: true, wall_ms, via, .. } = e {
            let from = job.kept.iter().rev().find(|p| p.wall_ms < *wall_ms).map_or(*wall_ms, |p| p.wall_ms);
            let kind = via.as_deref().unwrap_or("ferry_or_train");
            windows.push(json!({"kind": kind, "from": rfc3339(from), "to": rfc3339(*wall_ms)}));
        }
    }
    if !public {
        for br in &job.reverted {
            if let (Some(a), Some(b)) = (br.points.first(), br.points.last()) {
                windows.push(json!({"kind": "reverted", "from": rfc3339(a.wall_ms), "to": rfc3339(b.wall_ms)}));
            }
        }
    }
    // Refuels and fuel jumps as scored from every point (the stored row), not
    // from the thinned points.
    let detail = row.json("detail");
    for f in detail["fuel"]["refuels"].as_array().into_iter().flatten() {
        windows.push(json!({"kind": "refuel", "from": f["start_at"], "to": f["end_at"], "litres": f["litres"]}));
    }
    let markers: Vec<Value> = if public {
        Vec::new()
    } else {
        row.json("reasons")
            .as_array()
            .into_iter()
            .flatten()
            .filter(|x| x["code"] == "fuel_jump")
            .map(|x| json!({"kind": "fuel_jump", "at": x["details"]["at"], "litres": x["details"]["litres"]}))
            .collect()
    };
    Ok(json!({
        "job_id": row.s("job_id"), "game": row.s("game"), "bucket_s": r2(bucket_ms / 1000.0),
        "penalty_over_mph": limits.penalty_over_mph, "invalid_over_mph": limits.invalid_over_mph,
        "points": points, "windows": windows, "markers": markers,
    }))
}

pub async fn series<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request, raw_id: &str) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    auth::admin(h, req).await?;
    let n = max_points(req)?;
    let row = job_row(h, raw_id).await?;
    Ok(Response::ok(series_json(h, &row, n, false).await?))
}

/// `GET /api/v1/public/jobs/{job_id}/series`: everyone, but only for counted
/// jobs (owner, 2026-10-15: the community helps catch cheating).
pub async fn public_series<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request, raw_id: &str) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    auth::service(h, req)?;
    let n = max_points(req)?;
    let row = job_row(h, raw_id).await?;
    if !matches!(row.s("outcome").as_str(), "valid" | "approved") {
        return Err(ApiError::not_found("job"));
    }
    Ok(Response::ok(series_json(h, &row, n, true).await?))
}

// ---- trace (§6) ------------------------------------------------------------------

pub const TRACE_URL_TTL_MS: i64 = 15 * 60_000;

fn trace_sig<H: Host>(h: &H, job_id: &str, version: i64, exp_s: i64) -> String {
    util::hex(&util::hmac_sha256(h.settings().download_secret.as_bytes(), format!("trace.{job_id}.{version}.{exp_s}").as_bytes()))
}

fn trace_key(job_id: &str, version: i64) -> String {
    format!("traces/{job_id}-v{version}.jsonl.gz")
}

pub async fn trace<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request, raw_id: &str) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    let admin = auth::admin(h, req).await?;
    let row = job_row(h, raw_id).await?;
    let job_id = row.s("job_id");
    let version = row.i("version");
    let key = trace_key(&job_id, version);
    let (size, frames) = match h.blob_get(&format!("{key}.meta")).await? {
        Some(m) => {
            let v: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&m).unwrap_or_default();
            (v["size"].as_i64().unwrap_or(0), v["frames"].as_i64().unwrap_or(0))
        }
        None => build_trace(h, &row, &key).await?,
    };
    let now = h.now_ms();
    let exp_s = (now + TRACE_URL_TTL_MS) / 1000;
    let url = format!(
        "{}/dl/trace/{job_id}?v={version}&exp={exp_s}&sig={}",
        h.settings().public_url.trim_end_matches('/'),
        trace_sig(h, &job_id, version, exp_s)
    );
    store::audit(h, Audit {
        actor: &admin.discord_user_id, action: "trace.download", target_kind: "job", target_id: &job_id,
        target_user: None, reason: None, before: json!({}), after: json!({"version": version}),
    })
    .await?;
    Ok(Response::ok(json!({"url": url, "expires_at": rfc3339(exp_s * 1000), "size_bytes": size, "format": "jsonl+gzip", "frames": frames})))
}

/// Every raw frame of the job's sessions from accept to end, each marked
/// `pt_status` kept / reverted / outside.
async fn build_trace<H: Host>(h: &H, row: &Row, key: &str) -> ApiResult<(i64, i64)> {
    let stored = load_stored(h, &row.s("job_id")).await?;
    let (job, sess_ids) = (&stored.job, &stored.sess_ids);
    let wall = |e: &JobEvent| serde_json::to_value(e).ok().and_then(|v| v["wall_ms"].as_i64()).unwrap_or(0);
    let start = job.events.first().map(wall).unwrap_or(0);
    let end = job.events.last().map(wall).unwrap_or(i64::MAX);
    // Every point, by session index: one String per point would not fit for
    // a long job.
    let kept: std::collections::HashSet<(u32, u64)> = stored.iter(&job.kept).map(|p| (p.sess, p.seq)).collect();
    let reverted: std::collections::HashSet<(u32, u64)> =
        job.reverted.iter().flat_map(|b| stored.iter(&b.points)).map(|p| (p.sess, p.seq)).collect();
    let idx_of = |s: &str| sess_ids.iter().find(|(_, x)| x == s).map(|(i, _)| *i);
    let user_id = row.s("user_id");
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let mut frames = 0i64;
    for (_, sess) in sess_ids.iter() {
        let chunks = h
            .all("SELECT r2_key FROM raw_chunks WHERE user_id = ?1 AND sess = ?2 ORDER BY chunk_no", params![&user_id, sess])
            .await?;
        for c in chunks {
            let Some(blob) = h.blob_get(&c.s("r2_key")).await? else { continue };
            let text = util::gunzip(&blob, usize::MAX).map_err(|e| ApiError::internal(&e.to_string()))?;
            for line in text.split(|b| *b == b'\n').filter(|l| !l.is_empty()) {
                let Ok(mut v) = serde_json::from_slice::<Value>(line) else { continue };
                let w = v["wall_ms"].as_i64().unwrap_or(0);
                if w < start || w > end {
                    continue;
                }
                let k = (idx_of(sess).unwrap_or(u32::MAX), v["seq"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0));
                v["pt_status"] = if kept.contains(&k) {
                    "kept"
                } else if reverted.contains(&k) {
                    "reverted"
                } else {
                    "outside"
                }
                .into();
                out.extend_from_slice(v.to_string().as_bytes());
                out.push(b'\n');
                frames += 1;
            }
        }
    }
    let z = util::gzip(&out);
    let size = z.len() as i64;
    h.blob_put(key, z).await?;
    h.blob_put(&format!("{key}.meta"), json!({"size": size, "frames": frames}).to_string().into_bytes()).await?;
    Ok((size, frames))
}

/// `GET /dl/trace/{job_id}?v=&exp=&sig=`: the signed download itself.
pub async fn download_trace<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request, job_id: &str) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    let (Some(v), Some(exp), Some(sig)) = (req.q("v"), req.q("exp"), req.q("sig")) else {
        return Err(ApiError::forbidden("This link is not valid."));
    };
    let (Ok(version), Ok(exp_s)) = (v.parse::<i64>(), exp.parse::<i64>()) else {
        return Err(ApiError::forbidden("This link is not valid."));
    };
    if !util::constant_eq(sig.as_bytes(), trace_sig(h, job_id, version, exp_s).as_bytes()) {
        return Err(ApiError::forbidden("This link is not valid."));
    }
    if h.now_ms() / 1000 > exp_s {
        return Err(ApiError::forbidden("This link has expired."));
    }
    let blob = h.blob_get(&trace_key(job_id, version)).await?.ok_or_else(|| ApiError::not_found("trace"))?;
    Ok(Response::bytes(200, "application/gzip", blob)
        .with_header("content-disposition", &format!("attachment; filename=\"plasmatrack-{job_id}-v{version}.jsonl.gz\"")))
}

// ---- audit (§13) -----------------------------------------------------------------

pub async fn audit_log<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    auth::admin(h, req).await?;
    let now = h.now_ms();
    let (limit, offset) = http::page(req, now)?;
    let mut sql = String::from("1 = 1");
    let mut p: Vec<crate::env::P> = Vec::new();
    let mut add = |sql: &mut String, cond: &str, v: crate::env::P| {
        p.push(v);
        sql.push_str(&format!(" AND {cond} ?{}", p.len()));
    };
    if let Some(j) = req.q("job_id") {
        let id = util::normalize_job_id(j).ok_or_else(|| ApiError::bad_request("bad job_id"))?;
        sql.push_str(" AND target_kind = 'job'");
        add(&mut sql, "target_id =", id.into());
    }
    if let Some(a) = req.q("actor") {
        add(&mut sql, "actor =", a.into());
    }
    if let Some(t) = req.q("target_user") {
        add(&mut sql, "target_user =", t.into());
    }
    if let Some(a) = req.q("action") {
        add(&mut sql, "action =", a.into());
    }
    for (q, op) in [("since", "at >="), ("until", "at <")] {
        if let Some(s) = req.q(q) {
            let t = util::parse_rfc3339(s).ok_or_else(|| ApiError::bad_request(&format!("{q} must be RFC 3339")))?;
            add(&mut sql, op, t.into());
        }
    }
    let mut p2 = p.clone();
    p2.push(((limit + 1) as i64).into());
    p2.push((offset as i64).into());
    let n = p2.len();
    let rows = h
        .all(&format!("SELECT * FROM audit_log WHERE {sql} ORDER BY audit_no DESC LIMIT ?{} OFFSET ?{}", n - 1, n), p2)
        .await?;
    let more = rows.len() > limit;
    let items = audit_items(h, &rows[..rows.len().min(limit)]).await?;
    Ok(Response::ok(http::list(items, offset, limit, None, more, now)))
}

// ---- TruckersMP flags (§3) -------------------------------------------------------

pub async fn truckersmp_flags<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    auth::admin(h, req).await?;
    let now = h.now_ms();
    let (limit, offset) = http::page(req, now)?;
    let flags = player_flags(h, None).await?;
    let total = flags.len();
    let items: Vec<Value> = flags.into_iter().skip(offset).take(limit).collect();
    Ok(Response::ok(http::list(items, offset, limit, None, offset + limit < total, now)))
}

/// Both kinds of flag, optionally only those involving one user.
pub async fn player_flags<H: Host>(h: &H, only: Option<&User>) -> ApiResult<Vec<Value>> {
    let rows = h.all("SELECT a.user_id, u.discord_user_id, a.account_id FROM truckersmp_accounts a JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.user_id WHERE a.account_id > 0 ORDER BY a.user_id, a.account_id", vec![]).await?;
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let mut by_user: std::collections::BTreeMap<(String, String), Vec<i64>> = Default::default();
    let mut by_account: std::collections::BTreeMap<i64, Vec<(String, String)>> = Default::default();
    for r in &rows {
        by_user.entry((r.s("user_id"), r.s("discord_user_id"))).or_default().push(r.i("account_id"));
        by_account.entry(r.i("account_id")).or_default().push((r.s("user_id"), r.s("discord_user_id")));
    }
    let wanted = |uid: &str| only.is_none_or(|u| u.user_id == uid);
    for ((uid, did), accounts) in by_user {
        if accounts.len() > 1 && wanted(&uid) {
            out.push(json!({"kind": "player_multiple_accounts", "user_id": uid, "discord_user_id": did, "account_ids": accounts}));
        }
    }
    for (account, users) in by_account {
        if users.len() > 1 && users.iter().any(|(u, _)| wanted(u)) {
            let users: Vec<Value> = users.iter().map(|(u, d)| json!({"user_id": u, "discord_user_id": d})).collect();
            out.push(json!({"kind": "account_multiple_players", "account_id": account, "users": users}));
        }
    }
    Ok(out)
}
```

`crates/pt-server/src/auth.rs`:

```rs
//! Who is calling (API_CONVENTIONS §2): the read token, the bot token, a
//! moderator acting through the bot, or a player's client.

use crate::env::{Host, RowExt};
use crate::http::{ApiError, ApiResult, Request};
use crate::params;
use crate::store::{self, User};
use crate::util;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Service {
    Read,
    Bot,
}

fn bearer(req: &Request) -> Option<&str> {
    let v = req.header("authorization")?;
    let (scheme, token) = v.split_once(' ')?;
    scheme.eq_ignore_ascii_case("bearer").then(|| token.trim())
}

fn matches(hashes: &[String], token: &str) -> bool {
    let digest = util::sha256_hex(token.as_bytes());
    hashes.iter().any(|h| util::constant_eq(h.as_bytes(), digest.as_bytes()))
}

/// The read token or the bot token.
pub fn service<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request) -> ApiResult<Service> {
    let token = bearer(req).ok_or_else(ApiError::unauthorized)?;
    let s = h.settings();
    if matches(&s.bot_token_sha256, token) {
        Ok(Service::Bot)
    } else if matches(&s.read_token_sha256, token) {
        Ok(Service::Read)
    } else {
        Err(ApiError::unauthorized())
    }
}

pub fn bot<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request) -> ApiResult<()> {
    match service(h, req)? {
        Service::Bot => Ok(()),
        Service::Read => Err(ApiError::forbidden("The read token cannot do this.")),
    }
}

/// The moderator in `X-PlasmaTrack-Actor`: an admin who is not disabled. The
/// Discord IDs in the Worker's `BOOTSTRAP_ADMINS` are admins from their first
/// call (so the first admin can exist at all).
pub async fn admin<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request) -> ApiResult<User> {
    bot(h, req)?;
    let actor = req.header("x-plasmatrack-actor").unwrap_or_default().trim().to_string();
    if actor.is_empty() {
        return Err(ApiError::forbidden("X-PlasmaTrack-Actor is required on admin calls."));
    }
    store::check_discord_id(&actor)?;
    if h.settings().bootstrap_admins.contains(&actor) {
        let (u, _) = store::ensure_user(h, &actor, None).await?;
        if u.role != "admin" {
            h.run("UPDATE users SET role = 'admin' WHERE user_id = ?1", params![&u.user_id]).await?;
        }
        return Ok(User { role: "admin".into(), ..u });
    }
    match store::user_by_discord(h, &actor).await? {
        Some(u) if u.role == "admin" && !u.disabled => Ok(u),
        _ => Err(ApiError::forbidden("The actor is not an active admin.")),
    }
}

/// The player whose client uploads (`Authorization: Bearer pt_live_…`).
/// Disabled players get 401, like a revoked token (ADMIN_API §10).
pub async fn player<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request) -> ApiResult<User> {
    let token = bearer(req).ok_or_else(ApiError::unauthorized)?;
    let row = store::one(
        h,
        "SELECT t.token_id, t.last_used_at, u.user_id FROM tokens t JOIN users u ON u.user_id = t.user_id
         WHERE t.token_sha256 = ?1 AND t.revoked_at IS NULL AND u.disabled = 0",
        params![util::sha256_hex(token.as_bytes())],
    )
    .await?
    .ok_or_else(ApiError::unauthorized)?;
    let now = h.now_ms();
    // last_used_at to the minute is plenty and saves a write per upload.
    if now - row.opt_i("last_used_at").unwrap_or(0) > 60_000 {
        h.run("UPDATE tokens SET last_used_at = ?2 WHERE token_id = ?1", params![row.s("token_id"), now]).await?;
    }
    store::user_by_id(h, &row.s("user_id")).await?.ok_or_else(ApiError::unauthorized)
}
```

`crates/pt-server/src/backup.rs`:

```rs
//! Weekly backups of the D1 database to the backup bucket (docs/SERVER.md),
//! the same format as the bot's: one SQL file, per table `DELETE FROM t;` then
//! one `INSERT` per row, one statement per line, restorable with
//! `wrangler d1 execute <db> --remote --file <file>`. The newest two are kept.

use serde_json::{json, Value};

use crate::env::{Host, RowExt};
use crate::http::{ApiError, ApiResult, Request, Response};
use crate::params;
use crate::store::{self, Audit};
use crate::util::rfc3339;

/// Backups kept per server.
pub const KEEP: usize = 2;
/// Rows read per query.
const PAGE: i64 = 500;
/// Tables not worth restoring: replay protection that expires within a day.
const SKIP: [&str; 1] = ["idempotency"];

/// One SQL literal.
fn literal(v: &Value) -> String {
    match v {
        Value::Null => "NULL".into(),
        Value::Bool(b) => (*b as i32).to_string(),
        Value::Number(n) => n.to_string(),
        Value::String(s) => {
            // One statement per line: line breaks become a marker the text does
            // not contain, turned back by replace(). D1 allows expressions only
            // 100 deep, so a `|| char(10) ||` per line breaks on long texts
            // (the published config's TOML).
            // A marker counts only if decoding gives the text back: "~n0" before
            // a line break would otherwise become "~n0~n0~", which replace()
            // matches at the wrong place. \r is encoded first, so it is decoded
            // last (the outer replace).
            let mut t = s.clone();
            let mut steps = Vec::new();
            for (ch, name, code) in [('\r', "r", 13), ('\n', "n", 10)] {
                if t.contains(ch) {
                    let back = ch.to_string();
                    let m = (0..)
                        .map(|k| format!("~{name}{k}~"))
                        .find(|m| t.replace(ch, m).replace(m.as_str(), &back) == t)
                        .expect("some marker round-trips");
                    t = t.replace(ch, &m);
                    steps.push((m, code));
                }
            }
            let mut out = format!("'{}'", t.replace('\'', "''"));
            for (m, code) in steps.iter().rev() {
                out = format!("replace({out}, '{m}', char({code}))");
            }
            out
        }
        other => literal(&Value::String(other.to_string())),
    }
}

fn ident(name: &str) -> String {
    format!("\"{}\"", name.replace('"', "\"\""))
}

#[derive(Debug, Default)]
pub struct Report {
    pub key: String,
    pub bytes: usize,
    pub tables: Vec<(String, usize)>,
    pub deleted: Vec<String>,
}

/// The SQL dump of every table, and the row count per table.
pub async fn dump<H: Host>(h: &H) -> ApiResult<(String, Vec<(String, usize)>)> {
    let tables = h
        .all(
            "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' AND name NOT LIKE '_cf_%'
                 AND name != 'd1_migrations' ORDER BY name",
            vec![],
        )
        .await?;
    let mut out = String::from("-- PlasmaTrack server backup. Restore: wrangler d1 execute <db> --remote --file <this file>\n");
    let mut counts = Vec::new();
    for t in tables.iter().map(|r| r.s("name")).filter(|n| !SKIP.contains(&n.as_str())) {
        out.push_str(&format!("DELETE FROM {};\n", ident(&t)));
        let (mut last, mut n) = (i64::MIN, 0usize);
        loop {
            let rows = h
                .all(&format!("SELECT rowid AS \"_backup_rowid\", * FROM {} WHERE rowid > ?1 ORDER BY rowid LIMIT ?2", ident(&t)), params![last, PAGE])
                .await?;
            for r in &rows {
                last = r.i("_backup_rowid");
                let cols: Vec<&String> = r.keys().filter(|k| *k != "_backup_rowid").collect();
                let names: Vec<String> = cols.iter().map(|c| ident(c)).collect();
                let values: Vec<String> = cols.iter().map(|c| literal(&r[c.as_str()])).collect();
                out.push_str(&format!("INSERT INTO {} ({}) VALUES ({});\n", ident(&t), names.join(", "), values.join(", ")));
                n += 1;
            }
            if (rows.len() as i64) < PAGE {
                break;
            }
        }
        counts.push((t, n));
    }
    Ok((out, counts))
}

/// Writes a backup, then deletes all but the newest [`KEEP`]. A failed write
/// deletes nothing.
pub async fn run<H: Host>(h: &H) -> ApiResult<Report> {
    let prefix = h.settings().backup_prefix.clone();
    if prefix.is_empty() {
        return Err(ApiError::internal("no backup prefix configured"));
    }
    let (sql, tables) = dump(h).await?;
    let key = format!("{prefix}{}.sql", rfc3339(h.now_ms()).replace(':', "-"));
    let bytes = sql.len();
    h.backup_put(&key, sql.into_bytes()).await?;
    let mut keys: Vec<String> = h.backup_list(&prefix).await?.into_iter().filter(|k| k.ends_with(".sql")).collect();
    keys.sort();
    keys.reverse();
    let mut deleted = Vec::new();
    for k in keys.into_iter().skip(KEEP).filter(|k| *k != key) {
        h.backup_delete(&k).await?;
        deleted.push(k);
    }
    Ok(Report { key, bytes, tables, deleted })
}

pub fn report_json(r: &Report) -> Value {
    let tables: serde_json::Map<String, Value> = r.tables.iter().map(|(t, n)| (t.clone(), json!(n))).collect();
    json!({"key": r.key, "size_bytes": r.bytes, "rows": tables, "deleted": r.deleted})
}

/// `POST /api/v1/admin/backups`: a backup now, for example before a risky change.
pub async fn now<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    let admin = crate::auth::admin(h, req).await?;
    let idem = match store::idem_begin(h, req, "bot").await? {
        Ok(i) => i,
        Err(replay) => return Ok(replay),
    };
    let reason = store::reason(&req.json_body()?)?;
    let report = run(h).await?;
    let v = report_json(&report);
    store::audit(h, Audit {
        actor: &admin.discord_user_id, action: "backup.create", target_kind: "backup", target_id: &report.key,
        target_user: None, reason: Some(&reason), before: json!({}), after: json!({"size_bytes": report.bytes, "deleted": report.deleted}),
    })
    .await?;
    store::idem_store(h, idem, 201, &v).await?;
    Ok(Response::json(201, &v))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    /// Evaluates a text literal as SQLite would: nested replace(…, 'm', char(c))
    /// around one quoted string (left to right, non-overlapping, like
    /// `str::replace`).
    fn decode(lit: &str) -> String {
        let mut l = lit;
        let mut calls = Vec::new();
        while let Some(inner) = l.strip_prefix("replace(") {
            let close = inner.rfind(", '").unwrap();
            let (rest, tail) = (&inner[..close], &inner[close + 3..]);
            let (m, code) = tail.split_once("', char(").unwrap();
            calls.push((m.to_string(), code.trim_end_matches(')').parse::<u8>().unwrap() as char));
            l = rest;
        }
        let mut v = l.strip_prefix('\'').unwrap().strip_suffix('\'').unwrap().replace("''", "'");
        for (m, c) in calls.iter().rev() {
            v = v.replace(m.as_str(), &c.to_string());
        }
        v
    }

    #[test]
    fn literals_keep_one_statement_per_line() {
        assert_eq!(literal(&json!(null)), "NULL");
        assert_eq!(literal(&json!(42)), "42");
        assert_eq!(literal(&json!(7.5)), "7.5");
        assert_eq!(literal(&json!("it's")), "'it''s'");
        assert_eq!(literal(&json!("a\nb\r\nc")), "replace(replace('a~n0~b~r0~~n0~c', '~n0~', char(10)), '~r0~', char(13))");
        // A marker already in the text is skipped, and so is one a line break
        // would complete (found by the bot's session).
        assert_eq!(literal(&json!("~n0~\n")), "replace('~n0~~n1~', '~n1~', char(10))");
        assert_eq!(literal(&json!("~n0\n")), "replace('~n0~n1~', '~n1~', char(10))");
        // Decoding the way SQLite's replace() does gives every text back.
        for s in ["~n0\n", "\n~n0~", "~r0\r\n", "~n0~r0\r~n1\n", "~\n~", "~n\n0~", "a\r\r\n\n'b'~r0~~n0~", &"~n0\n".repeat(50)] {
            assert_eq!(decode(&literal(&json!(s))), s, "{s:?}");
        }
        // Depth stays constant however many lines (D1 allows 100).
        let long = literal(&json!("x\n".repeat(500)));
        assert_eq!((long.matches("replace(").count(), long.contains('\n')), (1, false));
        assert_eq!(ident("we\"ird"), "\"we\"\"ird\"");
    }
}
```

```rs
//! The config the server scores with: the current published version
//! (ADMIN_API §11), or the shipped sample until one is published. With no
//! published version every job is discarded by rule 0 anyway.

use pt_core::Config;
use serde_json::json;

use crate::env::{Host, RowExt};
use crate::http::ApiResult;
use crate::store;
use crate::util;

pub const SAMPLE_TOML: &str = include_str!("../../../config/plasmatrack.sample.toml");

pub struct Scoring {
    pub cfg: Config,
    /// `cfg_…` of the current version; `None` while none is published.
    pub version_id: Option<String>,
}

pub fn sample() -> Config {
    Config::from_toml_str(SAMPLE_TOML).expect("the sample config is valid")
}

pub async fn scoring<H: Host>(h: &H) -> ApiResult<Scoring> {
    let row = store::one(h, "SELECT version_id, toml FROM config_versions WHERE current = 1", vec![]).await?;
    Ok(match row.and_then(|r| Config::from_toml_str(&r.s("toml")).ok().map(|c| (r.s("version_id"), c))) {
        Some((id, cfg)) => Scoring { cfg, version_id: Some(id) },
        None => Scoring { cfg: sample(), version_id: None },
    })
}

/// Hash of everything the timeline itself reads: when it changes, stored
/// timelines are stale and the scorer replays from the raw frames.
pub fn timeline_key(cfg: &Config) -> String {
    let parts = json!({
        "timeline": cfg.timeline,
        "speed": cfg.rules.speed,
        "distance": cfg.rules.distance,
        "multiplayer": cfg.multiplayer,
        "review_policy": cfg.review_policy,
    });
    util::sha256_hex(parts.to_string().as_bytes())
}
```

```rs
//! What the server logic needs from its host. `pt-worker` implements these with
//! Cloudflare bindings (D1, R2, Queues, Durable Objects, fetch); the native
//! tests implement them with rusqlite and memory (tests/common).
//!
//! The futures are not `Send`: Workers run single-threaded.

use serde_json::{Map, Value};

/// A query parameter. D1 binds JavaScript values, so only these four kinds.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum P {
    Null,
    Int(i64),
    Real(f64),
    Text(String),
}

impl From<i64> for P {
    fn from(v: i64) -> P {
        P::Int(v)
    }
}
impl From<u64> for P {
    fn from(v: u64) -> P {
        P::Int(v as i64)
    }
}
impl From<u32> for P {
    fn from(v: u32) -> P {
        P::Int(v as i64)
    }
}
impl From<bool> for P {
    fn from(v: bool) -> P {
        P::Int(v as i64)
    }
}
impl From<f64> for P {
    fn from(v: f64) -> P {
        P::Real(v)
    }
}
impl From<&str> for P {
    fn from(v: &str) -> P {
        P::Text(v.to_string())
    }
}
impl From<String> for P {
    fn from(v: String) -> P {
        P::Text(v)
    }
}
impl From<&String> for P {
    fn from(v: &String) -> P {
        P::Text(v.clone())
    }
}
impl<T: Into<P>> From<Option<T>> for P {
    fn from(v: Option<T>) -> P {
        v.map_or(P::Null, Into::into)
    }
}

/// Builds a parameter list: `params![a, b, c]`.
#[macro_export]
macro_rules! params {
    ($($x:expr),* $(,)?) => { vec![$($crate::env::P::from($x)),*] };
}

pub type Row = Map<String, Value>;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub struct HostError(pub String);

impl std::fmt::Display for HostError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        f.write_str(&self.0)
    }
}

pub type HostResult<T> = Result<T, HostError>;

/// A statement for [`Host::batch`].
pub type Stmt = (String, Vec<P>);

/// Settings from the Worker's variables and secrets.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct Settings {
    /// SHA-256 (hex) of the read token and of the bot token.
    pub read_token_sha256: Vec<String>,
    pub bot_token_sha256: Vec<String>,
    /// Discord IDs that are admins even before any admin exists (bootstrap).
    pub bootstrap_admins: Vec<String>,
    /// Where webhooks go, and the secrets they are signed with (WEBHOOKS §1-2).
    pub webhook_url: Option<String>,
    pub webhook_secrets: Vec<String>,
    /// This server's public origin, for signed download URLs.
    pub public_url: String,
    /// Key for signed download URLs.
    pub download_secret: String,
    /// Where this server's backups go in the backup bucket, ending in `/`
    /// (docs/SERVER.md).
    pub backup_prefix: String,
    /// Keys whose signed updates may be published; empty means the release
    /// keys built into every client (`pt_core::update::UPDATE_KEYS`).
    pub update_keys: Vec<[u8; 32]>,
    /// Uploads from clients older than this are refused (426) until they
    /// update; the client keeps the data and retries. None: any version.
    pub min_client_version: Option<(u64, u64, u64)>,
}

#[allow(async_fn_in_trait)]
pub trait Host {
    fn settings(&self) -> &Settings;
    fn now_ms(&self) -> i64;
    fn random(&self, buf: &mut [u8]);

    /// Rows as JSON objects (column name → value).
    async fn all(&self, sql: &str, params: Vec<P>) -> HostResult<Vec<Row>>;
    /// Number of rows changed.
    async fn run(&self, sql: &str, params: Vec<P>) -> HostResult<u64>;
    /// Several statements in one transaction.
    async fn batch(&self, stmts: Vec<Stmt>) -> HostResult<()>;

    async fn blob_get(&self, key: &str) -> HostResult<Option<Vec<u8>>>;
    async fn blob_put(&self, key: &str, bytes: Vec<u8>) -> HostResult<()>;
    async fn blob_delete(&self, key: &str) -> HostResult<()>;
    /// An object's size, without reading it.
    async fn blob_size(&self, key: &str) -> HostResult<Option<u64>>;

    /// The backup bucket (a separate R2 bucket): write, list keys under a
    /// prefix, delete.
    async fn backup_put(&self, key: &str, bytes: Vec<u8>) -> HostResult<()>;
    async fn backup_list(&self, prefix: &str) -> HostResult<Vec<String>>;
    async fn backup_delete(&self, key: &str) -> HostResult<()>;

    /// The release bucket (client updates, setup programs and uninstallers,
    /// docs/UPDATES.md): an object's size. The Worker streams the files itself
    /// (`updates::STREAM_HEADER`).
    async fn release_size(&self, key: &str) -> HostResult<Option<u64>>;

    /// Asks the player's scorer to process new chunks. It must not wait for the
    /// scoring to finish (the Worker hands it to the Durable Object).
    async fn poke_scorer(&self, user_id: &str, game: &str) -> HostResult<()>;
    /// Queues a webhook delivery after `delay_s` seconds.
    async fn queue_webhook(&self, event_id: &str, delay_s: u32) -> HostResult<()>;
    /// Queues one step of a bulk operation.
    async fn queue_op(&self, msg: Value) -> HostResult<()>;
    /// POSTs a webhook; returns the HTTP status (or an error for network failures
    /// and timeouts).
    async fn http_post(&self, url: &str, headers: Vec<(String, String)>, body: Vec<u8>) -> HostResult<u16>;
}

/// A value of [`LocalSql`]: SQLite's own five kinds.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum SqlVal {
    Null,
    Int(i64),
    Real(f64),
    Text(String),
    Blob(Vec<u8>),
}

impl SqlVal {
    pub fn int(&self) -> i64 {
        match self {
            SqlVal::Int(i) => *i,
            SqlVal::Real(f) => *f as i64,
            _ => 0,
        }
    }
    pub fn real(&self) -> Option<f64> {
        match self {
            SqlVal::Int(i) => Some(*i as f64),
            SqlVal::Real(f) => Some(*f),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
    pub fn into_bytes(self) -> Vec<u8> {
        match self {
            SqlVal::Blob(b) => b,
            SqlVal::Text(s) => s.into_bytes(),
            _ => Vec::new(),
        }
    }
}

/// A scorer's own SQLite database (its Durable Object's storage; rusqlite
/// in tests). Synchronous: writes made between two awaits commit together.
pub trait LocalSql {
    /// Rows as positional values.
    fn exec(&self, sql: &str, params: &[SqlVal]) -> HostResult<Vec<Vec<SqlVal>>>;
}

/// Reading typed values out of a [`Row`]. D1 returns every number as a
/// JavaScript number, so integers are read leniently.
pub trait RowExt {
    fn s(&self, k: &str) -> String;
    fn opt_s(&self, k: &str) -> Option<String>;
    fn i(&self, k: &str) -> i64;
    fn opt_i(&self, k: &str) -> Option<i64>;
    fn f(&self, k: &str) -> f64;
    fn opt_f(&self, k: &str) -> Option<f64>;
    fn b(&self, k: &str) -> bool;
    fn json(&self, k: &str) -> Value;
}

impl RowExt for Row {
    fn s(&self, k: &str) -> String {
        self.opt_s(k).unwrap_or_default()
    }
    fn opt_s(&self, k: &str) -> Option<String> {
        match self.get(k) {
            Some(Value::String(s)) => Some(s.clone()),
            Some(Value::Number(n)) => Some(n.to_string()),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
    fn i(&self, k: &str) -> i64 {
        self.opt_i(k).unwrap_or(0)
    }
    fn opt_i(&self, k: &str) -> Option<i64> {
        match self.get(k) {
            Some(Value::Number(n)) => n.as_i64().or_else(|| n.as_f64().map(|f| f as i64)),
            Some(Value::String(s)) => s.parse().ok(),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
    fn f(&self, k: &str) -> f64 {
        self.opt_f(k).unwrap_or(0.0)
    }
    fn opt_f(&self, k: &str) -> Option<f64> {
        self.get(k).and_then(Value::as_f64)
    }
    fn b(&self, k: &str) -> bool {
        self.i(k) != 0
    }
    fn json(&self, k: &str) -> Value {
        self.opt_s(k).and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str(&s).ok()).unwrap_or(Value::Null)
    }
}
```
