`crates/pt-server/src/public.rs`:

```rs
//! Player self-service and public reads (docs/PUBLIC_API.md).

use pt_core::Game;
use serde_json::{json, Value};

use crate::env::{Host, RowExt};
use crate::http::{self, ApiError, ApiResult, Request, Response};
use crate::store::{self, Audit, User};
use crate::util::{self, mi, rfc3339, round2};
use crate::{auth, config, jobs, params};

pub fn game(s: &str) -> ApiResult<Game> {
    Game::from_api(s).ok_or_else(|| ApiError::not_found("game"))
}

// ---- self-service (§1) -----------------------------------------------------------

pub async fn issue_token<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request, discord_id: &str) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    auth::bot(h, req)?;
    store::check_discord_id(discord_id)?;
    let idem = match store::idem_begin(h, req, "bot").await? {
        Ok(i) => i,
        Err(replay) => return Ok(replay),
    };
    let body = req.json_body()?;
    let name = body.get("display_name").and_then(Value::as_str);
    if let Some(n) = name {
        store::check_display_name(n)?;
    }
    let (user, created) = store::ensure_user(h, discord_id, name).await?;
    if user.disabled {
        return Err(ApiError::forbidden("This player is disabled."));
    }
    let (token, previous) = store::issue_token(h, &user).await?;
    let mut user_json = user.brief();
    user_json["created"] = created.into();
    let resp = json!({"user": user_json, "token": token});
    store::audit(h, Audit {
        actor: "self", action: "token.issue", target_kind: "user", target_id: &user.user_id,
        target_user: Some(&user.discord_user_id), reason: None,
        before: json!({"token_id": previous}), after: json!({"token_id": token["token_id"]}),
    })
    .await?;
    store::idem_store(h, idem, 200, &replayed_token(&resp)).await?;
    Ok(Response::json(201, &resp))
}

/// A replayed token response: never the plaintext again (PUBLIC_API §1).
pub fn replayed_token(resp: &Value) -> Value {
    let mut r = resp.clone();
    r["token"]["token"] = Value::Null;
    r["details"] = json!({"replayed": true});
    r
}

async fn linked<H: Host>(h: &H, discord_id: &str) -> ApiResult<User> {
    store::check_discord_id(discord_id)?;
    store::user_by_discord(h, discord_id).await?.ok_or_else(|| ApiError::not_found("player"))
}

pub async fn token_status<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request, discord_id: &str) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    auth::bot(h, req)?;
    let user = linked(h, discord_id).await?;
    Ok(Response::ok(store::active_token(h, &user.user_id).await?.ok_or_else(|| ApiError::not_found("token"))?))
}

pub async fn revoke_token<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request, discord_id: &str) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    auth::bot(h, req)?;
    let idem = match store::idem_begin(h, req, "bot").await? {
        Ok(i) => i,
        Err(replay) => return Ok(replay),
    };
    let user = linked(h, discord_id).await?;
    let id = store::revoke_token(h, &user).await?;
    store::audit(h, Audit {
        actor: "self", action: "token.revoke", target_kind: "user", target_id: &user.user_id,
        target_user: Some(&user.discord_user_id), reason: None, before: json!({"token_id": id}), after: json!({}),
    })
    .await?;
    let resp = json!({"revoked_token_id": id});
    store::idem_store(h, idem, 200, &resp).await?;
    Ok(Response::ok(resp))
}

pub async fn rename<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request, discord_id: &str) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    auth::bot(h, req)?;
    let idem = match store::idem_begin(h, req, "bot").await? {
        Ok(i) => i,
        Err(replay) => return Ok(replay),
    };
    let user = linked(h, discord_id).await?;
    let body = req.json_body()?;
    let name = store::check_display_name(body.get("display_name").and_then(Value::as_str).unwrap_or_default())?;
    h.run("UPDATE users SET display_name = ?2 WHERE user_id = ?1", params![&user.user_id, &name]).await?;
    store::audit(h, Audit {
        actor: "self", action: "player.update", target_kind: "user", target_id: &user.user_id,
        target_user: Some(&user.discord_user_id), reason: None,
        before: json!({"display_name": user.display_name}), after: json!({"display_name": name}),
    })
    .await?;
    let resp = profile(h, &linked(h, discord_id).await?).await?;
    store::idem_store(h, idem, 200, &resp).await?;
    Ok(Response::ok(resp))
}

// ---- profiles and stats (§2) -----------------------------------------------------

pub async fn stats<H: Host>(h: &H, user_id: &str, g: Game) -> ApiResult<Value> {
    let r = store::one(
        h,
        "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(points), 0) AS points, COUNT(*) AS n, COALESCE(SUM(world_km), 0) AS world_km,
                COALESCE(SUM(game_km), 0) AS game_km
         FROM jobs WHERE user_id = ?1 AND game = ?2 AND outcome IN ('valid', 'approved')",
        params![user_id, g.as_str()],
    )
    .await?
    .unwrap_or_default();
    let pending = store::count(
        h,
        "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM jobs WHERE user_id = ?1 AND game = ?2 AND outcome = 'pending_review'",
        params![user_id, g.as_str()],
    )
    .await?;
    let (w, gk) = (r.f("world_km"), r.f("game_km"));
    let cfg = config::scoring(h).await?.cfg;

    // Every outcome, and the counted distance per scale class (PUBLIC_API §2).
    let mut outcomes = serde_json::Map::new();
    for o in OUTCOMES {
        outcomes.insert(o.into(), json!(0));
    }
    for row in h
        .all("SELECT outcome, COUNT(*) AS n FROM jobs WHERE user_id = ?1 AND game = ?2 GROUP BY outcome", params![user_id, g.as_str()])
        .await?
    {
        if OUTCOMES.contains(&row.s("outcome").as_str()) {
            outcomes.insert(row.s("outcome"), json!(row.i("n")));
        }
    }
    const CLASSES: [&str; 5] = ["city", "road", "one_to_one", "nonstandard", "unknown"];
    let sums: Vec<String> = CLASSES
        .iter()
        .flat_map(|c| {
            ["world_km", "game_km"].map(|k| format!("COALESCE(SUM(json_extract(summary, '$.distance_by_scale_class.{c}.{k}')), 0) AS {c}_{k}"))
        })
        .collect();
    let by = store::one(
        h,
        &format!("SELECT {} FROM jobs WHERE user_id = ?1 AND game = ?2 AND outcome IN ('valid', 'approved')", sums.join(", ")),
        params![user_id, g.as_str()],
    )
    .await?
    .unwrap_or_default();
    let mut by_class = serde_json::Map::new();
    for c in CLASSES {
        let (cw, cg) = (by.f(&format!("{c}_world_km")), by.f(&format!("{c}_game_km")));
        by_class.insert(c.into(), json!({"world_km": round2(cw), "world_mi": mi(cw), "game_km": round2(cg), "game_mi": mi(cg)}));
    }
    Ok(json!({
        "points": cfg.rules.floor_points(r.f("points")), "job_count": r.i("n"),
        "world_km": round2(w), "world_mi": mi(w), "game_km": round2(gk), "game_mi": mi(gk),
        "pending_review_count": pending,
        "outcomes": outcomes,
        "distance_by_scale_class": by_class,
    }))
}

pub async fn truckersmp_accounts<H: Host>(h: &H, user_id: &str) -> ApiResult<Vec<Value>> {
    let rows = h
        .all(
            "SELECT a.account_id, a.first_seen_at, a.last_seen_at,
                    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jobs j WHERE j.user_id = a.user_id AND j.tmp_account_id = a.account_id
                       AND j.outcome != 'incomplete') AS job_count
             FROM truckersmp_accounts a WHERE a.user_id = ?1 AND a.account_id > 0 ORDER BY a.first_seen_at",
            params![user_id],
        )
        .await?;
    Ok(rows
        .iter()
        .map(|r| {
            json!({"account_id": r.i("account_id"), "profile_url": format!("https://truckersmp.com/user/{}", r.i("account_id")),
                   "first_seen_at": util::rfc3339(r.i("first_seen_at")), "last_seen_at": util::rfc3339(r.i("last_seen_at")),
                   "job_count": r.i("job_count")})
        })
        .collect())
}

pub async fn profile<H: Host>(h: &H, user: &User) -> ApiResult<Value> {
    Ok(json!({
        "linked": true,
        "user_id": user.user_id,
        "discord_user_id": user.discord_user_id,
        "display_name": user.display_name,
        "singleplayer_division": user.singleplayer_division,
        "disabled": user.disabled,
        "truckersmp_accounts": truckersmp_accounts(h, &user.user_id).await?,
        "stats": {"ets2": stats(h, &user.user_id, Game::Ets2).await?, "ats": stats(h, &user.user_id, Game::Ats).await?},
    }))
}

pub async fn player<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request, discord_id: &str) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    auth::service(h, req)?;
    store::check_discord_id(discord_id)?;
    Ok(Response::ok(match store::user_by_discord(h, discord_id).await? {
        Some(u) => profile(h, &u).await?,
        None => json!({"linked": false, "discord_user_id": discord_id}),
    }))
}

pub async fn player_stats<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request, g: &str, discord_id: &str) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    auth::service(h, req)?;
    let g = game(g)?;
    let user = linked(h, discord_id).await?;
    let mut s = stats(h, &user.user_id, g).await?;
    s["game"] = g.as_str().into();
    Ok(Response::ok(s))
}

// ---- jobs (§3) -------------------------------------------------------------------

pub const OUTCOMES: [&str; 7] = ["valid", "approved", "pending_review", "invalid", "rejected", "discarded", "voided"];

pub async fn player_jobs<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request, g: &str, discord_id: &str) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    auth::service(h, req)?;
    let g = game(g)?;
    jobs_page(h, req, discord_id, Some(g)).await
}

/// `GET /api/v1/public/players/{discord_id}/jobs`: both games, newest first.
pub async fn player_jobs_all<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request, discord_id: &str) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    auth::service(h, req)?;
    jobs_page(h, req, discord_id, None).await
}

async fn jobs_page<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request, discord_id: &str, g: Option<Game>) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    let user = linked(h, discord_id).await?;
    let (limit, offset) = http::page(req, h.now_ms())?;
    let outcomes: Vec<String> = match req.q("outcome") {
        Some(s) if !s.is_empty() => s.split(',').map(|o| o.trim().to_string()).collect(),
        _ => OUTCOMES.iter().map(|o| o.to_string()).collect(),
    };
    if let Some(bad) = outcomes.iter().find(|o| !OUTCOMES.contains(&o.as_str())) {
        return Err(ApiError::bad_request("unknown outcome").details(json!({"outcome": bad})));
    }
    let list = outcomes.iter().map(|o| format!("'{o}'")).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(",");
    let filter = format!("user_id = ?1 AND (?2 IS NULL OR game = ?2) AND outcome IN ({list})");
    let game = g.map(|g| g.as_str());
    let total = store::count(h, &format!("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM jobs WHERE {filter}"), params![&user.user_id, game]).await?;
    let rows = h
        .all(
            &format!("SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE {filter} ORDER BY delivered_at DESC, job_id LIMIT ?3 OFFSET ?4"),
            params![&user.user_id, game, limit as i64, offset as i64],
        )
        .await?;
    let items = rows.iter().map(jobs::summary_json).collect();
    Ok(Response::ok(http::list(items, offset, limit, Some(total), offset + limit < total, h.now_ms())))
}

/// A finished job by id (accepts the forms of API_CONVENTIONS §6).
pub async fn job_row<H: Host>(h: &H, raw_id: &str) -> ApiResult<crate::env::Row> {
    let id = util::normalize_job_id(raw_id).ok_or_else(|| ApiError::not_found("job"))?;
    store::one(h, "SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE job_id = ?1 AND outcome != 'incomplete'", params![id])
        .await?
        .ok_or_else(|| ApiError::not_found("job"))
}

pub async fn job<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request, raw_id: &str) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    auth::service(h, req)?;
    let row = job_row(h, raw_id).await?;
    let user = store::user_by_id(h, &row.s("user_id")).await?.ok_or_else(|| ApiError::not_found("job"))?;
    let cfg = config::scoring(h).await?.cfg;
    let mut v = jobs::detail_json(&row, &user, &cfg);
    crate::manual::public_extras(h, &row, &mut v).await?;
    Ok(Response::ok(v))
}

// ---- history buckets (§7) --------------------------------------------------------

const DAY_MS: i64 = 86_400_000;
pub const MAX_BUCKETS: usize = 400;

fn bucket_start(kind: &str, ms: i64) -> i64 {
    match kind {
        "week" => {
            let (y, w) = util::iso_week_of(ms);
            util::iso_week_start(y, w)
        }
        "month" => {
            let (y, m) = util::year_month_of(ms);
            util::month_start(y, m)
        }
        _ => ms - ms.rem_euclid(DAY_MS),
    }
}

fn bucket_next(kind: &str, start: i64) -> i64 {
    match kind {
        "week" => start + 7 * DAY_MS,
        "month" => bucket_start("month", start + 32 * DAY_MS),
        _ => start + DAY_MS,
    }
}

/// An instant or a date (`2026-10-15`, taken as 00:00 UTC).
fn instant_or_date(name: &str, s: &str) -> ApiResult<i64> {
    util::parse_rfc3339(s)
        .or_else(|| util::parse_rfc3339(&format!("{s}T00:00:00Z")))
        .ok_or_else(|| ApiError::bad_request(&format!("{name} is an RFC 3339 instant or a date")).details(json!({name: s})))
}

/// Sums of counted jobs, as one bucket's numbers.
#[derive(Default, Clone)]
struct Sums {
    jobs: i64,
    points: f64,
    world_km: f64,
    game_km: f64,
    fuel_l: f64,
    income: f64,
    damage_sum: f64,
    damage_n: i64,
}

impl Sums {
    fn add(&mut self, r: &crate::env::Row) {
        self.jobs += 1;
        self.points += r.f("points");
        self.world_km += r.f("world_km");
        self.game_km += r.f("game_km");
        self.fuel_l += r.f("fuel");
        self.income += r.f("income");
        if let Some(d) = r.opt_f("damage") {
            self.damage_sum += d;
            self.damage_n += 1;
        }
    }

    fn merge(&mut self, o: &Sums) {
        self.jobs += o.jobs;
        self.points += o.points;
        self.world_km += o.world_km;
        self.game_km += o.game_km;
        self.fuel_l += o.fuel_l;
        self.income += o.income;
        self.damage_sum += o.damage_sum;
        self.damage_n += o.damage_n;
    }

    fn json(&self, cfg: &pt_core::Config) -> Value {
        json!({"job_count": self.jobs, "points": cfg.rules.floor_points(self.points),
               "world_km": round2(self.world_km), "world_mi": mi(self.world_km),
               "game_km": round2(self.game_km), "game_mi": mi(self.game_km),
               "fuel_used_l": round2(self.fuel_l), "income": self.income.round() as i64,
               "damage_pct_avg": (self.damage_n > 0).then(|| round2(self.damage_sum / self.damage_n as f64))})
    }
}

const COUNTED_COLUMNS: &str = "delivered_at, points, world_km, game_km, json_extract(summary, '$.fuel_used_l') AS fuel,
    json_extract(summary, '$.income') AS income, json_extract(summary, '$.damage_pct') AS damage";

/// `GET /api/v1/public/{game}/players/{discord_id}/history?bucket=day|week|month&from=&to=`
pub async fn player_history<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request, g: &str, discord_id: &str) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    auth::service(h, req)?;
    let g = game(g)?;
    let user = linked(h, discord_id).await?;
    let kind = req.q("bucket").unwrap_or("day");
    if !matches!(kind, "day" | "week" | "month") {
        return Err(ApiError::bad_request("bucket is day, week or month").details(json!({"bucket": kind})));
    }
    let now = h.now_ms();
    let to = match req.q("to") {
        Some(s) => instant_or_date("to", s)?,
        None => now,
    };
    let last = bucket_start(kind, to);
    let first = match req.q("from") {
        Some(s) => bucket_start(kind, instant_or_date("from", s)?),
        None => {
            let back = match kind {
                "week" => 11,
                "month" => 11,
                _ => 29,
            };
            (0..back).fold(last, |b, _| bucket_start(kind, b - 1))
        }
    };
    if first > last {
        return Err(ApiError::bad_request("from is after to"));
    }
    let mut starts = vec![first];
    while *starts.last().expect("one") < last {
        let next = bucket_next(kind, *starts.last().expect("one"));
        starts.push(next);
        if starts.len() > MAX_BUCKETS {
            return Err(ApiError::bad_request(&format!("at most {MAX_BUCKETS} buckets")).details(json!({"max_buckets": MAX_BUCKETS})));
        }
    }
    let end = bucket_next(kind, last);
    let counted = "user_id = ?1 AND game = ?2 AND outcome IN ('valid', 'approved')";
    let mut before = Sums::default();
    for r in h.all(&format!("SELECT {COUNTED_COLUMNS} FROM jobs WHERE {counted} AND delivered_at < ?3"), params![&user.user_id, g.as_str(), first]).await? {
        before.add(&r);
    }
    let rows = h
        .all(
            &format!("SELECT {COUNTED_COLUMNS} FROM jobs WHERE {counted} AND delivered_at >= ?3 AND delivered_at < ?4 ORDER BY delivered_at"),
            params![&user.user_id, g.as_str(), first, end],
        )
        .await?;
    let cfg = config::scoring(h).await?.cfg;
    let mut sums = vec![Sums::default(); starts.len()];
    for r in &rows {
        let t = r.i("delivered_at");
        let i = starts.partition_point(|s| *s <= t).saturating_sub(1);
        sums[i].add(r);
    }
    let mut running = before.clone();
    let items: Vec<Value> = starts
        .iter()
        .zip(&sums)
        .map(|(s, b)| {
            running.merge(b);
            let mut v = b.json(&cfg);
            v["start"] = rfc3339(*s).into();
            v["end"] = rfc3339(bucket_next(kind, *s)).into();
            v["running"] = running.json(&cfg);
            v
        })
        .collect();
    Ok(Response::ok(json!({
        "game": g.as_str(), "discord_user_id": user.discord_user_id, "bucket": kind,
        "from": rfc3339(first), "to": rfc3339(end), "currency": jobs::currency(g),
        "before": before.json(&cfg), "items": items,
    })))
}

// ---- leaderboards (§5) -----------------------------------------------------------

/// `[start, end)` of a period, and its `at` label.
pub fn period(kind: &str, at: Option<&str>, now: i64) -> ApiResult<(Option<(i64, i64)>, Value)> {
    let bad = || ApiError::bad_request("bad period or at").details(json!({"period": kind, "at": at}));
    match kind {
        "all" => Ok((None, Value::Null)),
        "month" => {
            let (y, m) = match at {
                Some(s) => {
                    let (y, m) = s.split_once('-').ok_or_else(bad)?;
                    let (y, m) = (y.parse::<i64>().map_err(|_| bad())?, m.parse::<u32>().map_err(|_| bad())?);
                    if !(1..=12).contains(&m) || s.len() != 7 {
                        return Err(bad());
                    }
                    (y, m)
                }
                None => util::year_month_of(now),
            };
            let (ny, nm) = if m == 12 { (y + 1, 1) } else { (y, m + 1) };
            Ok((Some((util::month_start(y, m), util::month_start(ny, nm))), format!("{y:04}-{m:02}").into()))
        }
        "week" => {
            let (y, w) = match at {
                Some(s) => {
                    let (y, w) = s.split_once("-W").ok_or_else(bad)?;
                    let (y, w) = (y.parse::<i64>().map_err(|_| bad())?, w.parse::<u32>().map_err(|_| bad())?);
                    if w == 0 || w > util::iso_weeks_in_year(y) {
                        return Err(bad());
                    }
                    (y, w)
                }
                None => util::iso_week_of(now),
            };
            let start = util::iso_week_start(y, w);
            Ok((Some((start, start + 7 * 86_400_000)), format!("{y:04}-W{w:02}").into()))
        }
        _ => Err(bad()),
    }
}

pub async fn leaderboard<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request, g: &str) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    auth::service(h, req)?;
    let g = game(g)?;
    let now = h.now_ms();
    let kind = req.q("period").unwrap_or("all");
    let (range, at) = period(kind, req.q("at"), now)?;
    let division = req.q("division").unwrap_or("all");
    if !matches!(division, "all" | "singleplayer") {
        return Err(ApiError::bad_request("division is all or singleplayer"));
    }
    let (limit, offset) = http::page(req, now)?;
    // What to rank by (owner, 2026-10-15); damage ranks the least first.
    let sort = req.q("sort").unwrap_or("points");
    if !matches!(sort, "points" | "distance" | "game_distance" | "fuel" | "income" | "damage") {
        return Err(ApiError::bad_request("sort is points, distance, game_distance, fuel, income or damage").details(json!({"sort": sort})));
    }
    let order = req.q("order").unwrap_or(if sort == "damage" { "asc" } else { "desc" });
    if !matches!(order, "asc" | "desc") {
        return Err(ApiError::bad_request("order is asc or desc"));
    }
    let (from, to) = range.unwrap_or((i64::MIN, i64::MAX));
    let rows = h
        .all(
            &format!(
                "SELECT u.user_id, u.discord_user_id, u.display_name, SUM(j.points) AS points, COUNT(*) AS n,
                        SUM(j.world_km) AS world_km, SUM(j.game_km) AS game_km, MAX(j.delivered_at) AS reached,
                        COALESCE(SUM(json_extract(j.summary, '$.fuel_used_l')), 0) AS fuel,
                        COALESCE(SUM(json_extract(j.summary, '$.income')), 0) AS income,
                        AVG(json_extract(j.summary, '$.damage_pct')) AS damage
                 FROM jobs j JOIN users u ON u.user_id = j.user_id
                 WHERE j.game = ?1 AND j.outcome IN ('valid', 'approved') AND u.disabled = 0
                   AND j.delivered_at >= ?2 AND j.delivered_at < ?3 {}
                 GROUP BY u.user_id",
                if division == "singleplayer" { "AND u.singleplayer_division = 1" } else { "" }
            ),
            params![g.as_str(), from, to],
        )
        .await?;
    let cfg = config::scoring(h).await?.cfg;
    // (value ranked by, reached, user, item); players with no damage data last.
    let mut board: Vec<(Option<f64>, i64, String, Value)> = rows
        .iter()
        .map(|r| {
            let pts = cfg.rules.floor_points(r.f("points"));
            let (w, gk) = (r.f("world_km"), r.f("game_km"));
            let damage = r.opt_f("damage").map(round2);
            let item = json!({"user_id": r.s("user_id"), "discord_user_id": r.s("discord_user_id"),
                "display_name": r.s("display_name"), "points": pts, "job_count": r.i("n"),
                "world_km": round2(w), "world_mi": mi(w), "game_km": round2(gk), "game_mi": mi(gk),
                "fuel_used_l": round2(r.f("fuel")), "income": r.f("income").round() as i64, "damage_pct_avg": damage});
            let key = match sort {
                "distance" => Some(round2(w)),
                "game_distance" => Some(round2(gk)),
                "fuel" => Some(round2(r.f("fuel"))),
                "income" => Some(r.f("income").round()),
                "damage" => damage,
                _ => Some(pts),
            };
            (key, r.i("reached"), r.s("user_id"), item)
        })
        .collect();
    board.sort_by(|a, b| {
        let by = match (a.0, b.0) {
            (Some(x), Some(y)) if order == "asc" => x.total_cmp(&y),
            (Some(x), Some(y)) => y.total_cmp(&x),
            (Some(_), None) => std::cmp::Ordering::Less,
            (None, Some(_)) => std::cmp::Ordering::Greater,
            (None, None) => std::cmp::Ordering::Equal,
        };
        by.then(a.1.cmp(&b.1)).then(a.2.cmp(&b.2))
    });
    let total = board.len();
    let mut items = Vec::new();
    let mut rank = 0;
    for (i, (key, _, _, item)) in board.iter().enumerate() {
        if i == 0 || *key != board[i - 1].0 {
            rank = i + 1;
        }
        if i >= offset && i < offset + limit {
            let mut item = item.clone();
            item["rank"] = rank.into();
            items.push(item);
        }
    }
    let mut v = http::list(items, offset, limit, Some(total), offset + limit < total, now);
    v["game"] = g.as_str().into();
    v["period"] = kind.into();
    v["at"] = at;
    v["division"] = division.into();
    v["sort"] = sort.into();
    v["order"] = order.into();
    v["currency"] = jobs::currency(g).into();
    v["period_start"] = range.map_or(Value::Null, |r| util::rfc3339(r.0).into());
    v["period_end"] = range.map_or(Value::Null, |r| util::rfc3339(r.1).into());
    v["generated_at"] = util::rfc3339(now).into();
    Ok(Response::ok(v))
}
```

`crates/pt-server/src/route.rs`:

```rs
//! Route GeoJSON (PUBLIC_API §4, ADMIN_API §5): a job's points projected to
//! WGS84 with `pt_core::projection`, split into features wherever the bot should
//! draw differently.

use pt_core::projection;
use pt_core::timeline::{Job, JobEvent, Point};
use pt_core::Config;
use serde_json::{json, Value};

use crate::env::{Host, RowExt};
use crate::http::{ApiResult, Request, Response};
use crate::jobs::class_name;
use crate::public::job_row;
use crate::util::{rfc3339, round2};
use crate::{admin, auth, config};

pub const MAX_VERTICES: usize = 5000;

/// A pause: the wall clock ran this much further than the simulation.
const PAUSE_MS: i64 = 5_000;

/// Jumps between runs shorter than this (game metres) are no break worth drawing:
/// a load lands where the save was made.
const CONNECT_M: f64 = 50.0;

/// Douglas–Peucker tolerances tried in turn (game metres) until the route fits.
const TOLERANCES_M: [f64; 12] = [1.0, 2.0, 5.0, 10.0, 20.0, 50.0, 100.0, 200.0, 500.0, 1000.0, 2000.0, 5000.0];

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum Status {
    Kept,
    Restored,
    Reverted,
}

impl Status {
    fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Status::Kept => "kept",
            Status::Restored => "restored",
            Status::Reverted => "reverted",
        }
    }
}

struct Seg {
    kind: &'static str,
    status: Status,
    /// Game X/Z.
    pts: Vec<[f64; 2]>,
    scale: Option<f64>,
    start: i64,
    end: i64,
    counted: bool,
    game_km: f64,
    world_km: f64,
}

/// Game metres per degree in the flat local projection (one degree of
/// latitude), so a 1:1 map keeps its real size.
const LOCAL_M_PER_DEG: f64 = 111_320.0;

/// `Some(centre)` (game x, z) when any point of the route falls outside the
/// basemap projection's range: a 1:1 map mod's distances, read at the vanilla
/// map's scale, wrap around the globe (the owner's Alaska job, 2026-10-20:
/// longitudes down to -332°). The whole route is then drawn flat in game
/// metres around that centre.
fn local_centre(job: &Job, shapes: &[Vec<[f64; 2]>]) -> Option<[f64; 2]> {
    let pts = || shapes.iter().flatten();
    let off = pts().any(|p| {
        let [lon, lat] = projection::to_lon_lat(job.game, p[0], p[1]);
        !(lon.is_finite() && lat.is_finite() && (-180.0..=180.0).contains(&lon) && (-85.0..=85.0).contains(&lat))
    });
    if !off {
        return None;
    }
    let (mut lo, mut hi) = ([f64::INFINITY; 2], [f64::NEG_INFINITY; 2]);
    for p in pts() {
        lo = [lo[0].min(p[0]), lo[1].min(p[1])];
        hi = [hi[0].max(p[0]), hi[1].max(p[1])];
    }
    Some([(lo[0] + hi[0]) / 2.0, (lo[1] + hi[1]) / 2.0])
}

fn xz(p: &Point) -> Option<[f64; 2]> {
    p.pos.map(|q| [q[0], q[2]])
}

fn dist(a: [f64; 2], b: [f64; 2]) -> f64 {
    (a[0] - b[0]).hypot(a[1] - b[1])
}

/// Kept points restored by a load (`LoadRestore`): the ones right after the fork.
fn kept_status(job: &Job) -> Vec<Status> {
    let mut st = vec![Status::Kept; job.kept.len()];
    for e in &job.events {
        if let JobEvent::LoadRestore { from_fork_seq, restored_points, .. } = e {
            if let Some(i) = job.kept.iter().position(|p| p.seq == *from_fork_seq) {
                for s in st.iter_mut().skip(i + 1).take(*restored_points) {
                    *s = Status::Restored;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    st
}

/// What lies between two points that are not neighbours on one drive.
fn connector(job: &Job, a: &Point, b: &Point, pa: [f64; 2], pb: [f64; 2]) -> Option<Seg> {
    let seg = |kind, counted, game_km: f64, world_km| Seg {
        kind, status: Status::Kept, pts: vec![pa, pb], scale: None, start: a.wall_ms, end: b.wall_ms, counted, game_km, world_km,
    };
    if b.after_teleport {
        let via = job.events.iter().find_map(|e| match e {
            JobEvent::Teleport { ferry_or_train, via, wall_ms, .. } if *wall_ms == b.wall_ms => Some((*ferry_or_train, via.clone())),
            _ => None,
        });
        let kind = match via {
            Some((true, Some(v))) if v == "ferry" => "ferry",
            Some((true, Some(v))) if v == "train" => "train",
            Some((true, _)) => "ferry_or_train",
            _ => "teleport",
        };
        return Some(seg(kind, false, 0.0, 0.0));
    }
    if let Some(g) = job.active_gaps().find(|g| g.to_sess == b.sess && g.to_seq == b.seq) {
        let km = g.game_km.unwrap_or(0.0).max(0.0);
        return Some(seg("gap", g.counted, km, km / g.local_scale));
    }
    (dist(pa, pb) > CONNECT_M).then(|| seg("teleport", false, 0.0, 0.0))
}

/// Splits one ordered run of points into driving features and connectors.
fn segments(job: &Job, points: &[(&Point, Status)], admin: bool, out: &mut Vec<Seg>) {
    let wot = job.info.is_world_of_trucks();
    let pts: Vec<(&Point, Status, [f64; 2])> = points.iter().filter_map(|(p, s)| xz(p).map(|q| (*p, *s, q))).collect();
    let mut cur: Option<Seg> = None;
    for w in pts.windows(2) {
        let ((a, _, pa), (b, sb, pb)) = (w[0], w[1]);
        let counted = wot || (b.cargo_loaded && b.trailer_connected);
        let same_drive = a.run == b.run && a.truck == b.truck && !b.after_teleport;
        if !same_drive {
            out.extend(cur.take());
            if let Some(mut c) = connector(job, a, b, pa, pb) {
                c.status = sb;
                out.push(c);
            }
            continue;
        }
        let paused = a.sess == b.sess && (b.wall_ms - a.wall_ms) - (b.sim_us.saturating_sub(a.sim_us) / 1000) as i64 > PAUSE_MS;
        let split = cur.as_ref().is_some_and(|c| {
            paused || c.scale != Some(b.local_scale) || c.counted != counted || (admin && c.status != sb)
        });
        if split {
            out.extend(cur.take());
        }
        let c = cur.get_or_insert_with(|| Seg {
            kind: "driving", status: sb, pts: vec![pa], scale: Some(b.local_scale), start: a.wall_ms, end: a.wall_ms,
            counted, game_km: 0.0, world_km: 0.0,
        });
        c.pts.push(pb);
        c.end = b.wall_ms;
        if let (Some(x), Some(y)) = (a.odometer_km, b.odometer_km) {
            let km = (y - x).max(0.0);
            c.game_km += km;
            c.world_km += km / b.local_scale;
        }
    }
    out.extend(cur);
}

/// Douglas–Peucker: the indices of the points to keep.
fn simplify(pts: &[[f64; 2]], tol: f64) -> Vec<[f64; 2]> {
    if pts.len() < 3 {
        return pts.to_vec();
    }
    let mut keep = vec![false; pts.len()];
    keep[0] = true;
    keep[pts.len() - 1] = true;
    let mut stack = vec![(0, pts.len() - 1)];
    while let Some((i, j)) = stack.pop() {
        let (a, b) = (pts[i], pts[j]);
        let len = dist(a, b);
        let (mut far, mut at) = (0.0, 0);
        for (k, p) in pts.iter().enumerate().take(j).skip(i + 1) {
            let d = if len == 0.0 {
                dist(*p, a)
            } else {
                ((b[0] - a[0]) * (a[1] - p[1]) - (a[0] - p[0]) * (b[1] - a[1])).abs() / len
            };
            if d > far {
                (far, at) = (d, k);
            }
        }
        if far > tol {
            keep[at] = true;
            stack.push((i, at));
            stack.push((at, j));
        }
    }
    pts.iter().zip(keep).filter(|(_, k)| *k).map(|(p, _)| *p).collect()
}

fn r6(v: f64) -> f64 {
    (v * 1e6).round() / 1e6
}

/// The FeatureCollection for a job; `admin` adds reverted material and statuses.
pub fn geojson(job: &Job, cfg: &Config, job_id: &str, admin: bool) -> Value {
    let status = kept_status(job);
    let kept: Vec<(&Point, Status)> = job.kept.iter().zip(status.iter().copied()).collect();
    let mut segs = Vec::new();
    segments(job, &kept, admin, &mut segs);
    if admin {
        for br in &job.reverted {
            let fork = job.kept.iter().find(|p| p.seq == br.fork_seq);
            let pts: Vec<(&Point, Status)> = fork.into_iter().chain(br.points.iter()).map(|p| (p, Status::Reverted)).collect();
            let mut s = Vec::new();
            segments(job, &pts, true, &mut s);
            for x in &mut s {
                x.status = Status::Reverted;
            }
            segs.extend(s);
        }
        segs.sort_by_key(|s| (s.start, s.status == Status::Reverted));
    }

    // Simplify the driving features until the whole route fits.
    let fixed: usize = segs.iter().filter(|s| s.kind != "driving").map(|s| s.pts.len()).sum();
    let mut tol = 0.0;
    let mut shapes: Vec<Vec<[f64; 2]>> = segs.iter().map(|s| s.pts.clone()).collect();
    for t in TOLERANCES_M {
        tol = t;
        shapes = segs.iter().map(|s| if s.kind == "driving" { simplify(&s.pts, t) } else { s.pts.clone() }).collect();
        if shapes.iter().map(Vec::len).sum::<usize>() <= MAX_VERTICES.max(fixed) {
            break;
        }
    }

    let vanilla = cfg.map.scale.vanilla(job.game);
    let local = local_centre(job, &shapes);
    let project = |p: &[f64; 2]| match local {
        Some([cx, cz]) => [(p[0] - cx) / LOCAL_M_PER_DEG, -(p[1] - cz) / LOCAL_M_PER_DEG],
        None => projection::to_lon_lat(job.game, p[0], p[1]),
    };
    let (mut lo, mut hi) = ([f64::INFINITY; 2], [f64::NEG_INFINITY; 2]);
    let mut features = Vec::new();
    let mut vertices = 0;
    for (i, (s, shape)) in segs.iter().zip(&shapes).enumerate() {
        let coords: Vec<Value> = shape
            .iter()
            .map(|p| {
                let [lon, lat] = project(p);
                lo = [lo[0].min(lon), lo[1].min(lat)];
                hi = [hi[0].max(lon), hi[1].max(lat)];
                json!([r6(lon), r6(lat)])
            })
            .collect();
        vertices += coords.len();
        let mut props = json!({
            "index": i, "segment": s.kind, "local_scale": s.scale,
            "scale_class": class_name(vanilla.classify(s.scale)),
            "start_at": rfc3339(s.start), "end_at": rfc3339(s.end),
            "counted": s.counted, "world_km": round2(s.world_km), "game_km": round2(s.game_km),
        });
        if admin {
            props["status"] = s.status.as_str().into();
        }
        features.push(json!({"type": "Feature", "geometry": {"type": "LineString", "coordinates": coords}, "properties": props}));
    }
    let bbox = if vertices > 0 { json!([r6(lo[0]), r6(lo[1]), r6(hi[0]), r6(hi[1])]) } else { Value::Null };
    json!({
        "type": "FeatureCollection",
        "bbox": bbox,
        "properties": {
            "job_id": job_id, "game": job.game.as_str(), "vertex_count": vertices, "max_vertices": MAX_VERTICES,
            // Game metres at the main road scale, as 1:1 metres.
            "simplification_tolerance_world_m": crate::util::round3(tol / vanilla.main_road_local_scale()),
            "includes_reverted": admin,
            // "basemap": lines up with the game's basemap tiles. "local": the
            // route left the basemap's projection (a 1:1 map mod), so it is
            // drawn flat in game metres around 0°, 0°, off any tiles.
            "projection": if local.is_some() { "local" } else { "basemap" },
        },
        "features": features,
    })
}

async fn respond<H: Host>(h: &H, id: &str, admin_view: bool) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    let row = job_row(h, id).await?;
    let job_id = row.s("job_id");
    let (job, _) = admin::load_job(h, &job_id).await?;
    let cfg = config::scoring(h).await?.cfg;
    let v = geojson(&job, &cfg, &job_id, admin_view);
    Ok(Response::bytes(200, "application/geo+json", v.to_string().into_bytes()))
}

pub async fn public<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request, id: &str) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    auth::service(h, req)?;
    respond(h, id, false).await
}

pub async fn admin<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request, id: &str) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    auth::admin(h, req).await?;
    respond(h, id, true).await
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn douglas_peucker() {
        let line: Vec<[f64; 2]> = (0..=100).map(|i| [i as f64, 0.0]).collect();
        assert_eq!(simplify(&line, 1.0), vec![[0.0, 0.0], [100.0, 0.0]]);
        let bend = vec![[0.0, 0.0], [5.0, 0.1], [10.0, 0.0], [10.0, 10.0]];
        assert_eq!(simplify(&bend, 1.0), vec![[0.0, 0.0], [10.0, 0.0], [10.0, 10.0]]);
        assert_eq!(simplify(&bend, 0.01).len(), 4);
    }
}
```

```rs
//! Path → handler. Every response, success or error, goes through [`handle`].

use crate::env::Host;
use crate::http::{ApiError, ApiResult, Request, Response};
use crate::{admin, ingest, manage, manual, public, route, updates};

pub async fn handle<H: Host>(h: &H, req: Request) -> Response {
    match dispatch(h, &req).await {
        Ok(r) => r,
        Err(e) => e.response(),
    }
}

async fn dispatch<H: Host>(h: &H, req: &Request) -> ApiResult<Response> {
    let segs: Vec<String> = req.path.trim_matches('/').split('/').map(crate::http::percent_decode).collect();
    let s: Vec<&str> = segs.iter().map(String::as_str).collect();
    let m = req.method.as_str();
    match (m, s.as_slice()) {
        ("GET", [""]) => Ok(Response::ok(serde_json::json!({"service": "plasmatrack", "api": "v1"}))),
        ("POST", ["api", "v1", "chunks"]) => ingest::upload(h, req).await,
        ("GET", ["dl", "trace", id]) => admin::download_trace(h, req, id).await,
        ("GET", ["dl", "evidence", id]) => manual::download(h, req, id).await,
        ("GET", ["dl", "releases", rest @ ..]) => updates::file(h, req, rest).await,
        ("GET", ["dl", "uninstall"]) => updates::uninstall(h, "windows").await,
        ("GET", ["dl", "uninstall", p @ ("windows" | "linux")]) => updates::uninstall(h, p).await,
        ("GET", ["api", "v1", "client", "update"]) => updates::client_update(h, req).await,

        // Player self-service.

        // Moderators.

        ("GET", ["api", "v1", "admin", "review-queue", "count"]) => admin::review_queue_count(h, req).await,
        ("GET", ["api", "v1", "admin", "truckersmp", "flags"]) => admin::truckersmp_flags(h, req).await,

        ("POST", ["api", "v1", "admin", "revocations"]) => manage::revocation_create(h, req).await,
        ("POST", ["api", "v1", "admin", "revocations", id, "cancel"]) => manage::revocation_cancel(h, req, id).await,
        ("GET", ["api", "v1", "admin", "admins"]) => manage::admins_list(h, req).await,
        ("POST", ["api", "v1", "admin", "admins"]) => manage::admin_add(h, req).await,
        ("DELETE", ["api", "v1", "admin", "admins", d]) => manage::admin_remove(h, req, d).await,
        ("GET", ["api", "v1", "admin", "audit"]) => admin::audit_log(h, req).await,
        ("POST", ["api", "v1", "admin", "backups"]) => crate::backup::now(h, req).await,

        _ => Err(ApiError::not_found("endpoint")),
    }
}
```

`crates/pt-server/src/scorer.rs`:

```rs
//! The per-(player, game) scorer (PLAN §7a). On Cloudflare one Durable Object
//! holds a [`Scorer`], so a player's frames are processed strictly in order,
//! one batch at a time.
//!
//! Since 2026-10-20 the scorer keeps nothing large in memory: the timelines'
//! points are in its own SQLite database ([`SqlPoints`]), and so is its state
//! (the timelines without their points, the processed chunks, the job memos).
//! Both are written after every chunk, between two awaits, so they commit
//! together: an object that restarts continues exactly where the last chunk
//! left it. (Before, the whole state went to R2 as one JSON snapshot, and a
//! job driven for two days made it 208 MB: more than an object's 128 MB.)

use std::collections::BTreeMap;

use pt_core::store::TrackId;
use pt_core::timeline::{Job, JobState, Notice, Profiles};
use pt_core::trace::{parse_frame, Body};
use pt_core::Game;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

use crate::config;
use crate::env::{Host, LocalSql, RowExt, SqlVal};
use crate::http::{ApiError, ApiResult};
use crate::jobs::{self, Facts, Trigger};
use crate::params;
use crate::points::{self, SqlPoints};
use crate::store::{self, User};
use crate::util;

/// Part of the state key: state of another format is not loaded, so every
/// scorer rebuilds once from the raw data (since 2026-10-23 a rebuild keeps
/// stored deliveries as they are, [`jobs::persist`]). 2 (2026-10-15): job memos know when
/// a job was stored, and finished jobs wait in `unstored`. 3 (2026-10-16): road
/// trips (`car_job`) are tracked, so past ones appear. 4 (2026-10-20): points
/// and state in the scorer's own database.
pub const SNAPSHOT_FORMAT: u32 = 4;
/// At most this many chunks per pass. A catch-up after hours offline (or a
/// capture-mode session: three times the frames, in small live chunks) is
/// worked through in several passes, so one never runs out of time or
/// subrequests; the Durable Object starts the next one ([`Report::more`]).
pub const MAX_CHUNKS_PER_PASS: usize = 400;
/// A job still being driven is stored at most this often while only its
/// points grow; any other change stores it at once.
pub const LIVE_STORE_EVERY_MS: i64 = 60_000;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]
struct JobMemo {
    /// What was last stored: changes when the job changes (state, events, points).
    fingerprint: String,
    delivered_at: Option<i64>,
    /// The fingerprint without the point count, and when it was last stored.
    #[serde(default)]
    shape: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    stored_ms: i64,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(bound = "")]
struct Snapshot<D> {
    /// [`config::timeline_key`] the timelines were built with.
    key: String,
    profiles: Profiles<SqlPoints<D>>,
    /// Sessions in processing order, with how many chunks are done.
    sessions: Vec<(String, i64)>,
    jobs: BTreeMap<String, JobMemo>,
    /// Latest TruckersMP (server, account) per session, while connected.
    truckersmp: BTreeMap<String, (u64, u64)>,
    /// Jobs that left the timelines, their points still in the store, not
    /// looked at yet.
    #[serde(default)]
    evicted: Vec<Job<TrackId>>,
    /// Finished jobs that left the timelines but could not be stored yet.
    #[serde(default)]
    unstored: Vec<(Job<TrackId>, Facts)>,
    /// A rebuild still working through the raw data in passes. Until it has
    /// caught up, jobs still in the timelines are only part-way replayed and
    /// are not stored (2026-10-15: a refresh wrote a delivered job back to
    /// `tracking` for a few minutes).
    #[serde(default)]
    rebuilding: bool,
}

impl<D: LocalSql + Clone> Snapshot<D> {
    /// An empty state; the database's points are dropped.
    fn new(key: String, cfg: pt_core::Config, db: &D) -> Snapshot<D> {
        let mut store = SqlPoints::open(db.clone());
        store.clear();
        Snapshot {
            key,
            profiles: Profiles::with_store(cfg, store),
            sessions: Vec::new(),
            jobs: BTreeMap::new(),
            truckersmp: BTreeMap::new(),
            evicted: Vec::new(),
            unstored: Vec::new(),
            rebuilding: false,
        }
    }

    /// Writes the points and the state. Synchronous: with no await in between,
    /// they commit together.
    fn commit(&mut self, db: &D) -> ApiResult<()> {
        self.profiles.store_mut().flush();
        let state = serde_json::to_vec(&*self).map_err(|e| ApiError::internal(&e.to_string()))?;
        db.exec("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO pt_kv (k, v) VALUES ('state', ?1)", &[SqlVal::Blob(state)]).map_err(|e| ApiError::internal(&e.0))?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Report {
    pub chunks: usize,
    pub frames: usize,
    pub jobs_stored: usize,
    pub rebuilt: bool,
    /// Chunks are left for another pass ([`MAX_CHUNKS_PER_PASS`]).
    pub more: bool,
}

pub struct Scorer<D> {
    pub user_id: String,
    pub game: Game,
    db: D,
    snap: Option<Snapshot<D>>,
}

/// Where the state lived before 2026-10-20 (R2); deleted once replaced.
fn legacy_snapshot_key(user_id: &str, game: Game) -> String {
    format!("snap/{user_id}/{}.json.gz", game.as_str())
}

/// `counts`: kept points, and reverted points over all branches ([`Job::point_counts`]).
fn fingerprint<P>(j: &Job<P>, counts: (usize, usize)) -> String {
    format!("{}|{}", shape(j, counts), counts.0)
}

/// Everything in the fingerprint but the kept points, which grow with every
/// upload while the job is driven.
fn shape<P>(j: &Job<P>, (_, reverted): (usize, usize)) -> String {
    format!("{:?}|{}|{}|{}|{}|{}", j.state, j.events.len(), reverted, j.gaps.len(), j.delivered.is_some(), j.info.cargo_loaded)
}

fn memo_key<P>(j: &Job<P>) -> String {
    format!("{}/{}", j.profile, j.id)
}

/// What a job is stored with besides itself.
fn job_facts<D: LocalSql>(snap: &Snapshot<D>, j: &Job<TrackId>) -> Facts {
    let point_sess = snap.profiles.point_sessions(j);
    let mut from_points = point_sess.clone();
    from_points.sort_unstable();
    from_points.dedup();
    let sessions: Vec<String> =
        from_points.iter().filter_map(|i| snap.profiles.session_id(&j.profile, *i).map(str::to_string)).collect();
    let mut idx = point_sess;
    idx.extend(j.gaps.iter().map(|g| g.to_sess));
    idx.sort_unstable();
    idx.dedup();
    let sess_ids = idx.into_iter().filter_map(|i| snap.profiles.session_id(&j.profile, i).map(|s| (i, s.to_string()))).collect();
    let truckersmp = sessions.iter().rev().find_map(|s| snap.truckersmp.get(s).copied());
    Facts { delivered_at: snap.jobs.get(&memo_key(j)).and_then(|m| m.delivered_at), sessions, sess_ids, truckersmp }
}

impl<D: LocalSql + Clone> Scorer<D> {
    /// `db`: the scorer's own database (its Durable Object's storage).
    pub fn new(user_id: &str, game: Game, db: D) -> Scorer<D> {
        Scorer { user_id: user_id.to_string(), game, db, snap: None }
    }

    /// Loads the state if not in memory. Returns true when there was none
    /// usable and a new, empty one was started.
    ///
    /// `replayed`: the player has raw data already. A state replaced because
    /// its key changed (a new [`SNAPSHOT_FORMAT`], a timeline config change)
    /// then catches up as a rebuild: stored jobs stay as they were, and nobody
    /// is told again (2026-10-23: every deploy re-sent the same speed-penalty
    /// DMs, and re-scored old jobs with the new rules).
    fn load(&mut self, key: &str, cfg: &pt_core::Config, replayed: bool) -> ApiResult<bool> {
        if self.snap.as_ref().is_some_and(|s| s.key == key) {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        points::ensure_schema(&self.db);
        let rows = self.db.exec("SELECT v FROM pt_kv WHERE k = 'state'", &[]).map_err(|e| ApiError::internal(&e.0))?;
        let had_state = !rows.is_empty() || self.snap.is_some();
        let stored = rows.into_iter().next().and_then(|mut r| serde_json::from_slice::<Snapshot<D>>(&r.remove(0).into_bytes()).ok());
        match stored {
            Some(mut s) if s.key == key => {
                s.profiles.store_mut().attach(self.db.clone());
                self.snap = Some(s);
                Ok(false)
            }
            _ => {
                let mut s = Snapshot::new(key.to_string(), cfg.clone(), &self.db);
                s.rebuilding = had_state && replayed;
                s.commit(&self.db)?;
                self.snap = Some(s);
                Ok(true)
            }
        }
    }

    /// Forgets everything; the next [`Scorer::process`] replays all raw data.
    pub async fn reset<H: Host>(&mut self, h: &H) -> ApiResult<()> {
        self.snap = None;
        points::ensure_schema(&self.db);
        for sql in ["DELETE FROM pt_points", "DELETE FROM pt_kv"] {
            self.db.exec(sql, &[]).map_err(|e| ApiError::internal(&e.0))?;
        }
        h.blob_delete(&legacy_snapshot_key(&self.user_id, self.game)).await?;
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Points held in memory now, and bytes of points on disk (tests, logs).
    pub fn footprint(&self) -> (usize, u64) {
        self.snap.as_ref().map_or((0, 0), |s| (s.profiles.store().points_in_memory(), s.profiles.store().stored_bytes()))
    }

    /// Processes every chunk not processed yet, then stores the jobs that changed.
    pub async fn process<H: Host>(&mut self, h: &H) -> ApiResult<Report> {
        let user = store::user_by_id(h, &self.user_id).await?.ok_or_else(|| ApiError::not_found("user"))?;
        let scoring = config::scoring(h).await?;
        let key = format!("{SNAPSHOT_FORMAT}:{}", config::timeline_key(&scoring.cfg));
        let sessions = h
            .all(
                "SELECT sess, chunk_count FROM plugin_sessions WHERE user_id = ?1 AND game = ?2 ORDER BY first_wall_ms, sess",
                params![&self.user_id, self.game.as_str()],
            )
            .await?;
        let sessions: Vec<(String, i64)> = sessions.iter().map(|r| (r.s("sess"), r.i("chunk_count"))).collect();
        let mut report = Report::default();
        if self.load(&key, &scoring.cfg, !sessions.is_empty())? {
            report.rebuilt = self.snap.as_ref().is_some_and(|s| s.rebuilding);
            // The state before 2026-10-20 is not needed any more.
            h.blob_delete(&legacy_snapshot_key(&self.user_id, self.game)).await?;
        }

        let Scorer { db, snap: snap_slot, user_id, game } = self;
        // Data in order: the processed sessions are a prefix of the list, and only
        // the last of them may still grow. Anything else rebuilds from scratch.
        let in_order = {
            let snap = snap_slot.as_ref().expect("loaded");
            let n = snap.sessions.len();
            snap.sessions.iter().enumerate().all(|(i, (s, done))| {
                sessions.get(i).is_some_and(|(sess, count)| sess == s && (i + 1 == n || count == done))
            })
        };
        if !in_order {
            report.rebuilt = true;
            let mut snap = Snapshot::new(key.clone(), scoring.cfg.clone(), db);
            snap.rebuilding = true;
            snap.commit(db)?;
            *snap_slot = Some(snap);
        }
        let snap = snap_slot.as_mut().expect("loaded");
        let trigger = if snap.rebuilding { Trigger::Rebuild } else { Trigger::Upload };

        let mp = scoring.cfg.multiplayer.clone();
        let mut penalties: Vec<(String, u32, i64)> = Vec::new();
        'sessions: for (i, (sess, count)) in sessions.iter().enumerate() {
            let done = snap.sessions.get(i).map_or(0, |(_, d)| *d);
            if done >= *count {
                continue;
            }
            if snap.sessions.len() <= i {
                snap.sessions.push((sess.clone(), 0));
            }
            if report.chunks >= MAX_CHUNKS_PER_PASS {
                report.more = true;
                break;
            }
            // One query for this pass's chunks of the session.
            let budget = (MAX_CHUNKS_PER_PASS - report.chunks) as i64;
            let rows = h
                .all(
                    "SELECT chunk_no, r2_key, received_at FROM raw_chunks WHERE user_id = ?1 AND sess = ?2 AND chunk_no >= ?3
                     ORDER BY chunk_no LIMIT ?4",
                    params![&*user_id, sess, done, budget],
                )
                .await?;
            for (k, chunk_no) in (done..*count).enumerate() {
                if report.chunks >= MAX_CHUNKS_PER_PASS {
                    report.more = true;
                    break 'sessions;
                }
                let row = rows.get(k).filter(|r| r.i("chunk_no") == chunk_no).ok_or_else(|| ApiError::internal("missing chunk"))?;
                let blob = h.blob_get(&row.s("r2_key")).await?.ok_or_else(|| ApiError::internal("missing chunk data"))?;
                let text = util::gunzip(&blob, usize::MAX).map_err(|e| ApiError::internal(&e.to_string()))?;
                let received_at = row.i("received_at");
                // From here to the commit: no await, so the chunk's points and
                // the state that counts it commit together.
                for line in text.split(|b| *b == b'\n').filter(|l| !l.is_empty()) {
                    let Ok(line) = std::str::from_utf8(line) else { continue };
                    let Ok(f) = parse_frame(line, &mp) else { continue };
                    if let Body::Truckersmp { connected: true, server_id, account_id, .. } = f.body {
                        if account_id > 0 {
                            snap.truckersmp.insert(f.sess.clone(), (server_id, account_id));
                        }
                    }
                    snap.profiles.push(&f);
                    report.frames += 1;
                }
                // Deliveries take the server's clock of the chunk they arrived in.
                for j in snap.profiles.jobs() {
                    let m = snap.jobs.entry(memo_key(j)).or_default();
                    match (j.delivered.is_some(), m.delivered_at) {
                        (true, None) => m.delivered_at = Some(received_at),
                        (false, Some(_)) => m.delivered_at = None,
                        _ => {}
                    }
                }
                for (profile, n) in snap.profiles.take_notices() {
                    if let Notice::PenaltyActivated { job, wall_ms } = n {
                        penalties.push((profile, job, wall_ms));
                    }
                }
                let evicted = snap.profiles.take_evicted_live();
                snap.evicted.extend(evicted);
                snap.sessions[i].1 = chunk_no + 1;
                report.chunks += 1;
                snap.commit(db)?;
            }
        }

        // Evicted jobs: unchanged since stored, the server's copy is final;
        // otherwise they wait in `unstored` until stored.
        for j in std::mem::take(&mut snap.evicted) {
            let key = memo_key(&j);
            let stored = snap.jobs.get(&key).is_some_and(|m| m.fingerprint == fingerprint(&j, j.point_counts(snap.profiles.store())));
            snap.jobs.remove(&key);
            if stored {
                snap.profiles.release(&j);
                continue;
            }
            let f = job_facts(snap, &j);
            snap.unstored.push((j, f));
        }
        snap.commit(db)?;
        // Finished jobs exist only here now: one that cannot be stored stays
        // for the next pass.
        while let Some((job, f)) = snap.unstored.first().cloned() {
            match jobs::persist(h, &scoring.cfg, scoring.version_id.as_deref(), &user, &job, snap.profiles.store(), &f, trigger, None).await {
                Ok(stored) => {
                    report.jobs_stored += stored.is_some() as usize;
                    snap.unstored.remove(0);
                    snap.profiles.release(&job);
                    snap.commit(db)?;
                }
                Err(e) => return Err(e),
            }
        }

        let now = h.now_ms();
        // Behind on the raw data: the jobs still in the timelines are stored
        // once a pass reaches the end of it, but delivered ones at once.
        let finished_state = |j: &Job<TrackId>| matches!(j.state, JobState::Delivered | JobState::Stopped);
        let mut changed: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
        for j in snap.profiles.jobs().filter(|j| !report.more || finished_state(j)) {
            let m = snap.jobs.get(&memo_key(j)).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
            let counts = j.point_counts(snap.profiles.store());
            if m.fingerprint == fingerprint(j, counts) {
                continue;
            }
            // Only the points grew: a job being driven waits a little.
            let growing = m.shape == shape(j, counts) && j.delivered.is_none();
            if growing && now - m.stored_ms < LIVE_STORE_EVERY_MS {
                continue;
            }
            changed.push(memo_key(j));
        }
        // Stored straight from the store, one at a time. The memo moves on only
        // once a job is stored, so a failed store is tried again on the next pass.
        for key in changed {
            let Some(job) = snap.profiles.jobs().find(|j| memo_key(j) == key).cloned() else { continue };
            let counts = job.point_counts(snap.profiles.store());
            let (fp, sh) = (fingerprint(&job, counts), shape(&job, counts));
            let f = job_facts(snap, &job);
            let stored = jobs::persist(h, &scoring.cfg, scoring.version_id.as_deref(), &user, &job, snap.profiles.store(), &f, trigger, None).await?;
            if stored.is_some() {
                report.jobs_stored += 1;
            }
            let m = snap.jobs.entry(key).or_default();
            m.fingerprint = fp;
            m.shape = sh;
            m.stored_ms = now;
            snap.commit(db)?;
        }
        if !report.more && snap.rebuilding {
            snap.rebuilding = false;
            snap.commit(db)?;
        }
        if trigger == Trigger::Upload {
            for (profile, id, wall_ms) in penalties {
                if let Some(j) = snap.profiles.jobs().find(|j| j.profile == profile && j.id == id).cloned() {
                    let r = snap.profiles.evaluate(&j, &scoring.cfg, &Default::default());
                    let job_id = store::one(
                        h,
                        "SELECT job_id FROM jobs WHERE user_id = ?1 AND game = ?2 AND profile_key = ?3 AND local_id = ?4",
                        params![&*user_id, game.as_str(), &profile, id],
                    )
                    .await?
                    .map(|r| r.s("job_id"));
                    jobs::notify(h, &scoring.cfg, &user, "speed_penalty_activated", job_id.as_deref(), *game, j.info.fingerprint.route.job_type, wall_ms, &j.info.cargo_name, &r)
                        .await?;
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(report)
    }
}

/// Re-scores every stored job of this player from its own points, with the
/// current config and bonuses (ADMIN_API §8). A change to the timeline's own
/// settings needs the raw frames instead: [`Scorer::reset`] first.
pub async fn rescore_job<H: Host>(h: &H, job_id: &str, trigger: Trigger, moderator: Option<jobs::Moderator<'_>>) -> ApiResult<()> {
    let row = store::one(h, "SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE job_id = ?1", params![job_id]).await?.ok_or_else(|| ApiError::not_found("job"))?;
    if row.s("origin") == "manual" {
        return crate::manual::rescore(h, &row, trigger, moderator).await;
    }
    let user = store::user_by_id(h, &row.s("user_id")).await?.ok_or_else(|| ApiError::not_found("user"))?;
    let stored = jobs::load_stored(h, job_id).await?.ok_or_else(|| ApiError::internal("missing job data"))?;
    let detail = row.json("detail");
    let sessions: Vec<String> = serde_json::from_value(detail["plugin_sessions"].clone()).unwrap_or_default();
    let truckersmp = match (row.opt_i("tmp_server_id"), row.opt_i("tmp_account_id")) {
        (Some(s), Some(a)) => Some((s as u64, a as u64)),
        _ => None,
    };
    let facts = Facts { delivered_at: row.opt_i("delivered_at"), sessions, sess_ids: stored.sess_ids.clone(), truckersmp };
    let scoring = config::scoring(h).await?;
    jobs::persist(h, &scoring.cfg, scoring.version_id.as_deref(), &user, &stored.job, &stored, &facts, trigger, moderator).await?;
    Ok(())
}

/// For callers that only have the user (tests, the queue consumer).
pub async fn user_games<H: Host>(h: &H, user: &User) -> ApiResult<Vec<Game>> {
    Ok(h.all("SELECT DISTINCT game FROM plugin_sessions WHERE user_id = ?1 AND game IS NOT NULL", params![&user.user_id])
        .await?
        .iter()
        .filter_map(|r| Game::from_api(&r.s("game")))
        .collect())
}
```
