```rs
#[test]
fn scoring_in_pieces_with_a_restart_matches_one_pass() {
    // One pass.
    let a = TestHost::new();
    chicago(&a);
    let one: Value = a.q("SELECT summary, points FROM jobs")[0].clone();

    // The same upload, scored after every chunk; the scorer is restarted from its
    // own database half way (a Durable Object eviction: no save step, every
    // chunk is committed as it is processed).
    let b = TestHost::new();
    publish(&b);
    let token = link(&b);
    let lines = fixture("ats-chicago-clean-delivery.jsonl.gz");
    let mid = lines.len() / 2;
    upload(&b, &token, &lines[..mid], 300);
    let mut s = b.scorer(&user_id(&b), Game::Ats);
    block_on(s.process(&b)).unwrap();
    let mut s = b.scorer(&user_id(&b), Game::Ats);
    upload(&b, &token, &lines[mid..], 300);
    let report = block_on(s.process(&b)).unwrap();
    assert!(!report.rebuilt);
    assert_eq!(b.q("SELECT summary, points FROM jobs")[0], one);
}

#[test]
fn clients_below_the_minimum_version_are_refused_until_they_update() {
    let mut t = TestHost::new();
    t.settings.min_client_version = Some((0, 2, 4));
    publish(&t);
    let token = link(&t);
    let lines = fixture("ats-chicago-clean-delivery.jsonl.gz");
    let sess = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&lines[0]).unwrap()["sess"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
    let c: Vec<&String> = lines[..250].iter().collect();
    let (cfg, m) = (pt_server::config::sample(), manifest());
    for old in ["0.2.3", "0.1.0", "garbage"] {
        let (r, _) = post_chunk(&t, &token, &sess, &c, old, &cfg, &m);
        assert_eq!(r.status, 426, "{old}");
        assert_eq!(r.body_json()["error"]["code"], "client_too_old");
        assert_eq!(r.body_json()["error"]["details"]["min_client_version"], "0.2.4");
    }
    assert_eq!(t.q("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM raw_chunks")[0]["n"], 0);
    // Updated, the same data goes in (the client kept it).
    for new in ["0.2.4", "0.3.0"] {
        let (r, _) = post_chunk(&t, &token, &sess, &c, new, &cfg, &m);
        assert_eq!(r.status, 200, "{new}: {}", r.body_json());
    }
    assert_eq!(t.q("SELECT SUM(frames) AS n FROM raw_chunks")[0]["n"], 250);
}

fn series_and_signed_trace_download() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    let job_id = chicago(&t);
    let s = t.call(t.admin("GET", &format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{job_id}/series?max_points=200"))).body_json();
    let pts = s["points"].as_array().unwrap();
    assert!(!pts.is_empty() && pts.len() <= 200);
    assert!(pts.iter().any(|p| p["speed_mph_max"].as_f64().unwrap() > 30.0));
    let tr = t.call(t.admin("GET", &format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{job_id}/trace"))).body_json();
    assert!(tr["frames"].as_i64().unwrap() > 1000, "{tr}");
    let url = tr["url"].as_str().unwrap().strip_prefix("https://pt.example").unwrap().to_string();
    let r = t.call(Request::new("GET", &url));
    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);
    let text = String::from_utf8(util::gunzip(&r.body, usize::MAX).unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert!(text.lines().all(|l| l.contains("\"pt_status\"")));
    assert!(text.contains("\"pt_status\":\"kept\""));
    assert_eq!(t.call(Request::new("GET", &url.replace("sig=", "sig=0"))).status, 403);
    t.advance(16 * 60_000);
    assert_eq!(t.call(Request::new("GET", &url)).status, 403, "expired");
}

#[test]
fn routes_land_on_the_real_map() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    let job_id = chicago(&t);
    let r = t.call(t.bot("GET", &format!("/api/v1/public/jobs/{job_id}/route")));
    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);
    assert!(r.headers.iter().any(|(k, v)| k == "content-type" && v == "application/geo+json"));
    let g = r.body_json();
    assert_eq!(g["type"], "FeatureCollection");
    assert_eq!(g["properties"]["includes_reverted"], false);
    // The capture is a delivery inside Chicago.
    let b: Vec<f64> = g["bbox"].as_array().unwrap().iter().map(|v| v.as_f64().unwrap()).collect();
    assert!(b[0] > -88.5 && b[2] < -87.0 && b[1] > 41.0 && b[3] < 42.5, "{b:?}");
    let features = g["features"].as_array().unwrap();
    let vertices: usize = features.iter().map(|f| f["geometry"]["coordinates"].as_array().unwrap().len()).sum();
    assert_eq!(g["properties"]["vertex_count"], vertices);
    assert!(vertices > 10 && vertices <= 5000);
    for (i, f) in features.iter().enumerate() {
        assert_eq!(f["properties"]["index"], i);
        assert!(f["properties"].get("status").is_none(), "statuses are admin-only");
    }
    // The counted features add up to the job's own game distance.
    let counted: f64 = features.iter().filter(|f| f["properties"]["counted"] == true).map(|f| f["properties"]["game_km"].as_f64().unwrap()).sum();
    let detail = t.call(t.admin("GET", &format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{job_id}"))).body_json();
    let tracked = detail["distances"]["tracked_counted_game_km"].as_f64().unwrap();
    assert!((counted - tracked).abs() < 0.05 * features.len() as f64, "{counted} vs {tracked}");
    assert!(features.iter().any(|f| f["properties"]["scale_class"] == "city"));

    let a = t.call(t.admin("GET", &format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{job_id}/route"))).body_json();
    assert_eq!(a["properties"]["includes_reverted"], true);
    assert!(a["features"].as_array().unwrap().iter().all(|f| f["properties"]["status"].is_string()));
}
```

`crates/pt-server/tests/backup.rs`:

```rs
//! Weekly backups (docs/SERVER.md): a dump restores into an empty database
//! exactly, and only the newest two are kept.

mod common;

use common::seed::*;
use common::{block_on, TestHost};
use serde_json::json;

const TABLES: [&str; 15] = [
    "users", "tokens", "plugin_sessions", "raw_chunks", "jobs", "truckersmp_accounts", "bonuses", "audit_log",
    "config_versions", "releases", "revocations", "webhook_outbox", "operations", "evidence", "idempotency",
];

fn table(t: &TestHost, name: &str) -> Vec<serde_json::Value> {
    t.q(&format!("SELECT * FROM {name} ORDER BY rowid"))
}

#[test]
fn a_backup_restores_every_table_exactly() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    chicago(&t);
    manual_job(&t);
    // Text with quotes and line breaks survives.
    t.call(t.admin("POST", "/api/v1/admin/bonuses").with_json(&json!({"game": "ats", "label": "It's\nnew\r\nweek",
        "match": "x*", "match_kind": "glob", "kind": "flat", "amount": 1.5,
        "active_from": "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z", "active_to": "2026-11-01T00:00:00Z", "reason": "Line\nbreaks"})));
    let report = block_on(pt_server::backup::run(&t)).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(report.key, "d1/test-server/2026-10-14T09-00-00.000Z.sql");
    assert!(report.tables.iter().all(|(n, _)| n != "idempotency"));
    let sql = String::from_utf8(t.backups.borrow()[&report.key].clone()).unwrap();
    assert!(sql.lines().all(|l| l.is_empty() || l.starts_with("--") || l.ends_with(';')), "one statement per line");

    // Restore into a fresh database (migrations applied, as on D1).
    let fresh = TestHost::new();
    fresh.exec(&sql);
    for name in TABLES.iter().filter(|n| **n != "idempotency") {
        assert_eq!(table(&fresh, name), table(&t, name), "{name}");
    }
    assert_eq!(fresh.q("SELECT label FROM bonuses")[0]["label"], "It's\nnew\r\nweek");
    // Restoring twice is the same: each table is emptied first.
    fresh.exec(&sql);
    assert_eq!(table(&fresh, "jobs"), table(&t, "jobs"));
}

#[test]
fn only_the_newest_two_are_kept() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    link(&t);
    let mut keys = Vec::new();
    for _ in 0..4 {
        keys.push(block_on(pt_server::backup::run(&t)).unwrap().key);
        t.advance(7 * 86_400_000);
    }
    let left: Vec<String> = t.backups.borrow().keys().cloned().collect();
    assert_eq!(left, keys[2..].to_vec());
    // Other prefixes (the bot's, the other server's) are never touched.
    t.backups.borrow_mut().insert("d1/plasmatrack-bot/2020-01-01T00-00-00.000Z.sql".into(), vec![]);
    block_on(pt_server::backup::run(&t)).unwrap();
    assert!(t.backups.borrow().contains_key("d1/plasmatrack-bot/2020-01-01T00-00-00.000Z.sql"));
    assert_eq!(t.backups.borrow().keys().filter(|k| k.starts_with("d1/test-server/")).count(), 2);

    // Moderators can take one now; it is audited.
    let r = t.call(t.admin("POST", "/api/v1/admin/backups").with_json(&json!({"reason": "Before a config change"})));
    assert_eq!(r.status, 201, "{}", r.body_json());
    assert!(r.body_json()["rows"]["users"].as_u64().unwrap() >= 1);
    assert_eq!(t.q("SELECT action FROM audit_log WHERE action = 'backup.create'").len(), 1);
}
```

`crates/pt-server/tests/common/mod.rs`:

```rs
//! A native [`Host`] for the tests: SQLite in memory with the D1 migrations,
//! R2 as a map, a settable clock, a deterministic RNG, and recorded queue
//! messages, scorer pokes and webhook POSTs.

#![allow(dead_code)]

use std::cell::{Cell, RefCell};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

use pt_server::env::{Host, HostError, HostResult, LocalSql, Row, Settings, SqlVal, Stmt, P};
use pt_server::http::{Request, Response};
use pt_server::util;
use rusqlite::types::ValueRef;
use serde_json::{json, Value};

pub const READ_TOKEN: &str = "read-token-for-tests";
pub const BOT_TOKEN: &str = "bot-token-for-tests";
pub const ADMIN: &str = "900000000000000001";
pub const WEBHOOK_SECRET: &str = "whsec-test";

type Post = (String, Vec<(String, String)>, Vec<u8>);

pub struct TestHost {
    pub db: rusqlite::Connection,
    pub blobs: RefCell<BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>>,
    /// The backup bucket.
    pub backups: RefCell<BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>>,
    /// The release bucket.
    pub releases: RefCell<BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>>,
    pub now: Cell<i64>,
    rng: Cell<u64>,
    pub settings: Settings,
    pub pokes: RefCell<Vec<(String, String)>>,
    pub webhooks_queued: RefCell<Vec<(String, u32)>>,
    pub ops_queued: RefCell<Vec<Value>>,
    pub posts: RefCell<Vec<Post>>,
    pub post_status: Cell<u16>,
    /// The next this many writes of job data (`jobs/…`) fail, like a Worker
    /// that ran out of memory or subrequests.
    pub fail_job_puts: Cell<u32>,
    /// Each scorer's own database, by "user:game".
    pub scorer_dbs: RefCell<BTreeMap<String, TestSql>>,
}

fn bind(p: &P) -> rusqlite::types::Value {
    match p {
        P::Null => rusqlite::types::Value::Null,
        P::Int(i) => rusqlite::types::Value::Integer(*i),
        P::Real(f) => rusqlite::types::Value::Real(*f),
        P::Text(s) => rusqlite::types::Value::Text(s.clone()),
    }
}

fn err(e: rusqlite::Error) -> HostError {
    HostError(e.to_string())
}

/// A scorer's own database (its Durable Object's SQLite): one per player and
/// game, shared by every `Scorer` made for them, like the object's storage
/// outliving its memory.
#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct TestSql(pub std::rc::Rc<rusqlite::Connection>);

impl TestSql {
    pub fn new() -> TestSql {
        TestSql(std::rc::Rc::new(rusqlite::Connection::open_in_memory().unwrap()))
    }
}

impl LocalSql for TestSql {
    fn exec(&self, sql: &str, params: &[SqlVal]) -> HostResult<Vec<Vec<SqlVal>>> {
        use rusqlite::types::Value as V;
        let sql = sql.trim();
        if sql.is_empty() {
            return Ok(Vec::new());
        }
        let vals: Vec<V> = params
            .iter()
            .map(|p| match p {
                SqlVal::Null => V::Null,
                SqlVal::Int(i) => V::Integer(*i),
                SqlVal::Real(f) => V::Real(*f),
                SqlVal::Text(s) => V::Text(s.clone()),
                SqlVal::Blob(b) => V::Blob(b.clone()),
            })
            .collect();
        let mut stmt = self.0.prepare(sql).map_err(err)?;
        let cols = stmt.column_count();
        let rows = stmt
            .query_map(rusqlite::params_from_iter(vals), |r| {
                (0..cols)
                    .map(|i| {
                        Ok(match r.get_ref(i)? {
                            ValueRef::Null => SqlVal::Null,
                            ValueRef::Integer(i) => SqlVal::Int(i),
                            ValueRef::Real(f) => SqlVal::Real(f),
                            ValueRef::Text(t) => SqlVal::Text(String::from_utf8_lossy(t).into_owned()),
                            ValueRef::Blob(b) => SqlVal::Blob(b.to_vec()),
                        })
                    })
                    .collect::<rusqlite::Result<Vec<SqlVal>>>()
            })
            .map_err(err)?;
        rows.collect::<rusqlite::Result<Vec<_>>>().map_err(err)
    }
}

impl TestHost {
    pub fn new() -> TestHost {
        let db = rusqlite::Connection::open_in_memory().unwrap();
        db.execute_batch(include_str!("../../migrations/0001_init.sql")).unwrap();
        db.execute_batch(include_str!("../../migrations/0002_manual_jobs.sql")).unwrap();
        db.execute_batch(include_str!("../../migrations/0003_adjusted_sections.sql")).unwrap();
        db.execute_batch(include_str!("../../migrations/0004_client_updates.sql")).unwrap();
        TestHost {
            db,
            blobs: RefCell::new(BTreeMap::new()),
            backups: RefCell::new(BTreeMap::new()),
            releases: RefCell::new(BTreeMap::new()),
            now: Cell::new(util::parse_rfc3339("2026-10-14T09:00:00Z").unwrap()),
            rng: Cell::new(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15),
            settings: Settings {
                read_token_sha256: vec![util::sha256_hex(READ_TOKEN.as_bytes())],
                bot_token_sha256: vec![util::sha256_hex(BOT_TOKEN.as_bytes())],
                bootstrap_admins: vec![ADMIN.to_string()],
                webhook_url: Some("https://bot.example/webhooks/plasmatrack".into()),
                webhook_secrets: vec![WEBHOOK_SECRET.into()],
                public_url: "https://pt.example".into(),
                download_secret: "dl-secret".into(),
                backup_prefix: "d1/test-server/".into(),
                update_keys: vec![update_signing_key().verifying_key().to_bytes()],
                min_client_version: None,
            },
            pokes: RefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            webhooks_queued: RefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            ops_queued: RefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            posts: RefCell::new(Vec::new()),
            post_status: Cell::new(202),
            fail_job_puts: Cell::new(0),
            scorer_dbs: RefCell::new(BTreeMap::new()),
        }
    }

    /// The player's scorer, as a fresh Durable Object instance: nothing in
    /// memory, its database as the last one left it.
    pub fn scorer(&self, user_id: &str, game: pt_core::Game) -> pt_server::scorer::Scorer<TestSql> {
        let db = self.scorer_dbs.borrow_mut().entry(format!("{user_id}:{}", game.as_str())).or_insert_with(TestSql::new).clone();
        pt_server::scorer::Scorer::new(user_id, game, db)
    }

    pub fn advance(&self, ms: i64) {
        self.now.set(self.now.get() + ms);
    }

    /// Runs a request through the server.
    pub fn call(&self, req: Request) -> Response {
        block_on(pt_server::handle(self, req))
    }

    /// A bot-token request.
    pub fn bot(&self, method: &str, path: &str) -> Request {
        Request::new(method, path).with_header("authorization", &format!("Bearer {BOT_TOKEN}"))
    }

    /// An admin request by [`ADMIN`], with an idempotency key on writes.
    pub fn admin(&self, method: &str, path: &str) -> Request {
        let r = self.bot(method, path).with_header("x-plasmatrack-actor", ADMIN);
        if method == "GET" {
            r
        } else {
            r.with_header("idempotency-key", &format!("k-{}-{}", path, self.now.get()))
        }
    }

/// Runs a whole SQL script (a backup restore).
    pub fn exec(&self, sql: &str) {
        self.db.execute_batch(sql).unwrap();
    }

    pub fn q(&self, sql: &str) -> Vec<Value> {
        let mut st = self.db.prepare(sql).unwrap();
        let names: Vec<String> = st.column_names().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect();
        let rows = st
            .query_map([], |r| {
                let mut o = serde_json::Map::new();
                for (i, n) in names.iter().enumerate() {
                    o.insert(n.clone(), value(r.get_ref(i)?));
                }
                Ok(Value::Object(o))
            })
            .unwrap();
        rows.map(|r| r.unwrap()).collect()
    }
}

fn value(v: ValueRef<'_>) -> Value {
    match v {
        ValueRef::Null => Value::Null,
        ValueRef::Integer(i) => json!(i),
        ValueRef::Real(f) => json!(f),
        ValueRef::Text(t) => Value::String(String::from_utf8_lossy(t).into_owned()),
        ValueRef::Blob(_) => Value::Null,
    }
}

pub fn block_on<F: std::future::Future>(f: F) -> F::Output {
    tokio::runtime::Builder::new_current_thread().build().unwrap().block_on(f)
}

impl Host for TestHost {
    fn settings(&self) -> &Settings {
        &self.settings
    }
    fn now_ms(&self) -> i64 {
        self.now.get()
    }
    fn random(&self, buf: &mut [u8]) {
        for b in buf {
            // xorshift64*
            let mut x = self.rng.get();
            x ^= x >> 12;
            x ^= x << 25;
            x ^= x >> 27;
            self.rng.set(x);
            *b = (x.wrapping_mul(0x2545_F491_4F6C_DD1D) >> 56) as u8;
        }
    }

    async fn all(&self, sql: &str, params: Vec<P>) -> HostResult<Vec<Row>> {
        let mut st = self.db.prepare(sql).map_err(err)?;
        let names: Vec<String> = st.column_names().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect();
        let vals: Vec<rusqlite::types::Value> = params.iter().map(bind).collect();
        let rows = st
            .query_map(rusqlite::params_from_iter(vals), |r| {
                let mut o = Row::new();
                for (i, n) in names.iter().enumerate() {
                    o.insert(n.clone(), value(r.get_ref(i)?));
                }
                Ok(o)
            })
            .map_err(err)?;
        rows.collect::<Result<_, _>>().map_err(err)
    }

    async fn run(&self, sql: &str, params: Vec<P>) -> HostResult<u64> {
        let vals: Vec<rusqlite::types::Value> = params.iter().map(bind).collect();
        self.db.execute(sql, rusqlite::params_from_iter(vals)).map(|n| n as u64).map_err(err)
    }

    async fn batch(&self, stmts: Vec<Stmt>) -> HostResult<()> {
        self.db.execute_batch("BEGIN").map_err(err)?;
        for (sql, params) in &stmts {
            let vals: Vec<rusqlite::types::Value> = params.iter().map(bind).collect();
            if let Err(e) = self.db.execute(sql, rusqlite::params_from_iter(vals)) {
                self.db.execute_batch("ROLLBACK").map_err(err)?;
                return Err(err(e));
            }
        }
        self.db.execute_batch("COMMIT").map_err(err)
    }

    async fn blob_get(&self, key: &str) -> HostResult<Option<Vec<u8>>> {
        Ok(self.blobs.borrow().get(key).cloned())
    }
    async fn blob_put(&self, key: &str, bytes: Vec<u8>) -> HostResult<()> {
        if key.starts_with("jobs/") && self.fail_job_puts.get() > 0 {
            self.fail_job_puts.set(self.fail_job_puts.get() - 1);
            return Err(HostError("R2 write failed".into()));
        }
        self.blobs.borrow_mut().insert(key.to_string(), bytes);
        Ok(())
    }
    async fn blob_delete(&self, key: &str) -> HostResult<()> {
        self.blobs.borrow_mut().remove(key);
        Ok(())
    }
    async fn blob_size(&self, key: &str) -> HostResult<Option<u64>> {
        Ok(self.blobs.borrow().get(key).map(|b| b.len() as u64))
    }

    async fn backup_put(&self, key: &str, bytes: Vec<u8>) -> HostResult<()> {
        self.backups.borrow_mut().insert(key.to_string(), bytes);
        Ok(())
    }

    async fn backup_list(&self, prefix: &str) -> HostResult<Vec<String>> {
        Ok(self.backups.borrow().keys().filter(|k| k.starts_with(prefix)).cloned().collect())
    }

    async fn backup_delete(&self, key: &str) -> HostResult<()> {
        self.backups.borrow_mut().remove(key);
        Ok(())
    }

    async fn release_size(&self, key: &str) -> HostResult<Option<u64>> {
        Ok(self.releases.borrow().get(key).map(|b| b.len() as u64))
    }

    async fn poke_scorer(&self, user_id: &str, game: &str) -> HostResult<()> {
        self.pokes.borrow_mut().push((user_id.to_string(), game.to_string()));
        Ok(())
    }
    async fn queue_webhook(&self, event_id: &str, delay_s: u32) -> HostResult<()> {
        self.webhooks_queued.borrow_mut().push((event_id.to_string(), delay_s));
        Ok(())
    }
    async fn queue_op(&self, msg: Value) -> HostResult<()> {
        self.ops_queued.borrow_mut().push(msg);
        Ok(())
    }
    async fn http_post(&self, url: &str, headers: Vec<(String, String)>, body: Vec<u8>) -> HostResult<u16> {
        self.posts.borrow_mut().push((url.to_string(), headers, body));
        Ok(self.post_status.get())
    }
}
pub mod seed;

/// Signs test updates; the test host accepts its public key.
pub fn update_signing_key() -> ed25519_dalek::SigningKey {
    ed25519_dalek::SigningKey::from_bytes(&[9; 32])
}

/// A signed client update for `version`: its files (gzip-compressed) and the
/// setup program in the release bucket, and the release's `files` hashes.
pub struct SignedUpdate {
    pub manifest: String,
    pub signature: String,
    pub files: Vec<Value>,
}

pub fn signed_update(t: &TestHost, version: &str) -> SignedUpdate {
    use ed25519_dalek::Signer;
    use pt_core::update::{UpdateFile, UpdateManifest, PRODUCT, SIGNING_CONTEXT};
    use std::io::Write;
    let gzip = |b: &[u8]| {
        let mut e = flate2::write::GzEncoder::new(Vec::new(), flate2::Compression::default());
        e.write_all(b).unwrap();
        e.finish().unwrap()
    };
    let contents = [
        ("plasmatrack-client.exe", format!("client {version}")),
        ("plasmatrack-clientw.exe", format!("clientw {version}")),
        ("plasmatrack.dll", format!("dll {version}")),
        ("licenses/LLVM-LICENSE.txt", "licence".to_string()),
    ];
    let mut m = UpdateManifest { product: PRODUCT.into(), platform: "windows".into(), version: version.into(), files: vec![] };
    for (path, body) in &contents {
        let gz = gzip(body.as_bytes());
        let f = UpdateFile { path: path.to_string(), sha256: util::sha256_hex(body.as_bytes()), size: body.len() as u64, gz_size: gz.len() as u64 };
        t.releases.borrow_mut().insert(m.key(&f), gz);
        m.files.push(f);
    }
    t.releases.borrow_mut().insert(format!("windows/{version}/PlasmaTrack-Setup-{version}.exe"), b"setup".to_vec());
    t.releases.borrow_mut().insert(format!("windows/{version}/PlasmaTrack-Uninstall.exe"), b"uninstall".to_vec());
    let manifest = serde_json::to_string(&m).unwrap();
    let sig = update_signing_key().sign(&[SIGNING_CONTEXT, manifest.as_bytes()].concat());
    let signature = sig.to_bytes().iter().map(|b| format!("{b:02x}")).collect();
    let sha = |p: &str| m.files.iter().find(|f| f.path == p).unwrap().sha256.clone();
    let files = vec![
        json!({"role": "plugin", "path_pattern": "*/plugins/plasmatrack.dll", "sha256": sha("plasmatrack.dll")}),
        json!({"role": "client_binary", "path_pattern": "*/plasmatrack-clientw.exe", "sha256": sha("plasmatrack-clientw.exe")}),
        json!({"role": "client_binary", "path_pattern": "*/plasmatrack-client.exe", "sha256": sha("plasmatrack-client.exe")}),
    ];
    SignedUpdate { manifest, signature, files }
}
```

```rs
/// Uploads a capture session by session, in chunks, like the client.
pub fn upload(t: &TestHost, token: &str, lines: &[String], per_chunk: usize) {
    upload_with(t, token, lines, per_chunk, manifest());
}

/// [`upload`] with a given install manifest.
pub fn upload_with(t: &TestHost, token: &str, lines: &[String], per_chunk: usize, manifest: Vec<ManifestEntry>) {
    let cfg = config::sample();
    let mut sessions: Vec<(String, Vec<&String>)> = Vec::new();
    for l in lines {
        let v: Value = serde_json::from_str(l).unwrap();
        let s = v["sess"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
        match sessions.iter_mut().find(|(x, _)| *x == s) {
            Some((_, v)) => v.push(l),
            None => sessions.push((s, vec![l])),
        }
    }
    for (sess, frames) in sessions {
        for c in frames.chunks(per_chunk) {
            let (r, seq_to) = post_chunk(t, token, &sess, c, "0.1.0", &cfg, &manifest);
            assert_eq!(r.status, 200, "{}", r.body_json());
            assert!(r.body_json()["accepted_through"].as_u64().unwrap() >= seq_to);
        }
    }
}

/// Posts one chunk of session `sess` as client `client_version`; the response
/// and the chunk's `seq_to`.
pub fn post_chunk(
    t: &TestHost, token: &str, sess: &str, c: &[&String], client_version: &str, cfg: &pt_core::config::Config,
    manifest: &[ManifestEntry],
) -> (Response, u64) {
    let seq = |l: &String| serde_json::from_str::<Value>(l).unwrap()["seq"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0);
    let chunk = UploadChunk {
        protocol: UPLOAD_PROTOCOL,
        client_version: client_version.into(),
        sess: sess.to_string(),
        hello: None,
        seq_from: c.iter().map(|l| seq(l)).filter(|s| *s > 0).min().unwrap_or(0),
        seq_to: c.iter().map(|l| seq(l)).max().unwrap_or(0),
        frames: c.iter().map(|l| RawValue::from_string(l.to_string()).unwrap()).collect(),
        config_hash: cfg.integrity_hash(),
        config: RawValue::from_string(cfg.integrity_canonical_json()).unwrap(),
        manifest: manifest.to_vec(),
    };
    let mut req = Request::new("POST", "/api/v1/chunks")
        .with_header("authorization", &format!("Bearer {token}"))
        .with_header("content-type", "application/json")
        .with_header("content-encoding", "gzip");
    req.body = util::gzip(&serde_json::to_vec(&chunk).unwrap());
    (t.call(req), chunk.seq_to)
}

/// A synthetic ATS session in one plugin session `sess`: a loaded job driven
/// `secs` at `mph`, then delivered (shaped like the replay simulator).
pub fn synthetic_job(sess: &str, mph: f64, secs: f64) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let (mut seq, mut sim, mut x, mut odo) = (0u64, 0u64, 0.0f64, 1000.0f64);
    let mut emit = |kind: &str, extra: Value, sim: u64| {
        seq += 1;
        let mut v = json!({"v": 1, "kind": kind, "sess": sess, "seq": seq, "wall_ms": 1_791_000_000_000i64 + (sim / 1000) as i64, "sim_us": sim});
        for (k, x) in extra.as_object().unwrap() {
            v[k] = x.clone();
        }
        out.push(v.to_string());
    };
    let a = |n: &str, v: Value| json!({"name": n, "index": null, "value": v});
    let job = json!([
        a("cargo.id", "tyres".into()), a("cargo", "Tyres".into()), a("source.city.id", "chicago".into()),
        a("source.city", "Chicago".into()), a("destination.city.id", "joliet".into()), a("destination.city", "Joliet".into()),
        a("source.company.id", "a".into()), a("destination.company.id", "b".into()), a("cargo.loaded", true.into()),
        a("job.market", "cargo_market".into()), a("planned_distance.km", 80.into()),
    ]);
    emit("init", json!({"game_id": "ats", "game_version": {"major": 1, "minor": 7}}), 0);
    emit("config", json!({"id": "truck", "attrs": [a("id", "volvo".into())]}), 0);
    let sample = |x: f64, odo: f64, v: f64| {
        json!({"ch": {"truck.speed": v, "truck.odometer": odo, "truck.fuel.amount": 500.0,
            "truck.world.placement": {"position": {"x": x, "y": 0.0, "z": 0.0}}, "game.time": 1000,
            "local.scale": 20.0, "trailer.0.connected": true}})
    };
    emit("sample", sample(x, odo, 0.0), sim);
    emit("config", json!({"id": "job", "attrs": job}), sim);
    let v = mph * 0.44704;
    for _ in 0..(secs * 20.0) as u64 {
        sim += 50_000;
        x += v * 0.05;
        odo += v * 0.05 * 20.0 / 1000.0;
        emit("sample", sample(x, odo, v), sim);
    }
    let km = json!([a("distance.km", ((odo - 1000.0) as u64).into())]);
    emit("gameplay", json!({"id": "job.delivered", "attrs": km}), sim);
    emit("config", json!({"id": "job", "attrs": []}), sim);
    sim += 50_000;
    emit("sample", sample(x, odo, 0.0), sim);
    out
}

/// A tiny WebP-shaped image (the server checks only the first bytes).
pub fn webp(n: u8) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut b = b"RIFF\x20\x00\x00\x00WEBPVP8 ".to_vec();
    b.extend(std::iter::repeat_n(n, 20));
    b
}
```

`crates/pt-server/tests/contract.rs`:

```rs
//! Generates the bot's machine-readable contract from real responses of this
//! server (API_CONVENTIONS §7):
//!
//! - `docs/examples/<name>.json`: one response per endpoint and one body per
//!   webhook type, from a scripted scenario on real captures;
//! - `docs/openapi/bot-api.yaml`: OpenAPI 3.1, every path with its auth,
//!   parameters and example, and response schemas inferred from the examples.
//!
//! The scenario is deterministic (fixed clock, seeded ids), so the files only
//! change when the server's output does. The test fails if they are stale;
//! regenerate with `UPDATE_CONTRACT=1 cargo test -p pt-server --test contract`.

mod common;

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use common::seed::*;
use common::{block_on, TestHost, ADMIN, READ_TOKEN};
use pt_core::Game;
use pt_server::http::Request;
use pt_server::manage;
use serde_json::{json, Map, Value};

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
enum Auth {
    Read,
    Bot,
    Admin,
    Player,
}

struct Call {
    name: &'static str,
    tag: &'static str,
    summary: &'static str,
    method: &'static str,
    template: &'static str,
    path: String,
    body: Option<Value>,
    auth: Auth,
    status: u16,
    /// An image upload (raw bytes) instead of a JSON body.
    image: bool,
}

struct Recorder<'a> {
    t: &'a TestHost,
    calls: Vec<(Call, Value)>,
    n: usize,
}

impl Recorder<'_> {
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    fn call(&mut self, name: &'static str, tag: &'static str, summary: &'static str, method: &'static str, template: &'static str, path: &str, body: Option<Value>, auth: Auth, status: u16) -> Value {
        self.n += 1;
        let mut req = match auth {
            Auth::Read => Request::new(method, path).with_header("authorization", &format!("Bearer {READ_TOKEN}")),
            Auth::Bot => self.t.bot(method, path),
            Auth::Admin => self.t.bot(method, path).with_header("x-plasmatrack-actor", ADMIN),
            Auth::Player => Request::new(method, path),
        };
        if method != "GET" {
            req = req.with_header("idempotency-key", &format!("example-{}", self.n));
        }
        if let Some(b) = &body {
            req = req.with_json(b);
        }
        let r = self.t.call(req);
        assert_eq!(r.status, status, "{name}: {}", r.body_json());
        let v = r.body_json();
        let call = Call { name, tag, summary, method, template, path: path.to_string(), body, auth, status, image: false };
        self.calls.push((call, v.clone()));
        self.t.advance(1000);
        v
    }

    /// An image upload: the raw bytes of a (tiny) WebP.
    fn upload_image(&mut self, name: &'static str, summary: &'static str, template: &'static str, path: &str, n: u8) -> Value {
        self.n += 1;
        let mut req = self.t.bot("POST", path).with_header("idempotency-key", &format!("example-{}", self.n)).with_header("content-type", "image/webp");
        req.body = webp(n);
        let r = self.t.call(req);
        assert_eq!(r.status, 201, "{name}: {}", r.body_json());
        let v = r.body_json();
        let call = Call { name, tag: "Manual jobs", summary, method: "POST", template, path: path.to_string(), body: None, auth: Auth::Bot, status: 201, image: true };
        self.calls.push((call, v.clone()));
        self.t.advance(1000);
        v
    }
}

fn root() -> PathBuf {
    Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../..")
}

// ---- schema inference --------------------------------------------------------------

fn infer(v: &Value) -> Value {
    match v {
        Value::Null => json!({"type": "null"}),
        Value::Bool(_) => json!({"type": "boolean"}),
        Value::Number(n) if n.is_i64() || n.is_u64() => json!({"type": "integer"}),
        Value::Number(_) => json!({"type": "number"}),
        Value::String(s) if pt_server::util::parse_rfc3339(s).is_some() => json!({"type": "string", "format": "date-time"}),
        Value::String(_) => json!({"type": "string"}),
        Value::Array(items) => {
            let mut s = Value::Null;
            for i in items {
                s = merge(s, infer(i));
            }
            if s.is_null() {
                json!({"type": "array"})
            } else {
                json!({"type": "array", "items": s})
            }
        }
        Value::Object(o) => {
            let props: Map<String, Value> = o.iter().map(|(k, x)| (k.clone(), infer(x))).collect();
            json!({"type": "object", "properties": props})
        }
    }
}

fn types(s: &Value) -> Vec<Value> {
    match &s["type"] {
        Value::Array(a) => a.clone(),
        Value::Null => vec![],
        t => vec![t.clone()],
    }
}

/// The union of two inferred schemas: types join, object properties merge.
fn merge(a: Value, b: Value) -> Value {
    if a.is_null() {
        return b;
    }
    let mut ts = types(&a);
    for t in types(&b) {
        if !ts.contains(&t) {
            ts.push(t);
        }
    }
    // An integer seen where a number also appears is just a number.
    if ts.contains(&json!("number")) {
        ts.retain(|t| t != "integer");
    }
    let mut out = Map::new();
    out.insert("type".into(), if ts.len() == 1 { ts[0].clone() } else { Value::Array(ts.clone()) });
    if a.get("format") == b.get("format") || b.get("format").is_none() || a.get("format").is_none() {
        if let Some(f) = a.get("format").or(b.get("format")) {
            out.insert("format".into(), f.clone());
        }
    }
    match (a.get("properties"), b.get("properties")) {
        (Some(pa), Some(pb)) => {
            let mut p = pa.as_object().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
            for (k, v) in pb.as_object().into_iter().flatten() {
                let m = merge(p.remove(k).unwrap_or(Value::Null), v.clone());
                p.insert(k.clone(), m);
            }
            out.insert("properties".into(), Value::Object(p));
        }
        (Some(p), None) | (None, Some(p)) => {
            out.insert("properties".into(), p.clone());
        }
        _ => {}
    }
    match (a.get("items"), b.get("items")) {
        (Some(x), Some(y)) => {
            out.insert("items".into(), merge(x.clone(), y.clone()));
        }
        (Some(x), None) | (None, Some(x)) => {
            out.insert("items".into(), x.clone());
        }
        _ => {}
    }
    Value::Object(out)
}

// ---- YAML (block style; scalars as JSON, which is valid YAML) -----------------------

fn yaml(v: &Value, indent: usize, out: &mut String) {
    let pad = " ".repeat(indent);
    match v {
        Value::Object(o) if !o.is_empty() => {
            for (k, x) in o {
                let key = serde_json::to_string(k).unwrap();
                match x {
                    Value::Object(m) if !m.is_empty() => {
                        out.push_str(&format!("{pad}{key}:\n"));
                        yaml(x, indent + 2, out);
                    }
                    Value::Array(a) if !a.is_empty() => {
                        out.push_str(&format!("{pad}{key}:\n"));
                        yaml(x, indent, out);
                    }
                    _ => out.push_str(&format!("{pad}{key}: {}\n", serde_json::to_string(x).unwrap())),
                }
            }
        }
        Value::Array(a) if !a.is_empty() => {
            for x in a {
                match x {
                    Value::Object(m) if !m.is_empty() => {
                        let mut inner = String::new();
                        yaml(x, indent + 2, &mut inner);
                        out.push_str(&format!("{pad}- {}", &inner[indent + 2..]));
                    }
                    _ => out.push_str(&format!("{pad}- {}\n", serde_json::to_string(x).unwrap())),
                }
            }
        }
        _ => out.push_str(&format!("{pad}{}\n", serde_json::to_string(v).unwrap())),
    }
}

// ---- the scenario -------------------------------------------------------------------

fn scenario(t: &TestHost) -> (Vec<(Call, Value)>, BTreeMap<String, Value>) {
    use Auth::*;
    publish(t);
    let mut r = Recorder { t, calls: Vec::new(), n: 0 };
    let p = PLAYER;
    r.call("player_token_issue", "Players", "Link a Discord user, or rotate their token", "POST", "/api/v1/players/{discord_id}/token", &format!("/api/v1/players/{p}/token"), Some(json!({"display_name": "Example Driver"})), Bot, 201);
    let token = r.calls.last().unwrap().1["token"]["token"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
    // The plaintext never goes into the docs.
    r.calls.last_mut().unwrap().1["token"]["token"] = json!("pt_live_EXAMPLE-ONLY-NEVER-A-REAL-TOKEN-000000000");
    for f in ["ats-chicago-clean-delivery.jsonl.gz", "ets2-tmp-norway-tunnel-profiles.jsonl.gz"] {
        upload(t, &token, &fixture(f), 2000);
    }
    let uid = t.q(&format!("SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE discord_user_id = '{p}'"))[0]["user_id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
    for g in [Game::Ats, Game::Ets2] {
        let mut s = t.scorer(&uid, g);
        block_on(s.process(t)).unwrap();
    }
    // A player whose install matches no release (job.discarded), and one who
    // delivers at 160 mph (Invalid: job.needs_review and player.notification).
    let other = link_other(t, "345678901234567890", "Unreleased Build");
    let mut bad = manifest();
    bad[0].sha256 = "dd".repeat(32);
    upload_with(t, &other, &fixture("ats-chicago-clean-delivery.jsonl.gz"), 2000, bad);
    let fast = link_other(t, "456789012345678901", "Lead Foot");
    upload(t, &fast, &synthetic_job("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef", 160.0, 120.0), 5000);
    for d in ["345678901234567890", "456789012345678901"] {
        let id = t.q(&format!("SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE discord_user_id = '{d}'"))[0]["user_id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
        block_on(t.scorer(&id, Game::Ats).process(t)).unwrap();
    }
    let job = |sql: &str| t.q(sql)[0]["job_id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
    let valid = job("SELECT job_id FROM jobs WHERE game = 'ats' AND outcome = 'valid'");

fn openapi(calls: &[(Call, Value)], hooks: &BTreeMap<String, Value>) -> Value {
    let mut paths: BTreeMap<String, Map<String, Value>> = BTreeMap::new();
    let mut schemas: BTreeMap<(String, String, u16), Value> = BTreeMap::new();
    for (c, v) in calls {
        let key = (c.template.to_string(), c.method.to_lowercase(), c.status);
        let s = schemas.remove(&key).unwrap_or(Value::Null);
        schemas.insert(key, merge(s, infer(v)));
    }
    for (c, _) in calls {
        let method = c.method.to_lowercase();
        let ops = paths.entry(c.template.to_string()).or_default();
        let op = ops.entry(method.clone()).or_insert_with(|| {
            let security = match c.auth {
                Auth::Read => json!([{"readToken": []}, {"botToken": []}]),
                Auth::Bot => json!([{"botToken": []}]),
                Auth::Admin => json!([{"botToken": []}]),
                Auth::Player => json!([{"readToken": []}, {"botToken": []}]),
            };
            let mut params: Vec<Value> = c
                .template
                .split('/')
                .filter_map(|s| s.strip_prefix('{').and_then(|s| s.strip_suffix('}')))
                .map(|name| {
                    let schema = match name {
                        "game" => json!({"type": "string", "enum": ["ets2", "ats"]}),
                        "action" => json!({"type": "string", "enum": ["approve", "reject", "void", "restore"]}),
                        _ => json!({"type": "string"}),
                    };
                    json!({"name": name, "in": "path", "required": true, "schema": schema})
                })
                .collect();
            if c.auth == Auth::Admin {
                params.push(json!({"$ref": "#/components/parameters/Actor"}));
            }
            if c.method != "GET" {
                params.push(json!({"$ref": "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"}));
            }
            json!({"tags": [c.tag], "summary": c.summary, "operationId": c.name, "security": security,
                   "parameters": params, "responses": {
                       "4XX": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Error"},
                       "5XX": {"$ref": "#/components/responses/Error"}}})
        });
        if op["summary"] == "" && !c.summary.is_empty() {
            op["summary"] = c.summary.into();
        }
        if let Some(q) = c.path.split_once('?').map(|(_, q)| q) {
            for (k, _) in q.split('&').filter_map(|kv| kv.split_once('=')) {
                let params = op["parameters"].as_array_mut().unwrap();
                if !params.iter().any(|p| p["name"] == k) {
                    params.push(json!({"name": k, "in": "query", "required": false, "schema": {"type": "string"}}));
                }
            }
        }
        if c.image && op.get("requestBody").is_none() {
            let bin = json!({"schema": {"type": "string", "format": "binary"}});
            op["requestBody"] = json!({"required": true, "description": "The image itself, at most 5 MB.",
                "content": {"image/avif": bin, "image/webp": bin, "image/png": bin, "image/jpeg": bin}});
        }
        if let (Some(b), None) = (&c.body, op.get("requestBody")) {
            op["requestBody"] = json!({"required": true, "content": {"application/json": {"example": b}}});
        }
        let status = c.status.to_string();
        if op["responses"].get(&status).is_none() {
            let schema = if c.status >= 400 {
                json!({"$ref": "#/components/schemas/Error"})
            } else {
                schemas[&(c.template.to_string(), c.method.to_lowercase(), c.status)].clone()
            };
            let media = if c.template.ends_with("/route") && c.status == 200 { "application/geo+json" } else { "application/json" };
            op["responses"][&status] = json!({"description": format!("See docs/examples/{}.json", c.name),
                "content": {media: {"schema": schema,
                    "examples": {c.name: {"externalValue": format!("../examples/{}.json", c.name)}}}}});
        }
    }
    let mut webhook_doc = Map::new();
    for (ty, body) in hooks {
        webhook_doc.insert(ty.clone(), json!({"post": {
            "summary": format!("{ty} (docs/WEBHOOKS.md §4)"),
            "operationId": format!("webhook_{}", ty.replace('.', "_")),
            "security": [],
            "parameters": [
                {"name": "X-PlasmaTrack-Event", "in": "header", "required": true, "schema": {"type": "string", "const": ty}},
                {"name": "X-PlasmaTrack-Event-Id", "in": "header", "required": true, "schema": {"type": "string"}},
                {"name": "X-PlasmaTrack-Signature", "in": "header", "required": true, "schema": {"type": "string"},
                 "description": "t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of \"{t}.{raw body}\">[,v1=…]"}],
            "requestBody": {"content": {"application/json": {"schema": infer(body),
                "examples": {"example": {"externalValue": format!("../examples/webhook_{}.json", ty.replace('.', "_"))}}}}},
            "responses": {"202": {"description": "Queued by the bot"}}}}));
    }
    json!({
        "openapi": "3.1.0",
        "info": {"title": "PlasmaTrack bot API", "version": "1",
                 "license": {"name": "PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0", "identifier": "PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0"},
                 "description": "Generated by crates/pt-server/tests/contract.rs from real responses of the server. The Markdown contract (docs/API_CONVENTIONS.md, PUBLIC_API.md, ADMIN_API.md, WEBHOOKS.md) is authoritative; response schemas here are inferred from the examples, so a field shown as one type may also be null where the contract says so."},
        "servers": [{"url": "https://plasmatrack-server.{account}.workers.dev", "description": "production",
                     "variables": {"account": {"default": "example"}}},
                    {"url": "https://plasmatrack-server-test.{account}.workers.dev", "description": "test",
                     "variables": {"account": {"default": "example"}}}],
        "paths": paths,
        "webhooks": webhook_doc,
        "components": {
            "securitySchemes": {
                "readToken": {"type": "http", "scheme": "bearer", "description": "Public reads only"},
                "botToken": {"type": "http", "scheme": "bearer", "description": "Everything"}},
            "parameters": {
                "Actor": {"name": "X-PlasmaTrack-Actor", "in": "header", "required": true,
                          "description": "Discord ID of the acting admin", "schema": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[0-9]{1,20}$"}},
                "IdempotencyKey": {"name": "Idempotency-Key", "in": "header", "required": true,
                                   "description": "1-128 printable ASCII; remembered 24 h", "schema": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "maxLength": 128}}},
            "responses": {"Error": {"description": "The error shape of API_CONVENTIONS §4",
                "content": {"application/json": {"schema": {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/Error"}}}}},
            "schemas": {"Error": {"type": "object", "required": ["error"], "properties": {"error": {"type": "object",
                "required": ["code", "message", "details"], "properties": {"code": {"type": "string"},
                "message": {"type": "string"}, "details": {"type": "object"}}}}}}
        }
    })
}

#[test]
fn contract_files_match_the_server() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    let (calls, hooks) = scenario(&t);
    let mut files: BTreeMap<PathBuf, String> = BTreeMap::new();
    let ex = root().join("docs/examples");
    for (c, v) in &calls {
        files.insert(ex.join(format!("{}.json", c.name)), serde_json::to_string_pretty(v).unwrap() + "\n");
    }
    for (ty, body) in &hooks {
        files.insert(ex.join(format!("webhook_{}.json", ty.replace('.', "_"))), serde_json::to_string_pretty(body).unwrap() + "\n");
    }
    let mut y = String::from("# Generated by crates/pt-server/tests/contract.rs. Do not edit; run\n# UPDATE_CONTRACT=1 cargo test -p pt-server --test contract\n");
    yaml(&openapi(&calls, &hooks), 0, &mut y);
    files.insert(root().join("docs/openapi/bot-api.yaml"), y);

    let update = std::env::var_os("UPDATE_CONTRACT").is_some();
    let mut stale = Vec::new();
    for (path, text) in &files {
        let have = std::fs::read_to_string(path).unwrap_or_default();
        if have.replace("\r\n", "\n") != *text {
            if update {
                std::fs::create_dir_all(path.parent().unwrap()).unwrap();
                std::fs::write(path, text).unwrap();
            } else {
                stale.push(path.display().to_string());
            }
        }
    }
    assert!(stale.is_empty(), "stale contract files (run with UPDATE_CONTRACT=1): {stale:#?}");
}
```

```rs
//! Data for the bot's graphs (owner, 2026-10-15): fuel, damage and income on
//! every job, a player's history in buckets, leaderboards by metric, and the

mod common;

use common::TestHost;

#[test]
fn jobs_carry_fuel_damage_and_income() {

#[test]
fn history_comes_in_buckets_with_running_totals() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    let job = chicago(&t);
    let j = get(&t, &format!("/api/v1/public/jobs/{job}")).body_json();
    let h = get(&t, &format!("/api/v1/public/ats/players/{PLAYER}/history")).body_json();
    assert_eq!((h["bucket"].as_str(), h["currency"].as_str()), (Some("day"), Some("USD")));
    let items = h["items"].as_array().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(items.len(), 30, "the last 30 days by default");
    let total: i64 = items.iter().map(|i| i["job_count"].as_i64().unwrap()).sum();
    assert_eq!(total, 1);
    let last = items.last().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(last["running"]["points"], 3.6);
    assert_eq!(last["running"]["income"], j["income"]);
    assert_eq!(h["before"]["job_count"], 0);

    // Weeks and months; a window after the job counts it in "before".
    let w = get(&t, &format!("/api/v1/public/ats/players/{PLAYER}/history?bucket=week&from=2026-10-12&to=2026-10-25")).body_json();
    assert_eq!(w["items"].as_array().unwrap().len(), 2);
    assert_eq!(w["items"][0]["start"], "2026-10-12T00:00:00.000Z");
    let m = get(&t, &format!("/api/v1/public/ats/players/{PLAYER}/history?bucket=month&from=2026-11-01&to=2026-12-31")).body_json();
    assert_eq!(m["items"].as_array().unwrap().len(), 2);
    assert_eq!(m["before"]["job_count"], 1);
    assert_eq!(m["items"][1]["running"]["job_count"], 1);
    for bad in ["bucket=hour", "from=yesterday", "from=2020-01-01&to=2026-01-01"] {
        assert_eq!(get(&t, &format!("/api/v1/public/ats/players/{PLAYER}/history?{bad}")).status, 400, "{bad}");
    }
}

#[test]
fn leaderboards_rank_by_any_metric() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    chicago(&t);
    let other = link_other(&t, "555", "Short Hauler");
    upload(&t, &other, &synthetic_job("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef", 50.0, 400.0), 5000);
    let id = t.q("SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE discord_user_id = '555'")[0]["user_id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
    common::block_on(t.scorer(&id, pt_core::Game::Ats).process(&t)).unwrap();
    let board = |q: &str| {
        let v = get(&t, &format!("/api/v1/public/ats/leaderboard?{q}")).body_json();
        let names: Vec<String> = v["items"].as_array().unwrap().iter().map(|i| i["display_name"].as_str().unwrap().to_string()).collect();
        (v, names)
    };
    let (v, _) = board("");
    assert_eq!(v["sort"], "points");
    let pts: Vec<f64> = v["items"].as_array().unwrap().iter().map(|i| i["points"].as_f64().unwrap()).collect();
    assert!(pts.len() == 2 && pts[0] >= pts[1], "{pts:?}");
    let (_, by_fuel_asc) = board("sort=fuel&order=asc");
    let (_, by_fuel) = board("sort=fuel");
    assert_eq!(by_fuel_asc.iter().rev().collect::<Vec<_>>(), by_fuel.iter().collect::<Vec<_>>());
    // Damage ranks the least first; a player without damage data comes last.
    let (v, by_damage) = board("sort=damage");
    assert_eq!(v["order"], "asc");
    assert_eq!(by_damage.last().unwrap(), "Short Hauler", "{}", v);
    assert!(v["items"][0]["damage_pct_avg"].is_number());
    assert!(v["items"][0]["fuel_used_l"].is_number() && v["items"][0]["income"].is_number());
    assert_eq!(get(&t, "/api/v1/public/ats/leaderboard?sort=speed").status, 400);
}

#[test]
fn series_carry_distance_and_damage_and_counted_jobs_are_public() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    let job = chicago(&t);
    let s = t.call(t.admin("GET", &format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{job}/series?max_points=100"))).body_json();
    let pts = s["points"].as_array().unwrap();
    let game: Vec<f64> = pts.iter().map(|p| p["game_km"].as_f64().unwrap()).collect();
    assert!(game.windows(2).all(|w| w[0] <= w[1]), "cumulative");
    let detail = t.call(t.admin("GET", &format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{job}"))).body_json();
    let tracked = detail["distances"]["tracked_whole_game_km"].as_f64().unwrap();
    assert!((game.last().unwrap() - tracked).abs() < 0.05, "{} vs {tracked}", game.last().unwrap());
    assert!(pts.last().unwrap()["world_km"].as_f64().unwrap() > 0.0);
    assert!(pts.iter().any(|p| p["damage_pct_max"].is_number()));

    // Public for a valid job, without review markers or reverted material.
    let p = get(&t, &format!("/api/v1/public/jobs/{job}/series?max_points=100"));
    assert_eq!(p.status, 200);
    let p = p.body_json();
    assert_eq!(p["markers"], json!([]));
    assert!(p["windows"].as_array().unwrap().iter().all(|w| w["kind"] != "reverted"));
    assert_eq!(p["points"], s["points"]);
    // Not while it is pending or after a rejection.
    t.call(t.admin("POST", &format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{job}/reject")).with_json(&json!({"reason": "Testing visibility"})));
    assert_eq!(get(&t, &format!("/api/v1/public/jobs/{job}/series")).status, 404);
    let _: Value = t.call(t.admin("GET", &format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{job}/series"))).body_json();
}
```

`crates/pt-server/tests/manual.rs`:

```rs
//! Manual submissions, moderator edits, the all-games history and the stats
//! breakdown (PUBLIC_API §2, §3, §6; ADMIN_API §7, §14).

mod common;

use common::seed::*;
use common::{block_on, TestHost, ADMIN};
use pt_core::Game;
use pt_server::http::Request;
use serde_json::{json, Value};

fn webhook_types(t: &TestHost) -> Vec<String> {
    t.q("SELECT type FROM webhook_outbox ORDER BY created_at, event_id").iter().map(|r| r["type"].as_str().unwrap().to_string()).collect()
}

fn get(t: &TestHost, url: &str) -> pt_server::http::Response {
    t.call(Request::new("GET", url.strip_prefix("https://pt.example").unwrap()))
}

#[test]
fn manual_jobs_go_to_review_and_score_by_map_scale() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    publish(&t);
    link(&t);

    // Images: only real image types, at most 5 MB.
    let mut bad = t.bot("POST", &format!("/api/v1/players/{PLAYER}/evidence")).with_header("idempotency-key", "bad");
    bad.body = b"not an image".to_vec();
    assert_eq!(t.call(bad).body_json()["error"]["details"]["fields"]["body"], "an AVIF, WebP, PNG or JPEG image");
    let mut big = t.bot("POST", &format!("/api/v1/players/{PLAYER}/evidence")).with_header("idempotency-key", "big");
    big.body = vec![0; 5 * 1024 * 1024 + 1];
    assert_eq!(t.call(big).status, 413);

    let (e, m, u) = (image(&t, PLAYER, 1), image(&t, PLAYER, 2), image(&t, PLAYER, 3));
    let submit = |key: &str, body: &Value| {
        t.call(t.bot("POST", &format!("/api/v1/players/{PLAYER}/manual-jobs")).with_header("idempotency-key", key).with_json(body))
    };
    // Validation names the bad fields.
    let mut wrong = manual_body(&e, &m, &u);
    wrong["damage"] = 140.into();
    wrong["uk"]["distance"] = 500.into();
    let r = submit("wrong", &wrong);
    assert_eq!(r.status, 422);
    assert!(r.body_json()["error"]["details"]["fields"]["damage"].is_string(), "{}", r.body_json());

    let r = submit("ok", &manual_body(&e, &m, &u));
    assert_eq!(r.status, 201, "{}", r.body_json());
    let j = r.body_json();
    let job_id = j["job_id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
    assert_eq!(j["origin"], "manual");
    assert_eq!(j["outcome"], "pending_review");
    assert_eq!(j["points"], Value::Null);
    // (380 − 76) ÷ 19 + 76 ÷ 15 world km.
    let world = 304.0 / 19.0 + 76.0 / 15.0;
    assert_eq!(j["held_points"], points_for_world_km(world));
    assert_eq!(j["world_km"], (world * 100.0).round() / 100.0);
    assert_eq!(j["game_km"], 380.0);
    assert_eq!(j["cargo"]["name"], "Apples");
    assert_eq!(j["source"]["city_name"], "Calais");
    assert_eq!(j["distance_by_scale_class"]["road"]["game_km"], 380.0);
    let map = get(&t, j["custom_map"]["url"].as_str().unwrap());
    assert_eq!((map.status, map.body.clone()), (200, webp(2)));
    assert!(webhook_types(&t).contains(&"job.needs_review".to_string()));
    let hook: Value = serde_json::from_str(t.q("SELECT body FROM webhook_outbox WHERE type = 'job.needs_review'")[0]["body"].as_str().unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(hook["data"]["origin"], "manual");
    assert_eq!(hook["data"]["reasons"][0]["code"], "manual_submission");

    // The same images cannot be used twice.
    let again = submit("again", &manual_body(&e, &m, &u));
    assert!(again.body_json()["error"]["details"]["fields"]["evidence[0]"].is_string(), "{}", again.body_json());

    // Moderators see it in the queue; the player sees their own images.
    let q = t.call(t.admin("GET", "/api/v1/admin/review-queue")).body_json();
    assert_eq!(q["items"][0]["origin"], "manual");
    let ev = t.call(t.bot("GET", &format!("/api/v1/players/{PLAYER}/jobs/{job_id}/evidence"))).body_json();
    assert_eq!(ev["items"].as_array().unwrap().len(), 3);
    assert!(ev["items"].as_array().unwrap().iter().any(|i| i["role"] == "uk_route"));
    link_other(&t, "555", "Someone Else");
    assert_eq!(t.call(t.bot("GET", &format!("/api/v1/players/555/jobs/{job_id}/evidence"))).status, 404);
    let d = t.call(t.admin("GET", &format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{job_id}"))).body_json();
    assert_eq!(d["submission"]["sheet"]["distance_km"], 380.0);
    assert_eq!(d["sheet"]["uk"]["entry_city"], "Folkestone");
    assert_eq!(d["evidence"].as_array().unwrap().len(), 3);
    assert_eq!(t.call(t.admin("GET", &format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{job_id}/route"))).status, 404);

    // Approve with a correction and the map hidden: one job.scored, by the moderator.
    let before = webhook_types(&t).len();
    let r = t.call(t.admin("POST", &format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{job_id}/approve")).with_json(&json!({
        "reason": "Checked the screenshots.", "expected_etag": d["etag"], "hide_map": true,
        "corrections": {"unit": "km", "distance": 400}})));
    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, "{}", r.body_json());
    let world2 = 324.0 / 19.0 + 76.0 / 15.0;
    assert_eq!(r.body_json()["points"], points_for_world_km(world2));
    let types = webhook_types(&t);
    assert_eq!((types.len() - before, types.iter().filter(|x| *x == "job.scored").count()), (1, 1), "{types:?}");
    let p = t.call(t.bot("GET", &format!("/api/v1/public/jobs/{job_id}"))).body_json();
    assert_eq!((p["outcome"].as_str(), p["custom_map"].clone()), (Some("approved"), Value::Null));
    let d = t.call(t.admin("GET", &format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{job_id}"))).body_json();
    assert_eq!(d["overrides"]["distance_km"], 400.0);
    assert_eq!(d["submission"]["sheet"]["distance_km"], 380.0);
    assert_eq!(d["hide_map"], true);
    let actions: Vec<&str> = d["audit"].as_array().unwrap().iter().map(|a| a["action"].as_str().unwrap()).collect();
    assert_eq!(actions, ["job.approve", "job.edit", "job.submit"]);

    // A moderator can give it a bonus afterwards; recalculation keeps it all.
    let b = t.call(t.admin("POST", "/api/v1/admin/bonuses").with_json(&json!({"game": "ets2", "label": "Apple week",
        "match": "apples", "match_kind": "exact", "kind": "multiplier", "amount": 2.0,
        "active_from": "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z", "active_to": "2026-11-01T00:00:00Z", "reason": "Event"}))).body_json();
    let r = t.call(t.admin("PATCH", &format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{job_id}")).with_json(&json!({"reason": "Event cargo", "bonus_id": b["bonus_id"]})));
    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, "{}", r.body_json());
    let doubled = {
        let c = pt_server::config::sample();
        c.rules.floor_points(pt_core::units::km_to_mi(world2) * c.rules.points_per_world_mi * 2.0)
    };
    assert_eq!(r.body_json()["points"], doubled);
    t.advance(1000);
    t.call(t.admin("POST", &format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{job_id}/recalculate")).with_json(&json!({"reason": "Check"})));
    assert_eq!(t.call(t.bot("GET", &format!("/api/v1/public/jobs/{job_id}"))).body_json()["points"], doubled);
}

#[test]
fn moderators_edit_tracked_jobs_and_edits_survive_rescoring() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    let job_id = chicago(&t);
    let path = format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{job_id}");
    let d = t.call(t.admin("GET", &path)).body_json();
    assert_eq!(d["origin"], "tracked");
    let game_km = d["sheet"]["distance_km"].as_f64().unwrap();
    let world_km = d["distances"]["world_km"].as_f64().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(d["points"], 3.6);

    // Unknown fields and stale etags are refused.
    let r = t.call(t.admin("PATCH", &path).with_json(&json!({"reason": "Typo", "top_speed": 3})));
    assert_eq!(r.body_json()["error"]["details"]["fields"]["top_speed"], "unknown field");
    let r = t.call(t.admin("PATCH", &path).with_json(&json!({"reason": "Typo", "cargo_name": "X", "expected_etag": "\"jX-v9\""})));
    assert_eq!(r.status, 409);

    // Double the distance: the job's own city/road mix carries over.
    t.advance(1);
    let r = t.call(t.admin("PATCH", &path).with_json(&json!({"reason": "Delivery distance was cut off", "unit": "km",
        "distance": game_km * 2.0, "cargo_name": "Corrected cargo", "damage": 4, "truck": "Peterbilt"})));
    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, "{}", r.body_json());
    let edited = r.body_json();
    assert_eq!(edited["outcome"], "valid");
    assert_eq!(edited["points"], points_for_world_km(world_km * 2.0));
    let hook: Value = serde_json::from_str(t.q("SELECT body FROM webhook_outbox WHERE type = 'job.scored' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1")[0]["body"].as_str().unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(hook["data"]["by"], json!({"kind": "moderator", "discord_user_id": ADMIN}));
    let p = t.call(t.bot("GET", &format!("/api/v1/public/jobs/{job_id}"))).body_json();
    assert_eq!(p["cargo"]["name"], "Corrected cargo");
    let d = t.call(t.admin("GET", &path)).body_json();
    assert_eq!(d["sheet"]["truck"], "Peterbilt");
    assert_eq!(d["overrides"]["damage_pct"], 4.0);
    assert_eq!(d["distances"]["edited"], true);

    // A full replay from the raw frames keeps the edit.
    let mut s = t.scorer(&user_id(&t), Game::Ats);
    block_on(s.reset(&t)).unwrap();
    block_on(s.process(&t)).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(t.call(t.bot("GET", &format!("/api/v1/public/jobs/{job_id}"))).body_json()["points"], edited["points"]);

    // Setting a field back to the recording's value drops its override.
    t.advance(1);
    let r = t.call(t.admin("PATCH", &path).with_json(&json!({"reason": "Undo", "unit": "km", "distance": game_km})));
    assert!(r.body_json()["overrides"].get("distance_km").is_none(), "{}", r.body_json());
    assert_eq!(r.body_json()["points"], 3.6);
}

#[test]
fn moderators_add_and_remove_the_speed_penalty() {
    // Owner, 2026-10-16: a mod command to add or remove the speed penalty.
    let t = TestHost::new();
    let job_id = chicago(&t);
    let path = format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{job_id}");
    let d = t.call(t.admin("GET", &path)).body_json();
    assert_eq!(d["points"], 3.6);
    assert_eq!(d["sheet"]["speed_penalty"], false);
    let world_mi = d["distances"]["world_km"].as_f64().unwrap() / 1.609344;
    let penalised = (world_mi * 0.85 * 10.0).floor() / 10.0;

    // Add it: the distance counts at 0.85, and the public notes say so.
    t.advance(1);
    let r = t.call(t.admin("PATCH", &path).with_json(&json!({"reason": "Speeding on the video", "speed_penalty": true})));
    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, "{}", r.body_json());
    assert_eq!(r.body_json()["points"], penalised);
    assert_eq!(r.body_json()["overrides"]["speed_penalty"], true);
    let p = t.call(t.bot("GET", &format!("/api/v1/public/jobs/{job_id}"))).body_json();
    assert!(p["public_notes"].as_array().unwrap().iter().any(|n| n["code"] == "speed_penalty"), "{p}");

    // It survives a full replay from the raw frames.
    let mut s = t.scorer(&user_id(&t), Game::Ats);
    block_on(s.reset(&t)).unwrap();
    block_on(s.process(&t)).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(t.call(t.bot("GET", &format!("/api/v1/public/jobs/{job_id}"))).body_json()["points"], penalised);

    // null: the rules decide again.
    t.advance(1);
    let r = t.call(t.admin("PATCH", &path).with_json(&json!({"reason": "Wrong job", "speed_penalty": null})));
    assert_eq!(r.body_json()["points"], 3.6);
    assert!(r.body_json()["overrides"].get("speed_penalty").is_none(), "{}", r.body_json());

    // Anything else is refused.
    t.advance(1);
    let r = t.call(t.admin("PATCH", &path).with_json(&json!({"reason": "Typo", "speed_penalty": "yes"})));
    assert_eq!(r.status, 422, "{}", r.body_json());
    assert_eq!(r.body_json()["error"]["details"]["fields"]["speed_penalty"], "true, false or null");
}

#[test]
fn a_moderator_removes_an_automatic_speed_penalty() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    publish(&t);
    let token = link(&t);
    // 110 mph for 60 s: over the ATS penalty limit (105 mph).
    upload(&t, &token, &synthetic_job("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef", 110.0, 60.0), 200);
    score(&t, Game::Ats);
    let job_id = t.q("SELECT job_id FROM jobs")[0]["job_id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
    let path = format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{job_id}");
    let d = t.call(t.admin("GET", &path)).body_json();
    assert_eq!(d["sheet"]["speed_penalty"], true, "{}", d["sheet"]);
    let before = t.call(t.bot("GET", &format!("/api/v1/public/jobs/{job_id}"))).body_json();
    assert_eq!(before["speed_penalty_applied"], true);

    let r = t.call(t.admin("PATCH", &path).with_json(&json!({"reason": "Downhill glitch", "speed_penalty": false})));
    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, "{}", r.body_json());
    let after = t.call(t.bot("GET", &format!("/api/v1/public/jobs/{job_id}"))).body_json();
    assert_eq!(after["speed_penalty_applied"], false);
    assert!(after["world_mi"].as_f64().unwrap() > 0.0);
    let mi = after["world_mi"].as_f64().unwrap();
    assert!(after["points"].as_f64().unwrap() > before["points"].as_f64().unwrap() || mi < 1.0, "{before} -> {after}");
}

#[test]
fn history_spans_both_games_and_stats_break_down() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    chicago(&t);
    manual_job(&t);
    let h = t.call(t.bot("GET", &format!("/api/v1/public/players/{PLAYER}/jobs"))).body_json();
    assert_eq!(h["total"], 2);
    let games: Vec<&str> = h["items"].as_array().unwrap().iter().map(|i| i["game"].as_str().unwrap()).collect();
    assert_eq!(games, ["ets2", "ats"], "newest first");
    let only = t.call(t.bot("GET", &format!("/api/v1/public/players/{PLAYER}/jobs?outcome=pending_review"))).body_json();
    assert_eq!((only["total"].as_u64(), only["items"][0]["origin"].as_str()), (Some(1), Some("manual")));

    let p = t.call(t.bot("GET", &format!("/api/v1/public/players/{PLAYER}"))).body_json();
    let ats = &p["stats"]["ats"];
    assert_eq!(ats["outcomes"]["valid"], 1);
    assert_eq!(ats["outcomes"]["rejected"], 0);
    let classes: f64 = ["city", "road", "one_to_one", "nonstandard", "unknown"].iter().map(|c| ats["distance_by_scale_class"][c]["world_km"].as_f64().unwrap()).sum();
    assert!((classes - ats["world_km"].as_f64().unwrap()).abs() < 0.05, "{classes} vs {}", ats["world_km"]);
    assert_eq!(p["stats"]["ets2"]["outcomes"]["pending_review"], 1);
    assert_eq!(p["stats"]["ets2"]["distance_by_scale_class"]["road"]["world_km"], 0.0, "pending jobs do not count");
}

#[test]
fn up_to_five_sections_each_with_its_image_and_the_city_minimum() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    publish(&t);
    link(&t);
    let (e, m, u, a0, a1) = (image(&t, PLAYER, 1), image(&t, PLAYER, 2), image(&t, PLAYER, 3), image(&t, PLAYER, 4), image(&t, PLAYER, 5));
    let mut body = manual_body(&e, &m, &u);
    // 380 km: 76 in the UK, 20 at 1:1 and 6 in a big city (scale 3).
    body["adjusted_scales"] = json!([
        {"entry_city": "Paris", "exit_city": "Paris", "distance": 6, "scale": 3, "evidence": a0},
        {"entry_city": "Lille", "exit_city": "Arras", "distance": 20, "scale": 1, "evidence": a1},
    ]);
    // A city section under 3 mi in game (4.828 km) is rejected.
    let mut small = body.clone();
    small["adjusted_scales"][0]["distance"] = 4.8.into();
    let r = t.call(t.bot("POST", &format!("/api/v1/players/{PLAYER}/manual-jobs")).with_header("idempotency-key", "small").with_json(&small));
    assert_eq!(r.status, 422);
    assert!(r.body_json()["error"]["details"]["fields"]["adjusted_scales[0].distance"].as_str().unwrap().contains("3 mi"), "{}", r.body_json());

    let r = t.call(t.bot("POST", &format!("/api/v1/players/{PLAYER}/manual-jobs")).with_header("idempotency-key", "ok").with_json(&body));
    assert_eq!(r.status, 201, "{}", r.body_json());
    let j = r.body_json();
    let job_id = j["job_id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
    let world = (380.0 - 76.0 - 26.0) / 19.0 + 76.0 / 15.0 + 6.0 / 3.0 + 20.0;
    assert_eq!(j["held_points"], points_for_world_km(world));
    assert_eq!(j["distance_by_scale_class"]["city"]["game_km"], 6.0);
    assert_eq!(j["distance_by_scale_class"]["one_to_one"]["world_km"], 20.0);

    // Each section's image says which section it shows.
    let ev = t.call(t.bot("GET", &format!("/api/v1/players/{PLAYER}/jobs/{job_id}/evidence"))).body_json();
    let sections: Vec<(String, Value)> = ev["items"].as_array().unwrap().iter().filter(|i| i["role"] == "adjusted_scale")
        .map(|i| (i["evidence_id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string(), i["section"].clone())).collect();
    assert_eq!(sections, vec![(a0.clone(), json!(0)), (a1.clone(), json!(1))]);
    assert!(ev["items"].as_array().unwrap().iter().filter(|i| i["role"] != "adjusted_scale").all(|i| i["section"].is_null()));

    // A moderator removes section 0 and shortens section 1, by number.
    let r = t.call(t.admin("PATCH", &format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{job_id}")).with_json(&json!({"reason": "Paris was not a big-city run",
        "unit": "km", "adjusted_scales": {"0": null, "1": {"distance": 10}}})));
    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, "{}", r.body_json());
    let world2 = (380.0 - 76.0 - 10.0) / 19.0 + 76.0 / 15.0 + 10.0;
    assert_eq!(r.body_json()["held_points"], points_for_world_km(world2));
    let d = t.call(t.admin("GET", &format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{job_id}"))).body_json();
    assert_eq!(d["sheet"]["adjusted_scales"].as_array().unwrap().len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(d["sheet"]["adjusted_scales"][0]["entry_city"], "Lille");
    assert_eq!(d["submission"]["sheet"]["adjusted_scales"].as_array().unwrap().len(), 2, "the submission stays as sent");
    // The city rule holds for moderators too.
    t.advance(1);
    let r = t.call(t.admin("PATCH", &format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{job_id}")).with_json(&json!({"reason": "Add a city", "unit": "mi",
        "adjusted_scales": {"1": {"entry_city": "Lyon", "exit_city": "Lyon", "distance": 2, "scale": 3}}})));
    assert_eq!(r.status, 422, "{}", r.body_json());
}
```

`crates/pt-server/tests/points_store.rs`:

```rs
//! The scorer's SQLite point store gives exactly what the in-memory one does:
//! every fixture and local capture replayed through both, jobs and scores
//! compared at checkpoints; and random sequences of the store's operations
//! across block boundaries.

mod common;

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use common::TestSql;
use pt_core::rules::Context;
use pt_core::store::{PointStore, TrackId, VecStore};
use pt_core::timeline::{Point, Profiles};
use pt_core::trace::Frame;
use pt_replay::{order_sessions, parse_lines, read_lines, sample_config};
use pt_server::points::{SqlPoints, BLOCK};

const CHECKPOINT_EVERY: usize = 2_500;

fn replay_both(frames: &[Frame]) {
    let cfg = sample_config();
    let ctx = Context::default();
    let mut mem = Profiles::new(cfg.clone());
    let mut sql = Profiles::with_store(cfg.clone(), SqlPoints::open(TestSql::new()));
    let check = |mem: &Profiles, sql: &Profiles<SqlPoints<TestSql>>, at: &str| {
        let a: Vec<_> = mem.jobs().map(|j| (mem.materialize(j), mem.evaluate(j, &cfg, &ctx))).collect();
        let b: Vec<_> = sql.jobs().map(|j| (sql.materialize(j), sql.evaluate(j, &cfg, &ctx))).collect();
        assert_eq!(a.len(), b.len(), "{at}: job count");
        for (x, y) in a.iter().zip(&b) {
            assert!(x == y, "{at}: job {}/{} differs between the stores", x.0.profile, x.0.id);
        }
        assert!(sql.store().points_in_memory() <= 4 * BLOCK, "{at}: {} points in memory", sql.store().points_in_memory());
    };
    for (i, f) in frames.iter().enumerate() {
        mem.push(f);
        sql.push(f);
        if (i + 1) % CHECKPOINT_EVERY == 0 {
            // A flush in the middle, as after every chunk on the server.
            sql.store_mut().flush();
            check(&mem, &sql, &format!("frame {}", i + 1));
        }
    }
    check(&mem, &sql, "end");
    let ev_a = mem.take_evicted();
    let ev_b = sql.take_evicted();
    assert_eq!(ev_a, ev_b);
    assert_eq!(mem.into_jobs(), sql.into_jobs());
}

fn frames_of(files: &[PathBuf]) -> Vec<Frame> {
    let cfg = sample_config();
    let mut frames = Vec::new();
    for f in files {
        frames.extend(parse_lines(&read_lines(f).unwrap(), &cfg).0);
    }
    order_sessions(&mut frames);
    frames
}

#[test]
fn fixtures_replay_the_same_from_sqlite() {
    let dir = Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../pt-replay/tests/fixtures/real");
    let mut files: Vec<PathBuf> = std::fs::read_dir(dir).unwrap().map(|e| e.unwrap().path()).collect();
    files.sort();
    for f in files {
        replay_both(&frames_of(&[f]));
    }
}

/// The full-rate captures (git-ignored), when present. Slow in a debug build:
/// `cargo test --release -p pt-server --test points_store`.
#[test]
fn captures_replay_the_same_from_sqlite() {
    let dir = Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../../captures");
    let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(dir) else { return };
    let mut dirs: Vec<PathBuf> = entries.map(|e| e.unwrap().path()).filter(|p| p.is_dir()).collect();
    dirs.sort();
    for d in dirs {
        let mut files: Vec<PathBuf> =
            std::fs::read_dir(&d).unwrap().map(|e| e.unwrap().path()).filter(|p| p.extension().is_some_and(|e| e == "jsonl")).collect();
        files.sort();
        if !files.is_empty() {
            replay_both(&frames_of(&files));
        }
    }
}

fn pt(i: u64) -> Point {
    Point {
        sess: (i % 3) as u32,
        seq: i,
        wall_ms: i as i64 * 50,
        sim_us: i * 50_000,
        run: (i / 700) as u32,
        speed_mps: (i % 31) as f64,
        odometer_km: Some(i as f64 * 0.02),
        fuel_l: if i % 5 == 0 { None } else { Some(400.0 - i as f64 * 0.001) },
        pos: if i % 11 == 0 { None } else { Some([(i % 997) as f64 * 3.0, 1.0, (i / 997) as f64 * 5.0]) },
        game_time_min: Some(i as u32 / 20),
        local_scale: 19.0,
        cargo_loaded: i % 2 == 0,
        trailer_connected: true,
        truck: (i / 5000) as u32,
        mp_time_offset: 0,
        truckersmp: false,
        mp_mod: if i % 7 == 0 { Some("haulmp".into()) } else { None },
        after_teleport: i % 1000 == 0,
        cargo_damage: None,
    }
}

/// A small deterministic generator (no extra crates).
struct Lcg(u64);
impl Lcg {
    fn next(&mut self, n: usize) -> usize {
        self.0 = self.0.wrapping_mul(6364136223846793005).wrapping_add(1442695040888963407);
        ((self.0 >> 33) as usize) % n.max(1)
    }
}

#[test]
fn random_operations_match_the_memory_store() {
    let mut rng = Lcg(42);
    let mut a = VecStore::new();
    let db = TestSql::new();
    let mut b = SqlPoints::open(db.clone());
    // Pairs of the same track in both stores.
    let mut tracks: Vec<(TrackId, TrackId)> = vec![(a.create(), b.create())];
    let mut seq = 0u64;
    for step in 0..3000 {
        let k = rng.next(tracks.len());
        match rng.next(20) {
            0..=11 => {
                for _ in 0..rng.next(3 * BLOCK) {
                    seq += 1;
                    a.push(tracks[k].0, pt(seq));
                    b.push(tracks[k].1, pt(seq));
                }
            }
            12..=13 => {
                let at = rng.next(a.len(tracks[k].0) + 1);
                tracks.push((a.split_off(tracks[k].0, at), b.split_off(tracks[k].1, at)));
            }
            14 if tracks.len() > 1 => {
                let j = (k + 1 + rng.next(tracks.len() - 1)) % tracks.len();
                let (src_a, src_b) = tracks.remove(j);
                let k = k.min(tracks.len() - 1);
                a.append(tracks[k].0, src_a);
                b.append(tracks[k].1, src_b);
            }
            15 if tracks.len() > 1 => {
                let (x, y) = tracks.remove(k);
                a.remove(x);
                b.remove(y);
            }
            16 => b.flush(),
            17 => {
                // A restart: the store is read back from the database.
                b.flush();
                let mut fresh = SqlPoints::open(db.clone());
                std::mem::swap(&mut b, &mut fresh);
            }
            _ => {
                let (x, y) = tracks[k];
                let n = a.len(x);
                assert_eq!(n, b.len(y), "step {step}: length");
                if n > 0 {
                    let i = rng.next(n);
                    assert_eq!(a.get(x, i), b.get(y, i), "step {step}: point {i}");
                    let p = a.get(x, i).unwrap();
                    if let Some(pos) = p.pos {
                        let near_a: Vec<usize> = a.iter(x).enumerate().filter(|(_, q)| q.pos.is_some_and(|q| pt_core::timeline::dist3(q, pos) <= 50.0)).map(|(i, _)| i).collect();
                        let near_b: Vec<usize> = b.near(y, pos, 50.0).filter(|(_, q)| q.pos.is_some_and(|q| pt_core::timeline::dist3(q, pos) <= 50.0)).map(|(i, _)| i).collect();
                        assert_eq!(near_a, near_b, "step {step}: near");
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    b.flush();
    for (x, y) in &tracks {
        assert_eq!(a.to_vec(*x), b.to_vec(*y));
    }
    let total: usize = tracks.iter().map(|(x, _)| a.len(*x)).sum();
    assert!(total > 10 * BLOCK, "the test moved enough points: {total}");
}
```
