`crates/pt-server/tests/real_replay.rs`:

```rs
//! A player's real data, scored as production would: D1 rows and raw chunks
//! copied from the server into the test host, then the scorer's passes, with
//! the memory each one needs measured. Also replays the same frames with every
//! point in memory (as the client does) and compares the jobs.
//!
//! Skipped unless `PT_REAL_DIR` names a directory with `rows_<table>.json`
//! (`wrangler d1 execute --json` output), `keys.txt` (`NNNNN r2_key` per line)
//! and `chunks/NNNNN.gz`:
//!
//!     PT_REAL_DIR=... cargo test --release -p pt-server --test real_replay -- --nocapture

mod common;

use std::alloc::{GlobalAlloc, Layout, System};
use std::path::Path;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};

use common::{block_on, TestHost};
use pt_core::rules::Context;
use pt_core::timeline::Profiles;
use pt_core::trace::parse_frame;
use pt_core::Game;
use pt_replay::sample_config;
use serde_json::Value;

struct Counting;
static CURRENT: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);
static PEAK: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);

fn grew(n: usize) {
    let now = CURRENT.fetch_add(n, Ordering::Relaxed) + n;
    PEAK.fetch_max(now, Ordering::Relaxed);
}

unsafe impl GlobalAlloc for Counting {
    unsafe fn alloc(&self, l: Layout) -> *mut u8 {
        let p = unsafe { System.alloc(l) };
        if !p.is_null() {
            grew(l.size());
        }
        p
    }
    unsafe fn dealloc(&self, p: *mut u8, l: Layout) {
        unsafe { System.dealloc(p, l) };
        CURRENT.fetch_sub(l.size(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    unsafe fn realloc(&self, p: *mut u8, l: Layout, new: usize) -> *mut u8 {
        let q = unsafe { System.realloc(p, l, new) };
        if !q.is_null() {
            if new > l.size() {
                grew(new - l.size());
            } else {
                CURRENT.fetch_sub(l.size() - new, Ordering::Relaxed);
            }
        }
        q
    }
}

#[global_allocator]
static ALLOC: Counting = Counting;

const MB: f64 = 1024.0 * 1024.0;

fn rows(dir: &Path, table: &str) -> Vec<serde_json::Map<String, Value>> {
    let raw = std::fs::read_to_string(dir.join(format!("rows_{table}.json"))).unwrap();
    let v: Value = serde_json::from_str(&raw[raw.find('[').unwrap()..]).unwrap();
    v[0]["results"].as_array().unwrap().iter().map(|r| r.as_object().unwrap().clone()).collect()
}

fn insert(t: &TestHost, table: &str, rows: &[serde_json::Map<String, Value>]) {
    for r in rows {
        let cols: Vec<&String> = r.keys().collect();
        let sql = format!(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO {table} ({}) VALUES ({})",
            cols.iter().map(|c| c.as_str()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", "),
            (1..=cols.len()).map(|i| format!("?{i}")).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ")
        );
        let vals: Vec<rusqlite::types::Value> = cols
            .iter()
            .map(|c| match &r[*c] {
                Value::Null => rusqlite::types::Value::Null,
                Value::Number(n) if n.is_i64() => rusqlite::types::Value::Integer(n.as_i64().unwrap()),
                Value::Number(n) => rusqlite::types::Value::Real(n.as_f64().unwrap()),
                Value::String(s) => rusqlite::types::Value::Text(s.clone()),
                other => rusqlite::types::Value::Text(other.to_string()),
            })
            .collect();
        t.db.execute(&sql, rusqlite::params_from_iter(vals)).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{table}: {e}"));
    }
}

fn blob_bytes(t: &TestHost) -> usize {
    t.blobs.borrow().values().map(Vec::len).sum()
}

#[test]
fn a_players_real_data_scores_within_a_durable_objects_memory() {
    let Some(dir) = std::env::var_os("PT_REAL_DIR") else { return };
    let dir = Path::new(&dir);
    let t = TestHost::new();
    t.db.execute("DELETE FROM config_versions", []).unwrap();
    for table in ["users", "config_versions", "releases", "revocations", "bonuses", "plugin_sessions", "raw_chunks"] {
        insert(&t, table, &rows(dir, table));
    }
    let user = rows(dir, "users")[0]["user_id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
    // Chunks, in the order they were listed (session start, then chunk number).
    let keys = std::fs::read_to_string(dir.join("keys.txt")).unwrap();
    let mut order: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    for line in keys.lines().filter(|l| !l.is_empty()) {
        let (n, key) = line.split_once(' ').unwrap();
        let data = std::fs::read(dir.join("chunks").join(format!("{n}.gz"))).unwrap_or_else(|_| panic!("chunk {n} missing"));
        t.blobs.borrow_mut().insert(key.to_string(), data);
        order.push(key.to_string());
    }
    t.now.set(1_792_468_000_000);

    let mut s = t.scorer(&user, Game::Ats);
    let (mut passes, mut chunks, mut stored, mut worst) = (0, 0, 0, 0.0f64);
    let start = CURRENT.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    let start_blobs = blob_bytes(&t);
    loop {
        let (base, blobs) = (CURRENT.load(Ordering::Relaxed), blob_bytes(&t));
        PEAK.store(base, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let r = block_on(s.process(&t)).unwrap();
        let new_blobs = blob_bytes(&t).saturating_sub(blobs);
        let held = (base - start).saturating_sub(blobs - start_blobs);
        let pass = (PEAK.load(Ordering::Relaxed) - base).saturating_sub(new_blobs);
        let peak = (held + pass) as f64 / MB;
        let (in_mem, on_disk) = s.footprint();
        println!(
            "pass {:>2}: {:>3} chunks, {} stored, held {:.1} MB + pass {:.1} MB; {in_mem} points in memory, {:.1} MB of points on disk",
            passes + 1,
            r.chunks,
            r.jobs_stored,
            held as f64 / MB,
            pass as f64 / MB,
            on_disk as f64 / MB
        );
        worst = worst.max(peak);
        passes += 1;
        chunks += r.chunks;
        stored += r.jobs_stored;
        if !r.more {
            break;
        }
    }
    println!("{chunks} chunks in {passes} passes, {stored} job stores; worst pass {worst:.1} MB above the host");
    let jobs = t.q("SELECT local_id, state, start_kind, outcome, points, held_points, world_km, game_km, reasons FROM jobs ORDER BY local_id");
    println!("jobs replayed: {}", jobs.len());

    // The views of every stored job: map (public and admin) and graphs, timed.
    for j in t.q("SELECT job_id FROM jobs") {
        let id = j["job_id"].as_str().unwrap();
        // The view was stored with the data; one rebuilt from the segments
        // (a job stored before views existed) gives the same map.
        let views: Vec<String> = t.blobs.borrow().keys().filter(|k| k.starts_with(&format!("jobs/{id}/view-"))).cloned().collect();
        assert_eq!(views.len(), 1, "{views:?}");
        let cached = t.call(t.bot("GET", &format!("/api/v1/public/jobs/{id}/route"))).body;
        t.blobs.borrow_mut().remove(&views[0]);
        let rebuilt = t.call(t.bot("GET", &format!("/api/v1/public/jobs/{id}/route"))).body;
        if let Some(dump) = std::env::var_os("PT_ROUTE_DUMP") { std::fs::write(std::path::Path::new(&dump).join(format!("{id}.json")), &rebuilt).unwrap(); }
        assert_eq!(cached, rebuilt, "map from the stored view vs rebuilt");
        assert!(t.blobs.borrow().contains_key(&views[0]), "the rebuilt view is stored again");
        for path in [format!("/api/v1/public/jobs/{id}/route"), format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{id}/route"), format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{id}/series")] {
            let req = if path.contains("/admin/") { t.admin("GET", &path) } else { t.bot("GET", &path) };
            PEAK.store(CURRENT.load(Ordering::Relaxed), Ordering::Relaxed);
            let before = CURRENT.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
            let started = std::time::Instant::now();
            let r = t.call(req);
            let mb = (PEAK.load(Ordering::Relaxed) - before) as f64 / MB;
            let features = serde_json::from_slice::<Value>(&r.body).ok().and_then(|v| v["features"].as_array().map(Vec::len));
            println!("{path}: {} in {:.2} s, {} bytes, peak {mb:.1} MB, features {features:?}", r.status, started.elapsed().as_secs_f64(), r.body.len());
            assert_eq!(r.status, 200);
            if path.ends_with("/route") {
                // Every coordinate within what the bot's renderer accepts.
                let v: Value = serde_json::from_slice(&r.body).unwrap();
                let valid = v["features"].as_array().unwrap().iter().flat_map(|f| f["geometry"]["coordinates"].as_array().unwrap()).all(|c| {
                    let (lon, lat) = (c[0].as_f64().unwrap_or(f64::NAN), c[1].as_f64().unwrap_or(f64::NAN));
                    (-180.0..=180.0).contains(&lon) && (-90.0..=90.0).contains(&lat)
                });
                assert!(valid, "{path}: a coordinate out of range");
                println!("{path}: projection {}", v["properties"]["projection"]);
            }
        }
    }

    // The same frames with every point in memory, as the client scores them.
    let cfg = sample_config();
    let mp = cfg.multiplayer.clone();
    let mut client = Profiles::new(cfg.clone());
    for key in &order {
        let text = pt_server::util::gunzip(&t.blobs.borrow()[key], usize::MAX).unwrap();
        for line in text.split(|b| *b == b'\n').filter(|l| !l.is_empty()) {
            if let Ok(f) = parse_frame(std::str::from_utf8(line).unwrap(), &mp) {
                client.push(&f);
            }
        }
    }
    for j in client.jobs() {
        let r = client.evaluate(j, &cfg, &Context::default());
        let (kept, reverted) = j.point_counts(client.store());
        println!(
            "client: job {} {:?} {:?} kept {kept} reverted {reverted}: {:?} {:.1} points, {:.1} world km, {:.0} game km",
            j.id, j.state, j.start, r.outcome, r.points_raw, r.distances.world_km, r.distances.counted_game_km
        );
    }
    assert!(worst < 64.0, "a pass needed {worst:.1} MB; a Durable Object has 128 MB in all");
}
```

```rs
//! `tests/sample-config.json` is what scripts/seed-server.mjs uploads as the
//! client's config: the sample config's canonical JSON and integrity hash.
//! Regenerate with `UPDATE_SAMPLE_CONFIG=1 cargo test -p pt-server --test sample_config`.

fn seed_script_config_matches_the_sample() {
```

`crates/pt-server/tests/scorer_memory.rs`:

```rs
//! Peak memory of a full rebuild, as a Durable Object (128 MB) would hold it.
//! On 2026-10-16 the owner's ETS2 rebuild never finished on Cloudflare: nine
//! jobs of the last 48 h (capture mode included) kept 373k points, and the last
//! catch-up pass copied every job to store it.
//!
//! Skipped unless `PT_MEMORY_FIXTURE` names a recording (JSONL, one frame per
//! line):
//!
//!     PT_MEMORY_FIXTURE=ets2.jsonl cargo test --release -p pt-server --test scorer_memory -- --nocapture

mod common;

use std::alloc::{GlobalAlloc, Layout, System};
use std::io::BufRead;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};

use common::seed::*;
use common::{block_on, TestHost};
use pt_core::Game;

struct Counting;
static CURRENT: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);
static PEAK: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);

fn grew(n: usize) {
    let now = CURRENT.fetch_add(n, Ordering::Relaxed) + n;
    PEAK.fetch_max(now, Ordering::Relaxed);
}

unsafe impl GlobalAlloc for Counting {
    unsafe fn alloc(&self, l: Layout) -> *mut u8 {
        let p = unsafe { System.alloc(l) };
        if !p.is_null() {
            grew(l.size());
        }
        p
    }
    unsafe fn dealloc(&self, p: *mut u8, l: Layout) {
        unsafe { System.dealloc(p, l) };
        CURRENT.fetch_sub(l.size(), Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    unsafe fn realloc(&self, p: *mut u8, l: Layout, new: usize) -> *mut u8 {
        let q = unsafe { System.realloc(p, l, new) };
        if !q.is_null() {
            if new > l.size() {
                grew(new - l.size());
            } else {
                CURRENT.fetch_sub(l.size() - new, Ordering::Relaxed);
            }
        }
        q
    }
}

#[global_allocator]
static ALLOC: Counting = Counting;

const MB: f64 = 1024.0 * 1024.0;

fn blob_bytes(t: &TestHost) -> usize {
    t.blobs.borrow().values().map(Vec::len).sum()
}

#[test]
fn a_full_rebuild_fits_a_durable_object() {
    let Some(path) = std::env::var_os("PT_MEMORY_FIXTURE") else { return };
    let t = TestHost::new();
    publish(&t);
    let token = link(&t);
    let file = std::fs::File::open(path).unwrap();
    let lines: Vec<String> = std::io::BufReader::new(file).lines().map(Result::unwrap).filter(|l| !l.trim().is_empty()).collect();
    upload(&t, &token, &lines, 80);
    let frames = lines.len();
    drop(lines);

    let game = if t.q("SELECT game FROM plugin_sessions WHERE game IS NOT NULL")[0]["game"] == "ats" { Game::Ats } else { Game::Ets2 };
    let mut s = t.scorer(&user_id(&t), game);
    let (mut passes, mut stored) = (0, 0);
    let mut worst = 0.0f64;
    let (start, start_blobs) = (CURRENT.load(Ordering::Relaxed), blob_bytes(&t));
    loop {
        // What the scorer holds: everything allocated beyond the host's own storage.
        let (base, blobs) = (CURRENT.load(Ordering::Relaxed), blob_bytes(&t));
        PEAK.store(base, Ordering::Relaxed);
        let r = block_on(s.process(&t)).unwrap();
        let new_blobs = blob_bytes(&t).saturating_sub(blobs);
        // Held between passes (the timelines) plus the pass's own peak.
        let held = (base - start).saturating_sub(blobs - start_blobs);
        let pass = (PEAK.load(Ordering::Relaxed) - base).saturating_sub(new_blobs);
        let peak = (held + pass) as f64 / MB;
        if peak > worst {
            println!("pass {}: held {:.1} MB + pass {:.1} MB ({} chunks, {} jobs stored)", passes + 1, held as f64 / MB, pass as f64 / MB, r.chunks, r.jobs_stored);
        }
        worst = worst.max(peak);
        passes += 1;
        stored += r.jobs_stored;
        if !r.more {
            break;
        }
    }
    println!("{frames} frames, {passes} passes, {stored} jobs stored, peak above the host: {worst:.1} MB");
    assert!(stored > 0);
    assert!(worst < 80.0, "a pass peaked at {worst:.1} MB; a Durable Object has 128 MB in all");
}
```

`crates/pt-server/tests/scorer_offload.rs`:

```rs
//! Finished jobs are not held in memory. Since 2026-10-20 every point is in
//! the scorer's own database and only an open block per track is in memory;
//! a job brought back by a load continues exactly as on the player's client
//! (which keeps every point), and storing it again keeps every point.

mod common;

use common::seed::*;
use common::{block_on, TestHost};
use pt_core::rules::Context;
use pt_core::timeline::Profiles;
use pt_core::Game;
use pt_replay::{order_sessions, parse_lines, sample_config};
use pt_server::points::BLOCK;
use serde_json::{json, Value};

const BASE_WALL: i64 = 1_791_000_000_000;

enum End {
    Deliver,
    Cancel,
    Nothing,
}

/// One plugin session on the Chicago → Joliet tyres job (as `synthetic_job`),
/// starting `wall_s` seconds after the base wall clock, at odometer `odo` and
/// position `x`, driving `secs` at 50 mph.
fn session(sess: &str, wall_s: i64, odo: f64, x: f64, secs: f64, end: End) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let (mut seq, mut sim, mut x, mut odo) = (0u64, 0u64, x, odo);
    let mut emit = |kind: &str, extra: Value, sim: u64| {
        seq += 1;
        let mut v = json!({"v": 1, "kind": kind, "sess": sess, "seq": seq, "wall_ms": BASE_WALL + wall_s * 1000 + (sim / 1000) as i64, "sim_us": sim});
        for (k, x) in extra.as_object().unwrap() {
            v[k] = x.clone();
        }
        out.push(v.to_string());
    };
    let a = |n: &str, v: Value| json!({"name": n, "index": null, "value": v});
    let job = json!([
        a("cargo.id", "tyres".into()), a("cargo", "Tyres".into()), a("source.city.id", "chicago".into()),
        a("source.city", "Chicago".into()), a("destination.city.id", "joliet".into()), a("destination.city", "Joliet".into()),
        a("source.company.id", "a".into()), a("destination.company.id", "b".into()), a("cargo.loaded", true.into()),
        a("job.market", "cargo_market".into()), a("planned_distance.km", 80.into()),
    ]);
    let sample = |x: f64, odo: f64, v: f64| {
        json!({"ch": {"truck.speed": v, "truck.odometer": odo, "truck.fuel.amount": 500.0,
            "truck.world.placement": {"position": {"x": x, "y": 0.0, "z": 0.0}}, "game.time": 1000,
            "local.scale": 20.0, "trailer.0.connected": true}})
    };
    emit("init", json!({"game_id": "ats", "game_version": {"major": 1, "minor": 7}}), 0);
    emit("config", json!({"id": "truck", "attrs": [a("id", "volvo".into())]}), 0);
    emit("config", json!({"id": "job", "attrs": job}), 0);
    emit("sample", sample(x, odo, 0.0), sim);
    let v = 50.0 * 0.44704;
    for _ in 0..(secs * 20.0) as u64 {
        sim += 50_000;
        x += v * 0.05;
        odo += v * 0.05 * 20.0 / 1000.0;
        emit("sample", sample(x, odo, v), sim);
    }
    match end {
        End::Deliver => {
            emit("gameplay", json!({"id": "job.delivered", "attrs": [a("distance.km", 8.into())]}), sim);
            emit("config", json!({"id": "job", "attrs": []}), sim);
        }
        End::Cancel => {
            emit("config", json!({"id": "job", "attrs": []}), sim);
            emit("gameplay", json!({"id": "job.cancelled", "attrs": [a("cancel.penalty", 1000.into())]}), sim);
        }
        End::Nothing => {}
    }
    sim += 50_000;
    emit("sample", sample(x, odo, 0.0), sim);
    out
}


/// The stored job's kept points (on disk).
fn stored_points(t: &TestHost) -> (String, usize) {
    let id = t.q("SELECT job_id FROM jobs")[0]["job_id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
    let stored = block_on(pt_server::jobs::load_stored(t, &id)).unwrap().expect("job data");
    (id, stored.job.kept.n)
}

/// What the player's client makes of the same frames (all points in memory).
fn client_view(sessions: &[Vec<String>]) -> Vec<(String, f64)> {
    let cfg = sample_config();
    let lines: Vec<String> = sessions.concat();
    let (mut frames, _) = parse_lines(&lines, &cfg);
    order_sessions(&mut frames);
    let mut p = Profiles::new(cfg.clone());
    for f in &frames {
        p.push(f);
    }
    p.into_jobs()
        .iter()
        .map(|j| (format!("{:?}", j.state).to_lowercase(), pt_core::rules::evaluate(j, &cfg, &Context::default()).distances.counted_game_km))
        .collect()
}

#[test]
fn a_delivered_job_leaves_memory_and_a_load_into_it_keeps_its_points() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    publish(&t);
    let token = link(&t);
    let first = session("aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa1", 0, 1000.0, 0.0, 60.0, End::Deliver);
    upload(&t, &token, &first, 200);
    let mut s = t.scorer(&user_id(&t), Game::Ats);
    while block_on(s.process(&t)).unwrap().more {}
    let (id, on_disk) = stored_points(&t);
    assert!(on_disk > 1000, "{on_disk}");
    let (in_memory, bytes) = s.footprint();
    assert!(in_memory <= BLOCK, "only open blocks stay in memory: {in_memory}");
    assert!(bytes > 0, "the points are on disk");
    let before = t.call(t.bot("GET", &format!("/api/v1/public/jobs/{id}"))).body_json();

    // A save from mid-job loaded in a new session: the job stops, and storing
    // that keeps every point. A new object instance (nothing in memory) picks
    // up where the last one committed.
    let second = session("aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa2", 600, 1003.0, 150.0, 5.0, End::Nothing);
    upload(&t, &token, &second, 200);
    let mut s = t.scorer(&user_id(&t), Game::Ats);
    while block_on(s.process(&t)).unwrap().more {}
    let detail = t.call(t.admin("GET", &format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{id}"))).body_json();
    assert!(detail.to_string().contains("stopped_after_delivery"), "{}", detail["timeline"]);
    assert_eq!(stored_points(&t), (id.clone(), on_disk));
    let after = t.call(t.bot("GET", &format!("/api/v1/public/jobs/{id}"))).body_json();
    assert_eq!((after["outcome"].clone(), after["points"].clone()), (before["outcome"].clone(), before["points"].clone()));
    assert_eq!(t.call(t.admin("GET", &format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{id}/series?max_points=50"))).status, 200);
    assert!(s.footprint().0 <= BLOCK);
    assert_eq!(client_view(&[first, second])[0].0, "stopped");
}

#[test]
fn a_cancelled_job_brought_back_by_a_load_continues_as_on_the_client() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    publish(&t);
    let token = link(&t);
    let first = session("bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb1", 0, 1000.0, 0.0, 60.0, End::Cancel);
    upload(&t, &token, &first, 200);
    let mut s = t.scorer(&user_id(&t), Game::Ats);
    while block_on(s.process(&t)).unwrap().more {}
    // A cancelled job stays with the player's tracker: no record here.
    assert!(t.q("SELECT job_id FROM jobs").is_empty());
    assert!(s.footprint().0 <= BLOCK);

    // A save from before the cancel: the job comes back from that point and
    // is delivered, exactly as the client sees it.
    let second = session("bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb2", 600, 1010.0, 450.0, 30.0, End::Deliver);
    upload(&t, &token, &second, 200);
    while block_on(s.process(&t)).unwrap().more {}
    let (id, _) = stored_points(&t);
    assert_eq!(t.q("SELECT job_id FROM jobs").len(), 1);
    let detail = t.call(t.admin("GET", &format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{id}"))).body_json();
    assert_eq!(detail["state"], "delivered", "{}", detail["state"]);
    let timeline = detail["timeline"].to_string();
    assert!(timeline.contains("cancellation_reverted"), "{timeline}");
    let client = client_view(&[first, second]);
    assert_eq!(client.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(client[0].0, "delivered");
    let server_km = detail["distances"]["counted_game_km"].as_f64().unwrap();
    assert!((server_km - pt_server::util::round2(client[0].1)).abs() < 1e-9, "server {server_km} vs client {}", client[0].1);
}

```

`crates/pt-server/tests/scorer_passes.rs`:

```rs
//! The scorer with a lot of data (2026-10-15, the owner's capture-mode World of
//! Trucks job): small live chunks are worked through in bounded passes, and a
//! job whose data could not be written is written on the next pass.

mod common;

use common::seed::*;
use common::TestHost;
use pt_server::scorer::MAX_CHUNKS_PER_PASS;

#[test]
fn many_small_chunks_take_several_passes() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    publish(&t);
    let token = link(&t);
    // 20 Hz for 3 minutes, one chunk per 4 frames: like a live upload.
    let lines = synthetic_job("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef", 50.0, 180.0);
    upload(&t, &token, &lines, 4);
    let chunks = lines.len().div_ceil(4);
    assert!(chunks > 2 * MAX_CHUNKS_PER_PASS, "{chunks}");

    let mut s = t.scorer(&user_id(&t), pt_core::Game::Ats);
    let mut passes = Vec::new();
    loop {
        let r = common::block_on(s.process(&t)).unwrap();
        assert!(r.chunks <= MAX_CHUNKS_PER_PASS);
        passes.push(r.chunks);
        if !r.more {
            break;
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(passes.iter().sum::<usize>(), chunks, "{passes:?}");
    assert_eq!(passes.len(), chunks.div_ceil(MAX_CHUNKS_PER_PASS));
    let job = t.q("SELECT job_id, state FROM jobs");
    assert_eq!(job.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(job[0]["state"], "delivered");
    // Its data is there, and the series reads it.
    let id = job[0]["job_id"].as_str().unwrap();
    let r = t.call(t.admin("GET", &format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{id}/series?max_points=50")));
    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, "{}", r.body_json());
}

#[test]
fn a_rebuild_in_several_passes_never_stores_a_job_half_replayed() {
    // 2026-10-15: a refresh replayed the owner's capture-mode session, and the
    // first pass wrote the delivered job back to `tracking` for a few minutes.
    let t = TestHost::new();
    publish(&t);
    let token = link(&t);
    let lines = synthetic_job("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef", 50.0, 180.0);
    upload(&t, &token, &lines, 4);
    let mut s = t.scorer(&user_id(&t), pt_core::Game::Ats);
    while common::block_on(s.process(&t)).unwrap().more {}
    let before = t.q("SELECT job_id, state, outcome, version FROM jobs");
    assert_eq!(before[0]["state"], "delivered");
    let events = t.q("SELECT event_id FROM webhook_outbox").len();

    common::block_on(s.reset(&t)).unwrap();
    let mut passes = 0;
    loop {
        let r = common::block_on(s.process(&t)).unwrap();
        passes += 1;
        let now = t.q("SELECT job_id, state, outcome, version FROM jobs");
        assert_eq!(now[0]["state"], "delivered", "pass {passes}");
        assert_eq!(now[0]["outcome"], before[0]["outcome"], "pass {passes}");
        if !r.more {
            break;
        }
        assert_eq!(r.jobs_stored, 0, "pass {passes}");
    }
    assert!(passes > 2, "{passes}");
    assert_eq!(t.q("SELECT job_id FROM jobs").len(), 1);
    // Nothing changed, so nothing was announced.
    assert_eq!(t.q("SELECT event_id FROM webhook_outbox").len(), events);
}

#[test]
fn a_job_whose_data_failed_to_store_is_stored_on_the_next_pass() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    publish(&t);
    let token = link(&t);
    upload(&t, &token, &synthetic_job("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef", 50.0, 60.0), 200);
    let mut s = t.scorer(&user_id(&t), pt_core::Game::Ats);
    t.fail_job_puts.set(1);
    assert!(common::block_on(s.process(&t)).is_err(), "the write failed");
    assert!(t.blobs.borrow().keys().all(|k| !k.starts_with("jobs/")));
    assert!(t.q("SELECT job_id FROM jobs").is_empty(), "no row without its data");

    // Nothing new uploaded: the next pass still stores it.
    let r = common::block_on(s.process(&t)).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(r.jobs_stored, 1);
    let id = t.q("SELECT job_id FROM jobs")[0]["job_id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
    assert!(t.blobs.borrow().contains_key(&pt_server::jobs::meta_key(&id)));
    assert_eq!(t.call(t.admin("GET", &format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{id}/series"))).status, 200);
}

#[test]
fn a_row_whose_data_went_missing_gets_it_back() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    publish(&t);
    let token = link(&t);
    upload(&t, &token, &synthetic_job("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef", 50.0, 60.0), 200);
    score(&t, pt_core::Game::Ats);
    let id = t.q("SELECT job_id FROM jobs")[0]["job_id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
    // As production had it: the row, without its data.
    t.blobs.borrow_mut().retain(|k, _| !k.starts_with(&format!("jobs/{id}")));
    assert_eq!(t.call(t.admin("GET", &format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{id}/series"))).status, 404);
    // Replaying the raw data (a scorer with an empty database) restores it.
    t.scorer_dbs.borrow_mut().clear();
    score(&t, pt_core::Game::Ats);
    assert_eq!(t.call(t.admin("GET", &format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{id}/series"))).status, 200);
}

#[test]
fn a_new_scorer_format_wakes_every_scorer_once() {

/// Fuel save-edited far past full (the owner's Actros: 600 L × 99,999) reads
/// 59,999,400 L and never visibly drops: no fuel used is shown, and the job
/// says its fuel could not be read. A normal job is unchanged.
#[test]
fn fuel_edited_past_any_tank_shows_no_fuel_used() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    publish(&t);
    let token = link(&t);
    let lines: Vec<String> = synthetic_job("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef", 50.0, 60.0)
        .into_iter()
        .map(|l| l.replace("\"truck.fuel.amount\":500.0", "\"truck.fuel.amount\":59999400.0"))
        .collect();
    assert!(lines.iter().any(|l| l.contains("59999400")), "the fixture's fuel was replaced");
    upload(&t, &token, &lines, 200);
    score(&t, pt_core::Game::Ats);
    let summary = &t.q("SELECT summary FROM jobs")[0]["summary"];
    let s: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(summary.as_str().unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(s["fuel_used_l"], serde_json::Value::Null);
    assert_eq!(s["fuel_readable"], false);
    let id = t.q("SELECT job_id FROM jobs")[0]["job_id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
    let api = t.call(t.bot("GET", &format!("/api/v1/public/jobs/{id}"))).body_json();
    assert_eq!((api["fuel_used_l"].clone(), api["fuel_readable"].clone()), (serde_json::Value::Null, serde_json::Value::Bool(false)));

    let d = TestHost::new();
    publish(&d);
    let token = link(&d);
    upload(&d, &token, &synthetic_job("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef", 50.0, 60.0), 200);
    score(&d, pt_core::Game::Ats);
    let s: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(d.q("SELECT summary FROM jobs")[0]["summary"].as_str().unwrap()).unwrap();
    assert!(s["fuel_used_l"].is_number());
    let id = d.q("SELECT job_id FROM jobs")[0]["job_id"].as_str().unwrap().to_string();
    assert!(d.call(d.bot("GET", &format!("/api/v1/public/jobs/{id}"))).body_json().get("fuel_readable").is_none());
    assert!(s.get("fuel_readable").is_none());
}
```

`crates/pt-server/tests/scorer_rebuild.rs`:

```rs
//! A deploy must not re-score stored jobs or tell players again (2026-10-23:
//! the same "Speed penalty" DM for job 3H17-V9C2 after the deploys of 10-15,
//! 10-20 and 10-23, the last one at 155 mph instead of 105). A new scorer
//! format or timeline config rebuilds the state from the raw data, but a
//! stored delivery keeps its outcome and points.

mod common;

use common::seed::*;
use common::TestHost;
use pt_core::Game;
use serde_json::{json, Value};

/// A delivered ATS job at 110 mph for 60 s: over the penalty limit (105 mph),
/// so the player was told once.
fn speeding_job(t: &TestHost) -> Vec<Value> {
    publish(t);
    let token = link(t);
    upload(t, &token, &synthetic_job("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef", 110.0, 60.0), 200);
    score(t, Game::Ats);
    let jobs = stored(t);
    assert_eq!(jobs.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(jobs[0]["state"], "delivered");
    assert!(notifications(t) > 0, "the penalty was announced once");
    jobs
}

fn stored(t: &TestHost) -> Vec<Value> {
    t.q("SELECT job_id, state, outcome, auto_outcome, points, held_points, version, summary, updated_at FROM jobs ORDER BY job_id")
}

/// Webhooks of these types sent so far.
fn sent(t: &TestHost, types: &str) -> usize {
    t.q(&format!("SELECT event_id FROM webhook_outbox WHERE type IN ({types})")).len()
}

/// DMs to the player, and announcements of a job's score.
fn notifications(t: &TestHost) -> usize {
    sent(t, "'player.notification', 'job.scored'")
}

/// The state as a scorer of another format left it.
fn older_format(t: &TestHost) {
    let dbs = t.scorer_dbs.borrow();
    let db = dbs.get(&format!("{}:ats", user_id(t))).expect("the scorer has a database");
    let n = db.0.execute("UPDATE pt_kv SET v = CAST(json_set(CAST(v AS TEXT), '$.key', '3:old') AS BLOB) WHERE k = 'state'", []).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(n, 1);
}

/// Scores until caught up, with a scorer that has nothing in memory (a
/// restarted Durable Object, as after a deploy).
fn rescore(t: &TestHost) -> pt_server::scorer::Report {
    let mut s = t.scorer(&user_id(t), Game::Ats);
    let mut last = common::block_on(s.process(t)).unwrap();
    let rebuilt = last.rebuilt;
    while last.more {
        last = common::block_on(s.process(t)).unwrap();
    }
    last.rebuilt |= rebuilt;
    last
}

#[test]
fn a_new_scorer_format_keeps_stored_jobs_and_tells_nobody_again() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    let before = speeding_job(&t);
    let told = notifications(&t);

    older_format(&t);
    let r = rescore(&t);
    assert!(r.rebuilt, "{r:?}");
    assert_eq!(stored(&t), before);
    assert_eq!(notifications(&t), told);

    // Caught up: the next pass finds nothing to store.
    let r = rescore(&t);
    assert!(!r.rebuilt);
    assert_eq!(r.jobs_stored, 0, "{r:?}");
    assert_eq!(stored(&t), before);
}

#[test]
fn a_new_speed_limit_does_not_re_score_past_jobs() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    let before = speeding_job(&t);
    let told = notifications(&t);

    // The timeline config changes (part of the state key): 105 -> 120 mph.
    let toml = pt_server::config::SAMPLE_TOML.replace("penalty_over_mph = 105.0   # rule 5", "penalty_over_mph = 120.0   # rule 5");
    assert_ne!(toml, pt_server::config::SAMPLE_TOML);
    t.advance(1);
    let r = t.call(t.admin("POST", "/api/v1/admin/config-versions").with_json(&json!({"toml": toml, "make_current": true, "reason": "Higher limit"})));
    assert_eq!(r.status, 201, "{}", r.body_json());

    let r = rescore(&t);
    assert!(r.rebuilt, "{r:?}");
    assert_eq!(stored(&t), before, "the penalty stays");
    assert_eq!(notifications(&t), told);

    // A moderator's recalculation applies the new limit on purpose.
    let id = before[0]["job_id"].as_str().unwrap();
    let path = format!("/api/v1/admin/jobs/{id}");
    assert_eq!(t.call(t.admin("GET", &path)).body_json()["sheet"]["speed_penalty"], true);
    common::block_on(pt_server::scorer::rescore_job(&t, id, pt_server::jobs::Trigger::Recalculation, None)).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(t.call(t.admin("GET", &path)).body_json()["sheet"]["speed_penalty"], false);
}

#[test]
fn a_rebuild_still_stores_a_job_not_stored_yet() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    let before = speeding_job(&t);
    let told = sent(&t, "'player.notification'");
    // As a kind of job tracked only from now on: nothing stored for it.
    t.exec("DELETE FROM jobs");

    older_format(&t);
    let r = rescore(&t);
    assert!(r.rebuilt);
    let now = stored(&t);
    assert_eq!(now.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(now[0]["state"], "delivered");
    assert_eq!(now[0]["outcome"], before[0]["outcome"]);
    // Announced as a new job, but the player is not told again.
    assert_eq!(sent(&t, "'player.notification'"), told);
}
```

`crates/pt-server/tests/updates.rs`:

```rs
//! Client updates (docs/UPDATES.md): a release published with a signed update
//! manifest is offered to older clients with a player token, the setup program
//! only through a personal link the bot asks for, and the uninstaller to anyone.

mod common;

use common::seed::{link, PLAYER};
use common::{SignedUpdate, TestHost};
use pt_server::http::{Request, Response};
use pt_server::updates::STREAM_HEADER;
use ed25519_dalek::Signer;
use pt_core::update::SIGNING_CONTEXT;
use serde_json::{json, Value};

fn build(t: &TestHost, version: &str) -> SignedUpdate {
    common::signed_update(t, version)
}

fn publish(t: &TestHost, version: &str, b: &SignedUpdate, extra: Value) -> pt_server::http::Response {
    let mut body = json!({
        "release_version": version, "platform": "windows", "files": b.files, "reason": format!("Release {version}"),
        "update": {"manifest": b.manifest, "signature": b.signature},
        "installer": format!("PlasmaTrack-Setup-{version}.exe"), "notes": "Faster uploads.",
    });
    for (k, v) in extra.as_object().unwrap() {
        body[k] = v.clone();
    }
    t.advance(1000);
    t.call(t.admin("POST", "/api/v1/admin/releases").with_json(&body))
}

/// A client with a player token.
fn client(t: &TestHost, path: &str) -> Response {
    let token = match t.q("SELECT 1 AS x FROM tokens").len() {
        0 => link(t),
        _ => TOKEN.with(|k| k.borrow().clone()),
    };
    TOKEN.with(|k| *k.borrow_mut() = token.clone());
    t.call(Request::new("GET", path).with_header("authorization", &format!("Bearer {token}")))
}

thread_local! {
    static TOKEN: std::cell::RefCell<String> = const { std::cell::RefCell::new(String::new()) };
}

fn check(t: &TestHost, version: &str) -> Value {
    let r = client(t, &format!("/api/v1/client/update?platform=windows&version={version}"));
    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, "{}", r.body_json());
    r.body_json()["update"].clone()
}

fn header<'a>(r: &'a Response, name: &str) -> Option<&'a str> {
    r.headers.iter().find(|(k, _)| k == name).map(|(_, v)| v.as_str())
}

fn anyone(t: &TestHost, path: &str) -> Response {
    t.call(Request::new("GET", path))
}

#[test]
fn a_signed_release_is_offered_to_older_clients() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    let b = build(&t, "0.2.0");
    let r = publish(&t, "0.2.0", &b, json!({}));
    assert_eq!(r.status, 201, "{}", r.body_json());
    let rel = r.body_json();
    assert_eq!((rel["offered"].as_bool(), rel["update"]["files"].as_u64()), (Some(true), Some(4)));
    assert_eq!(rel["installer"], "PlasmaTrack-Setup-0.2.0.exe");

    let u = check(&t, "0.1.1");
    assert_eq!(u["version"], "0.2.0");
    assert_eq!(u["notes"], "Faster uploads.");
    let m = pt_core::update::verify_with(u["manifest"].as_str().unwrap(), u["signature"].as_str().unwrap(), &[common::update_signing_key().verifying_key().to_bytes()]).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(m.version, "0.2.0");
    assert_eq!(check(&t, "0.2.0"), Value::Null, "already current");
    assert_eq!(check(&t, "0.10.0"), Value::Null, "newer than anything offered");
    assert_eq!(client(&t, "/api/v1/client/update?version=latest").status, 400);
    assert_eq!(anyone(&t, "/api/v1/client/update?platform=windows&version=0.1.1").status, 401, "a client needs its token");

    // Update files: for clients with a token, streamed by the Worker.
    let dll = format!("/dl/releases/{}", m.key(&m.files[2]));
    let f = client(&t, &dll);
    assert_eq!(f.status, 200);
    assert_eq!(header(&f, STREAM_HEADER), Some("windows/0.2.0/plasmatrack.dll.gz"));
    assert!(f.body.is_empty());
    assert_eq!(anyone(&t, &dll).status, 401);
    for p in ["/dl/releases/windows/0.2.0/../secret", "/dl/releases/windows/latest/x.gz", "/dl/releases/windows/0.2.0/missing.gz"] {
        assert_eq!(client(&t, p).status, 404, "{p}");
    }
    assert_eq!(anyone(&t, "/dl/setup").status, 404, "no public setup link");
}

#[test]
fn the_setup_needs_a_personal_link_and_the_uninstaller_is_public() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    let b = build(&t, "0.2.0");
    assert_eq!(publish(&t, "0.2.0", &b, json!({})).status, 201);
    let setup = "/dl/releases/windows/0.2.0/PlasmaTrack-Setup-0.2.0.exe";
    assert_eq!(anyone(&t, setup).status, 403);
    assert_eq!(client(&t, setup).status, 403, "a token is not a link");

    // The bot asks for a link for a member with the right role.
    assert_eq!(t.call(Request::new("GET", "/api/v1/players/555/client-download")).status, 401);
    let r = t.call(t.bot("GET", "/api/v1/players/555/client-download?platform=windows"));
    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, "{}", r.body_json());
    let d = r.body_json();
    assert_eq!((d["version"].as_str(), d["file_name"].as_str(), d["bytes"].as_u64()), (Some("0.2.0"), Some("PlasmaTrack-Setup-0.2.0.exe"), Some(5)));
    assert!(t.q("SELECT 1 AS x FROM users WHERE discord_user_id = '555'").is_empty(), "nobody is created");
    let url = d["url"].as_str().unwrap().trim_start_matches("https://pt.example").to_string();
    let f = anyone(&t, &url);
    assert_eq!(f.status, 200, "{}", f.body_json());
    assert_eq!(header(&f, STREAM_HEADER), Some("windows/0.2.0/PlasmaTrack-Setup-0.2.0.exe"));
    assert!(header(&f, "content-disposition").unwrap().contains("PlasmaTrack-Setup-0.2.0.exe"));
    assert_eq!(header(&f, "cache-control"), Some("private, no-store"));
    // Another file, or a changed expiry, does not pass; an hour later it expires.
    assert_eq!(anyone(&t, &url.replace("PlasmaTrack-Setup-0.2.0.exe", "plasmatrack.dll")).status, 403);
    let exp: i64 = url.split("exp=").nth(1).unwrap().split('&').next().unwrap().parse().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(anyone(&t, &url.replace(&format!("exp={exp}"), &format!("exp={}", exp + 3600))).status, 403);
    t.advance(3_601_000);
    let late = anyone(&t, &url);
    assert_eq!(late.status, 403);
    assert!(late.body_json()["error"]["message"].as_str().unwrap().contains("expired"));

    // A disabled player gets none (linked above, by client()).
    t.advance(1000);
    let r = t.call(t.admin("PATCH", &format!("/api/v1/admin/players/{PLAYER}")).with_json(&json!({"disabled": true, "reason": "Cheating"})));
    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, "{}", r.body_json());
    assert_eq!(t.call(t.bot("GET", &format!("/api/v1/players/{PLAYER}/client-download"))).status, 403);

    // The uninstaller: one link for anyone, cacheable.
    let u = anyone(&t, "/dl/uninstall");
    assert_eq!(u.status, 302);
    let to = header(&u, "location").unwrap().trim_start_matches("https://pt.example").to_string();
    assert_eq!(to, "/dl/releases/windows/0.2.0/PlasmaTrack-Uninstall.exe");
    let f = anyone(&t, &to);
    assert_eq!((f.status, header(&f, STREAM_HEADER)), (200, Some("windows/0.2.0/PlasmaTrack-Uninstall.exe")));
    assert!(header(&f, "cache-control").unwrap().contains("public"));

    // What the bot shows: no setup link, the uninstaller's link.
    assert_eq!(anyone(&t, "/api/v1/public/client").status, 401);
    let l = t.call(t.bot("GET", "/api/v1/public/client?platform=windows")).body_json();
    assert_eq!(l["version"], "0.2.0");
    assert_eq!(l["installer"], json!({"file_name": "PlasmaTrack-Setup-0.2.0.exe", "bytes": 5}));
    assert_eq!(l["uninstaller"]["url"], "https://pt.example/dl/uninstall/windows");
}

#[test]
fn the_newest_offered_release_wins_and_can_be_withdrawn() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    let (a, b) = (build(&t, "0.2.0"), build(&t, "0.10.0"));
    assert_eq!(publish(&t, "0.10.0", &b, json!({})).status, 201);
    assert_eq!(publish(&t, "0.2.0", &a, json!({})).status, 201);
    assert_eq!(check(&t, "0.1.1")["version"], "0.10.0", "by version, not by date");

    // Withdrawn: the older one is offered again; offered again: back.
    let r = t.call(t.admin("POST", "/api/v1/admin/releases/rel_0_10_0_windows/offer").with_json(&json!({"offered": false, "reason": "Crashes on start"})));
    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, "{}", r.body_json());
    assert_eq!(check(&t, "0.1.1")["version"], "0.2.0");
    t.advance(1000);
    t.call(t.admin("POST", "/api/v1/admin/releases/rel_0_10_0_windows/offer").with_json(&json!({"offered": true, "reason": "Fixed"})));
    assert_eq!(check(&t, "0.1.1")["version"], "0.10.0");

    // A scheduled revocation stops the offer at once.
    t.advance(1000);
    let r = t.call(t.admin("POST", "/api/v1/admin/revocations").with_json(&json!({"target": {"kind": "release", "id": "rel_0_10_0_windows"}, "reason": "Bad build"})));
    assert_eq!(r.status, 201, "{}", r.body_json());
    assert_eq!(check(&t, "0.1.1")["version"], "0.2.0");

    // A release without an update is never offered.
    t.advance(1000);
    let plain = json!({"release_version": "0.3.0", "platform": "windows", "files": a.files, "reason": "Hand-installed build"});
    assert_eq!(t.call(t.admin("POST", "/api/v1/admin/releases").with_json(&plain)).status, 201);
    assert_eq!(check(&t, "0.1.1")["version"], "0.2.0");
    let r = t.call(t.admin("POST", "/api/v1/admin/releases/rel_0_3_0_windows/offer").with_json(&json!({"offered": true, "reason": "Try"})));
    assert_eq!(r.status, 422);
}

#[test]
fn an_update_must_be_signed_complete_and_match_the_release() {
    let t = TestHost::new();
    let b = build(&t, "0.2.0");
    let refused = |extra: Value| {
        let r = publish(&t, "0.2.0", &b, extra);
        assert_eq!(r.status, 422, "{}", r.body_json());
        r.body_json()["error"]["details"].to_string()
    };
    // Signed by another key.
    let other = ed25519_dalek::SigningKey::from_bytes(&[1; 32]).sign(&[SIGNING_CONTEXT, b.manifest.as_bytes()].concat());
    let hex: String = other.to_bytes().iter().map(|x| format!("{x:02x}")).collect();
    assert!(refused(json!({"update": {"manifest": b.manifest, "signature": hex}})).contains("release key"));
    // Published under another version.
    assert!(publish(&t, "0.2.1", &b, json!({"installer": null})).body_json()["error"]["details"].to_string().contains("0.2.0"));
    // A program in the release that the update does not ship.
    let mut files = b.files.clone();
    files[0]["sha256"] = json!("00".repeat(32));
    assert!(refused(json!({"files": files})).contains("plugin hash"));
    // A file missing from the bucket, or of another size.
    let key = "windows/0.2.0/licenses/LLVM-LICENSE.txt.gz".to_string();
    let saved = t.releases.borrow_mut().remove(&key).unwrap();
    assert!(refused(json!({})).contains("not in the release bucket"));
    t.releases.borrow_mut().insert(key.clone(), b"short".to_vec());
    assert!(refused(json!({})).contains("bytes"));
    t.releases.borrow_mut().insert(key, saved);
    assert!(refused(json!({"installer": "Missing.exe"})).contains("installer"));
    assert!(refused(json!({"installer": "../x.exe"})).contains("installer"));
    assert!(refused(json!({"notes": "x".repeat(2001)})).contains("notes"));
    // All good.
    assert_eq!(publish(&t, "0.2.0", &b, json!({})).status, 201);
}
```

`crates/pt-worker/src/lib.rs`:

```rs
//! The PlasmaTrack server on Cloudflare Workers (PLAN §7a). All logic lives in
//! `pt-server`; this crate only adapts it to the bindings in `wrangler.toml`:
//!
//! - `DB` (D1), `RAW`, `BACKUPS` and `RELEASES` (R2), queues `WEBHOOKS` and `OPS`, Durable Object
//!   `SCORER` (one per player and game), and a Cron Trigger;
//! - variables `PUBLIC_URL`, `WEBHOOK_URL`, `BOOTSTRAP_ADMINS`;
//! - secrets `READ_TOKEN`, `BOT_TOKEN`, `WEBHOOK_SECRETS`, `DOWNLOAD_SECRET`
//!   (comma-separated lists where rotation needs two values at once).

use std::cell::{Cell, RefCell};
use std::time::Duration;

use futures_util::future::{select, Either};
use pt_core::Game;
use pt_server::env::{Host, HostError, HostResult, LocalSql, Row, Settings, SqlVal, Stmt, P};
use pt_server::http;
use pt_server::scorer::Scorer;
use pt_server::webhooks::Delivery;
use pt_server::{manage, updates, util, webhooks};
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use worker::wasm_bindgen::JsValue;
use worker::*;

const WEBHOOK_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(10);
/// A pass that failed (R2, D1) is tried again this soon.
const RETRY_MS: i64 = 60_000;
/// When a pass left chunks (`Report::more`), the next starts this soon, as a
/// new invocation with its own limits.
const NEXT_PASS_MS: i64 = 1_000;

/// A variable or secret (either works for every name), split at commas.
fn list(env: &Env, name: &str, _secret: bool) -> Vec<String> {
    let v = env.var(name).map(|s| s.to_string()).or_else(|_| env.secret(name).map(|s| s.to_string()));
    v.unwrap_or_default().split(',').map(str::trim).filter(|s| !s.is_empty()).map(str::to_string).collect()
}

fn settings(env: &Env) -> Settings {
    let hashes = |name| list(env, name, true).iter().map(|t| util::sha256_hex(t.as_bytes())).collect();
    Settings {
        read_token_sha256: hashes("READ_TOKEN"),
        bot_token_sha256: hashes("BOT_TOKEN"),
        bootstrap_admins: list(env, "BOOTSTRAP_ADMINS", false),
        webhook_url: list(env, "WEBHOOK_URL", false).into_iter().next(),
        webhook_secrets: list(env, "WEBHOOK_SECRETS", true),
        public_url: list(env, "PUBLIC_URL", false).into_iter().next().unwrap_or_default(),
        download_secret: list(env, "DOWNLOAD_SECRET", true).into_iter().next().unwrap_or_default(),
        backup_prefix: list(env, "BACKUP_PREFIX", false).into_iter().next().unwrap_or_default(),
        update_keys: Vec::new(),
        min_client_version: list(env, "MIN_CLIENT_VERSION", false).first().and_then(|v| pt_core::update::parse_version(v)),
    }
}

struct CfHost {
    env: Env,
    settings: Settings,
    /// Lets an upload hand the scorer poke off without waiting for it.
    ctx: Option<Context>,
}

fn host_err(e: impl std::fmt::Display) -> HostError {
    HostError(e.to_string())
}

fn js(p: &P) -> JsValue {
    match p {
        P::Null => JsValue::NULL,
        P::Int(i) => JsValue::from_f64(*i as f64),
        P::Real(f) => JsValue::from_f64(*f),
        P::Text(s) => JsValue::from_str(s),
    }
}

impl CfHost {
    fn new(env: Env, ctx: Option<Context>) -> CfHost {
        let settings = settings(&env);
        CfHost { env, settings, ctx }
    }

    fn statement(&self, sql: &str, params: &[P]) -> HostResult<D1PreparedStatement> {
        let db = self.env.d1("DB").map_err(host_err)?;
        let vals: Vec<JsValue> = params.iter().map(js).collect();
        db.prepare(sql).bind(&vals).map_err(host_err)
    }
}

impl Host for CfHost {
    fn settings(&self) -> &Settings {
        &self.settings
    }

    fn now_ms(&self) -> i64 {
        Date::now().as_millis() as i64
    }

    fn random(&self, buf: &mut [u8]) {
        getrandom::fill(buf).expect("crypto.getRandomValues");
    }

    async fn all(&self, sql: &str, params: Vec<P>) -> HostResult<Vec<Row>> {
        let r = self.statement(sql, &params)?.all().await.map_err(host_err)?;
        let rows: Vec<Value> = r.results().map_err(host_err)?;
        Ok(rows.into_iter().filter_map(|v| if let Value::Object(o) = v { Some(o) } else { None }).collect())
    }

    async fn run(&self, sql: &str, params: Vec<P>) -> HostResult<u64> {
        let r = self.statement(sql, &params)?.run().await.map_err(host_err)?;
        Ok(r.meta().ok().flatten().and_then(|m| m.changes).unwrap_or(0) as u64)
    }

    async fn batch(&self, stmts: Vec<Stmt>) -> HostResult<()> {
        let db = self.env.d1("DB").map_err(host_err)?;
        let prepared = stmts.iter().map(|(sql, p)| self.statement(sql, p)).collect::<HostResult<Vec<_>>>()?;
        for r in db.batch(prepared).await.map_err(host_err)? {
            if let Some(e) = r.error() {
                return Err(HostError(e));
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    async fn blob_get(&self, key: &str) -> HostResult<Option<Vec<u8>>> {
        let bucket = self.env.bucket("RAW").map_err(host_err)?;
        match bucket.get(key).execute().await.map_err(host_err)? {
            Some(obj) => match obj.body() {
                Some(b) => Ok(Some(b.bytes().await.map_err(host_err)?)),
                None => Ok(Some(Vec::new())),
            },
            None => Ok(None),
        }
    }

    async fn blob_put(&self, key: &str, bytes: Vec<u8>) -> HostResult<()> {
        let bucket = self.env.bucket("RAW").map_err(host_err)?;
        bucket.put(key, bytes).execute().await.map_err(host_err)?;
        Ok(())
    }

    async fn blob_delete(&self, key: &str) -> HostResult<()> {
        let bucket = self.env.bucket("RAW").map_err(host_err)?;
        bucket.delete(key).await.map_err(host_err)
    }

    async fn blob_size(&self, key: &str) -> HostResult<Option<u64>> {
        let bucket = self.env.bucket("RAW").map_err(host_err)?;
        Ok(bucket.head(key).await.map_err(host_err)?.map(|o| o.size()))
    }

    async fn backup_put(&self, key: &str, bytes: Vec<u8>) -> HostResult<()> {
        let bucket = self.env.bucket("BACKUPS").map_err(host_err)?;
        bucket.put(key, bytes).execute().await.map_err(host_err)?;
        Ok(())
    }

    async fn backup_list(&self, prefix: &str) -> HostResult<Vec<String>> {
        let bucket = self.env.bucket("BACKUPS").map_err(host_err)?;
        let mut keys = Vec::new();
        let mut cursor: Option<String> = None;
        loop {
            let mut list = bucket.list().prefix(prefix);
            if let Some(c) = cursor.take() {
                list = list.cursor(c);
            }
            let page = list.execute().await.map_err(host_err)?;
            keys.extend(page.objects().iter().map(|o| o.key()));
            match page.cursor() {
                Some(c) if page.truncated() => cursor = Some(c),
                _ => return Ok(keys),
            }
        }
    }

    async fn backup_delete(&self, key: &str) -> HostResult<()> {
        let bucket = self.env.bucket("BACKUPS").map_err(host_err)?;
        bucket.delete(key).await.map_err(host_err)
    }

    async fn release_size(&self, key: &str) -> HostResult<Option<u64>> {
        let bucket = self.env.bucket("RELEASES").map_err(host_err)?;
        Ok(bucket.head(key).await.map_err(host_err)?.map(|o| o.size()))
    }

    async fn poke_scorer(&self, user_id: &str, game: &str) -> HostResult<()> {
        let ns = self.env.durable_object("SCORER").map_err(host_err)?;
        let name = format!("{user_id}:{game}");
        let url = format!("https://scorer/process?user={user_id}&game={game}");
        let poke = async move {
            let stub = ns.id_from_name(&name).and_then(|id| id.get_stub());
            match stub {
                Ok(s) => {
                    if let Err(e) = s.fetch_with_str(&url).await {
                        console_error!("scorer {name}: {e}");
                    }
                }
                Err(e) => console_error!("scorer {name}: {e}"),
            }
        };
        match &self.ctx {
            Some(ctx) => ctx.wait_until(poke),
            None => poke.await,
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    async fn queue_webhook(&self, event_id: &str, delay_s: u32) -> HostResult<()> {
        let q = self.env.queue("WEBHOOKS").map_err(host_err)?;
        // Plain strings: an object would arrive as a JS Map (serde-wasm-bindgen).
        q.send(MessageBuilder::new(event_id.to_string()).delay_seconds(delay_s).build()).await.map_err(host_err)
    }

    async fn queue_op(&self, msg: Value) -> HostResult<()> {
        let q = self.env.queue("OPS").map_err(host_err)?;
        q.send(msg.to_string()).await.map_err(host_err)
    }

    async fn http_post(&self, url: &str, headers: Vec<(String, String)>, body: Vec<u8>) -> HostResult<u16> {
        let h = Headers::new();
        for (k, v) in &headers {
            h.set(k, v).map_err(host_err)?;
        }
        let mut init = RequestInit::new();
        init.with_method(Method::Post).with_headers(h).with_body(Some(JsValue::from_str(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&body))));
        let req = Request::new_with_init(url, &init).map_err(host_err)?;
        let controller = AbortController::default();
        let signal = controller.signal();
        let fetch = Fetch::Request(req);
        let sending = Box::pin(fetch.send_with_signal(&signal));
        let timeout = Box::pin(Delay::from(WEBHOOK_TIMEOUT));
        let outcome = match select(sending, timeout).await {
            Either::Left((r, _)) => Some(r.map(|resp| resp.status_code())),
            Either::Right(_) => None,
        };
        match outcome {
            Some(Ok(status)) => Ok(status),
            Some(Err(e)) => Err(host_err(e)),
            None => {
                controller.abort();
                Err(HostError("timed out after 10 s".into()))
            }
        }
    }
}

async fn to_request(mut req: Request) -> Result<http::Request> {
    let url = req.url()?;
    let mut r = http::Request::new(req.method().as_ref(), url.path());
    r.query = http::parse_query(url.query().unwrap_or(""));
    r.headers = req.headers().entries().map(|(k, v)| (k.to_ascii_lowercase(), v)).collect();
    r.body = req.bytes().await.unwrap_or_default();
    Ok(r)
}

fn to_response(r: http::Response) -> Result<Response> {
    let h = Headers::new();
    for (k, v) in &r.headers {
        h.set(k, v)?;
    }
    Ok(Response::from_bytes(r.body)?.with_status(r.status).with_headers(h))
}

/// A release file pt-server allowed (`updates::STREAM_HEADER`), streamed from
/// the release bucket: a setup program is too large to hold in memory. The
/// body is handed to the runtime as is, so it costs no CPU time and keeps its
/// length.
async fn stream_release(env: &Env, r: http::Response) -> Result<Response> {
    let key = r.headers.iter().find(|(k, _)| k == updates::STREAM_HEADER).map(|(_, v)| v.clone()).unwrap_or_default();
    let obj = env.bucket("RELEASES")?.get(&key).execute().await?;
    let Some(body) = obj.as_ref().and_then(|o| o.body()) else {
        return to_response(http::ApiError::not_found("file").response());
    };
    let h = Headers::new();
    for (k, v) in r.headers.iter().filter(|(k, _)| k != updates::STREAM_HEADER) {
        h.set(k, v)?;
    }
    Ok(Response::from_body(body.response_body()?)?.with_status(r.status).with_headers(h))
}

#[event(fetch)]
async fn fetch(req: Request, env: Env, ctx: Context) -> Result<Response> {
    let mut host = CfHost::new(env, Some(ctx));
    if host.settings.public_url.is_empty() {
        // Signed download links point back at whatever URL the bot called.
        let url = req.url()?;
        host.settings.public_url = url.origin().ascii_serialization();
    }
    let r = pt_server::handle(&host, to_request(req).await?).await;
    if r.headers.iter().any(|(k, _)| k == updates::STREAM_HEADER) {
        return stream_release(&host.env, r).await;
    }
    to_response(r)
}

/// Both queues: webhook deliveries (an `evt_…` id) and operation steps (JSON
/// text).
#[event(queue)]
async fn queue(batch: MessageBatch<Value>, env: Env, _ctx: Context) -> Result<()> {
    let host = CfHost::new(env, None);
    for msg in batch.messages()? {
        let text = match msg.body() {
            Value::String(s) => s.clone(),
            other => other.to_string(),
        };
        if let Some(id) = text.strip_prefix("evt_").map(|_| text.as_str()) {
            match webhooks::deliver(&host, id).await {
                Ok(Delivery::Done | Delivery::Dropped) => msg.ack(),
                Ok(Delivery::RetryIn(s)) => msg.retry_with_options(&QueueRetryOptionsBuilder::new().with_delay_seconds(s).build()),
                Err(e) => {
                    console_error!("webhook {id}: {}", e.message);
                    msg.retry_with_options(&QueueRetryOptionsBuilder::new().with_delay_seconds(60).build());
                }
            }
        } else {
            let body: Value = serde_json::from_str(&text).unwrap_or(Value::Null);
            match manage::run_op(&host, &body).await {
                Ok(next) => {
                    if let Some(next) = next {
                        host.queue_op(next).await.map_err(|e| Error::RustError(e.0))?;
                    }
                    msg.ack();
                }
                Err(e) => {
                    console_error!("operation step: {}", e.message);
                    msg.retry_with_options(&QueueRetryOptionsBuilder::new().with_delay_seconds(60).build());
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// The weekly backup, `47 3 * * SUN` in wrangler.toml (docs/SERVER.md); every
/// other schedule is the cron job. Matched by its time, so Cloudflare's
/// spelling of the weekday does not matter.
const BACKUP_CRON_TIME: &str = "47 3 ";

#[event(scheduled)]
async fn scheduled(event: ScheduledEvent, env: Env, _ctx: ScheduleContext) {
    let host = CfHost::new(env, None);
    if event.cron().starts_with(BACKUP_CRON_TIME) {
        // Sizes and row counts only, never row contents.
        match pt_server::backup::run(&host).await {
            Ok(r) => console_log!("backup written: {} ({} bytes, {} tables, deleted {:?})", r.key, r.bytes, r.tables.len(), r.deleted),
            Err(e) => console_error!("backup failed: {}", e.message),
        }
    } else if let Err(e) = manage::cron(&host).await {
        console_error!("cron: {}", e.message);
    }
}

/// The object's own SQLite storage, where the scorer keeps its points and
/// state (pt_server::points).
#[derive(Clone)]
struct ObjectSql(SqlStorage);

impl LocalSql for ObjectSql {
    fn exec(&self, sql: &str, params: &[SqlVal]) -> HostResult<Vec<Vec<SqlVal>>> {
        let sql = sql.trim();
        if sql.is_empty() {
            return Ok(Vec::new());
        }
        let bindings: Vec<SqlStorageValue> = params
            .iter()
            .map(|p| match p {
                SqlVal::Null => SqlStorageValue::Null,
                SqlVal::Int(i) => SqlStorageValue::Integer(*i),
                SqlVal::Real(f) => SqlStorageValue::Float(*f),
                SqlVal::Text(s) => SqlStorageValue::String(s.clone()),
                SqlVal::Blob(b) => SqlStorageValue::Blob(b.clone()),
            })
            .collect();
        let cursor = self.0.exec(sql, bindings).map_err(host_err)?;
        let mut rows = Vec::new();
        for row in cursor.raw() {
            let row = row.map_err(host_err)?;
            rows.push(
                row.into_iter()
                    .map(|v| match v {
                        SqlStorageValue::Null => SqlVal::Null,
                        SqlStorageValue::Boolean(b) => SqlVal::Int(b as i64),
                        SqlStorageValue::Integer(i) => SqlVal::Int(i),
                        SqlStorageValue::Float(f) => SqlVal::Real(f),
                        SqlStorageValue::String(s) => SqlVal::Text(s),
                        SqlStorageValue::Blob(b) => SqlVal::Blob(b),
                    })
                    .collect(),
            );
        }
        Ok(rows)
    }
}

/// One per (player, game): runs that player's timeline (pt_server::scorer).
/// Requests are processed one at a time; a poke during a run makes the run
/// go round once more instead of overlapping it. Everything the scorer needs
/// to continue is committed to the object's SQLite after every chunk, so
/// nothing has to be saved when the object goes idle.
#[durable_object]
pub struct ScorerObject {
    state: State,
    env: Env,
    scorer: RefCell<Option<Scorer<ObjectSql>>>,
    busy: Cell<bool>,
    again: Cell<bool>,
    /// The last pass left chunks for the next one.
    more: Cell<bool>,
    /// (user, game) of this object, from its first request; the alarm needs it.
    who: RefCell<Option<(String, Game)>>,
}

impl ScorerObject {
    /// Processes until no poke arrived during the last run, or until a pass
    /// leaves chunks for the next invocation.
    async fn drain(&self, host: &CfHost, scorer: &mut Scorer<ObjectSql>) -> pt_server::http::ApiResult<pt_server::scorer::Report> {
        loop {
            self.again.set(false);
            let r = scorer.process(host).await;
            self.more.set(r.as_ref().is_ok_and(|r| r.more));
            if r.is_err() || self.more.get() || !self.again.get() {
                return r;
            }
        }
    }
}

impl DurableObject for ScorerObject {
    fn new(state: State, env: Env) -> Self {
        ScorerObject {
            state,
            env,
            scorer: RefCell::new(None),
            busy: Cell::new(false),
            again: Cell::new(false),
            more: Cell::new(false),
            who: RefCell::new(None),
        }
    }

    async fn fetch(&self, req: Request) -> Result<Response> {
        let url = req.url()?;
        let q: Vec<(String, String)> = url.query_pairs().map(|(k, v)| (k.into_owned(), v.into_owned())).collect();
        let get = |k: &str| q.iter().find(|(x, _)| x == k).map(|(_, v)| v.clone()).unwrap_or_default();
        let (user, game) = (get("user"), Game::from_api(&get("game")).ok_or_else(|| Error::RustError("bad game".into()))?);
        if self.who.borrow().as_ref() != Some(&(user.clone(), game)) {
            // Kept in storage too: an alarm can wake an evicted object.
            self.state.storage().put("who", (user.clone(), game.as_str().to_string())).await?;
            *self.who.borrow_mut() = Some((user.clone(), game));
        }
        if self.busy.get() {
            // The running pass (or the alarm) goes round once more.
            self.again.set(true);
            return Response::ok("queued");
        }
        self.busy.set(true);
        let host = CfHost::new(self.env.clone(), None);
        let taken = self.scorer.borrow_mut().take();
        let mut scorer = taken.unwrap_or_else(|| Scorer::new(&user, game, ObjectSql(self.state.storage().sql())));
        let result = self.drain(&host, &mut scorer).await;
        let (in_memory, on_disk) = scorer.footprint();
        *self.scorer.borrow_mut() = Some(scorer);
        self.busy.set(false);
        if self.more.get() || result.is_err() {
            // More chunks, or a failure (R2, D1): try again soon.
            let delay = if self.more.get() { NEXT_PASS_MS } else { RETRY_MS };
            self.state.storage().set_alarm(delay).await?;
        }
        match result {
            Ok(r) => Response::from_json(&json!({"chunks": r.chunks, "frames": r.frames, "jobs_stored": r.jobs_stored, "rebuilt": r.rebuilt,
                "points_in_memory": in_memory, "point_bytes_on_disk": on_disk})),
            Err(e) => {
                console_error!("scorer {user}: {}", e.message);
                Response::error(e.message, e.status)
            }
        }
    }

    /// The next pass of a long catch-up, or a retry after a failure.
    async fn alarm(&self) -> Result<Response> {
        if self.busy.get() {
            self.state.storage().set_alarm(NEXT_PASS_MS).await?;
            return Response::ok("busy");
        }
        let known = self.who.borrow().clone();
        let who = match known {
            Some(w) => Some(w),
            None => self
                .state
                .storage()
                .get::<(String, String)>("who")
                .await
                .ok()
                .flatten()
                .and_then(|(u, g)| Game::from_api(&g).map(|g| (u, g))),
        };
        let Some((user, game)) = who else { return Response::ok("idle") };
        *self.who.borrow_mut() = Some((user.clone(), game));
        let taken = self.scorer.borrow_mut().take();
        let mut scorer = taken.unwrap_or_else(|| Scorer::new(&user, game, ObjectSql(self.state.storage().sql())));
        self.busy.set(true);
        let host = CfHost::new(self.env.clone(), None);
        let outcome = self.drain(&host, &mut scorer).await;
        let (in_memory, on_disk) = scorer.footprint();
        *self.scorer.borrow_mut() = Some(scorer);
        self.busy.set(false);
        match outcome {
            Ok(r) => {
                console_log!("scorer {user}: {} chunks, {} jobs stored, {in_memory} points in memory, {on_disk} bytes on disk", r.chunks, r.jobs_stored);
                if self.more.get() {
                    self.state.storage().set_alarm(NEXT_PASS_MS).await?;
                    return Response::ok("more");
                }
                Response::ok("done")
            }
            Err(e) => {
                console_error!("scorer {user}: {}", e.message);
                self.state.storage().set_alarm(RETRY_MS).await?;
                Response::ok("retry")
            }
        }
    }
}

```
