`installer/src/renderer.js`:

```js
'use strict';

const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
const GAME_NAMES = { ats: 'American Truck Simulator', ets2: 'Euro Truck Simulator 2' };
let current = null;

function item(cls, text, detail) {
  const li = document.createElement('li');
  li.className = cls;
  li.textContent = text;
  if (detail) {
    const d = document.createElement('span');
    d.className = 'detail';
    d.textContent = detail;
    li.append(d);
  }
  return li;
}

function render(s) {
  current = s;
  $('version').textContent = `v${s.version}`;

  const games = s.games.filter((g) => g.windows_build);
  $('games').replaceChildren(
    ...(games.length
      ? games.map((g) =>
          item(g.plugin_installed ? 'ok' : 'todo', GAME_NAMES[g.game] || g.game, g.plugin_installed ? 'Plugin installed' : 'Plugin not installed yet'))
      : [item('bad', 'No ETS2 or ATS install found in your Steam libraries')]),
  );
  const running = s.gamesRunning;
  $('games-running').hidden = running.length === 0;
  $('games-running').textContent = 'Close the game before installing or uninstalling, so the plugin can be replaced.';

  if (!$('server').value) $('server').value = s.serverUrl;
  $('token').placeholder = s.tokenSet ? 'Saved (leave empty to keep it)' : 'Paste your token';
  if (s.installed) $('autostart').checked = s.autostart;

  $('install').textContent = s.installed ? 'Update' : 'Install';
  $('install').disabled = games.length === 0;
  $('status').hidden = !s.running;
  $('start').hidden = !s.installed || s.running;
  $('remove').hidden = !s.installed;
}

function showSteps(title, result) {
  $('result').hidden = false;
  if (result.error) {
    $('result-title').textContent = 'Something went wrong';
    $('steps').replaceChildren(item('bad', result.error));
    return;
  }
  const failed = result.steps.some((s) => !s.ok);
  $('result-title').textContent = failed ? `${title}, with problems` : title;
  $('steps').replaceChildren(...result.steps.map((s) => item(s.ok ? 'ok' : 'bad', s.text, s.detail)));
}

async function refresh() {
  const s = await window.setup.state();
  if (s.error) return showSteps('', s);
  render(s);
}

async function busy(button, label, fn) {
  const all = document.querySelectorAll('button');
  const old = button.textContent;
  all.forEach((b) => (b.disabled = true));
  button.textContent = label;
  try {
    await fn();
  } finally {
    button.textContent = old;
    all.forEach((b) => (b.disabled = false));
    await refresh();
  }
}

$('install').addEventListener('click', () =>
  busy($('install'), 'Installing…', async () => {
    const server = $('server').value.trim();
    const token = $('token').value.trim();
    if (!token && !current.tokenSet) {
      if (!confirm('No token entered. PlasmaTrack will record your jobs but not upload them until you add one. Continue?')) return;
    }
    const r = await window.setup.install({ serverUrl: server, token, autostart: $('autostart').checked });
    $('token').value = '';
    showSteps(current.installed ? 'Updated' : 'Installed', r);
  }),
);

$('uninstall').addEventListener('click', () =>
  busy($('uninstall'), 'Uninstalling…', async () => {
    const del = $('delete-data').checked;
    if (del && !confirm('Delete all local PlasmaTrack data, including anything not uploaded yet?')) return;
    showSteps('Uninstalled', await window.setup.uninstall({ deleteData: del }));
  }),
);

$('status').addEventListener('click', () => window.setup.openStatus(current.statusUrl));
$('start').addEventListener('click', () =>
  busy($('start'), 'Starting…', async () => {
    await window.setup.start();
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500));
  }),
);

refresh();

```

```txt
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(plasmatrack_plugin LANGUAGES CXX)

# The SCS SDK headers are C++ only (unconditional extern "C" blocks, inheritance).
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif()

set(SCS_SDK_INCLUDE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../third_party/scssdk-1.14/include")
# TruckersMP client SDK (MIT, header-only; only its C layer is used).
set(TMP_SDK_INCLUDE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../third_party/truckersmp-client-sdk-1.1.0/include")

# Everything except the SDK entry points, shared by the plugin and the tests.
add_library(pt_plugin_core STATIC
  src/journal.cpp
  src/platform_posix.cpp
  src/platform_win.cpp
  src/sender.cpp
  src/settings.cpp
  src/sha256.cpp
)
set_target_properties(pt_plugin_core PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_include_directories(pt_plugin_core PUBLIC src "${SCS_SDK_INCLUDE}")
if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang|GNU")
  target_compile_options(pt_plugin_core PUBLIC -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter)
endif()
if(WIN32)
  target_compile_definitions(pt_plugin_core PUBLIC WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN NOMINMAX _WIN32_WINNT=0x0601)
  # K32EnumProcessModules / K32GetModuleBaseNameW live in kernel32 (no psapi.dll).
  target_link_libraries(pt_plugin_core PUBLIC ws2_32 bcrypt)
else()
  find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
  target_link_libraries(pt_plugin_core PUBLIC Threads::Threads ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
endif()

# ---- the plugin -----------------------------------------------------------
add_library(plasmatrack_telemetry SHARED src/plugin.cpp src/tmp.cpp)
target_link_libraries(plasmatrack_telemetry PRIVATE pt_plugin_core)
target_include_directories(plasmatrack_telemetry PRIVATE "${TMP_SDK_INCLUDE}")
set_target_properties(plasmatrack_telemetry PROPERTIES PREFIX "" OUTPUT_NAME plasmatrack)
if(WIN32)
  target_sources(plasmatrack_telemetry PRIVATE plasmatrack.def)
  # Self-contained DLL: no libc++/libstdc++, libunwind/libgcc or winpthread DLLs
  # next to the game. Only system DLLs may remain (checked by the imports test).
  target_link_options(plasmatrack_telemetry PRIVATE -static)
  if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")
    target_link_options(plasmatrack_telemetry PRIVATE -static-libgcc -static-libstdc++)
  endif()
else()
  target_compile_options(plasmatrack_telemetry PRIVATE -fvisibility=hidden)
  target_link_options(plasmatrack_telemetry PRIVATE
    -static-libstdc++ -static-libgcc
    "-Wl,--version-script=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/plasmatrack.map")
endif()

# ---- tests ----------------------------------------------------------------
include(CTest)
if(BUILD_TESTING)
  add_executable(pt_unit_tests tests/unit_tests.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(pt_unit_tests PRIVATE pt_plugin_core)
  if(WIN32)
    target_link_options(pt_unit_tests PRIVATE -static)
  endif()
  add_test(NAME unit_tests COMMAND pt_unit_tests)

  add_executable(pt_fake_game tests/fake_game.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(pt_fake_game PRIVATE pt_plugin_core)
  target_include_directories(pt_fake_game PRIVATE "${TMP_SDK_INCLUDE}")
  if(WIN32)
    target_link_options(pt_fake_game PRIVATE -static)
  endif()
  add_test(NAME fake_game COMMAND pt_fake_game $<TARGET_FILE:plasmatrack_telemetry>)

  # Used by scripts/e2e-plugin-client.ps1 together with the real client binary.
  add_executable(pt_drive_plugin tests/drive_plugin.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(pt_drive_plugin PRIVATE pt_plugin_core)
  if(WIN32)
    target_link_options(pt_drive_plugin PRIVATE -static)
  endif()

  if(WIN32)
    if(NOT PT_OBJDUMP)
      find_program(PT_OBJDUMP NAMES llvm-objdump x86_64-w64-mingw32-objdump objdump)
    endif()
    if(PT_OBJDUMP)
      add_test(NAME dll_imports_exports
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -DOBJDUMP=${PT_OBJDUMP} -DDLL=$<TARGET_FILE:plasmatrack_telemetry>
                -P ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/check_dll.cmake)
    endif()
  endif()
endif()
```

`plugin/README.md`:

```md
# PlasmaTrack telemetry plugin

A native SCS Telemetry SDK 1.14 plugin (C++17). It forwards raw data only and makes no
scoring decisions.

- **Game thread** (`src/plugin.cpp`): SDK callbacks copy values and render JSON into a lock-free SPSC
  ring (`src/spsc_ring.hpp`). They never block. A full ring drops the message and counts it.
- **Sender thread** (`src/sender.cpp`): the only owner of the socket and the disk.
  - Connects out to the client on `127.0.0.1`.
  - Journals durable events until they are acknowledged (`src/journal.cpp`).
  - Replays on reconnect.
  - Reports the plugin's own SHA-256 and the loaded modules.
  - Never calls into the SDK.
- **Wire protocol:** `docs/WIRE.md`. **Build:** `docs/BUILD.md`. **Install:** `docs/INSTALL.md`.
  **Captures:** `docs/CAPTURE.md`.

```

`plugin/cmake/check_dll.cmake`:

```cmake
# Verifies the built DLL:
#  - exports scs_telemetry_init and scs_telemetry_shutdown (SCS SDK) and
#    truckersmp_init and truckersmp_shutdown (TruckersMP client SDK), undecorated
#  - imports only DLLs that ship with Windows (and Wine/Proton): no MinGW
#    runtime DLLs (libc++, libunwind, libstdc++, libgcc, libwinpthread).
execute_process(COMMAND "${OBJDUMP}" -p "${DLL}" OUTPUT_VARIABLE out RESULT_VARIABLE rc)
if(NOT rc EQUAL 0)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "objdump failed on ${DLL}")
endif()

string(REGEX MATCHALL "DLL Name: [^\r\n]+" imports "${out}")
set(allowed "^(kernel32|ws2_32|bcrypt|advapi32|ntdll|ucrtbase|msvcrt|api-ms-win-[a-z0-9-]+)\\.dll$")
foreach(line IN LISTS imports)
  string(REPLACE "DLL Name: " "" dll "${line}")
  string(STRIP "${dll}" dll)
  string(TOLOWER "${dll}" dll_l)
  message(STATUS "import: ${dll}")
  if(NOT dll_l MATCHES "${allowed}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Unexpected DLL dependency: ${dll}")
  endif()
endforeach()

foreach(sym scs_telemetry_init scs_telemetry_shutdown truckersmp_init truckersmp_shutdown)
  if(NOT out MATCHES "[ \t]${sym}[\r\n]")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing export: ${sym}")
  endif()
endforeach()
message(STATUS "DLL imports/exports OK")

```

```cmake
# Cross/native toolchain for llvm-mingw (UCRT), https://github.com/mstorsjo/llvm-mingw
# Usage: cmake -G Ninja -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=plugin/cmake/toolchain-llvm-mingw.cmake \
```

`plugin/src/journal.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "journal.hpp"

#include <charconv>
#include <cstdio>

#include "platform.hpp"

namespace pt {
namespace {

bool ends_with(const std::string& s, const std::string& suffix) {
    return s.size() >= suffix.size() && s.compare(s.size() - suffix.size(), suffix.size(), suffix) == 0;
}

std::uint64_t read_ack(const std::string& path) {
    std::uint64_t v = 0;
    if (std::FILE* f = open_file_utf8(path, "rb")) {
        char buf[32] = {};
        std::size_t n = std::fread(buf, 1, sizeof buf - 1, f);
        std::fclose(f);
        std::from_chars(buf, buf + n, v);
    }
    return v;
}

void write_ack(const std::string& path, std::uint64_t seq) {
    const std::string tmp = path + ".tmp";
    if (std::FILE* f = open_file_utf8(tmp, "wb")) {
        char buf[32];
        auto r = std::to_chars(buf, buf + sizeof buf, seq);
        std::fwrite(buf, 1, std::size_t(r.ptr - buf), f);
        std::fclose(f);
        replace_file(tmp, path);
    }
}

}  // namespace

std::uint64_t Journal::seq_of(const std::string& json) {
    static const std::string key = "\"seq\":";
    auto p = json.find(key);
    if (p == std::string::npos) return 0;
    std::uint64_t v = 0;
    const char* b = json.data() + p + key.size();
    std::from_chars(b, json.data() + json.size(), v);
    return v;
}

Journal::Journal(std::string dir, std::string current_sess, std::uint64_t max_bytes)
    : dir_(std::move(dir)), sess_(std::move(current_sess)), max_bytes_(max_bytes) {
    make_dirs(dir_);
    load_previous_sessions();
}

std::string Journal::file_for(const std::string& sess, const char* ext) const {
    return join_path(dir_, sess + ext);
}

void Journal::load_previous_sessions() {
    for (const std::string& name : list_dir(dir_)) {
        if (!ends_with(name, ".jsonl")) continue;
        const std::string sess = name.substr(0, name.size() - 6);
        if (sess == sess_) continue;
        const std::uint64_t acked = read_ack(file_for(sess, ".ack"));
        std::deque<JournalEntry> entries;
        if (std::FILE* f = open_file_utf8(file_for(sess, ".jsonl"), "rb")) {
            std::string line;
            int c;
            while ((c = std::fgetc(f)) != EOF) {
                if (c != '\n') { line += char(c); continue; }
                const std::uint64_t seq = seq_of(line);
                if (seq > acked) entries.push_back({seq, line});
                line.clear();
            }
            std::fclose(f);  // a trailing partial line (crash mid-write) is discarded
        }
        if (entries.empty()) {
            remove_file(file_for(sess, ".jsonl"));
            remove_file(file_for(sess, ".ack"));
        } else {
            pending_[sess] = std::move(entries);
        }
    }
}

bool Journal::append(std::uint64_t seq, const std::string& json) {
    pending_[sess_].push_back({seq, json});
    if (written_bytes_ + json.size() + 1 > max_bytes_) {
        ++dropped_;
        return false;
    }
    std::FILE* f = open_file_utf8(file_for(sess_, ".jsonl"), "ab");
    if (!f) { ++dropped_; return false; }
    const bool ok = std::fwrite(json.data(), 1, json.size(), f) == json.size() && std::fputc('\n', f) != EOF;
    std::fclose(f);
    written_bytes_ += json.size() + 1;
    if (!ok) ++dropped_;
    return ok;
}

void Journal::ack(const std::string& sess, std::uint64_t seq) {
    auto it = pending_.find(sess);
    if (it == pending_.end()) return;
    auto& q = it->second;
    while (!q.empty() && q.front().seq <= seq) q.pop_front();
    write_ack(file_for(sess, ".ack"), seq);
    if (sess == sess_) {
        compact_current();
    } else if (q.empty()) {
        remove_file(file_for(sess, ".jsonl"));
        remove_file(file_for(sess, ".ack"));
        pending_.erase(it);
    }
}

void Journal::compact_current() {
    // Once everything of the current session is acknowledged, restart its file
    // so it does not grow for the whole game session.
    auto it = pending_.find(sess_);
    if (it != pending_.end() && it->second.empty() && written_bytes_ > (1u << 20)) {
        if (std::FILE* f = open_file_utf8(file_for(sess_, ".jsonl"), "wb")) std::fclose(f);
        written_bytes_ = 0;
    }
}

}  // namespace pt

```

`plugin/src/journal.hpp`:

```hpp
// On-disk journal of durable messages (init, config, gameplay, paused/started,
// timer_restart, integrity, modules, shutdown) until the client acknowledges
// them. A client that was closed during a delivery still receives it when it
// next connects, even after the game has restarted.
//
// Layout in `dir`: `<sess>.jsonl` (one message per line, appended) and
// `<sess>.ack` (highest acknowledged seq, decimal). Only the sender thread
// touches the journal.
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
#include <deque>
#include <map>
#include <string>

namespace pt {

struct JournalEntry {
    std::uint64_t seq;
    std::string json;
};

class Journal {
public:
    Journal(std::string dir, std::string current_sess, std::uint64_t max_bytes);

    // Appends a durable message of the current session. Returns false (and the
    // message is still kept in memory for this run) if the disk write failed or
    // the size cap was reached.
    bool append(std::uint64_t seq, const std::string& json);

    // Everything <= seq of `sess` is acknowledged by the client.
    void ack(const std::string& sess, std::uint64_t seq);

    // Unacknowledged entries, per session, oldest session first is not
    // guaranteed; each deque is in seq order.
    const std::map<std::string, std::deque<JournalEntry>>& pending() const { return pending_; }

    std::uint64_t dropped() const { return dropped_; }

    // Parses the `"seq":N` field of one of our own messages; 0 if absent.
    static std::uint64_t seq_of(const std::string& json);

private:
    std::string file_for(const std::string& sess, const char* ext) const;
    void load_previous_sessions();
    void compact_current();

    std::string dir_;
    std::string sess_;
    std::uint64_t max_bytes_;
    std::uint64_t written_bytes_ = 0;
    std::uint64_t dropped_ = 0;
    std::map<std::string, std::deque<JournalEntry>> pending_;
};

}  // namespace pt
```

`plugin/src/json.hpp`:

```hpp
// Minimal streaming JSON writer.
//
// Numbers are formatted with std::to_chars, which is locale-independent and
// round-trips exactly (shortest representation). printf-style formatting is not
// used anywhere in the plugin because the game process may change the C locale.
#pragma once

#include <charconv>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace pt {

class JsonWriter {
public:
    JsonWriter() { out_.reserve(256); }

    JsonWriter& begin_object() { value_prefix(); out_ += '{'; first_.push_back(true); return *this; }
    JsonWriter& end_object() { out_ += '}'; first_.pop_back(); return *this; }
    JsonWriter& begin_array() { value_prefix(); out_ += '['; first_.push_back(true); return *this; }
    JsonWriter& end_array() { out_ += ']'; first_.pop_back(); return *this; }

    JsonWriter& key(std::string_view k) {
        comma();
        write_string(k);
        out_ += ':';
        after_key_ = true;
        return *this;
    }

    JsonWriter& str(std::string_view s) { value_prefix(); write_string(s); return *this; }
    JsonWriter& null() { value_prefix(); out_ += "null"; return *this; }
    JsonWriter& boolean(bool b) { value_prefix(); out_ += b ? "true" : "false"; return *this; }
    JsonWriter& u64(std::uint64_t v) { value_prefix(); append_int(v); return *this; }
    JsonWriter& i64(std::int64_t v) { value_prefix(); append_int(v); return *this; }

    // Non-finite values are not representable in JSON and are written as null.
    JsonWriter& f32(float v) { value_prefix(); append_float(v); return *this; }
    JsonWriter& f64(double v) { value_prefix(); append_float(v); return *this; }

    // Splices pre-rendered JSON (must itself be a valid JSON value).
    JsonWriter& raw(std::string_view json) { value_prefix(); out_ += json; return *this; }

    const std::string& str_ref() const { return out_; }
    std::string take() { return std::move(out_); }

private:
    void comma() {
        if (!first_.empty()) {
            if (!first_.back()) out_ += ',';
            first_.back() = false;
        }
    }

    void value_prefix() {
        if (after_key_) { after_key_ = false; return; }
        comma();
    }

    template <typename T>
    void append_int(T v) {
        char buf[32];
        auto r = std::to_chars(buf, buf + sizeof buf, v);
        out_.append(buf, r.ptr);
    }

    template <typename T>
    void append_float(T v) {
        if (!std::isfinite(v)) { out_ += "null"; return; }
        char buf[64];
        auto r = std::to_chars(buf, buf + sizeof buf, v);
        out_.append(buf, r.ptr);
    }

    void write_string(std::string_view s) {
        static const char hex[] = "0123456789abcdef";
        out_ += '"';
        for (unsigned char c : s) {
            switch (c) {
                case '"': out_ += "\\\""; break;
                case '\\': out_ += "\\\\"; break;
                case '\n': out_ += "\\n"; break;
                case '\r': out_ += "\\r"; break;
                case '\t': out_ += "\\t"; break;
                default:
                    if (c < 0x20) {
                        out_ += "\\u00";
                        out_ += hex[c >> 4];
                        out_ += hex[c & 0xf];
                    } else {
                        out_ += static_cast<char>(c);  // UTF-8 passes through unchanged
                    }
            }
        }
        out_ += '"';
    }

    std::string out_;
    std::vector<bool> first_;
    bool after_key_ = false;
};

}  // namespace pt

```

`plugin/src/message.hpp`:

```hpp
// Messages passed from the game thread to the sender thread, and the common
// wire envelope. Wire format: docs/WIRE.md.
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>

#include "json.hpp"
#include "platform.hpp"

namespace pt {

constexpr int kProtocolVersion = 1;
constexpr const char* kPluginVersion = "0.1.0";

enum class Kind : std::uint8_t {
    Init, Config, Gameplay, Paused, Started, TimerRestart, Sample, Heartbeat, Shutdown, Integrity, Modules, Scale, Truckersmp,
};

inline const char* kind_name(Kind k) {
    switch (k) {
        case Kind::Init: return "init";
        case Kind::Config: return "config";
        case Kind::Gameplay: return "gameplay";
        case Kind::Paused: return "paused";
        case Kind::Started: return "started";
        case Kind::TimerRestart: return "timer_restart";
        case Kind::Sample: return "sample";
        case Kind::Heartbeat: return "heartbeat";
        case Kind::Shutdown: return "shutdown";
        case Kind::Integrity: return "integrity";
        case Kind::Modules: return "modules";
        case Kind::Scale: return "scale";
        case Kind::Truckersmp: return "truckersmp";
    }
    return "unknown";
}

// Durable kinds are journaled to disk until the client acknowledges them.
inline bool is_durable(Kind k) { return k != Kind::Sample && k != Kind::Heartbeat; }

struct Msg {
    std::uint64_t seq = 0;
    Kind kind = Kind::Heartbeat;
    std::string config_id;  // Kind::Config only
    std::string json;
};

// Opens a message object with the common envelope fields. The caller adds its
// own fields and calls end_object().
inline void envelope(JsonWriter& w, Kind kind, const std::string& sess, std::uint64_t seq) {
    w.begin_object();
    w.key("v").i64(kProtocolVersion);
    w.key("kind").str(kind_name(kind));
    w.key("sess").str(sess);
    w.key("seq").u64(seq);
    w.key("wall_ms").i64(wall_ms());
}

// Length-prefixed frame: u32 little-endian byte length, then UTF-8 JSON.
inline void append_frame(std::string& out, const std::string& json) {
    const auto n = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(json.size());
    const char len[4] = {char(n & 0xff), char((n >> 8) & 0xff), char((n >> 16) & 0xff), char((n >> 24) & 0xff)};
    out.append(len, 4);
    out += json;
}

}  // namespace pt

```

```hpp
// OS abstraction for the plugin: files, module paths, randomness and sockets.
// Windows (native and under Proton/Wine) is primary; POSIX is the native-Linux
// secondary target.
#pragma once

#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace pt {

// ---- files -----------------------------------------------------------------
std::FILE* open_file_utf8(const std::string& path, const char* mode);
bool make_dirs(const std::string& path);
bool remove_file(const std::string& path);
bool replace_file(const std::string& from, const std::string& to);

std::string dir_of(const std::string& path);

// ---- process ---------------------------------------------------------------
// UTF-8 path of the plugin module itself (DLL or .so).
std::string own_module_path();
// Base file names of all modules loaded in this process (reported raw; the
// client decides what they mean, e.g. TruckersMP detection).
std::vector<std::string> loaded_module_names();
// Cryptographically random 64-bit value from the OS.
std::uint64_t os_random_u64();

// Monotonic milliseconds for timers (immune to wall-clock changes).
inline std::int64_t steady_ms() {
    using namespace std::chrono;
    return duration_cast<milliseconds>(steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
}

inline std::int64_t wall_ms() {
    using namespace std::chrono;
    return duration_cast<milliseconds>(system_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
}

// ---- sockets (IPv4 loopback only) ------------------------------------------
namespace net {

#ifdef _WIN32
using Socket = std::uintptr_t;
#else
using Socket = int;
#endif

Socket invalid_socket();
bool startup();   // WSAStartup on Windows; no-op elsewhere
void cleanup();

// Starts a non-blocking connect to 127.0.0.1:port. Returns invalid_socket() on
// immediate failure; `pending` is set when the connect is still in progress.
Socket connect_loopback(std::uint16_t port, bool& pending);

struct PollResult { bool readable = false; bool writable = false; bool error = false; };
PollResult poll(Socket s, bool want_write, int timeout_ms);

// True once a pending connect completed successfully.
bool connect_succeeded(Socket s);

// >= 0: bytes transferred. -1: would block. -2: connection error or closed.
long send_some(Socket s, const char* data, std::size_t len);
long recv_some(Socket s, char* data, std::size_t len);

void close(Socket s);

}  // namespace net
}  // namespace pt
```

```cpp
// POSIX implementation (native Linux build; secondary target).
#ifndef _WIN32

#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <netinet/in.h>
#include <netinet/tcp.h>
#include <sys/select.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include <cstring>
#include <set>

#include "platform.hpp"

namespace pt {

std::FILE* open_file_utf8(const std::string& path, const char* mode) { return std::fopen(path.c_str(), mode); }

bool make_dirs(const std::string& path) {
    if (path.empty()) return false;
    for (std::size_t i = 1; i <= path.size(); ++i) {
        if (i == path.size() || path[i] == '/') {
            std::string part = path.substr(0, i);
            if (::mkdir(part.c_str(), 0755) != 0 && errno != EEXIST) return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

bool remove_file(const std::string& path) { return ::unlink(path.c_str()) == 0; }
bool replace_file(const std::string& from, const std::string& to) { return ::rename(from.c_str(), to.c_str()) == 0; }

std::vector<std::string> list_dir(const std::string& dir) {
    std::vector<std::string> out;
    DIR* d = ::opendir(dir.c_str());
    if (!d) return out;
    while (dirent* e = ::readdir(d)) {
        std::string name = e->d_name;
        if (name == "." || name == "..") continue;
        struct stat st;
        if (::stat(join_path(dir, name).c_str(), &st) == 0 && S_ISREG(st.st_mode)) out.push_back(name);
    }
    ::closedir(d);
    return out;
}

std::string dir_of(const std::string& path) {
    auto p = path.find_last_of('/');
    return p == std::string::npos ? std::string(".") : path.substr(0, p);
}

std::string join_path(const std::string& dir, const std::string& name) { return dir + "/" + name; }

std::string own_module_path() {
    Dl_info info{};
    if (::dladdr(reinterpret_cast<void*>(&own_module_path), &info) == 0 || !info.dli_fname) return {};
    return info.dli_fname;
}

std::vector<std::string> loaded_module_names() {
    std::set<std::string> names;
    std::FILE* f = std::fopen("/proc/self/maps", "r");
    if (!f) return {};
    char line[4096];
    while (std::fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) {
        const char* slash = std::strchr(line, '/');
        if (!slash) continue;
        std::string path(slash);
        while (!path.empty() && (path.back() == '\n' || path.back() == ' ')) path.pop_back();
        auto p = path.find_last_of('/');
        names.insert(p == std::string::npos ? path : path.substr(p + 1));
    }
    std::fclose(f);
    return {names.begin(), names.end()};
}

std::uint64_t os_random_u64() {
    std::uint64_t v = 0;
    if (std::FILE* f = std::fopen("/dev/urandom", "rb")) {
        if (std::fread(&v, sizeof v, 1, f) != 1) v = 0;
        std::fclose(f);
    }
    return v;
}

namespace net {

Socket invalid_socket() { return -1; }
bool startup() { return true; }
void cleanup() {}

Socket connect_loopback(std::uint16_t port, bool& pending) {
    pending = false;
    int s = ::socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, IPPROTO_TCP);
    if (s < 0) return -1;
    ::fcntl(s, F_SETFL, ::fcntl(s, F_GETFL, 0) | O_NONBLOCK);
    ::fcntl(s, F_SETFD, FD_CLOEXEC);
    int one = 1;
    ::setsockopt(s, IPPROTO_TCP, TCP_NODELAY, &one, sizeof one);
#ifdef SO_NOSIGPIPE
    ::setsockopt(s, SOL_SOCKET, SO_NOSIGPIPE, &one, sizeof one);
#endif
    sockaddr_in addr{};
    addr.sin_family = AF_INET;
    addr.sin_port = htons(port);
    addr.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
    if (::connect(s, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&addr), sizeof addr) == 0) return s;
    if (errno == EINPROGRESS) { pending = true; return s; }
    ::close(s);
    return -1;
}

PollResult poll(Socket s, bool want_write, int timeout_ms) {
    PollResult r;
    fd_set rs, ws;
    FD_ZERO(&rs); FD_ZERO(&ws);
    FD_SET(s, &rs);
    if (want_write) FD_SET(s, &ws);
    timeval tv{timeout_ms / 1000, (timeout_ms % 1000) * 1000};
    int n = ::select(s + 1, &rs, want_write ? &ws : nullptr, nullptr, &tv);
    if (n < 0) { r.error = errno != EINTR; return r; }
    r.readable = FD_ISSET(s, &rs);
    r.writable = want_write && FD_ISSET(s, &ws);
    return r;
}

bool connect_succeeded(Socket s) {
    int err = 0;
    socklen_t len = sizeof err;
    return ::getsockopt(s, SOL_SOCKET, SO_ERROR, &err, &len) == 0 && err == 0;
}

long send_some(Socket s, const char* data, std::size_t len) {
#ifdef MSG_NOSIGNAL
    ssize_t n = ::send(s, data, len, MSG_NOSIGNAL);
#else
    ssize_t n = ::send(s, data, len, 0);
#endif
    if (n >= 0) return long(n);
    return (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK) ? -1 : -2;
}

long recv_some(Socket s, char* data, std::size_t len) {
    ssize_t n = ::recv(s, data, len, 0);
    if (n > 0) return long(n);
    if (n == 0) return -2;
    return (errno == EAGAIN || errno == EWOULDBLOCK) ? -1 : -2;
}

void close(Socket s) {
    if (s >= 0) ::close(s);
}

}  // namespace net
}  // namespace pt

#endif  // !_WIN32
```

`plugin/src/platform_win.cpp`:

```cpp
// Windows implementation (also what runs under Proton/Wine).
#ifdef _WIN32

#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <ws2tcpip.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include <bcrypt.h>
#include <psapi.h>

#include "platform.hpp"

namespace pt {
namespace {

std::wstring widen(const std::string& s) {
    if (s.empty()) return {};
    int n = MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, s.data(), int(s.size()), nullptr, 0);
    std::wstring w(std::size_t(n), L'\0');
    MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8, 0, s.data(), int(s.size()), w.data(), n);
    return w;
}

std::string narrow(const wchar_t* w, std::size_t len) {
    if (len == 0) return {};
    int n = WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, w, int(len), nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr);
    std::string s(std::size_t(n), '\0');
    WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, w, int(len), s.data(), n, nullptr, nullptr);
    return s;
}

}  // namespace

std::FILE* open_file_utf8(const std::string& path, const char* mode) {
    return _wfopen(widen(path).c_str(), widen(mode).c_str());
}

bool make_dirs(const std::string& path) {
    if (path.empty()) return false;
    std::wstring w = widen(path);
    for (std::size_t i = 1; i <= w.size(); ++i) {
        if (i == w.size() || w[i] == L'\\' || w[i] == L'/') {
            std::wstring part = w.substr(0, i);
            if (part.size() == 2 && part[1] == L':') continue;  // drive letter
            if (!CreateDirectoryW(part.c_str(), nullptr) && GetLastError() != ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS) return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

bool remove_file(const std::string& path) { return DeleteFileW(widen(path).c_str()) != 0; }

bool replace_file(const std::string& from, const std::string& to) {
    return MoveFileExW(widen(from).c_str(), widen(to).c_str(), MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING) != 0;
}

std::vector<std::string> list_dir(const std::string& dir) {
    std::vector<std::string> out;
    WIN32_FIND_DATAW fd;
    HANDLE h = FindFirstFileW(widen(join_path(dir, "*")).c_str(), &fd);
    if (h == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return out;
    do {
        if (!(fd.dwFileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY)) out.push_back(narrow(fd.cFileName, wcslen(fd.cFileName)));
    } while (FindNextFileW(h, &fd));
    FindClose(h);
    return out;
}

std::string dir_of(const std::string& path) {
    auto p = path.find_last_of("\\/");
    return p == std::string::npos ? std::string(".") : path.substr(0, p);
}

std::string join_path(const std::string& dir, const std::string& name) { return dir + "\\" + name; }

std::string own_module_path() {
    HMODULE self = nullptr;
    if (!GetModuleHandleExW(GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_FROM_ADDRESS | GET_MODULE_HANDLE_EX_FLAG_UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT,
                            reinterpret_cast<LPCWSTR>(&own_module_path), &self)) {
        return {};
    }
    std::wstring buf(1024, L'\0');
    for (;;) {
        DWORD n = GetModuleFileNameW(self, buf.data(), DWORD(buf.size()));
        if (n == 0) return {};
        if (n < buf.size()) return narrow(buf.data(), n);
        buf.resize(buf.size() * 2);
    }
}

std::vector<std::string> loaded_module_names() {
    std::vector<std::string> out;
    HANDLE proc = GetCurrentProcess();
    std::vector<HMODULE> mods(512);
    DWORD needed = 0;
    for (;;) {
        if (!K32EnumProcessModules(proc, mods.data(), DWORD(mods.size() * sizeof(HMODULE)), &needed)) return out;
        if (needed <= mods.size() * sizeof(HMODULE)) break;
        mods.resize(needed / sizeof(HMODULE) + 16);
    }
    const std::size_t count = needed / sizeof(HMODULE);
    wchar_t name[MAX_PATH];
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        DWORD n = K32GetModuleBaseNameW(proc, mods[i], name, MAX_PATH);
        if (n > 0) out.push_back(narrow(name, n));
    }
    return out;
}

std::uint64_t os_random_u64() {
    std::uint64_t v = 0;
    BCryptGenRandom(nullptr, reinterpret_cast<PUCHAR>(&v), sizeof v, BCRYPT_USE_SYSTEM_PREFERRED_RNG);
    return v;
}

namespace net {

Socket invalid_socket() { return INVALID_SOCKET; }

bool startup() {
    WSADATA wsa;
    return WSAStartup(MAKEWORD(2, 2), &wsa) == 0;
}

void cleanup() { WSACleanup(); }

Socket connect_loopback(std::uint16_t port, bool& pending) {
    pending = false;
    SOCKET s = ::socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, IPPROTO_TCP);
    if (s == INVALID_SOCKET) return INVALID_SOCKET;
    u_long nb = 1;
    ioctlsocket(s, FIONBIO, &nb);
    int one = 1;
    setsockopt(s, IPPROTO_TCP, TCP_NODELAY, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&one), sizeof one);
    sockaddr_in addr{};
    addr.sin_family = AF_INET;
    addr.sin_port = htons(port);
    addr.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);  // literal 127.0.0.1, never "localhost"
    if (::connect(s, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&addr), sizeof addr) == 0) return s;
    if (WSAGetLastError() == WSAEWOULDBLOCK) { pending = true; return s; }
    closesocket(s);
    return INVALID_SOCKET;
}

PollResult poll(Socket s, bool want_write, int timeout_ms) {
    PollResult r;
    fd_set rs, ws, es;
    FD_ZERO(&rs); FD_ZERO(&ws); FD_ZERO(&es);
    FD_SET(SOCKET(s), &rs);
    if (want_write) FD_SET(SOCKET(s), &ws);
    FD_SET(SOCKET(s), &es);
    timeval tv{timeout_ms / 1000, (timeout_ms % 1000) * 1000};
    int n = ::select(0, &rs, want_write ? &ws : nullptr, &es, &tv);
    if (n == SOCKET_ERROR) { r.error = true; return r; }
    r.readable = FD_ISSET(SOCKET(s), &rs) != 0;
    r.writable = want_write && FD_ISSET(SOCKET(s), &ws) != 0;
    r.error = FD_ISSET(SOCKET(s), &es) != 0;  // on Windows a failed connect is reported here
    return r;
}

bool connect_succeeded(Socket s) {
    int err = 0;
    int len = sizeof err;
    if (getsockopt(SOCKET(s), SOL_SOCKET, SO_ERROR, reinterpret_cast<char*>(&err), &len) != 0) return false;
    return err == 0;
}

long send_some(Socket s, const char* data, std::size_t len) {
    int n = ::send(SOCKET(s), data, int(len > 1 << 20 ? 1 << 20 : len), 0);
    if (n >= 0) return n;
    return WSAGetLastError() == WSAEWOULDBLOCK ? -1 : -2;
}

long recv_some(Socket s, char* data, std::size_t len) {
    int n = ::recv(SOCKET(s), data, int(len), 0);
    if (n > 0) return n;
    if (n == 0) return -2;  // orderly close
    return WSAGetLastError() == WSAEWOULDBLOCK ? -1 : -2;
}

void close(Socket s) {
    if (s != INVALID_SOCKET) closesocket(SOCKET(s));
}

}  // namespace net
}  // namespace pt

#endif  // _WIN32
```

`plugin/src/plugin.cpp`:

```cpp
// PlasmaTrack telemetry plugin: SDK entry points and game-thread callbacks.
//
// The plugin forwards raw data only and makes no scoring decisions. Every SDK
// callback runs on the game's main thread (SDK readme.txt, "Calling conventions
// and threading"); callbacks only copy values, render JSON and push it into a
// lock-free ring. They never block and never touch the socket or the disk.
//
// SDK references (third_party/scssdk-1.14/include):
//   entry points ............ scssdk_telemetry.h:93,101
//   events .................. scssdk_telemetry_event.h:23-97
//   job/truck configs ....... common/scssdk_telemetry_common_configs.h
//   gameplay events ......... common/scssdk_telemetry_common_gameplay_events.h
//   channels ................ common/scssdk_telemetry_{common,truck_common,job_common}_channels.h

#include <algorithm>
#include <exception>
#include <memory>
#include <string>

#include "scssdk_telemetry.h"
#include "amtrucks/scssdk_ats.h"
#include "amtrucks/scssdk_telemetry_ats.h"
#include "common/scssdk_telemetry_common_channels.h"
#include "common/scssdk_telemetry_common_configs.h"
#include "common/scssdk_telemetry_common_gameplay_events.h"  // not included by the ATS header
#include "common/scssdk_telemetry_job_common_channels.h"
#include "common/scssdk_telemetry_trailer_common_channels.h"
#include "common/scssdk_telemetry_truck_common_channels.h"
#include "eurotrucks2/scssdk_eut2.h"
#include "eurotrucks2/scssdk_telemetry_eut2.h"

#include "message.hpp"
#include "platform.hpp"
#include "sender.hpp"
#include "settings.hpp"
#include "spsc_ring.hpp"
#include "tmp.hpp"
#include "value_json.hpp"

namespace pt {
namespace {

// "trailer." -> "trailer.0." for the first trailer (trailer_common_channels.h:18-24).
constexpr const char* kTrailer0Connected = "trailer.0.connected";

struct Channel {
    const char* name;
    scs_value_type_t type;
    bool registered = false;
    bool available = false;  // last callback carried a value
    bool updated = false;    // a callback arrived during the current frame
    scs_value_t value{};
};

// Channels registered with each_frame | no_value so every physics frame reports
// either a value or "unavailable", which lets the client tell live data from
// held-over values. Types are the ones each header documents.
Channel make_channels_table(const char* name, scs_value_type_t type) { return Channel{name, type}; }

class Plugin {
public:
    scs_log_t log_fn = nullptr;
    std::string game_id;
    std::string game_name;
    scs_u32_t game_version = 0;
    std::string sess;
    Settings settings;

    SpscRing<Msg> ring{1u << 14};
    SpscRing<std::string> logs{256};
    SharedCounters counters;
    std::unique_ptr<Sender> sender;

    Channel channels[14] = {
        make_channels_table(SCS_TELEMETRY_TRUCK_CHANNEL_speed, SCS_VALUE_TYPE_float),
        make_channels_table(SCS_TELEMETRY_TRUCK_CHANNEL_odometer, SCS_VALUE_TYPE_float),
        make_channels_table(SCS_TELEMETRY_TRUCK_CHANNEL_fuel, SCS_VALUE_TYPE_float),
        make_channels_table(SCS_TELEMETRY_TRUCK_CHANNEL_world_placement, SCS_VALUE_TYPE_dplacement),
        make_channels_table(SCS_TELEMETRY_TRUCK_CHANNEL_local_linear_velocity, SCS_VALUE_TYPE_fvector),
        make_channels_table(SCS_TELEMETRY_CHANNEL_game_time, SCS_VALUE_TYPE_u32),
        make_channels_table(SCS_TELEMETRY_CHANNEL_local_scale, SCS_VALUE_TYPE_float),
        make_channels_table(SCS_TELEMETRY_CHANNEL_multiplayer_time_offset, SCS_VALUE_TYPE_s32),
        make_channels_table(SCS_TELEMETRY_JOB_CHANNEL_cargo_damage, SCS_VALUE_TYPE_float),
        make_channels_table(SCS_TELEMETRY_TRUCK_CHANNEL_navigation_distance, SCS_VALUE_TYPE_float),
        make_channels_table(SCS_TELEMETRY_TRUCK_CHANNEL_navigation_time, SCS_VALUE_TYPE_float),
        make_channels_table(SCS_TELEMETRY_TRUCK_CHANNEL_engine_enabled, SCS_VALUE_TYPE_bool),
        make_channels_table(SCS_TELEMETRY_TRUCK_CHANNEL_parking_brake, SCS_VALUE_TYPE_bool),
        // First trailer (the one hitched to the truck): trailer_common_channels.h:16-36.
        // Distance driven without it (bobtailing) is not scored (PLAN §6).
        make_channels_table(kTrailer0Connected, SCS_VALUE_TYPE_bool),
    };

    scs_telemetry_frame_start_t frame{};
    std::uint64_t frame_index = 0;
    bool paused = true;  // telemetry is paused when init is called (scssdk_telemetry.h:87)
    bool force_sample = true;
    bool have_sample = false;
    scs_timestamp_t last_sample_sim_us = 0;
    double next_sample_due_us = 0.0;  // paused-simulation time of the next scheduled sample
    std::int64_t last_emit_ms = 0;

    // Map scale tracking (PLAN §6): every change of local.scale is reported as a
    // durable "scale" message, checked each frame, so the server can split a job
    // into constant-scale runs and the route map can colour them.
    // Last TruckersMP SDK state reported (tmp.hpp); UINT32_MAX = none yet.
    std::uint32_t tmp_version = UINT32_MAX;

    Channel* local_scale = nullptr;
    bool scale_reported = false;
    bool scale_was_available = false;
    float scale_value = 0.0f;

    Channel* find_channel(const char* name) {
        for (Channel& c : channels)
            if (std::string(c.name) == name) return &c;
        return nullptr;
    }

    void track_truckersmp() {
        const tmp::State& s = tmp::state();
        const std::uint32_t v = s.version.load();
        if (v == tmp_version) return;
        tmp_version = v;
        emit(Kind::Truckersmp, [&s](JsonWriter& w) {
            w.key("loaded").boolean(s.loaded.load());
            w.key("connected").boolean(s.connected.load());
            w.key("server_id").u64(s.server_id.load());
            w.key("account_id").u64(s.account_id.load());
        });
    }

    void track_scale() {
        if (!local_scale || !local_scale->registered || !local_scale->updated) return;
        const bool avail = local_scale->available;
        const float v = avail ? local_scale->value.value_float.value : 0.0f;
        if (scale_reported && avail == scale_was_available && (!avail || v == scale_value)) return;
        const bool had = scale_reported && scale_was_available;
        const float prev = scale_value;
        emit(Kind::Scale, [&](JsonWriter& w) {
            w.key("local_scale");
            if (avail) w.f64(v); else w.null();
            w.key("previous");
            if (had) w.f64(prev); else w.null();
            // Where the change happened, for splitting distance and drawing the map.
            for (const char* n : {SCS_TELEMETRY_TRUCK_CHANNEL_odometer, SCS_TELEMETRY_TRUCK_CHANNEL_world_placement}) {
                const Channel* c = find_channel(n);
                w.key(n);
                if (c && c->available) write_value(w, c->value); else w.null();
            }
        });
        scale_reported = true;
        scale_was_available = avail;
        scale_value = v;
        force_sample = true;
    }

    // Allocates a seq, lets `fill` add fields to the envelope, and pushes the
    // message. A full ring drops the message (counted); the game never waits.
    template <typename F>
    void emit(Kind kind, F&& fill, const char* config_id = nullptr) {
        Msg m;
        m.kind = kind;
        m.seq = counters.next_seq.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        if (config_id) m.config_id = config_id;
        JsonWriter w;
        envelope(w, kind, sess, m.seq);
        w.key("frame").u64(frame_index);
        w.key("sim_us").u64(frame.paused_simulation_time);
        fill(w);
        w.end_object();
        m.json = w.take();
        if (!ring.try_push(std::move(m))) counters.ring_dropped.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
        last_emit_ms = steady_ms();
    }

    void flush_logs() {
        std::string line;
        while (logs.try_pop(line)) log_fn(SCS_LOG_TYPE_message, line.c_str());
    }

    void emit_sample() {
        emit(Kind::Sample, [this](JsonWriter& w) {
            w.key("simulation_us").u64(frame.simulation_time);
            w.key("render_us").u64(frame.render_time);
            w.key("ch").begin_object();
            for (const Channel& c : channels) {
                if (!c.registered) continue;
                w.key(c.name);
                if (c.available) write_value(w, c.value); else w.null();
            }
            w.end_object();
            // Available but not refreshed this frame: a held-over value.
            w.key("stale").begin_array();
            for (const Channel& c : channels) {
                if (c.registered && c.available && !c.updated) w.str(c.name);
            }
            w.end_array();
        });
        have_sample = true;
        force_sample = false;
        last_sample_sim_us = frame.paused_simulation_time;
    }
};

Plugin* g_plugin = nullptr;

// ---- callbacks (game main thread) --------------------------------------------

SCSAPI_VOID on_frame_start(const scs_event_t, const void* const info, const scs_context_t) {
    Plugin* p = g_plugin;
    if (!p || !info) return;
    try {
        p->frame = *static_cast<const scs_telemetry_frame_start_t*>(info);
        ++p->frame_index;
        for (Channel& c : p->channels) c.updated = false;
        if (p->frame.flags & SCS_TELEMETRY_FRAME_START_FLAG_timer_restart) {
            p->emit(Kind::TimerRestart, [p](JsonWriter& w) {
                w.key("simulation_us").u64(p->frame.simulation_time);
                w.key("render_us").u64(p->frame.render_time);
            });
            p->force_sample = true;
        }
        p->flush_logs();
    } catch (...) {
    }
}

SCSAPI_VOID on_frame_end(const scs_event_t, const void* const, const scs_context_t) {
    Plugin* p = g_plugin;
    if (!p) return;
    try {
        p->track_scale();
        p->track_truckersmp();
        if (!p->paused) {
            const double rate = p->settings.capture ? 0.0 : p->settings.sample_rate_hz;
            const scs_timestamp_t now = p->frame.paused_simulation_time;
            // Fixed schedule with a small tolerance. The game's physics step is
            // 16666 us (observed in ATS 1.61), so three steps (49998 us) fall just
            // short of a 50 ms interval; comparing against the last sample time
            // would only fire every 4th step (15 Hz instead of 20 Hz).
            const double interval = rate > 0.0 ? 1e6 / rate : 0.0;
            const double tolerance = interval > 0.0 ? std::min(2000.0, interval / 4.0) : 0.0;
            const bool restarted = now < p->last_sample_sim_us;
            const bool scheduled = rate <= 0.0 || !p->have_sample || restarted ||
                                   double(now) + tolerance >= p->next_sample_due_us;
            if (p->force_sample || scheduled) {
                const bool had_sample = p->have_sample;
                p->emit_sample();
                if (scheduled) {
                    const bool on_time = had_sample && !restarted && double(now) < p->next_sample_due_us + interval;
                    p->next_sample_due_us = on_time ? p->next_sample_due_us + interval : double(now) + interval;
                }
            }
        }
        if (steady_ms() - p->last_emit_ms >= 1000) {
            p->emit(Kind::Heartbeat, [p](JsonWriter& w) {
                w.key("paused").boolean(p->paused);
                w.key("local_scale");
                if (p->scale_reported && p->scale_was_available) w.f64(p->scale_value); else w.null();
                w.key("ring_dropped").u64(p->counters.ring_dropped.load(std::memory_order_relaxed));
            });
        }
    } catch (...) {
    }
}

SCSAPI_VOID on_pause_change(const scs_event_t event, const void* const, const scs_context_t) {
    Plugin* p = g_plugin;
    if (!p) return;
    try {
        p->paused = event == SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_paused;
        p->emit(p->paused ? Kind::Paused : Kind::Started, [](JsonWriter&) {});
        p->force_sample = true;
    } catch (...) {
    }
}

SCSAPI_VOID on_configuration(const scs_event_t, const void* const info, const scs_context_t) {
    Plugin* p = g_plugin;
    if (!p || !info) return;
    try {
        const auto* cfg = static_cast<const scs_telemetry_configuration_t*>(info);
        p->emit(Kind::Config, [cfg](JsonWriter& w) {
            w.key("id").str(cfg->id);
            w.key("attrs");
            write_attributes(w, cfg->attributes);
        }, cfg->id);
        p->force_sample = true;
    } catch (...) {
    }
}

SCSAPI_VOID on_gameplay(const scs_event_t, const void* const info, const scs_context_t) {
    Plugin* p = g_plugin;
    if (!p || !info) return;
    try {
        const auto* ev = static_cast<const scs_telemetry_gameplay_event_t*>(info);
        // Forwarded verbatim, including ids the SDK 1.14 headers do not document.
        p->emit(Kind::Gameplay, [ev](JsonWriter& w) {
            w.key("id").str(ev->id);
            w.key("attrs");
            write_attributes(w, ev->attributes);
        });
        p->force_sample = true;
    } catch (...) {
    }
}

SCSAPI_VOID on_channel(const scs_string_t, const scs_u32_t, const scs_value_t* const value, const scs_context_t ctx) {
    auto* c = static_cast<Channel*>(ctx);
    c->updated = true;
    c->available = value != nullptr;
    if (value) c->value = *value;  // registered types never carry pointers
}

std::string random_session_id() {
    static const char hex[] = "0123456789abcdef";
    std::string s;
    for (std::uint64_t v : {os_random_u64(), os_random_u64()}) {
        for (int shift = 60; shift >= 0; shift -= 4) s += hex[(v >> shift) & 0xf];
    }
    return s;
}

}  // namespace
}  // namespace pt

using namespace pt;

SCSAPI_RESULT scs_telemetry_init(const scs_u32_t version, const scs_telemetry_init_params_t* const params) {
    // API 1.01 is required: it added gameplay events and s64 values (scssdk_telemetry.h:23).
    if (version != SCS_TELEMETRY_VERSION_1_01) return SCS_RESULT_unsupported;
    if (g_plugin) return SCS_RESULT_generic_error;
    const auto* init = static_cast<const scs_telemetry_init_params_v101_t*>(params);

    try {
        auto plugin = std::make_unique<Plugin>();
        Plugin* p = plugin.get();
        p->log_fn = init->common.log;
        p->game_id = init->common.game_id;
        p->game_name = init->common.game_name;
        p->game_version = init->common.game_version;

        if (p->game_id != SCS_GAME_ID_EUT2 && p->game_id != SCS_GAME_ID_ATS) {
            p->log_fn(SCS_LOG_TYPE_warning, ("[plasmatrack] unsupported game id: " + p->game_id).c_str());
            return SCS_RESULT_unsupported;
        }

        const std::string module_path = own_module_path();
        const std::string plugin_dir = dir_of(module_path);
        p->settings = load_settings(join_path(plugin_dir, "plasmatrack.ini"));
        p->sess = random_session_id();

        // Events. gameplay needs game telemetry ETS2 >= 1.14 / ATS >= 1.01; a
        // failure is reported in the init message rather than being fatal.
        struct { scs_event_t ev; scs_telemetry_event_callback_t cb; const char* name; } events[] = {
            {SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_frame_start, on_frame_start, "frame_start"},
            {SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_frame_end, on_frame_end, "frame_end"},
            {SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_paused, on_pause_change, "paused"},
            {SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_started, on_pause_change, "started"},
            {SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_configuration, on_configuration, "configuration"},
            {SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_gameplay, on_gameplay, "gameplay"},
        };
        std::string events_failed;
        for (const auto& e : events) {
            if (init->register_for_event(e.ev, e.cb, nullptr) != SCS_RESULT_ok) {
                if (e.ev == SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_frame_start || e.ev == SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_frame_end ||
                    e.ev == SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_configuration) {
                    p->log_fn(SCS_LOG_TYPE_error, "[plasmatrack] required event registration failed");
                    return SCS_RESULT_generic_error;
                }
                events_failed += events_failed.empty() ? "" : ",";
                events_failed += e.name;
            }
        }
        for (Channel& c : p->channels) {
            c.registered = init->register_for_channel(c.name, SCS_U32_NIL, c.type,
                                                      SCS_TELEMETRY_CHANNEL_FLAG_each_frame |
                                                          SCS_TELEMETRY_CHANNEL_FLAG_no_value,
                                                      on_channel, &c) == SCS_RESULT_ok;
        }
        p->local_scale = p->find_channel(SCS_TELEMETRY_CHANNEL_local_scale);

        p->emit(Kind::Init, [&](JsonWriter& w) {
            w.key("api_version").str("1.01");
            w.key("game_id").str(p->game_id);
            w.key("game_name").str(p->game_name);
            w.key("game_version").begin_object();
            w.key("major").u64(p->game_version >> 16);
            w.key("minor").u64(p->game_version & 0xffff);
            w.end_object();
            w.key("plugin_version").str(kPluginVersion);
            w.key("platform").str(
#ifdef _WIN32
                "win_x64"
#else
                "linux_x64"
#endif
            );
            w.key("sample_rate_hz").f64(p->settings.capture ? 0.0 : p->settings.sample_rate_hz);
            w.key("capture").boolean(p->settings.capture);
            w.key("channels").begin_object();
            for (const Channel& c : p->channels) w.key(c.name).boolean(c.registered);
            w.end_object();
            w.key("events_failed").str(events_failed);
        });

        SenderConfig sc;
        sc.settings = p->settings;
        sc.sess = p->sess;
        sc.plugin_path = module_path;
        sc.data_dir = join_path(plugin_dir, "plasmatrack");
        p->sender = std::make_unique<Sender>(std::move(sc), p->ring, p->logs, p->counters);
        p->sender->start();

        p->log_fn(SCS_LOG_TYPE_message, ("[plasmatrack] telemetry initialized, session " + p->sess +
                                         ", client port " + std::to_string(p->settings.port)).c_str());
        g_plugin = plugin.release();
        return SCS_RESULT_ok;
    } catch (...) {
        return SCS_RESULT_generic_error;
    }
}

SCSAPI_VOID scs_telemetry_shutdown(void) {
    Plugin* p = g_plugin;
    if (!p) return;
    try {
        p->emit(Kind::Shutdown, [](JsonWriter&) {});
        // Joins without a timeout: the DLL may be unloaded right after we return.
        p->sender->stop_and_join();
        p->flush_logs();
    } catch (...) {
    }
    g_plugin = nullptr;
    delete p;
}
```

`plugin/src/sender.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "sender.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <vector>

#include "sha256.hpp"

namespace pt {
namespace {

constexpr std::size_t kOutbufLimit = 32u << 20;   // drop a client that cannot keep up
constexpr std::uint32_t kMaxInboundFrame = 1u << 20;
constexpr std::int64_t kConnectTimeoutMs = 2000;
constexpr std::int64_t kMaxBackoffMs = 5000;
constexpr std::int64_t kModuleScanMs = 10000;

// Extracts a string field ("key":"value") from one of the client's messages.
std::string json_str_field(const std::string& json, const std::string& key) {
    const std::string k = "\"" + key + "\":\"";
    auto p = json.find(k);
    if (p == std::string::npos) return {};
    p += k.size();
    auto e = json.find('"', p);
    return e == std::string::npos ? std::string{} : json.substr(p, e - p);
}

}  // namespace

Sender::Sender(SenderConfig cfg, SpscRing<Msg>& in, SpscRing<std::string>& log_out, SharedCounters& counters)
    : cfg_(std::move(cfg)), in_(in), log_out_(log_out), counters_(counters), sock_(net::invalid_socket()) {}

Sender::~Sender() { stop_and_join(); }

void Sender::start() { thread_ = std::thread([this] { run(); }); }

void Sender::stop_and_join() {
    stop_.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    if (thread_.joinable()) thread_.join();
}

void Sender::log(const std::string& line) {
    std::string copy = "[plasmatrack] " + line;
    if (!log_out_.try_push(std::move(copy))) counters_.log_dropped.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
}

void Sender::run() {
    net::startup();
    journal_ = std::make_unique<Journal>(join_path(cfg_.data_dir, "journal"), cfg_.sess,
                                         std::uint64_t(cfg_.settings.journal_max_mib) << 20);
    if (cfg_.settings.capture) {
        const std::string dir = join_path(cfg_.data_dir, "captures");
        make_dirs(dir);
        capture_ = open_file_utf8(join_path(dir, cfg_.sess + ".jsonl"), "ab");
        log(capture_ ? "capture mode: writing " + join_path(dir, cfg_.sess + ".jsonl") : "capture mode: cannot open file");
    }

    emit_own(Kind::Integrity, [this](JsonWriter& w) {
        w.key("plugin_path").str(cfg_.plugin_path);
        w.key("plugin_sha256").str(sha256_file(cfg_.plugin_path));
    });
    scan_modules(true);

    Msg m;
    for (;;) {
        bool drained_any = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4096 && in_.try_pop(m); ++i) {
            handle(std::move(m));
            drained_any = true;
        }
        if (stop_.load(std::memory_order_acquire) && !drained_any) break;

        if (steady_ms() >= next_module_scan_ms_) scan_modules(false);
        manage_connection();
    }

    // Best effort: give a connected client a moment to receive the tail
    // (it is journaled anyway, so nothing durable is lost if this fails).
    if (conn_ == Conn::Connected) {
        const std::int64_t until = steady_ms() + 200;
        while (out_off_ < outbuf_.size() && steady_ms() < until) {
            auto r = net::poll(sock_, true, 20);
            if (r.error) break;
            if (r.writable) {
                long n = net::send_some(sock_, outbuf_.data() + out_off_, outbuf_.size() - out_off_);
                if (n < -1) break;
                if (n > 0) out_off_ += std::size_t(n);
            }
        }
    }
    net::close(sock_);
    sock_ = net::invalid_socket();
    if (capture_) std::fclose(capture_);
    capture_ = nullptr;
    journal_.reset();
    net::cleanup();
}

void Sender::emit_own(Kind kind, const std::function<void(JsonWriter&)>& fields) {
    Msg m;
    m.kind = kind;
    m.seq = counters_.next_seq.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    JsonWriter w;
    envelope(w, kind, cfg_.sess, m.seq);
    fields(w);
    w.end_object();
    m.json = w.take();
    handle(std::move(m));
}

void Sender::scan_modules(bool force) {
    next_module_scan_ms_ = steady_ms() + kModuleScanMs;
    auto names = loaded_module_names();
    std::sort(names.begin(), names.end());
    JsonWriter list;
    list.begin_array();
    for (const auto& n : names) list.str(n);
    list.end_array();
    std::string rendered = list.take();
    if (!force && rendered == last_modules_) return;
    last_modules_ = rendered;
    emit_own(Kind::Modules, [this](JsonWriter& w) { w.key("modules").raw(last_modules_); });
}

void Sender::handle(Msg&& m) {
    if (capture_) {
        std::fwrite(m.json.data(), 1, m.json.size(), capture_);
        std::fputc('\n', capture_);
    }
    switch (m.kind) {
        case Kind::Config: latest_config_[m.config_id] = m.json; break;
        case Kind::Paused: paused_ = true; break;
        case Kind::Started: paused_ = false; break;
        case Kind::Sample: {
            last_sample_ = m.json;
            const std::int64_t now = steady_ms();
            replay_.push_back({m.seq, now, m.json});
            const auto keep_ms = std::int64_t(cfg_.settings.replay_buffer_s * 1000.0);
            while (!replay_.empty() && now - replay_.front().wall > keep_ms) replay_.pop_front();
            break;
        }
        default: break;
    }
    if (is_durable(m.kind)) journal_->append(m.seq, m.json);
    if (conn_ == Conn::Connected) enqueue(m.json);
}

void Sender::enqueue(const std::string& json) {
    if (conn_ != Conn::Connected) return;
    append_frame(outbuf_, json);
    if (outbuf_.size() - out_off_ > kOutbufLimit) disconnect("client too slow; reconnect will replay");
}

std::string Sender::build_hello() const {
    JsonWriter w;
    w.begin_object();
    w.key("v").i64(kProtocolVersion);
    w.key("kind").str("hello");
    w.key("sess").str(cfg_.sess);
    w.key("wall_ms").i64(wall_ms());
    w.key("plugin_version").str(kPluginVersion);
    w.key("last_seq").u64(counters_.next_seq.load() - 1);
    w.key("sample_rate_hz").f64(cfg_.settings.sample_rate_hz);
    w.key("replay_buffer_s").f64(cfg_.settings.replay_buffer_s);
    w.key("capture").boolean(cfg_.settings.capture);
    w.key("ring_dropped").u64(counters_.ring_dropped.load());
    w.key("journal_dropped").u64(journal_->dropped());
    w.key("log_dropped").u64(counters_.log_dropped.load());
    w.end_object();
    return w.take();
}

std::string Sender::build_snapshot() const {
    JsonWriter w;
    w.begin_object();
    w.key("v").i64(kProtocolVersion);
    w.key("kind").str("snapshot");
    w.key("sess").str(cfg_.sess);
    w.key("wall_ms").i64(wall_ms());
    w.key("paused").boolean(paused_);
    w.key("configs").begin_array();
    for (const auto& [id, json] : latest_config_) w.raw(json);
    w.end_array();
    w.key("last_sample");
    if (last_sample_.empty()) w.null(); else w.raw(last_sample_);
    w.end_object();
    return w.take();
}

void Sender::on_connected() {
    conn_ = Conn::Connected;
    backoff_ms_ = 250;
    outbuf_.clear();
    out_off_ = 0;
    inbuf_.clear();
    log("connected to client on 127.0.0.1:" + std::to_string(cfg_.settings.port));

    enqueue(build_hello());
    enqueue(build_snapshot());

    // Replay: unacknowledged durable messages of earlier sessions first, then
    // this session's durable messages and buffered samples merged by seq.
    // The client de-duplicates by (sess, seq).
    for (const auto& [sess, entries] : journal_->pending()) {
        if (sess == cfg_.sess) continue;
        for (const auto& e : entries) enqueue(e.json);
    }
    struct Item { std::uint64_t seq; const std::string* json; };
    std::vector<Item> items;
    if (auto it = journal_->pending().find(cfg_.sess); it != journal_->pending().end()) {
        for (const auto& e : it->second) items.push_back({e.seq, &e.json});
    }
    for (const auto& s : replay_) items.push_back({s.seq, &s.json});
    std::sort(items.begin(), items.end(), [](const Item& a, const Item& b) { return a.seq < b.seq; });
    for (const auto& i : items) enqueue(*i.json);
}

void Sender::disconnect(const char* why) {
    if (conn_ == Conn::Connected) log(std::string("disconnected: ") + why);
    net::close(sock_);
    sock_ = net::invalid_socket();
    conn_ = Conn::Disconnected;
    outbuf_.clear();
    out_off_ = 0;
    next_attempt_ms_ = steady_ms() + backoff_ms_;
    backoff_ms_ = std::min(backoff_ms_ * 2, kMaxBackoffMs);
}

void Sender::read_acks() {
    char buf[8192];
    for (;;) {
        long n = net::recv_some(sock_, buf, sizeof buf);
        if (n == -1) break;
        if (n < 0) { disconnect("connection closed"); return; }
        inbuf_.append(buf, std::size_t(n));
    }
    std::size_t off = 0;
    while (inbuf_.size() - off >= 4) {
        const auto* p = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(inbuf_.data() + off);
        const std::uint32_t len = std::uint32_t(p[0]) | (std::uint32_t(p[1]) << 8) | (std::uint32_t(p[2]) << 16) |
                                  (std::uint32_t(p[3]) << 24);
        if (len > kMaxInboundFrame) { disconnect("oversized frame from client"); return; }
        if (inbuf_.size() - off - 4 < len) break;
        const std::string msg = inbuf_.substr(off + 4, len);
        off += 4 + len;
        if (json_str_field(msg, "kind") == "ack") {
            const std::string sess = json_str_field(msg, "sess");
            const std::uint64_t seq = Journal::seq_of(msg);
            journal_->ack(sess, seq);
            if (sess == cfg_.sess) {
                while (!replay_.empty() && replay_.front().seq <= seq) replay_.pop_front();
            }
        }
    }
    inbuf_.erase(0, off);
}

void Sender::manage_connection() {
    const std::int64_t now = steady_ms();
    switch (conn_) {
        case Conn::Disconnected: {
            if (now < next_attempt_ms_) {
                std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(20));
                return;
            }
            bool pending = false;
            sock_ = net::connect_loopback(cfg_.settings.port, pending);
            if (sock_ == net::invalid_socket()) { disconnect("connect failed"); return; }
            if (!pending) { on_connected(); return; }
            conn_ = Conn::Connecting;
            connect_started_ms_ = now;
            return;
        }
        case Conn::Connecting: {
            auto r = net::poll(sock_, true, 20);
            if (r.error || (r.writable && !net::connect_succeeded(sock_))) { disconnect("no client listening"); return; }
            if (r.writable) { on_connected(); return; }
            if (now - connect_started_ms_ > kConnectTimeoutMs) disconnect("connect timeout");
            return;
        }
        case Conn::Connected: {
            auto r = net::poll(sock_, out_off_ < outbuf_.size(), 20);
            if (r.error) { disconnect("socket error"); return; }
            if (r.readable) {
                read_acks();
                if (conn_ != Conn::Connected) return;
            }
            if (r.writable && out_off_ < outbuf_.size()) {
                long n = net::send_some(sock_, outbuf_.data() + out_off_, outbuf_.size() - out_off_);
                if (n < -1) { disconnect("send failed"); return; }
                if (n > 0) out_off_ += std::size_t(n);
                if (out_off_ == outbuf_.size()) { outbuf_.clear(); out_off_ = 0; }
            }
            return;
        }
    }
}

}  // namespace pt
```

```hpp
// it never calls into the SDK (SDK readme: all calls back to the game must
```

`plugin/src/settings.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "settings.hpp"

#include <charconv>
#include <cmath>
#include <string_view>

#include "platform.hpp"

namespace pt {
namespace {

std::string_view trim(std::string_view s) {
    while (!s.empty() && (s.front() == ' ' || s.front() == '\t')) s.remove_prefix(1);
    while (!s.empty() && (s.back() == ' ' || s.back() == '\t' || s.back() == '\r')) s.remove_suffix(1);
    return s;
}

template <typename T>
bool parse_num(std::string_view v, T& out) {
    T tmp{};
    auto r = std::from_chars(v.data(), v.data() + v.size(), tmp);
    if (r.ec != std::errc() || r.ptr != v.data() + v.size()) return false;
    out = tmp;
    return true;
}

}  // namespace

Settings parse_settings(const std::string& text) {
    Settings s;
    std::string_view rest(text);
    while (!rest.empty()) {
        auto nl = rest.find('\n');
        std::string_view line = rest.substr(0, nl);
        rest = nl == std::string_view::npos ? std::string_view{} : rest.substr(nl + 1);

        auto hash = line.find_first_of("#;");
        if (hash != std::string_view::npos) line = line.substr(0, hash);
        auto eq = line.find('=');
        if (eq == std::string_view::npos) continue;
        std::string_view key = trim(line.substr(0, eq));
        std::string_view val = trim(line.substr(eq + 1));

        if (key == "port") {
            std::uint32_t p = 0;
            if (parse_num(val, p) && p > 0 && p <= 65535) s.port = std::uint16_t(p);
        } else if (key == "sample_rate_hz") {
            double d = 0;
            if (parse_num(val, d) && std::isfinite(d) && d >= 0.0 && d <= 1000.0) s.sample_rate_hz = d;
        } else if (key == "replay_buffer_s") {
            double d = 0;
            if (parse_num(val, d) && std::isfinite(d) && d >= 0.0 && d <= 3600.0) s.replay_buffer_s = d;
        } else if (key == "capture") {
            s.capture = (val == "1" || val == "true");
        } else if (key == "journal_max_mib") {
            std::uint32_t m = 0;
            if (parse_num(val, m) && m >= 1 && m <= 4096) s.journal_max_mib = m;
        }
    }
    return s;
}

Settings load_settings(const std::string& ini_path) {
    std::string text;
    if (std::FILE* f = open_file_utf8(ini_path, "rb")) {
        char buf[4096];
        std::size_t n;
        while ((n = std::fread(buf, 1, sizeof buf, f)) > 0 && text.size() < 65536) text.append(buf, n);
        std::fclose(f);
    }
    return parse_settings(text);
}

}  // namespace pt
```

```cpp
#include "sha256.hpp"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include "platform.hpp"

namespace pt {
namespace {

constexpr std::uint32_t K[64] = {
    0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5,
    0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3, 0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174,
    0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da,
    0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
    0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85,
    0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
    0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,
    0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2,
};

inline std::uint32_t rotr(std::uint32_t x, int n) { return (x >> n) | (x << (32 - n)); }

}  // namespace

Sha256::Sha256()
    : h_{0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19} {}

void Sha256::block(const std::uint8_t* p) {
    std::uint32_t w[64];
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
        w[i] = (std::uint32_t(p[4 * i]) << 24) | (std::uint32_t(p[4 * i + 1]) << 16) |
               (std::uint32_t(p[4 * i + 2]) << 8) | std::uint32_t(p[4 * i + 3]);
    }
    for (int i = 16; i < 64; ++i) {
        std::uint32_t s0 = rotr(w[i - 15], 7) ^ rotr(w[i - 15], 18) ^ (w[i - 15] >> 3);
        std::uint32_t s1 = rotr(w[i - 2], 17) ^ rotr(w[i - 2], 19) ^ (w[i - 2] >> 10);
        w[i] = w[i - 16] + s0 + w[i - 7] + s1;
    }
    std::uint32_t a = h_[0], b = h_[1], c = h_[2], d = h_[3], e = h_[4], f = h_[5], g = h_[6], h = h_[7];
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; ++i) {
        std::uint32_t S1 = rotr(e, 6) ^ rotr(e, 11) ^ rotr(e, 25);
        std::uint32_t ch = (e & f) ^ (~e & g);
        std::uint32_t t1 = h + S1 + ch + K[i] + w[i];
        std::uint32_t S0 = rotr(a, 2) ^ rotr(a, 13) ^ rotr(a, 22);
        std::uint32_t maj = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c);
        std::uint32_t t2 = S0 + maj;
        h = g; g = f; f = e; e = d + t1; d = c; c = b; b = a; a = t1 + t2;
    }
    h_[0] += a; h_[1] += b; h_[2] += c; h_[3] += d; h_[4] += e; h_[5] += f; h_[6] += g; h_[7] += h;
}

void Sha256::update(const void* data, std::size_t len) {
    const auto* p = static_cast<const std::uint8_t*>(data);
    total_len_ += len;
    while (len > 0) {
        std::size_t n = 64 - buf_len_;
        if (n > len) n = len;
        std::memcpy(buf_ + buf_len_, p, n);
        buf_len_ += n;
        p += n;
        len -= n;
        if (buf_len_ == 64) { block(buf_); buf_len_ = 0; }
    }
}

std::string Sha256::hex_digest() {
    const std::uint64_t bits = total_len_ * 8;
    const std::uint8_t pad = 0x80;
    update(&pad, 1);
    const std::uint8_t zero = 0;
    while (buf_len_ != 56) update(&zero, 1);
    std::uint8_t len_be[8];
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) len_be[i] = std::uint8_t(bits >> (56 - 8 * i));
    update(len_be, 8);

    static const char hex[] = "0123456789abcdef";
    std::string out;
    out.reserve(64);
    for (std::uint32_t v : h_) {
        for (int shift = 28; shift >= 0; shift -= 4) out += hex[(v >> shift) & 0xf];
    }
    return out;
}

std::string sha256_file(const std::string& utf8_path) {
    std::FILE* f = open_file_utf8(utf8_path, "rb");
    if (!f) return {};
    Sha256 h;
    char buf[64 * 1024];
    std::size_t n;
    while ((n = std::fread(buf, 1, sizeof buf, f)) > 0) h.update(buf, n);
    const bool ok = !std::ferror(f);
    std::fclose(f);
    return ok ? h.hex_digest() : std::string{};
}

}  // namespace pt
```

`plugin/src/spsc_ring.hpp`:

```hpp
// Bounded lock-free single-producer / single-consumer ring.
//
// The producer never blocks: when the ring is full, try_push fails and the
// caller drops the item (and counts the drop). Used game thread -> sender thread
// for telemetry, and sender thread -> game thread for log lines.
#pragma once

#include <atomic>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <memory>
#include <utility>

namespace pt {

template <typename T>
class SpscRing {
public:
    explicit SpscRing(std::size_t capacity_pow2)
        : mask_(capacity_pow2 - 1), slots_(new T[capacity_pow2]) {
        // Capacity must be a power of two so indices wrap with a mask.
        if (capacity_pow2 == 0 || (capacity_pow2 & mask_) != 0) std::abort();
    }

    SpscRing(const SpscRing&) = delete;
    SpscRing& operator=(const SpscRing&) = delete;

    // Producer side only.
    bool try_push(T&& item) {
        const std::size_t head = head_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        const std::size_t tail = tail_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (head - tail > mask_) return false;  // full
        slots_[head & mask_] = std::move(item);
        head_.store(head + 1, std::memory_order_release);
        return true;
    }

    // Consumer side only.
    bool try_pop(T& out) {
        const std::size_t tail = tail_.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
        const std::size_t head = head_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (tail == head) return false;  // empty
        out = std::move(slots_[tail & mask_]);
        tail_.store(tail + 1, std::memory_order_release);
        return true;
    }

    std::size_t capacity() const { return mask_ + 1; }

private:
    const std::size_t mask_;
    std::unique_ptr<T[]> slots_;
    alignas(64) std::atomic<std::size_t> head_{0};
    alignas(64) std::atomic<std::size_t> tail_{0};
};

}  // namespace pt

```

`plugin/src/tmp.cpp`:

```cpp
// TruckersMP client SDK entry points. Uses only the SDK's C layer
// (TruckersMP_Base.h, TruckersMP.h); every call mirrors what the SDK's own C++
// wrapper does in Session::Create (TruckersMP.hxx:1892-1920).
//
// Threading: the TruckersMP client calls init/shutdown and delivers events on
// the game thread (docs: concepts/threading). State is stored in atomics that
// the telemetry callbacks (also the game thread) read.

#include "tmp.hpp"

#include <cstring>

#include "TruckersMP/TruckersMP.h"
#include "message.hpp"

namespace pt::tmp {
namespace {

State g_state;
TruckersMP_PluginContext* g_ctx = nullptr;
const TruckersMP_Core* g_core = nullptr;
const TruckersMP_Network* g_net = nullptr;
const TruckersMP_Accounts* g_acc = nullptr;

void refresh() {
    bool connected = false;
    std::uint64_t server = 0;
    std::uint64_t account = 0;
    if (g_net && g_net->IsConnected) {
        bool c = false;
        if (g_net->IsConnected(g_ctx, &c)) connected = c;
        if (connected && g_net->GetGameServerID) g_net->GetGameServerID(g_ctx, &server);
    }
    if (g_acc && g_acc->GetAccountID) g_acc->GetAccountID(g_ctx, &account);
    g_state.connected.store(connected);
    g_state.server_id.store(server);
    g_state.account_id.store(account);
    g_state.version.fetch_add(1);
}

void TMP_API on_network(void*, std::uint64_t, void*, std::uint32_t) {
    refresh();
}

void copy(char* dst, std::size_t n, const char* src) {
    std::size_t len = std::strlen(src);
    if (len >= n) len = n - 1;
    std::memcpy(dst, src, len);
    dst[len] = '\0';
}

void clear() {
    g_ctx = nullptr;
    g_core = nullptr;
    g_net = nullptr;
    g_acc = nullptr;
}

}  // namespace

State& state() { return g_state; }

}  // namespace pt::tmp

using namespace pt::tmp;

TMP_EXPORT bool TMP_API truckersmp_init(const TruckersMP_Host* host, TruckersMP_PluginDesc* desc) {
    try {
        if (!host || host->m_size < sizeof(TruckersMP_Host) || !host->GetApi || !host->DeclareVersion) return false;
        if (host->DeclareVersion(host->m_ctx, TRUCKERSMP_SDK_VERSION) != TruckersMP_Result_Ok) return false;
        g_ctx = host->m_ctx;
        g_core = static_cast<const TruckersMP_Core*>(host->GetApi(g_ctx, TRUCKERSMP_API_CORE));
        if (!g_core) {
            clear();
            return false;
        }
        g_net = static_cast<const TruckersMP_Network*>(host->GetApi(g_ctx, TRUCKERSMP_API_NETWORK));
        g_acc = static_cast<const TruckersMP_Accounts*>(host->GetApi(g_ctx, TRUCKERSMP_API_ACCOUNTS));
        if (desc) {
            copy(desc->m_name, sizeof desc->m_name, "PlasmaTrack");
            copy(desc->m_author, sizeof desc->m_author, "PlasmaTrack");
            copy(desc->m_version, sizeof desc->m_version, pt::kPluginVersion);
            copy(desc->m_description, sizeof desc->m_description,
                 "Job tracker. Reads whether you are connected to a TruckersMP server, which server, "
                 "and your TruckersMP account ID.");
        }
        if (g_core->AddListener) {
            g_core->AddListener(g_ctx, TRUCKERSMP_EVT_NETWORK_CONNECTED, on_network, nullptr);
            g_core->AddListener(g_ctx, TRUCKERSMP_EVT_NETWORK_DISCONNECTED, on_network, nullptr);
        }
        g_state.loaded.store(true);
        refresh();  // a load in the middle of a server session sees the current state
        return true;
    } catch (...) {
        clear();
        return false;
    }
}

TMP_EXPORT void TMP_API truckersmp_shutdown(void) {
    try {
        if (g_core && g_core->RemoveListener) {
            g_core->RemoveListener(g_ctx, TRUCKERSMP_EVT_NETWORK_CONNECTED, on_network, nullptr);
            g_core->RemoveListener(g_ctx, TRUCKERSMP_EVT_NETWORK_DISCONNECTED, on_network, nullptr);
        }
    } catch (...) {
    }
    clear();
    g_state.loaded.store(false);
    g_state.connected.store(false);
    g_state.server_id.store(0);
    g_state.version.fetch_add(1);
}
```

```hpp
// TruckersMP client SDK side of the plugin (third_party/truckersmp-client-sdk-1.1.0).
//
// The TruckersMP client loads plugins from the same folder as SCS telemetry
// plugins and calls `truckersmp_init` / `truckersmp_shutdown` (TruckersMP_Base.h:121-129),
// so plasmatrack.dll exports both entry points. The telemetry side reports this
// state as `truckersmp` messages (docs/WIRE.md): it tells a job driven on a
// TruckersMP server apart from singleplayer launched through the TruckersMP
// launcher, which a loaded-module check cannot (PLAN §6b).
#pragma once

#include <atomic>
#include <cstdint>

namespace pt::tmp {

struct State {
    std::atomic<bool> loaded{false};     // truckersmp_init succeeded
    std::atomic<bool> connected{false};  // TruckersMP_Network::IsConnected
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> server_id{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> account_id{0};
    std::atomic<std::uint32_t> version{0};  // bumped on every change
};

State& state();

}  // namespace pt::tmp
```
