`plugin/src/value_json.hpp`:

```hpp
// JSON rendering of SDK values and attribute arrays (scssdk_value.h).
#pragma once

#include "json.hpp"
#include "scssdk_value.h"

namespace pt {

inline const char* value_type_name(scs_value_type_t t) {
    switch (t) {
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_bool: return "bool";
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_s32: return "s32";
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_u32: return "u32";
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_u64: return "u64";
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_float: return "float";
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_double: return "double";
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_fvector: return "fvector";
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_dvector: return "dvector";
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_euler: return "euler";
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_fplacement: return "fplacement";
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_dplacement: return "dplacement";
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_string: return "string";
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_s64: return "s64";
        default: return "unknown";
    }
}

template <typename V>
void write_vector(JsonWriter& w, const V& v) {
    w.begin_object();
    w.key("x"); if constexpr (sizeof(v.x) == 4) w.f32(v.x); else w.f64(v.x);
    w.key("y"); if constexpr (sizeof(v.y) == 4) w.f32(v.y); else w.f64(v.y);
    w.key("z"); if constexpr (sizeof(v.z) == 4) w.f32(v.z); else w.f64(v.z);
    w.end_object();
}

inline void write_euler(JsonWriter& w, const scs_value_euler_t& e) {
    w.begin_object();
    w.key("heading").f32(e.heading);
    w.key("pitch").f32(e.pitch);
    w.key("roll").f32(e.roll);
    w.end_object();
}

// Values keep the SDK's own units; conversions happen in pt-core.
inline void write_value(JsonWriter& w, const scs_value_t& v) {
    switch (v.type) {
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_bool: w.boolean(v.value_bool.value != 0); break;
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_s32: w.i64(v.value_s32.value); break;
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_u32: w.u64(v.value_u32.value); break;
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_u64: w.u64(v.value_u64.value); break;
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_s64: w.i64(v.value_s64.value); break;
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_float: w.f32(v.value_float.value); break;
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_double: w.f64(v.value_double.value); break;
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_fvector: write_vector(w, v.value_fvector); break;
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_dvector: write_vector(w, v.value_dvector); break;
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_euler: write_euler(w, v.value_euler); break;
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_fplacement:
            w.begin_object();
            w.key("position"); write_vector(w, v.value_fplacement.position);
            w.key("orientation"); write_euler(w, v.value_fplacement.orientation);
            w.end_object();
            break;
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_dplacement:
            w.begin_object();
            w.key("position"); write_vector(w, v.value_dplacement.position);
            w.key("orientation"); write_euler(w, v.value_dplacement.orientation);
            w.end_object();
            break;
        case SCS_VALUE_TYPE_string:
            if (v.value_string.value) w.str(v.value_string.value); else w.null();
            break;
        default: w.null(); break;
    }
}

// Renders a NULL-name-terminated attribute array (scssdk_telemetry_event.h:156-166)
// as [{"name":..,"index":null|n,"type":..,"value":..}, ...]. Strings are copied
// now because their pointers are only valid during the callback.
inline void write_attributes(JsonWriter& w, const scs_named_value_t* attrs) {
    w.begin_array();
    for (const scs_named_value_t* a = attrs; a && a->name; ++a) {
        w.begin_object();
        w.key("name").str(a->name);
        w.key("index");
        if (a->index == SCS_U32_NIL) w.null(); else w.u64(a->index);
        w.key("type").str(value_type_name(a->value.type));
        w.key("value");
        write_value(w, a->value);
        w.end_object();
    }
    w.end_array();
}

}  // namespace pt
```

`plugin/tests/drive_plugin.cpp`:

```cpp
// Drives the real plugin through a short scripted job so it talks to a real,
// separately running PlasmaTrack client (scripts/e2e-plugin-client.ps1).
//
// Usage: pt_drive_plugin <plasmatrack.dll> <work dir> <client port>
// Prints the plugin session id on success.
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <map>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#else
#include <dlfcn.h>
#endif

#include "scssdk_telemetry.h"
#include "common/scssdk_telemetry_common_channels.h"
#include "common/scssdk_telemetry_common_configs.h"
#include "common/scssdk_telemetry_common_gameplay_events.h"
#include "common/scssdk_telemetry_truck_common_channels.h"
#include "amtrucks/scssdk_ats.h"
#include "amtrucks/scssdk_telemetry_ats.h"

#include "platform.hpp"

namespace {
std::map<scs_event_t, scs_telemetry_event_callback_t> g_events;
struct Ch { std::string name; scs_value_type_t type; scs_telemetry_channel_callback_t cb; scs_context_t ctx; };
std::vector<Ch> g_channels;

SCSAPI_RESULT reg_event(const scs_event_t e, const scs_telemetry_event_callback_t cb, const scs_context_t) { g_events[e] = cb; return SCS_RESULT_ok; }
SCSAPI_RESULT unreg_event(const scs_event_t e) { g_events.erase(e); return SCS_RESULT_ok; }
SCSAPI_RESULT reg_channel(const scs_string_t n, const scs_u32_t, const scs_value_type_t t, const scs_u32_t,
                          const scs_telemetry_channel_callback_t cb, const scs_context_t ctx) {
    g_channels.push_back({n, t, cb, ctx});
    return SCS_RESULT_ok;
}
SCSAPI_RESULT unreg_channel(const scs_string_t, const scs_u32_t, const scs_value_type_t) { return SCS_RESULT_ok; }
SCSAPI_VOID log_fn(const scs_log_type_t, const scs_string_t msg) { std::fprintf(stderr, "game log: %s\n", msg); }

void fire(scs_event_t e, const void* info = nullptr) {
    auto it = g_events.find(e);
    if (it != g_events.end()) it->second(e, info, nullptr);
}

scs_named_value_t attr(const char* name, scs_value_type_t type) {
    scs_named_value_t a{};
    a.name = name;
    a.index = SCS_U32_NIL;
    a.value.type = type;
    return a;
}
}  // namespace

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc != 4) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s <plugin> <work dir> <port>\n", argv[0]);
        return 2;
    }
    const std::string work = argv[2];
    pt::make_dirs(work);
    const std::string dll = pt::join_path(work, "plasmatrack.dll");
    {
        std::FILE* in = pt::open_file_utf8(argv[1], "rb");
        std::FILE* out = pt::open_file_utf8(dll, "wb");
        if (!in || !out) return 1;
        char buf[65536];
        std::size_t n;
        while ((n = std::fread(buf, 1, sizeof buf, in)) > 0) std::fwrite(buf, 1, n, out);
        std::fclose(in);
        std::fclose(out);
        std::FILE* ini = pt::open_file_utf8(pt::join_path(work, "plasmatrack.ini"), "wb");
        std::fprintf(ini, "port = %s\nsample_rate_hz = 20\n", argv[3]);
        std::fclose(ini);
    }
#ifdef _WIN32
    HMODULE lib = LoadLibraryA(dll.c_str());
    auto init = reinterpret_cast<scs_result_t (*)(scs_u32_t, const scs_telemetry_init_params_t*)>(
        reinterpret_cast<void*>(GetProcAddress(lib, "scs_telemetry_init")));
    auto shutdown = reinterpret_cast<void (*)()>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(GetProcAddress(lib, "scs_telemetry_shutdown")));
#else
    void* lib = dlopen(dll.c_str(), RTLD_NOW);
    auto init = reinterpret_cast<scs_result_t (*)(scs_u32_t, const scs_telemetry_init_params_t*)>(dlsym(lib, "scs_telemetry_init"));
    auto shutdown = reinterpret_cast<void (*)()>(dlsym(lib, "scs_telemetry_shutdown"));
#endif
    if (!lib || !init || !shutdown) return 1;

    scs_telemetry_init_params_v101_t p{};
    p.common.game_name = "American Truck Simulator";
    p.common.game_id = SCS_GAME_ID_ATS;
    p.common.game_version = SCS_TELEMETRY_ATS_GAME_VERSION_1_05;
    p.common.log = log_fn;
    p.register_for_event = reg_event;
    p.unregister_from_event = unreg_event;
    p.register_for_channel = reg_channel;
    p.unregister_from_channel = unreg_channel;
    if (init(SCS_TELEMETRY_VERSION_1_01, &p) != SCS_RESULT_ok) return 1;

    scs_named_value_t job[4] = {attr(SCS_TELEMETRY_CONFIG_ATTRIBUTE_cargo_id, SCS_VALUE_TYPE_string),
                                attr(SCS_TELEMETRY_CONFIG_ATTRIBUTE_planned_distance_km, SCS_VALUE_TYPE_u32),
                                attr(SCS_TELEMETRY_CONFIG_ATTRIBUTE_destination_city, SCS_VALUE_TYPE_string), {}};
    job[0].value.value_string.value = "e2e_cargo";
    job[1].value.value_u32.value = 5;
    job[2].value.value_string.value = "Las Vegas";
    scs_telemetry_configuration_t job_cfg{SCS_TELEMETRY_CONFIG_job, job};
    fire(SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_configuration, &job_cfg);
    fire(SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_started);

    scs_named_value_t delivered[2] = {attr(SCS_TELEMETRY_GAMEPLAY_EVENT_ATTRIBUTE_revenue, SCS_VALUE_TYPE_s64), {}};
    delivered[0].value.value_s64.value = 777;
    scs_telemetry_gameplay_event_t ev{SCS_TELEMETRY_GAMEPLAY_EVENT_job_delivered, delivered};

    // 3 s of simulated driving at 60 Hz, paced in real time so the plugin's
    // sender thread and the client exchange frames and acks while it runs.
    scs_timestamp_t sim = 0;
    double odo = 1000.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 180; ++i) {
        sim += 16666;  // the real game's physics step
        odo += 25.0 * 0.016667 / 1000.0;
        scs_telemetry_frame_start_t fs{};
        fs.simulation_time = fs.paused_simulation_time = fs.render_time = sim;
        fire(SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_frame_start, &fs);
        if (i == 170) fire(SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_gameplay, &ev);
        for (auto& c : g_channels) {
            scs_value_t v{};
            v.type = c.type;
            if (c.name == SCS_TELEMETRY_TRUCK_CHANNEL_speed) v.value_float.value = 25.0f;
            else if (c.name == SCS_TELEMETRY_TRUCK_CHANNEL_odometer) v.value_float.value = float(odo);
            else if (c.name == SCS_TELEMETRY_TRUCK_CHANNEL_fuel) v.value_float.value = 500.0f;
            else if (c.name == SCS_TELEMETRY_TRUCK_CHANNEL_world_placement) v.value_dplacement.position = {double(i), 0, 0};
            c.cb(c.name.c_str(), SCS_U32_NIL, &v, c.ctx);
        }
        fire(SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_frame_end);
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(16));
    }
    fire(SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_paused);
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1000));  // let the client ack
    shutdown();
#ifdef _WIN32
    FreeLibrary(lib);
#else
    dlclose(lib);
#endif
    // The session id is the name of the plugin's journal file.
    for (const auto& f : pt::list_dir(pt::join_path(work, "plasmatrack/journal"))) {
        if (f.size() == 38 && f.substr(32) == ".jsonl") std::printf("%s\n", f.substr(0, 32).c_str());
    }
    return 0;
}
```

```cpp
static int g_failures = 0;
#define CHECK(cond)                                                            \
    do {                                                                       \
        if (!(cond)) {                                                         \
            std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL %s:%d: %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #cond); \
            ++g_failures;                                                      \
        }                                                                      \
    } while (0)
#define REQUIRE(cond)                                                          \
    do {                                                                       \
        if (!(cond)) {                                                         \
            std::fprintf(stderr, "FATAL %s:%d: %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #cond); \
            return 1;                                                          \

// ---- mock SDK ----------------------------------------------------------------

struct MockChannel {

SCSAPI_RESULT mock_register_event(const scs_event_t e, const scs_telemetry_event_callback_t cb, const scs_context_t) {

using init_fn = scs_result_t (*)(scs_u32_t, const scs_telemetry_init_params_t*);
using shutdown_fn = void (*)();

// ---- minimal loopback listener -----------------------------------------------

#ifdef _WIN32
using sock_t = SOCKET;
static const sock_t kBad = INVALID_SOCKET;
static void close_sock(sock_t s) { closesocket(s); }
static void set_nonblocking(sock_t s) { u_long nb = 1; ioctlsocket(s, FIONBIO, &nb); }
#else
using sock_t = int;
static const sock_t kBad = -1;
static void close_sock(sock_t s) { ::close(s); }
static void set_nonblocking(sock_t s) { fcntl(s, F_SETFL, fcntl(s, F_GETFL, 0) | O_NONBLOCK); }
#endif

struct Message {
    std::string kind, sess, json;
    std::uint64_t seq = 0;
};

static std::string str_field(const std::string& json, const std::string& key) {
    const std::string k = "\"" + key + "\":\"";
    auto p = json.find(k);
    if (p == std::string::npos) return {};
    p += k.size();
    return json.substr(p, json.find('"', p) - p);
}
static std::uint64_t seq_field(const std::string& json) {
    auto p = json.find("\"seq\":");
    return p == std::string::npos ? 0 : std::strtoull(json.c_str() + p + 6, nullptr, 10);
}

class Client {
public:
    sock_t listener = kBad, conn = kBad;
    std::string inbuf;
    std::vector<Message> received;

    std::uint16_t listen_any() {
        listener = ::socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, IPPROTO_TCP);
        sockaddr_in a{};
        a.sin_family = AF_INET;
        a.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
        a.sin_port = 0;
        ::bind(listener, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&a), sizeof a);
        ::listen(listener, 4);
        set_nonblocking(listener);
        socklen_t len = sizeof a;
        ::getsockname(listener, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&a), &len);
        return ntohs(a.sin_port);
    }

    bool accept_within(int ms) {
        const auto end = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::milliseconds(ms);
        while (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < end) {
            sock_t s = ::accept(listener, nullptr, nullptr);
            if (s != kBad) {
                set_nonblocking(s);
                conn = s;
                inbuf.clear();
                return true;
            }
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(5));
        }
        return false;
    }

    void pump() {
        char buf[65536];
        for (;;) {
            int n = int(::recv(conn, buf, sizeof buf, 0));
            if (n <= 0) break;
            inbuf.append(buf, std::size_t(n));
        }
        std::size_t off = 0;
        while (inbuf.size() - off >= 4) {
            const auto* p = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(inbuf.data() + off);
            std::uint32_t len = p[0] | (p[1] << 8) | (p[2] << 16) | (std::uint32_t(p[3]) << 24);
            if (inbuf.size() - off - 4 < len) break;
            Message m;
            m.json = inbuf.substr(off + 4, len);
            m.kind = str_field(m.json, "kind");
            m.sess = str_field(m.json, "sess");
            m.seq = seq_field(m.json);
            received.push_back(std::move(m));
            off += 4 + len;
        }
        inbuf.erase(0, off);
    }

    // Pumps until `pred` holds over the received messages or the timeout expires.
    bool wait_for(const std::function<bool(const std::vector<Message>&)>& pred, int ms = 5000) {
        const auto end = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::milliseconds(ms);
        do {
            pump();
            if (pred(received)) return true;
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(5));
        } while (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < end);
        return false;
    }

    void send_ack(const std::string& sess, std::uint64_t seq) {
        std::string json = "{\"kind\":\"ack\",\"sess\":\"" + sess + "\",\"seq\":" + std::to_string(seq) + "}";
        std::uint32_t n = std::uint32_t(json.size());
        char hdr[4] = {char(n), char(n >> 8), char(n >> 16), char(n >> 24)};
        std::string frame(hdr, 4);
        frame += json;
        ::send(conn, frame.data(), int(frame.size()), 0);
    }

    void drop_connection() {
        close_sock(conn);
        conn = kBad;
    }
};

static bool has_kind(const std::vector<Message>& v, const std::string& kind, const std::string& sess = {}) {
    return std::any_of(v.begin(), v.end(), [&](const Message& m) {
        return m.kind == kind && (sess.empty() || m.sess == sess);
    });
}
static const Message* find_kind(const std::vector<Message>& v, const std::string& kind, const std::string& sess = {}) {
    for (const auto& m : v)
        if (m.kind == kind && (sess.empty() || m.sess == sess)) return &m;
    return nullptr;
}

// ---- driving the plugin like the game ------------------------------------------

struct Game {
    scs_timestamp_t sim_us = 0;

    void event(scs_event_t e, const void* info = nullptr) {
        auto it = g_mock.events.find(e);
        if (it != g_mock.events.end()) it->second(e, info, nullptr);
    }

    // One physics frame (SDK order: frame_start, gameplay, channels, frame_end).
    double scale = 19.0;  // local.scale reported by the next frames

    void frame(bool paused, double speed_mps, double odo_km, double fuel_l, double x,
               scs_u32_t flags = 0, bool fuel_available = true,
               const scs_telemetry_gameplay_event_t* gameplay = nullptr) {
        if (!paused) sim_us += 16666;  // the real game's physics step (observed in ATS 1.61)
        scs_telemetry_frame_start_t fs{};
        fs.flags = flags;
        fs.render_time = sim_us + 5000;
        fs.simulation_time = sim_us;
        fs.paused_simulation_time = sim_us;
        event(SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_frame_start, &fs);
        if (gameplay) event(SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_gameplay, gameplay);
        if (!paused) {
            for (auto& c : g_mock.channels) {
                scs_value_t v{};
                v.type = c.type;
                const scs_value_t* pv = &v;
                if (c.name == SCS_TELEMETRY_TRUCK_CHANNEL_speed) v.value_float.value = float(speed_mps);
                else if (c.name == SCS_TELEMETRY_TRUCK_CHANNEL_odometer) v.value_float.value = float(odo_km);
                else if (c.name == SCS_TELEMETRY_TRUCK_CHANNEL_fuel) { v.value_float.value = float(fuel_l); if (!fuel_available) pv = nullptr; }
                else if (c.name == SCS_TELEMETRY_TRUCK_CHANNEL_world_placement) v.value_dplacement.position = {x, 50.0, -1000.0};
                else if (c.name == SCS_TELEMETRY_CHANNEL_game_time) v.value_u32.value = 4000;
                else if (c.name == SCS_TELEMETRY_CHANNEL_local_scale) v.value_float.value = float(scale);
                else if (c.name == "trailer.0.connected") v.value_bool.value = 1;
                c.cb(c.name.c_str(), SCS_U32_NIL, pv, c.ctx);
            }
        }
        event(SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_frame_end);
    }
};

static scs_named_value_t attr_str(const char* name, const char* v) {
    scs_named_value_t a{};
    a.name = name; a.index = SCS_U32_NIL; a.value.type = SCS_VALUE_TYPE_string; a.value.value_string.value = v;
    return a;
}
static scs_named_value_t attr_u32(const char* name, scs_u32_t v) {
    scs_named_value_t a{};
    a.name = name; a.index = SCS_U32_NIL; a.value.type = SCS_VALUE_TYPE_u32; a.value.value_u32.value = v;
    return a;
}
static scs_named_value_t attr_s64(const char* name, scs_s64_t v) {
    scs_named_value_t a{};
    a.name = name; a.index = SCS_U32_NIL; a.value.type = SCS_VALUE_TYPE_s64; a.value.value_s64.value = v;
    return a;
}
static scs_named_value_t attr_float(const char* name, float v) {
    scs_named_value_t a{};
    a.name = name; a.index = SCS_U32_NIL; a.value.type = SCS_VALUE_TYPE_float; a.value.value_float.value = v;
    return a;
}

static bool copy_file(const std::string& from, const std::string& to) {
    std::FILE* in = pt::open_file_utf8(from, "rb");
    if (!in) return false;
    std::FILE* out = pt::open_file_utf8(to, "wb");
    if (!out) { std::fclose(in); return false; }
    char buf[65536];
    std::size_t n;
    while ((n = std::fread(buf, 1, sizeof buf, in)) > 0) std::fwrite(buf, 1, n, out);
    std::fclose(in);
    std::fclose(out);
    return true;
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    REQUIRE(argc == 2);
    g_mock.main_thread = std::this_thread::get_id();
#ifdef _WIN32
    WSADATA wsa;
    WSAStartup(MAKEWORD(2, 2), &wsa);
#endif

    // Isolated copy of the plugin so its ini and journal live in a scratch dir.
    const std::string work = pt::join_path(pt::dir_of(pt::own_module_path()), "fake_game_run");
    pt::make_dirs(pt::join_path(work, "plasmatrack/journal"));
    for (const auto& f : pt::list_dir(pt::join_path(work, "plasmatrack/journal")))
        pt::remove_file(pt::join_path(pt::join_path(work, "plasmatrack/journal"), f));
    const std::string name = pt::dir_of(argv[1]) == "." ? argv[1] : std::string(argv[1]).substr(pt::dir_of(argv[1]).size() + 1);
    const std::string dll = pt::join_path(work, name);
    REQUIRE(copy_file(argv[1], dll));

    Client client;
    const std::uint16_t port = client.listen_any();
    {
        std::FILE* ini = pt::open_file_utf8(pt::join_path(work, "plasmatrack.ini"), "wb");
        REQUIRE(ini);
        std::fprintf(ini, "# written by pt_fake_game\nport = %u\nsample_rate_hz = 20\nreplay_buffer_s = 120\n", unsigned(port));
        std::fclose(ini);
    }

#ifdef _WIN32
    HMODULE lib = LoadLibraryA(dll.c_str());
    REQUIRE(lib);
    auto init = reinterpret_cast<init_fn>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(GetProcAddress(lib, "scs_telemetry_init")));
    auto shutdown = reinterpret_cast<shutdown_fn>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(GetProcAddress(lib, "scs_telemetry_shutdown")));
#else
    void* lib = dlopen(dll.c_str(), RTLD_NOW | RTLD_LOCAL);
    REQUIRE(lib);
    auto init = reinterpret_cast<init_fn>(dlsym(lib, "scs_telemetry_init"));
    auto shutdown = reinterpret_cast<shutdown_fn>(dlsym(lib, "scs_telemetry_shutdown"));
#endif
    REQUIRE(init && shutdown);

    scs_telemetry_init_params_v101_t params{};
    params.common.game_name = "Euro Truck Simulator 2";
    params.common.game_id = SCS_GAME_ID_EUT2;
    params.common.game_version = SCS_TELEMETRY_EUT2_GAME_VERSION_1_18;
    params.common.log = mock_log;
    params.register_for_event = mock_register_event;
    params.unregister_from_event = mock_unregister_event;
    params.register_for_channel = mock_register_channel;
    params.unregister_from_channel = mock_unregister_channel;

    // Version negotiation: only API 1.01 is accepted.
    CHECK(init(SCS_TELEMETRY_VERSION_1_00, &params) == SCS_RESULT_unsupported);
    {
        auto other = params;
        other.common.game_id = "some_other_game";
        CHECK(init(SCS_TELEMETRY_VERSION_1_01, &other) == SCS_RESULT_unsupported);
        g_mock.reset();
    }
    REQUIRE(init(SCS_TELEMETRY_VERSION_1_01, &params) == SCS_RESULT_ok);
    CHECK(g_mock.events.count(SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_gameplay) == 1);
    CHECK(g_mock.events.count(SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_configuration) == 1);
    CHECK(g_mock.channels.size() == 14);
    for (const auto& c : g_mock.channels)
        CHECK(c.flags == (SCS_TELEMETRY_CHANNEL_FLAG_each_frame | SCS_TELEMETRY_CHANNEL_FLAG_no_value));
    for (const auto& c : g_mock.channels)
        if (c.name == SCS_TELEMETRY_TRUCK_CHANNEL_world_placement) CHECK(c.type == SCS_VALUE_TYPE_dplacement);

    // ---- connect, handshake, integrity ----------------------------------------
    REQUIRE(client.accept_within(3000));
    REQUIRE(client.wait_for([](auto& v) {
        return has_kind(v, "hello") && has_kind(v, "snapshot") && has_kind(v, "init") &&
               has_kind(v, "integrity") && has_kind(v, "modules");
    }));
    const std::string sess1 = find_kind(client.received, "hello")->sess;
    CHECK(sess1.size() == 32);
    const Message* init_msg = find_kind(client.received, "init");
    CHECK(init_msg->json.find("\"game_id\":\"eut2\"") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(init_msg->json.find("\"game_version\":{\"major\":1,\"minor\":18}") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(init_msg->json.find("\"events_failed\":\"\"") != std::string::npos);
    const std::string expected_hash = pt::sha256_file(dll);
    CHECK(expected_hash.size() == 64);
    CHECK(find_kind(client.received, "integrity")->json.find("\"plugin_sha256\":\"" + expected_hash + "\"") != std::string::npos);
    CHECK(find_kind(client.received, "modules")->json.find(name) != std::string::npos);

    // ---- a short job ------------------------------------------------------------
    Game game;
    scs_named_value_t job_attrs[] = {
        attr_str(SCS_TELEMETRY_CONFIG_ATTRIBUTE_cargo_id, "apples"),
        attr_str(SCS_TELEMETRY_CONFIG_ATTRIBUTE_cargo, "\xC3\x84pfel"),  // UTF-8
        attr_float(SCS_TELEMETRY_CONFIG_ATTRIBUTE_cargo_mass, 20000.0f),
        attr_u32(SCS_TELEMETRY_CONFIG_ATTRIBUTE_planned_distance_km, 412),
        scs_named_value_t{},
    };
    scs_telemetry_configuration_t job_cfg{SCS_TELEMETRY_CONFIG_job, job_attrs};
    game.event(SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_configuration, &job_cfg);
    game.event(SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_started);

    scs_named_value_t delivered_attrs[] = {
        attr_s64(SCS_TELEMETRY_GAMEPLAY_EVENT_ATTRIBUTE_revenue, 12000),
        attr_float(SCS_TELEMETRY_GAMEPLAY_EVENT_ATTRIBUTE_distance_km, 1.25f),
        scs_named_value_t{},
    };
    scs_telemetry_gameplay_event_t delivered{SCS_TELEMETRY_GAMEPLAY_EVENT_job_delivered, delivered_attrs};
    double odo = 100.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 120; ++i) {  // 2 s of simulation at 60 Hz
        odo += 20.0 * 0.016667 / 1000.0;
        if (i == 80) game.scale = 3.0;  // drive into a city
        game.frame(false, 20.0, odo, 300.0 - i * 0.01, 1000.0 + i, 0, i != 60, i == 100 ? &delivered : nullptr);
    }
    game.event(SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_paused);
    game.frame(true, 0, 0, 0, 0);

    REQUIRE(client.wait_for([&](auto& v) { return has_kind(v, "paused", sess1); }));
    {
        std::vector<std::uint64_t> seqs;
        int samples = 0;
        for (const auto& m : client.received) {
            if (m.sess == sess1 && m.seq) seqs.push_back(m.seq);
            if (m.kind == "sample") ++samples;
        }
        std::sort(seqs.begin(), seqs.end());
        CHECK(!seqs.empty() && seqs.front() == 1);
        bool contiguous = true;
        for (std::size_t i = 1; i < seqs.size(); ++i) contiguous &= seqs[i] == seqs[i - 1] + 1;
        CHECK(contiguous);
        // 20 Hz over 2 s = 40, plus samples forced by config/started/gameplay.
        CHECK(samples >= 40 && samples <= 46);
        if (samples < 40 || samples > 46) std::fprintf(stderr, "  samples=%d\n", samples);

        const Message* cfg = find_kind(client.received, "config", sess1);
        REQUIRE(cfg);
        CHECK(cfg->json.find("\"id\":\"job\"") != std::string::npos);
        CHECK(cfg->json.find("{\"name\":\"cargo.id\",\"index\":null,\"type\":\"string\",\"value\":\"apples\"}") != std::string::npos);
        CHECK(cfg->json.find("\"value\":\"\xC3\x84pfel\"") != std::string::npos);
        CHECK(cfg->json.find("{\"name\":\"planned_distance.km\",\"index\":null,\"type\":\"u32\",\"value\":412}") != std::string::npos);

        const Message* gp = find_kind(client.received, "gameplay", sess1);
        REQUIRE(gp);
        CHECK(gp->json.find("\"id\":\"job.delivered\"") != std::string::npos);
        CHECK(gp->json.find("{\"name\":\"revenue\",\"index\":null,\"type\":\"s64\",\"value\":12000}") != std::string::npos);
        CHECK(gp->json.find("{\"name\":\"distance.km\",\"index\":null,\"type\":\"float\",\"value\":1.25}") != std::string::npos);

        const Message* s = find_kind(client.received, "sample", sess1);
        REQUIRE(s);
        CHECK(s->json.find("\"truck.speed\":20") != std::string::npos);
        CHECK(s->json.find("\"truck.world.placement\":{\"position\":{\"x\":") != std::string::npos);
        CHECK(s->json.find("\"local.scale\":19") != std::string::npos);
        CHECK(s->json.find("\"trailer.0.connected\":true") != std::string::npos);

        // Scale changes are durable messages: the first value, then 19 -> 3.
        std::vector<const Message*> scales;
        for (const auto& m : client.received)
            if (m.sess == sess1 && m.kind == "scale") scales.push_back(&m);
        CHECK(scales.size() == 2);
        if (scales.size() == 2) {
            CHECK(scales[0]->json.find("\"local_scale\":19,\"previous\":null") != std::string::npos);
            CHECK(scales[1]->json.find("\"local_scale\":3,\"previous\":19") != std::string::npos);
            CHECK(scales[1]->json.find("\"truck.odometer\":") != std::string::npos);
            CHECK(scales[1]->json.find("\"truck.world.placement\":{\"position\"") != std::string::npos);
        }
    }

    // ---- ack part, disconnect, keep playing, reconnect: durable replay ----------
    const std::uint64_t acked = find_kind(client.received, "gameplay", sess1)->seq;
    client.send_ack(sess1, acked);
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(100));
    client.drop_connection();
    client.received.clear();

    scs_telemetry_configuration_t empty_job{SCS_TELEMETRY_CONFIG_job, job_attrs + 4};  // "no job"
    game.event(SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_configuration, &empty_job);
    game.event(SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_started);
    game.frame(false, 0, odo, 290, 2000, SCS_TELEMETRY_FRAME_START_FLAG_timer_restart);
    game.event(SCS_TELEMETRY_EVENT_paused);
    game.frame(true, 0, 0, 0, 0);

    REQUIRE(client.accept_within(8000));
    REQUIRE(client.wait_for([&](auto& v) { return has_kind(v, "timer_restart", sess1) && has_kind(v, "paused", sess1); }));
    {
        const Message* snap = find_kind(client.received, "snapshot");
        REQUIRE(snap);
        CHECK(snap->json.find("\"paused\":true") != std::string::npos);
        CHECK(snap->json.find("\"id\":\"job\",\"attrs\":[]") != std::string::npos);  // latest job config is empty
        bool replayed_acked = false;
        for (const auto& m : client.received)
            if (m.sess == sess1 && m.seq && m.seq <= acked && m.kind != "sample") replayed_acked = true;
        CHECK(!replayed_acked);
        CHECK(has_kind(client.received, "config", sess1));
    }

    // Heartbeat while paused.
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1100));
    game.frame(true, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    CHECK(client.wait_for([&](auto& v) { return has_kind(v, "heartbeat", sess1); }, 2000));
    CHECK(find_kind(client.received, "heartbeat", sess1)->json.find("\"local_scale\":3") != std::string::npos);

    // Logs are flushed on the game thread only.
    game.frame(true, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    CHECK(std::any_of(g_mock.logs.begin(), g_mock.logs.end(),
                      [](const std::string& l) { return l.find("connected to client") != std::string::npos; }));

    // ---- the same DLL as a TruckersMP client SDK plugin ----------------------------
    {
        auto last_tmp = [&](const char* needle) {
            return client.wait_for([&](auto& v) {
                for (auto it = v.rbegin(); it != v.rend(); ++it)
                    if (it->sess == sess1 && it->kind == "truckersmp") return it->json.find(needle) != std::string::npos;
                return false;
            }, 2000);
        };
#ifdef _WIN32
        using tmp_init_fn = bool (*)(const TruckersMP_Host*, TruckersMP_PluginDesc*);
        auto tmp_init = reinterpret_cast<tmp_init_fn>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(GetProcAddress(lib, "truckersmp_init")));
        auto tmp_shutdown = reinterpret_cast<void (*)()>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(GetProcAddress(lib, "truckersmp_shutdown")));
        REQUIRE(tmp_init && tmp_shutdown);
        TruckersMP_Host host{sizeof(TruckersMP_Host), nullptr, faketmp::declare, faketmp::get_api, faketmp::free_fn};
        TruckersMP_PluginDesc desc{};
        desc.m_size = sizeof desc;
        CHECK(tmp_init(&host, &desc));
        CHECK(faketmp::declared == TRUCKERSMP_SDK_VERSION);
        CHECK(std::string(desc.m_name) == "PlasmaTrack");
        CHECK(faketmp::listeners.size() == 2);
        game.frame(true, 0, 0, 0, 0);
        CHECK(last_tmp("\"loaded\":true,\"connected\":false"));
        faketmp::connected = true;
        faketmp::server = 42;
        faketmp::fire(TRUCKERSMP_EVT_NETWORK_CONNECTED);
        game.frame(true, 0, 0, 0, 0);
        CHECK(last_tmp("\"loaded\":true,\"connected\":true,\"server_id\":42,\"account_id\":5557777"));
        faketmp::connected = false;
        faketmp::fire(TRUCKERSMP_EVT_NETWORK_DISCONNECTED);
        game.frame(true, 0, 0, 0, 0);
        CHECK(last_tmp("\"connected\":false,\"server_id\":0"));
        tmp_shutdown();
        CHECK(faketmp::listeners.empty());
        game.frame(true, 0, 0, 0, 0);
        CHECK(last_tmp("\"loaded\":false"));
        // A client built for another SDK version is refused.
        TruckersMP_Host old = host;
        old.DeclareVersion = [](TruckersMP_PluginContext*, std::uint32_t) -> TruckersMP_EResult { return TruckersMP_Result_NotSupported; };
        CHECK(!tmp_init(&old, &desc));
#endif
    }

    // ---- sdk reload: shutdown (unacknowledged tail) and init again -----------------
    shutdown();
    CHECK(client.wait_for([&](auto& v) { return has_kind(v, "shutdown", sess1); }, 2000));
    client.drop_connection();
    client.received.clear();
    g_mock.reset();

    REQUIRE(init(SCS_TELEMETRY_VERSION_1_01, &params) == SCS_RESULT_ok);
    REQUIRE(client.accept_within(8000));
    REQUIRE(client.wait_for([&](auto& v) { return has_kind(v, "hello") && has_kind(v, "shutdown", sess1); }));
    const std::string sess2 = find_kind(client.received, "hello")->sess;
    CHECK(sess2 != sess1);
    CHECK(has_kind(client.received, "init", sess2));

    // Acknowledge both sessions; the old session's journal files disappear.
    std::uint64_t last1 = 0;
    for (const auto& m : client.received) if (m.sess == sess1) last1 = std::max(last1, m.seq);
    client.send_ack(sess1, last1);
    const std::string jdir = pt::join_path(work, "plasmatrack/journal");
    bool gone = false;
    for (int i = 0; i < 100 && !gone; ++i) {
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(20));
        auto files = pt::list_dir(jdir);
        gone = std::none_of(files.begin(), files.end(), [&](const std::string& f) { return f.rfind(sess1, 0) == 0; });
    }
    CHECK(gone);

    shutdown();
    CHECK(g_mock.thread_violations == 0);
#ifdef _WIN32
    CHECK(FreeLibrary(lib) != 0);
#else
    CHECK(dlclose(lib) == 0);
#endif

    if (g_failures) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "%d check(s) failed\n", g_failures);
        return 1;
    }
    std::printf("fake game harness passed (sessions %s, %s; %d log lines)\n", sess1.c_str(), sess2.c_str(),
                int(g_mock.logs.size()));
    return 0;
}
```

`plugin/tests/unit_tests.cpp`:

```cpp
// Unit tests for the plugin's building blocks. No framework: CHECK counts failures.
#include <atomic>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

#include "journal.hpp"
#include "json.hpp"
#include "platform.hpp"
#include "settings.hpp"
#include "sha256.hpp"
#include "spsc_ring.hpp"
#include "value_json.hpp"

static int g_failures = 0;
#define CHECK(cond)                                                          \
    do {                                                                     \
        if (!(cond)) {                                                       \
            std::fprintf(stderr, "FAIL %s:%d: %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, #cond); \
            ++g_failures;                                                    \
        }                                                                    \
    } while (0)

using namespace pt;

static std::string sha(const std::string& s) {
    Sha256 h;
    h.update(s.data(), s.size());
    return h.hex_digest();
}

static void test_sha256() {
    // FIPS 180-4 / NIST CAVS examples.
    CHECK(sha("") == "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855");
    CHECK(sha("abc") == "ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad");
    CHECK(sha("abcdbcdecdefdefgefghfghighijhijkijkljklmklmnlmnomnopnopq") ==
          "248d6a61d20638b8e5c026930c3e6039a33ce45964ff2167f6ecedd419db06c1");
    Sha256 h;
    std::string chunk(1000, 'a');
    for (int i = 0; i < 1000; ++i) h.update(chunk.data(), chunk.size());
    CHECK(h.hex_digest() == "cdc76e5c9914fb9281a1c7e284d73e67f1809a48a497200e046d39ccc7112cd0");
}

static void test_json() {
    JsonWriter w;
    w.begin_object();
    w.key("s").str("a\"b\\c\n\x01");
    w.key("f").f32(46.939f);
    w.key("d").f64(0.1);
    w.key("nan").f64(std::nan(""));
    w.key("neg").i64(-5);
    w.key("big").u64(18446744073709551615ull);
    w.key("arr").begin_array();
    w.boolean(true).null().str("x");
    w.end_array();
    w.key("obj").begin_object().key("k").u64(1).end_object();
    w.key("utf8").str("K\xC3\xB6ln");
    w.end_object();
    const std::string expect =
        "{\"s\":\"a\\\"b\\\\c\\n\\u0001\",\"f\":46.939,\"d\":0.1,\"nan\":null,\"neg\":-5,"
        "\"big\":18446744073709551615,\"arr\":[true,null,\"x\"],\"obj\":{\"k\":1},\"utf8\":\"K\xC3\xB6ln\"}";
    CHECK(w.str_ref() == expect);
    if (w.str_ref() != expect) std::fprintf(stderr, "  got: %s\n", w.str_ref().c_str());
}

static void test_value_json() {
    scs_named_value_t attrs[4] = {};
    attrs[0].name = "cargo.id";
    attrs[0].index = SCS_U32_NIL;
    attrs[0].value.type = SCS_VALUE_TYPE_string;
    attrs[0].value.value_string.value = "apples";
    attrs[1].name = "income";
    attrs[1].index = SCS_U32_NIL;
    attrs[1].value.type = SCS_VALUE_TYPE_u64;
    attrs[1].value.value_u64.value = 12345;
    attrs[2].name = "wheel.position";
    attrs[2].index = 3;
    attrs[2].value.type = SCS_VALUE_TYPE_fvector;
    attrs[2].value.value_fvector = {1.5f, -2.0f, 0.25f};
    attrs[3].name = nullptr;  // terminator
    JsonWriter w;
    write_attributes(w, attrs);
    const std::string expect =
        "[{\"name\":\"cargo.id\",\"index\":null,\"type\":\"string\",\"value\":\"apples\"},"
        "{\"name\":\"income\",\"index\":null,\"type\":\"u64\",\"value\":12345},"
        "{\"name\":\"wheel.position\",\"index\":3,\"type\":\"fvector\",\"value\":{\"x\":1.5,\"y\":-2,\"z\":0.25}}]";
    CHECK(w.str_ref() == expect);
    if (w.str_ref() != expect) std::fprintf(stderr, "  got: %s\n", w.str_ref().c_str());

    scs_value_t p{};
    p.type = SCS_VALUE_TYPE_dplacement;
    p.value_dplacement.position = {-30120.25, 50.5, 5847.125};
    p.value_dplacement.orientation = {0.25f, 0.0f, -0.5f};
    JsonWriter w2;
    write_value(w2, p);
    CHECK(w2.str_ref() ==
          "{\"position\":{\"x\":-30120.25,\"y\":50.5,\"z\":5847.125},\"orientation\":{\"heading\":0.25,\"pitch\":0,\"roll\":-0.5}}");
}

static void test_ring() {
    SpscRing<int> r(4);
    int out = 0;
    CHECK(!r.try_pop(out));
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) CHECK(r.try_push(int(i)));
    CHECK(!r.try_push(99));  // full: producer drops, never blocks
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) { CHECK(r.try_pop(out)); CHECK(out == i); }
    CHECK(!r.try_pop(out));

    // Concurrent: every pushed item is received exactly once, in order.
    SpscRing<std::uint64_t> big(1024);
    constexpr std::uint64_t N = 2'000'000;
    std::atomic<std::uint64_t> dropped{0};
    std::thread producer([&] {
        for (std::uint64_t i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            std::uint64_t v = i;
            if (!big.try_push(std::move(v))) dropped.fetch_add(1);
        }
    });
    std::uint64_t last = 0, received = 0, v = 0;
    bool ordered = true;
    for (;;) {
        if (big.try_pop(v)) {
            if (v <= last) ordered = false;
            last = v;
            ++received;
            continue;
        }
        if (received + dropped.load() >= N) break;
    }
    producer.join();
    while (big.try_pop(v)) { if (v <= last) ordered = false; last = v; ++received; }
    CHECK(ordered);
    CHECK(received + dropped.load() == N);
}

static void test_settings() {
    Settings d = parse_settings("");
    CHECK(d.port == 30455 && d.sample_rate_hz == 20.0 && !d.capture && d.replay_buffer_s == 120.0);
    Settings s = parse_settings(
        "# comment\r\nport = 40001\r\nsample_rate_hz=12.5 ; trailing\ncapture = 1\nreplay_buffer_s = 30\n"
        "bogus = 7\njournal_max_mib = 8\n");
    CHECK(s.port == 40001);
    CHECK(s.sample_rate_hz == 12.5);
    CHECK(s.capture);
    CHECK(s.replay_buffer_s == 30.0);
    CHECK(s.journal_max_mib == 8);
    Settings bad = parse_settings("port = 70000\nsample_rate_hz = abc\nsample_rate_hz = -1\n");
    CHECK(bad.port == 30455 && bad.sample_rate_hz == 20.0);
}

static std::string msg(const char* sess, std::uint64_t seq) {
    return std::string("{\"v\":1,\"kind\":\"config\",\"sess\":\"") + sess + "\",\"seq\":" + std::to_string(seq) + "}";
}

static void test_journal() {
    const std::string dir = join_path(dir_of(own_module_path()), "pt_journal_test");
    for (const auto& f : list_dir(dir)) remove_file(join_path(dir, f));

    {
        Journal j(dir, "sessA", 1 << 20);
        CHECK(j.pending().empty());
        CHECK(j.append(1, msg("sessA", 1)));
        CHECK(j.append(2, msg("sessA", 2)));
        CHECK(j.append(5, msg("sessA", 5)));
        j.ack("sessA", 2);
        CHECK(j.pending().at("sessA").size() == 1);
    }
    {
        // Next game session: sessA's unacknowledged message survives on disk.
        Journal j(dir, "sessB", 1 << 20);
        CHECK(j.pending().count("sessA") == 1);
        CHECK(j.pending().at("sessA").size() == 1);
        CHECK(j.pending().at("sessA").front().seq == 5);
        CHECK(Journal::seq_of(j.pending().at("sessA").front().json) == 5);
        j.ack("sessA", 5);
        CHECK(j.pending().count("sessA") == 0);
    }
    {
        Journal j(dir, "sessC", 1 << 20);
        CHECK(j.pending().count("sessA") == 0);  // files were deleted after the full ack
        CHECK(j.pending().count("sessB") == 0);  // sessB never wrote anything
    }
    {
        // Size cap: over the cap, messages stay in memory but are not written.
        Journal j(dir, "sessD", 100);
        CHECK(j.append(1, std::string(60, 'x')));
        CHECK(!j.append(2, std::string(60, 'y')));
        CHECK(j.dropped() == 1);
    }
    for (const auto& f : list_dir(dir)) remove_file(join_path(dir, f));
}

int main() {
    test_sha256();
    test_json();
    test_value_json();
    test_ring();
    test_settings();
    test_journal();
    if (g_failures) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "%d check(s) failed\n", g_failures);
        return 1;
    }
    std::printf("all unit tests passed\n");
    return 0;
}
```

`scripts/build-plugin.ps1`:

```ps1
# Builds and tests the PlasmaTrack plugin DLL on Windows with llvm-mingw.
#
# Tools are looked up in this order: -ToolsDir (portable folders as unpacked by
# docs/BUILD.md), then PATH (e.g. winget installs of Kitware.CMake,
# Ninja-build.Ninja, MartinStorsjo.LLVM-MinGW.UCRT).
#
#   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-plugin.ps1 [-Config Release] [-NoTest]
param(
    [string]$ToolsDir = (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'PlasmaTrackTools'),
    [string]$Config = 'Release',
    [switch]$NoTest
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot

if (Test-Path $ToolsDir) {
    $extra = @()
    $extra += Get-ChildItem $ToolsDir -Directory -Filter 'cmake-*' | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_.FullName 'bin' }
    $extra += $ToolsDir
    $extra += Get-ChildItem $ToolsDir -Directory -Filter 'llvm-mingw-*ucrt*' | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_.FullName 'bin' }
    $env:PATH = ($extra -join ';') + ';' + $env:PATH
}

$clang = (Get-Command x86_64-w64-mingw32-clang++ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
if (-not $clang) { throw 'llvm-mingw not found (x86_64-w64-mingw32-clang++). See docs/BUILD.md.' }
$llvmMingwRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $clang.Source)
foreach ($t in 'cmake', 'ninja') {
    if (-not (Get-Command $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { throw "$t not found. See docs/BUILD.md." }
}

$build = Join-Path $root 'plugin/build-win'
cmake -S (Join-Path $root 'plugin') -B $build -G Ninja `
    "-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=$Config" `
    "-DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=$(Join-Path $root 'plugin/cmake/toolchain-llvm-mingw.cmake')" `
    "-DLLVM_MINGW_ROOT=$llvmMingwRoot"
if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'cmake configure failed' }
cmake --build $build
if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'build failed' }

if (-not $NoTest) {
    ctest --test-dir $build --output-on-failure
    if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'tests failed' }
}
Write-Host "Plugin: $(Join-Path $build 'plasmatrack.dll')"

```

`scripts/build-plugin.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env sh
# Builds the PlasmaTrack plugin on Linux.
#   scripts/build-plugin.sh win     Windows x64 DLL (primary; used under Proton)
#                                   - with LLVM_MINGW_ROOT set: llvm-mingw (recommended)
#                                   - otherwise: Debian/Ubuntu g++-mingw-w64-x86-64-posix
#                                   Tests run under wine if it is installed.
#   scripts/build-plugin.sh linux   native .so (secondary target)
set -eu
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
target=${1:-win}

case "$target" in
  win)
    build="$root/plugin/build-cross"
    if [ -n "${LLVM_MINGW_ROOT:-}" ]; then
      tc="$root/plugin/cmake/toolchain-llvm-mingw.cmake"
      set -- -DLLVM_MINGW_ROOT="$LLVM_MINGW_ROOT"
    else
      tc="$root/plugin/cmake/toolchain-debian-mingw.cmake"
      set --
    fi
    cmake -S "$root/plugin" -B "$build" -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE="$tc" "$@"
    ;;
  linux)
    build="$root/plugin/build-linux"
    cmake -S "$root/plugin" -B "$build" -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
    ;;
  *) echo "usage: $0 [win|linux]" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac

cmake --build "$build"
if [ "$target" = linux ] || command -v wine64 >/dev/null 2>&1 || command -v wine >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  ctest --test-dir "$build" --output-on-failure
else
  echo "wine not found: skipping tests of the Windows DLL"
fi
ls -l "$build"/plasmatrack.*

```

`scripts/e2e-plugin-client.ps1`:

```ps1
# End-to-end on Windows: the REAL plugin DLL (driven through a scripted job by
# pt_drive_plugin) talks to the REAL plasmatrack-client binary over loopback.
# Checks that every frame is persisted by the client and acknowledged back to the
# plugin's journal.
#
#   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/e2e-plugin-client.ps1
param([int]$Port = 30555)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$tools = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'PlasmaTrackTools'
if (Test-Path $tools) {
    $extra = @(Get-ChildItem $tools -Directory -Filter 'cmake-*' | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_.FullName 'bin' }) + $tools +
             @(Get-ChildItem $tools -Directory -Filter 'llvm-mingw-*ucrt*' | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_.FullName 'bin' })
    $env:PATH = ($extra -join ';') + ";$env:USERPROFILE\.cargo\bin;" + $env:PATH
}

& powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File (Join-Path $root 'scripts/build-plugin.ps1') -NoTest | Out-Null
if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'plugin build failed' }
Push-Location $root
cargo build -q -p pt-client
if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'client build failed' }
Pop-Location

$client = Join-Path $root 'target/debug/plasmatrack-client.exe'
$driver = Join-Path $root 'plugin/build-win/pt_drive_plugin.exe'
$dll = Join-Path $root 'plugin/build-win/plasmatrack.dll'
$tmp = Join-Path $env:TEMP ("pt-e2e-" + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $tmp | Out-Null
$cfgPath = Join-Path $tmp 'plasmatrack.toml'
(Get-Content (Join-Path $root 'config/plasmatrack.sample.toml') -Raw) `
    -replace '(?m)^port = 30455', "port = $Port" `
    -replace '(?m)^status_port = 30456', "status_port = $($Port + 1)" |
    Set-Content -NoNewline -Encoding ascii $cfgPath

$data = Join-Path $tmp 'data'
$log = Join-Path $tmp 'client.log'
$proc = Start-Process -FilePath $client -ArgumentList @('run', '--config', $cfgPath, '--data-dir', $data) `
    -PassThru -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardError $log
try {
    # Wait until the client listens.
    $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(15)
    while ($true) {
        try { (New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient('127.0.0.1', $Port)).Close(); break } catch {}
        if ((Get-Date) -gt $deadline) { throw "client did not start: $(Get-Content $log -Raw)" }
        Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100
    }
    $sess = (& $driver $dll (Join-Path $tmp 'plugins') $Port) | Select-Object -Last 1
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -or -not $sess) { throw 'driver failed' }
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
    $status = Invoke-RestMethod "http://127.0.0.1:$($Port + 1)/status.json"
} finally {
    Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}

$stats = (& $client status --data-dir $data) | ConvertFrom-Json
$ackFile = Join-Path $tmp "plugins/plasmatrack/journal/$sess.ack"
$acked = if (Test-Path $ackFile) { [uint64](Get-Content $ackFile -Raw) } else { 0 }
$fail = @()
if ($stats.sessions -ne 1) { $fail += "expected 1 session, got $($stats.sessions)" }
if ($stats.frames -lt 65) { $fail += "expected >= 65 frames (3 s at 20 Hz + events), got $($stats.frames)" }
if ($stats.snapshots -lt 1) { $fail += 'no snapshot stored' }
if ($acked -lt 60) { $fail += "plugin journal acknowledged only through seq $acked" }
if ($status.last_game -ne 'ats') { $fail += "status page game: $($status.last_game)" }
if ($status.frames_received -lt $stats.frames) { $fail += 'status page frame count too low' }

Write-Host "session $sess : $($stats.frames) frames stored, plugin journal acked through $acked, game $($status.last_game)"
if ($fail) { $fail | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "FAIL: $_" }; Get-Content $log | Write-Host; exit 1 }
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $tmp
Write-Host 'e2e plugin <-> client: PASS'

```

`scripts/make-release-key.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Creates the Ed25519 key that signs client updates (docs/UPDATES.md). The
// private key goes to .release-signing-key.pem in the repository root
// (gitignored); the public key, printed as hex, belongs in
// pt-core/src/update.rs (UPDATE_KEYS), so every client build trusts it.
//
//   node scripts/make-release-key.mjs           create the key (refuses to overwrite)
//   node scripts/make-release-key.mjs --show    print the public key of the existing one
//
// Keep a copy of the private key somewhere safe and offline: without it, no
// update can be signed for the clients already installed, and players would
// have to run a new installer by hand.

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { generateKeyPairSync, createPrivateKey, createPublicKey } from "node:crypto";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";

const file = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..", ".release-signing-key.pem");
const publicHex = (key) => createPublicKey(key).export({ type: "spki", format: "der" }).subarray(-32).toString("hex");

if (process.argv.includes("--show")) {
  console.log(publicHex(createPrivateKey(readFileSync(file, "utf8"))));
} else {
  if (existsSync(file)) {
    console.error(`${file} already exists; --show prints its public key`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  const { privateKey } = generateKeyPairSync("ed25519");
  writeFileSync(file, privateKey.export({ type: "pkcs8", format: "pem" }), { mode: 0o600 });
  console.log(`wrote ${file}`);
  console.log(`public key: ${publicHex(privateKey)}`);
}

```

`scripts/make-secrets.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Generates the server's secrets for one deployment and stores them in
// Cloudflare with `wrangler secret bulk`. A copy stays in
// crates/pt-worker/.secrets.<env>.json (gitignored): the bot owner copies the
// bot token, read token and webhook secret into the bot from there.
//
//   node scripts/make-secrets.mjs --env production|test --webhook-url URL --admins ID[,ID…] [--keep]
//
// --keep reuses the tokens already in the file (to change the URL or admins only).

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, unlinkSync } from "node:fs";
import { randomBytes } from "node:crypto";
import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";

const dir = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..", "crates", "pt-worker");
const arg = (n) => {
  const i = process.argv.indexOf(`--${n}`);
  return i < 0 ? undefined : process.argv[i + 1];
};
const env = arg("env");
const webhookUrl = arg("webhook-url");
const admins = arg("admins");
if (!["production", "test"].includes(env) || !webhookUrl || !admins) {
  console.error("usage: make-secrets.mjs --env production|test --webhook-url URL --admins ID[,ID…] [--keep]");
  process.exit(2);
}
if (!/^\d{1,20}(,\d{1,20})*$/.test(admins)) throw new Error("--admins: comma-separated Discord IDs");
const file = join(dir, `.secrets.${env}.json`);
const old = process.argv.includes("--keep") && existsSync(file) ? JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, "utf8")) : {};
const rnd = (prefix) => prefix + randomBytes(32).toString("base64url");
const secrets = {
  READ_TOKEN: old.READ_TOKEN ?? rnd("ptr_"),
  BOT_TOKEN: old.BOT_TOKEN ?? rnd("ptb_"),
  WEBHOOK_SECRETS: old.WEBHOOK_SECRETS ?? randomBytes(32).toString("base64url"),
  DOWNLOAD_SECRET: old.DOWNLOAD_SECRET ?? randomBytes(32).toString("base64url"),
  WEBHOOK_URL: webhookUrl,
  BOOTSTRAP_ADMINS: admins,
};
writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify(secrets, null, 2) + "\n", { mode: 0o600 });
const tmp = join(dir, `.secrets.${env}.upload.json`);
writeFileSync(tmp, JSON.stringify(secrets), { mode: 0o600 });
try {
  const args = ["wrangler", "secret", "bulk", `.secrets.${env}.upload.json`]; // relative: the path has spaces
  if (env === "test") args.push("--env", "test");
  execFileSync("npx", args, { cwd: dir, stdio: "inherit", shell: process.platform === "win32" });
} finally {
  unlinkSync(tmp);
}
console.log(`secrets set for ${env}; copy kept in ${file} (never commit or paste it)`);

```

`scripts/publish-release.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Publishes a release to a server (docs/UPDATES.md):
//
// 1. the current config (config/plasmatrack.sample.toml) as the current config
//    version;
// 2. the release in installer/payload (its manifest.json, written by
//    `npm run payload`), so jobs from that build pass rule 0 (PLAN §6a), with a
//    signed update manifest so older clients update themselves, the setup
//    program installer/dist/PlasmaTrack-Setup-<version>.exe for new players
//    (downloaded through personal links the bot asks for), and the uninstaller
//    PlasmaTrack-Uninstall.exe, which anyone may download.
//
//   node scripts/publish-release.mjs --env production|test --url https://… --actor DISCORD_ID
//        [--version 0.2.0] [--upload] [--notes "What changed"] [--no-offer]
//
// --upload  gzips the payload files and puts them, the setup program and the
//           uninstaller in the R2 bucket plasmatrack-releases (shared by both
//           servers, so once is enough) with wrangler.
// --no-offer publishes without offering the update yet
//           (POST /api/v1/admin/releases/{id}/offer starts it later).
//
// The update manifest is signed with .release-signing-key.pem
// (scripts/make-release-key.mjs). It and the .gz files are kept in
// installer/dist/update-<version>/, so every server gets the same bytes.
// The bot token is read from crates/pt-worker/.secrets.<env>.json (make-secrets.mjs).

import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, statSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { createHash, createPrivateKey, randomUUID, sign } from "node:crypto";
import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
import { gzipSync } from "node:zlib";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";

const root = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
const arg = (n, d) => {
  const i = process.argv.indexOf(`--${n}`);
  return i < 0 ? d : process.argv[i + 1];
};
const flag = (n) => process.argv.includes(`--${n}`);
const env = arg("env");
const url = (arg("url") || "").replace(/\/$/, "");
const actor = arg("actor");
const version = arg("version", /^version = "(.+)"/m.exec(readFileSync(join(root, "crates", "pt-client", "Cargo.toml"), "utf8"))[1]);
const notes = arg("notes");
if (!env || !url || !actor) {
  console.error("usage: publish-release.mjs --env production|test --url URL --actor DISCORD_ID [--version V] [--upload] [--notes TEXT] [--no-offer]");
  process.exit(2);
}
const { BOT_TOKEN } = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, "crates", "pt-worker", `.secrets.${env}.json`), "utf8"));
const payloadDir = join(root, "installer", "payload");
const payload = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(payloadDir, "manifest.json"), "utf8"));
const setupName = `PlasmaTrack-Setup-${version}.exe`;
const setupPath = join(root, "installer", "dist", setupName);
const BUCKET = "plasmatrack-releases";
const PLATFORM = "windows";
const CONTEXT = Buffer.from("plasmatrack-update-v1\n");

// ---- the signed update manifest -------------------------------------------------
const outDir = join(root, "installer", "dist", `update-${version}`);
const manifestFile = join(outDir, "update.json");
const sigFile = join(outDir, "update.sig");
const sha256 = (b) => createHash("sha256").update(b).digest("hex");
const gzPath = (p) => join(outDir, "files", ...`${p}.gz`.split("/"));
if (!existsSync(manifestFile)) {
  const files = [];
  for (const [path, hash] of Object.entries(payload)) {
    const data = readFileSync(join(payloadDir, ...path.split("/")));
    if (sha256(data) !== hash) throw new Error(`payload/${path} does not match payload/manifest.json; run npm run payload`);
    const gz = gzipSync(data, { level: 9 });
    mkdirSync(dirname(gzPath(path)), { recursive: true });
    writeFileSync(gzPath(path), gz);
    files.push({ path, sha256: hash, size: data.length, gz_size: gz.length });
  }
  const text = JSON.stringify({ product: "plasmatrack", platform: PLATFORM, version, files });
  const key = createPrivateKey(readFileSync(join(root, ".release-signing-key.pem"), "utf8"));
  const signature = sign(null, Buffer.concat([CONTEXT, Buffer.from(text)]), key).toString("hex");
  writeFileSync(manifestFile, text);
  writeFileSync(sigFile, signature);
  console.log(`signed the update manifest for ${version} (${files.length} files)`);
}
const manifestText = readFileSync(manifestFile, "utf8");
const signature = readFileSync(sigFile, "utf8").trim();
const manifest = JSON.parse(manifestText);
if (manifest.version !== version) throw new Error(`${manifestFile} is for ${manifest.version}`);

// ---- upload to R2 ---------------------------------------------------------------
if (flag("upload")) {
  const workerDir = join(root, "crates", "pt-worker");
  const childEnv = { ...process.env };
  delete childEnv.ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE;
  const put = (key, file, type) => {
    // The wrangler that crates/pt-worker installs (npm ci there), run by this node.
    const wrangler = join(workerDir, "node_modules", "wrangler", "bin", "wrangler.js");
    execFileSync(process.execPath, [wrangler, "r2", "object", "put", `${BUCKET}/${key}`, "--file", file, "--content-type", type, "--remote"], {
      cwd: workerDir, env: childEnv, stdio: ["ignore", "ignore", "inherit"],
    });
    console.log(`uploaded ${key} (${statSync(file).size} bytes)`);
  };
  for (const f of manifest.files) put(`${PLATFORM}/${version}/${f.path}.gz`, gzPath(f.path), "application/gzip");
  put(`${PLATFORM}/${version}/PlasmaTrack-Uninstall.exe`, join(payloadDir, "plasmatrack-uninstall.exe"), "application/vnd.microsoft.portable-executable");
  if (existsSync(setupPath)) put(`${PLATFORM}/${version}/${setupName}`, setupPath, "application/vnd.microsoft.portable-executable");
  else console.warn(`no ${setupPath}; publishing without a setup program`);
}

// ---- the server ----------------------------------------------------------------
async function post(path, body) {
  const res = await fetch(url + path, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      authorization: `Bearer ${BOT_TOKEN}`,
      "x-plasmatrack-actor": actor,
      "idempotency-key": randomUUID(),
      "content-type": "application/json",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  return { status: res.status, json: await res.json() };
}

// A server still running older code (or mid-deploy) would store the release
// without its update, or hand out the setup the old way. The newest endpoint
// answers 200, or 404 for a missing release; older code says "no such endpoint".
const probe = await fetch(`${url}/api/v1/players/${actor}/client-download?platform=${PLATFORM}`, {
  headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${BOT_TOKEN}` },
});
const probed = await probe.json().catch(() => ({}));
if (probe.status !== 200 && probed.error?.details?.resource !== "release") {
  console.error(`${url} runs older code (${probe.status} ${probed.error?.message ?? ""}); deploy it, wait a minute, and try again`);
  process.exit(1);
}

const toml = readFileSync(join(root, "config", "plasmatrack.sample.toml"), "utf8");
let r = await post("/api/v1/admin/config-versions", { toml, make_current: true, reason: `Config shipped with PlasmaTrack ${version}` });
console.log("config:", r.status, r.json.version_id ?? r.json.error?.message ?? "", r.json.error?.details ? JSON.stringify(r.json.error.details) : "");

const files = [
  { role: "plugin", path_pattern: "*/plugins/plasmatrack.dll", sha256: payload["plasmatrack.dll"] },
  { role: "client_binary", path_pattern: "*/plasmatrack-clientw.exe", sha256: payload["plasmatrack-clientw.exe"] },
  { role: "client_binary", path_pattern: "*/plasmatrack-client.exe", sha256: payload["plasmatrack-client.exe"] },
  { role: "client_binary", path_pattern: "*/plasmatrack-uninstall.exe", sha256: payload["plasmatrack-uninstall.exe"] },
];
r = await post("/api/v1/admin/releases", {
  release_version: version,
  platform: PLATFORM,
  files,
  update: { manifest: manifestText, signature },
  installer: existsSync(setupPath) ? setupName : undefined,
  notes,
  offer: !flag("no-offer"),
  reason: `Release ${version}`,
});
console.log("release:", r.status, r.json.release_id ?? r.json.error?.message, r.json.error?.details ? JSON.stringify(r.json.error.details) : "");
if (r.status >= 300) process.exit(1);
```

`scripts/seed-server.mjs`:

```mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Seeds a PlasmaTrack server with recorded captures, through the real HTTP API
// exactly as the client and the bot would use it. For local checks and for the
// test instance; never point it at production with --publish.
//
//   node scripts/seed-server.mjs --url http://127.0.0.1:8787 --bot-token T --actor 900000000000000001 \
//        [--publish] [--player 123456789012345678 --name "Test Driver"] fixture.jsonl.gz ...
//
// --publish  publishes config/plasmatrack.sample.toml and a test release whose
//            hashes match the manifest this script uploads (test data only).
// Prints the player's token once (so later runs can reuse it with --token).

import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { gunzipSync, gzipSync } from "node:zlib";
import { createHash, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";

const root = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const opt = (name, dflt) => {
  const i = args.indexOf(`--${name}`);
  if (i < 0) return dflt;
  const v = args[i + 1];
  args.splice(i, 2);
  return v;
};
const flag = (name) => {
  const i = args.indexOf(`--${name}`);
  if (i < 0) return false;
  args.splice(i, 1);
  return true;
};
const url = opt("url", "http://127.0.0.1:8787").replace(/\/$/, "");
const botToken = opt("bot-token");
const actor = opt("actor");
const player = opt("player", "123456789012345678");
const name = opt("name", "Test Driver");
let token = opt("token");
const perChunk = Number(opt("chunk", "2000"));
const publish = flag("publish");
// --real-release: report the hashes of the build in installer/payload (already
// published), so nothing fake is published; for temporary data on production.
const realRelease = flag("real-release");
const files = args;
if (!botToken || !actor || files.length === 0 || (publish && realRelease)) {
  console.error("usage: seed-server.mjs --url U --bot-token T --actor DISCORD_ID [--publish | --real-release] [--player ID] files...");
  process.exit(2);
}

// The manifest the fake client reports, and the release that matches it.
const payload = realRelease ? JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, "installer", "payload", "manifest.json"), "utf8")) : null;
const PLUGIN_SHA = payload ? payload["plasmatrack.dll"] : createHash("sha256").update("plasmatrack-test-plugin").digest("hex");
const CLIENT_SHA = payload ? payload["plasmatrack-clientw.exe"] : createHash("sha256").update("plasmatrack-test-client").digest("hex");
const manifest = [
  { role: "plugin", path: "C:\\Steam\\steamapps\\common\\Game\\bin\\win_x64\\plugins\\plasmatrack.dll", sha256: PLUGIN_SHA },
  { role: "client_binary", path: "C:\\PlasmaTrack\\bin\\plasmatrack-clientw.exe", sha256: CLIENT_SHA },
];

async function call(method, path, body, headers = {}) {
  const res = await fetch(url + path, {
    method,
    headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${botToken}`, "content-type": "application/json", ...headers },
    body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  const text = await res.text();
  let json;
  try {
    json = JSON.parse(text);
  } catch {
    json = text;
  }
  return { status: res.status, json };
}
const admin = (method, path, body) =>
  call(method, path, body, { "x-plasmatrack-actor": actor, "idempotency-key": randomUUID() });

function must(r, ...ok) {
  if (!ok.includes(r.status)) {
    console.error(JSON.stringify(r.json, null, 2));
    throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
  }
  return r.json;
}

if (publish) {
  const toml = readFileSync(join(root, "config", "plasmatrack.sample.toml"), "utf8");
  const c = await admin("POST", "/api/v1/admin/config-versions", { toml, make_current: true, reason: "Seed: sample config" });
  console.log("config:", c.status === 409 ? "already published" : must(c, 201).version_id);
  const r = await admin("POST", "/api/v1/admin/releases", {
    release_version: "0.0.0-test",
    platform: "windows",
    reason: "Seed: test release matching the seed script",
    files: [
      { role: "plugin", path_pattern: "*/plugins/plasmatrack.dll", sha256: PLUGIN_SHA },
      { role: "client_binary", path_pattern: "*/plasmatrack-clientw.exe", sha256: CLIENT_SHA },
    ],
  });
  console.log("release:", r.status === 409 ? "already published" : must(r, 201).release_id);
}

if (!token) {
  const r = must(
    await call("POST", `/api/v1/players/${player}/token`, { display_name: name }, { "idempotency-key": randomUUID() }),
    201,
  );
  token = r.token.token;
  console.log(`player ${player} linked; token (shown once): ${token}`);
}

// The config hash the server expects comes from pt-core; the seed asks the
// server for nothing and simply sends what the client would: the sample config.
const configJson = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, "crates", "pt-server", "tests", "sample-config.json"), "utf8"));

for (const file of files) {
  const raw = readFileSync(file);
  const text = (file.endsWith(".gz") ? gunzipSync(raw) : raw).toString("utf8");
  const sessions = new Map();
  for (const line of text.split("\n")) {
    if (!line.trim()) continue;
    const v = JSON.parse(line);
    if (!sessions.has(v.sess)) sessions.set(v.sess, []);
    sessions.get(v.sess).push(line);
  }
  let chunks = 0;
  for (const [sess, lines] of sessions) {
    for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i += perChunk) {
      const part = lines.slice(i, i + perChunk);
      const seqs = part.map((l) => JSON.parse(l).seq ?? 0).filter((s) => s > 0);
      const chunk = {
        protocol: 1,
        client_version: "0.0.0-seed",
        sess,
        hello: null,
        seq_from: seqs.length ? Math.min(...seqs) : 0,
        seq_to: seqs.length ? Math.max(...seqs) : 0,
        frames: part.map((l) => JSON.parse(l)),
        config_hash: configJson.hash,
        config: configJson.config,
        manifest,
      };
      const res = await fetch(`${url}/api/v1/chunks`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, "content-type": "application/json", "content-encoding": "gzip" },
        body: gzipSync(Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(chunk))),
      });
      if (res.status !== 200) throw new Error(`upload ${file}: HTTP ${res.status} ${await res.text()}`);
      chunks++;
    }
  }
  console.log(`${file}: ${sessions.size} session(s), ${chunks} chunk(s) uploaded`);
}

// Scoring runs in the background; give it a moment, then show the jobs.
await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3000));
for (const game of ["ats", "ets2"]) {
  const r = must(await call("GET", `/api/v1/public/${game}/players/${player}/jobs?limit=100`), 200);
  for (const j of r.items) {
    console.log(`${game} ${j.job_id} ${j.outcome.padEnd(14)} ${String(j.points ?? j.held_points).padStart(6)} pts  ${j.cargo.name}: ${j.source.city_name} -> ${j.destination.city_name}`);
  }
}
```

`scripts/set-linux-process-match.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Writes the Linux game-process match into crates/pt-client/src/updater.rs, so the
# client knows when ETS2 / ATS are running under Proton (updater and uninstaller wait
# on that; without it `games_running()` always says yes on Linux).
#
#   scripts/set-linux-process-match.sh [--ets2 NAME|pick] [--ats NAME|pick] [--install] [--no-test]
#
#   NAME     the game's process name as Linux sees it, i.e. the .exe file name
#            (default eurotrucks2.exe / amtrucks.exe). Not the window title.
#   pick     click the running game's window instead: its PID comes from the window
#            (_NET_WM_PID, via xprop; Proton games are XWayland windows), and the
#            .exe name from that process's argv[0].
#   --install  also build the release client, copy it to ~/.local/bin and restart
#              plasmatrack-client.service if it is running.
#
# Safe to re-run: the match code is written once; later runs only change the names in
# GAME_PROCESSES (which Windows uses too, so keep them the real .exe names).
set -euo pipefail

root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
src="$root/crates/pt-client/src/updater.rs"
ets2="eurotrucks2.exe"
ats="amtrucks.exe"
install=0
test=1

usage() { sed -n '2,19p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; exit "${1:-0}"; }

# Click a window, return the .exe name of the process that owns it.
pick() {
    local game=$1 pid argv0
    command -v xprop >/dev/null || { echo "pick needs xprop (xorg-xprop)" >&2; exit 1; }
    echo "Click the $game window..." >&2
    pid=$(xprop _NET_WM_PID | sed -n 's/.*= *\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
    [[ -n "$pid" && -r /proc/$pid/cmdline ]] || { echo "that window has no readable PID" >&2; exit 1; }
    argv0=$(tr '\0' '\n' < "/proc/$pid/cmdline" | head -n1)
    argv0=${argv0##*[/\\]}            # last component, Windows or Unix separators
    [[ -n "$argv0" ]] || argv0=$(cat "/proc/$pid/comm")
    echo "  -> pid $pid, process $argv0" >&2
    printf '%s' "$argv0"
}

while (($#)); do
    case "$1" in
        --ets2) ets2=${2:?--ets2 needs a name or pick}; shift 2 ;;
        --ats)  ats=${2:?--ats needs a name or pick}; shift 2 ;;
        --install) install=1; shift ;;
        --no-test) test=0; shift ;;
        -h|--help) usage ;;
        *) echo "unknown argument: $1" >&2; usage 2 ;;
    esac
done
[[ "$ets2" == pick ]] && ets2=$(pick "Euro Truck Simulator 2")
[[ "$ats" == pick ]] && ats=$(pick "American Truck Simulator")

ets2=${ets2,,}; ats=${ats,,}          # the match compares lowercase
for n in "$ets2" "$ats"; do
    [[ "$n" =~ ^[a-z0-9._+-]+$ ]] || { echo "not a plain file name: '$n'" >&2; exit 1; }
done
[[ -f "$src" ]] || { echo "not found: $src" >&2; exit 1; }

python3 -I - "$src" "$ets2" "$ats" <<'PY'
import re, sys
path, ets2, ats = sys.argv[1:4]
text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()

# 1. The names (shared with Windows).
text, n = re.subn(r'pub const GAME_PROCESSES: \[&str; 2\] = \[[^\]]*\];',
                  f'pub const GAME_PROCESSES: [&str; 2] = ["{ets2}", "{ats}"];', text)
if n != 1:
    sys.exit("could not find the GAME_PROCESSES line")

# 2. The match itself, replacing the TODO scaffold once.
IMPL = r'''/// Linux: the same question asked of `/proc`. Under Proton the games are Wine
/// processes, so the Windows file name has to be recognised in a Linux process.
/// Per process, `/proc/<pid>/comm` is the kernel name (Wine sets it to the .exe
/// name, cut to 15 bytes: "eurotrucks2.exe" just fits) and `/proc/<pid>/cmdline`
/// is NUL-separated argv, where Wine's argv[0] is a Windows path such as
/// `Z:\home\me\...\bin\win_x64\eurotrucks2.exe` (backslashes, any letter case).
#[cfg(not(windows))]
pub fn processes(names: &[&str]) -> Option<Vec<u32>> {
    let me = std::process::id();
    let mut found = Vec::new();
    for entry in std::fs::read_dir("/proc").ok()? {
        let Some(pid) = entry.ok().and_then(|e| e.file_name().to_str()?.parse::<u32>().ok()) else { continue };
        if pid == me {
            continue;
        }
        let dir = Path::new("/proc").join(pid.to_string());
        // A process can exit between read_dir and these reads; it then just doesn't match.
        let comm = std::fs::read_to_string(dir.join("comm")).unwrap_or_default();
        let cmdline = std::fs::read(dir.join("cmdline")).unwrap_or_default();
        if process_matches(&comm, &cmdline, names) {
            found.push(pid);
        }
    }
    Some(found)
}

/// Whether a process with this `comm` and raw `cmdline` is one of `names`: by the
/// last component of argv[0] (split on `/` and `\`), or by the kernel name, which
/// is a prefix of a longer name when the kernel cut it to 15 bytes. Never by a
/// later argument, so `grep eurotrucks2.exe` is not the game.
#[cfg(not(windows))]
fn process_matches(comm: &str, cmdline: &[u8], names: &[&str]) -> bool {
    let argv0 = String::from_utf8_lossy(cmdline.split(|&b| b == 0).next().unwrap_or_default());
    let exe = argv0.rsplit(['/', '\\']).next().unwrap_or_default().to_ascii_lowercase();
    let comm = comm.trim_end_matches('\n').to_ascii_lowercase();
    names.iter().map(|n| n.to_ascii_lowercase()).any(|n| {
        (!exe.is_empty() && exe == n) || comm == n || (comm.len() == 15 && n.len() > 15 && n.starts_with(&comm))
    })
}
'''
START = "/// Linux: the same question asked of `/proc`."
END = "    let _ = found;\n    None\n}\n"
if "fn process_matches(" in text:
    print("match code already in place; names updated")
elif "// TODO(Ari): decide whether `pid` is one of `names`" in text:
    s = text.index(START)
    e = text.index(END, s) + len(END)
    text = text[:s] + IMPL + text[e:]
    print("match code written")
else:
    sys.exit("could not find the processes() TODO scaffold to replace")

# 3. Tests, once.
TEST = r'''
    #[cfg(not(windows))]
    #[test]
    fn linux_process_names_match_wine_games() {
        let games = ["eurotrucks2.exe", "amtrucks.exe"];
        let wine_argv = b"Z:\\home\\me\\Euro Truck Simulator 2\\bin\\win_x64\\eurotrucks2.exe\0-homedir\0x\0";
        assert!(process_matches("eurotrucks2.exe\n", wine_argv, &games));
        // Seen live 2026-11-15 (tinkergame + proton-cachyos): Proton's S: game drive, and
        // /proc/<pid>/exe is Wine's preloader, so only argv[0] / comm name the game.
        let seen = b"S:\\steamapps\\common\\Euro Truck Simulator 2\\bin\\win_x64\\eurotrucks2.exe\0";
        assert!(process_matches("eurotrucks2.exe\n", seen, &games));
        assert!(process_matches("wine-preloader\n", seen, &games), "argv[0] alone is enough");
        assert!(process_matches("wine64-preload\n", b"C:\\Games\\AMTRUCKS.EXE\0", &games), "argv[0], any case");
        assert!(process_matches("amtrucks.exe\n", b"", &games), "kernel name alone (cmdline unreadable)");
        assert!(!process_matches("grep\n", b"/usr/bin/grep\0eurotrucks2.exe\0", &games), "a later argument is not the process");
        assert!(!process_matches("eurotrucks2.ex\n", b"", &games), "a shorter kernel name is not a cut one");
        assert!(process_matches("plasmatrack-cli\n", b"", &["plasmatrack-client"]), "15-byte kernel names are prefixes");
        // Whatever names GAME_PROCESSES holds must match their own (cut) kernel name.
        for n in GAME_PROCESSES {
            let comm: String = n.chars().take(15).collect();
            assert!(process_matches(&format!("{comm}\n"), b"", &[n]), "{n}");
        }
    }
'''
if "fn linux_process_names_match_wine_games" not in text:
    anchor = "mod tests {\n    use super::*;\n"
    if anchor not in text:
        sys.exit("could not find updater.rs's test module")
    text = text.replace(anchor, anchor + TEST, 1)

open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(text)
PY

grep -n 'pub const GAME_PROCESSES' "$src"

if ((test)); then
    (cd "$root" && cargo test -q -p pt-client updater:: 2>&1 | tail -n 4)
fi

if ((install)); then
    (cd "$root" && cargo build --release -q -p pt-client)
    install -m755 "$root/target/release/plasmatrack-client" "$HOME/.local/bin/plasmatrack-client"
    if systemctl --user is-active --quiet plasmatrack-client.service; then
        systemctl --user restart plasmatrack-client.service
        echo "installed and restarted plasmatrack-client.service"
    else
        echo "installed ~/.local/bin/plasmatrack-client"
    fi
fi

```
